chapters.title: Chapter 3751: Small Force in the Political Hostage Manor
paragraphs: Chapter 3751: Small Force in the Political Hostage Manor
Ling Han raised his head, only to see a woman in purple standing atop the wall.
This woman looked to be in her early twenties. She was extremely beautiful, and had a
graceful figure. She stood at a high place, her dress fluttering in the wind, clinging tightly to her body, outlining her captivating curves.
“Miss is?” Ling Han asked.
“My name is Liu Xunyu,” the woman said, “Are you the new arrival, Ling Han?”
“I am.” Ling Han nodded, still looking at her with a questioning expression.
‘What’s the meaning of you standing on the wall of my courtyard?’

Liu Xunyu giggled, and leaped down from the wall. “I’m really sorry. Smelling the fragrance of alchemical pills, I couldn’t help but want to take a look. I really didn’t expect that you are actually an alchemist as well!”

However, Ling Han was slightly apprehensive. He hadn’t discovered when she had leaped onto the wall. Although he was fully focused on refining pills here, even so, no Foundation Building Tier cultivator could possibly deceive his divine sense. Ling Han still had that much confidence.
Thus, there was only one possibility, and that was this Liu Xunyu was not in the Foundation Building Tier. At least, she was in the Cauldron Forging Tier.
“Thank you for the compliment.” Ling Han smiled faintly.

Yet Liu Xunyu was very cordial, “You are too modest. Though there are a great many hostages here, and there is no shortage of those with astonishing natural talent in cultivation, but as far as I know, you are the only alchemist here.”
“All right.” Ling Han nodded honestly and without reservations. His talent in alchemy was indeed amazing.
Liu Xunyu smiled beautifully, “You have just arrived, so you should not have much understanding of this place, so I have come to tell you.”
“All right.”

Liu Xunyu gave Ling Han an introduction. There were a total of 23 hostages here, representing the 23 forces that were subordinate to the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire. Some forces had already existed for tens of thousands of years, but there were also some forces that had just been established not too long ago.

The Azure Dragon Majestic Empire allowed their subordinate forces to compete in private. For example, if another force appeared on the Celestial Sea Planet and destroyed the Chen Clan, replacing them, then the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire wouldn’t send troops to avenge the Chen Clan. As long as that force obediently paid their tribute, then there wouldn’t be any problem.

Of course, this force definitely couldn’t affect the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire’s own rule. Otherwise, it would be unavoidable that they would be destroyed, just like the Chen Clan’s Royal Empire. In fact, they didn’t do anything treasonous. It was only because the Meng Clan felt that if this continued, the Chen Clan might become uncontrollable, powerful enough to threaten the existence of the Meng Clan.
Because they were all hostages, the members of Jia Yuan Manor all united, and Liu Xunyu was the “captain” of the hostage group.
“Ling Han, we’re all living under someone else’s roof, so we have to help each other, right?” Liu Xunyu asked in the end.
Ling Han naturally agreed, and replied, “Yes.”

Liu Xunyu cast a meaningful look at Ling Han, “If you encounter any difficulties in future, remember to look for me. If the conditions permit, I will definitely help you resolve them.” “I’ll keep that in mind.”
Liu Xunyu left gracefully, while Ling Han stroked his chin, deep in thought.
In a small place like the Political Hostage Manor, the residents were actually uniting together to form their own forces.𝒇𝓻𝓮𝓮𝙬𝙚𝒃𝒏𝓸𝙫𝒆𝙡.𝓬𝓸𝒎

According to Liu Xunyu, there were a total of three Cauldron Forging Origin Tier cultivators here. One was her, and the other two were Han Bing and Zhao Xiao. The others were only in the Foundation Building Tier.

It wasn’t that the people here were weaker in talent, but rather that they usually wouldn’t be hostages for more than a hundred years. At that time, they would be replaced by new hostages, and it was extremely difficult to break through to the Core Formation Tier. Those who could cultivate to this cultivation level were basically old monsters who were hundreds of years old, and those who could break through to the Core Formation Tier before a hundred years old probably wouldn’t exceed ten people per planet.

Theoretically, Ling Han only had to stay here obediently for a hundred years, and he would naturally be “released after serving his sentence”, but the problem was that he had to lose his freedom in this Jia Yuan Manor for a hundred years?
What a joke.
How could he leave?

Ling Han naturally had no intention of becoming a hostage at all. He had only come here because there was a station of the Chang Clan on the Moonlight Planet. Furthermore, he could not leave, and could only depend on the large black dog to move on his behalf. This was too inconvenient.
En, Ling Han immediately thought of his alchemy skills.
For a prodigy alchemist like him, he could become an esteemed guest no matter where he went. Thus, as long as his reputation was raised, it would not be a problem for him to leave
this place.
Undoubtedly, the Foundation Dissolution Pill was the best proof.
Ling Han decided to concoct more Foundation Dissolution Pills. This not only represented wealth, but also symbolized status and identity.

Thus, he had to calm down first. He didn’t believe that the people from the Political Hostage Manor had never had the chance to go out-prisoners would go out for a walk, and in name, they were the envoys of various forces, not prisoners.
Ling Han continued to concoct alchemical pills. He had just concocted a cauldron, and his technique had not reached a state of perfection yet. There was still a lot of room for improvement.
He was quite low-key, and did not leave his residence, concocting alchemical pills every day.

The name of Political Hostage Manor was an unofficial one. In reality, the residents of Jia Yuan Manor were the envoys of various forces. Thus, the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire naturally had to express its interest. Every month, they would provide Jia Yuan Manor with a large amount of cultivation resources, but the right to distribute them was in Liu Xunyu’s
hands.
As expected, as a “captain”, she was not really doing this for the pleasure of helping others and uniting them. Instead, she possessed considerable power.
-I don’t like the look of you, so what if I give you a little less? You can’t even leave, so who are you going to complain to?

Furthermore, the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire delivered cultivation resources every month, but Liu Xunyu distributed them every day, so if one offended her, the speed of retaliation would also be very fast.
A day passed, and Ling Han stopped concocting alchemical pills. Then, he opened the connection device.

Recently, he had not been able to contact Brother Monkey. It should not be that he had turned off the connection device, but rather that he was adventuring in some Mystery Realm. Usually, in Mystery Realms, the Galaxy Network could not be connected.
Ling Han sent a message to Brother Monkey as usual, and switched to the trading interface. He hung up the news of the sale of the Foundation Dissolution Pill, and then queued up to
fight in the ranking battles.
Almost in an instant, someone sent him a message.
“F*ck, aren’t you the guy who broke Origin’s record? Why are you selling alchemical pills
now?”
“Psst, have you gone mad from wanting money? You want to sell fake alchemical pills to earn money?”

Numerous messages were sent over. Some were curious that Ling Han was actually doing the business of a peddler, while others questioned whether the alchemical pills that Ling Han was selling were real or fake.

It could not be helped. Previously, the matter of tickets had already tagged Ling Han with the label of being greedy for money, and now seeing him selling alchemical pills, there would naturally be people who would be suspicious.
Ling Han couldn’t help but break out in a cold sweat. Was his credibility really that low?
He added another line to the sales information, “You can use Galaxy Network’s delivery service. Return any fakes that you discover.”
This time, there were finally much fewer people who doubted him, but there were still a few scattered people who doubted him, and they did not believe him at all.
Ling Han couldn’t even be bothered to reply. He was selling Foundation Dissolution Pills, so what need was there for him to beg others to buy them?

After he put on an aloof attitude, a considerable number of people actually believed him. Moreover, with Galaxy Network as guarantor, if they really encountered a fake, they could still get their money back.

chapters.title: Chapter 3752: Sell Me Ten
paragraphs: Chapter 3752: Sell Me Ten
Ling Han only accepted ten orders, and then withdrew the orders for the sale of Foundation Dissolution Pills.

The rarer something was, the more valuable it would be. After all, he was the Alchemy Emperor, and the alchemical pills he took out would naturally have to be sold for an astronomical price. How could he sell them cheaply? That would be too embarrassing. Ling Han had the large black dog make another trip to the Chang Clan’s office to deliver goods. This postage fee was naturally borne by the buyer, but it was now frozen by Galaxy Network. If it was proven that Ling Han was selling fake goods, then not only would he not be able to sell the goods, he would also lose a huge sum in postage fees.
After waiting for a while, he began the ranking battles. After three rounds, he had spent more than four hours.
It was mainly because he had waited for too long.
No wonder some prodigies didn’t participate in the ranking battles. For those who weren’t patient enough, this would drive them crazy from waiting.
A night passed, and Ling Han cultivated as usual in the morning.

After advancing into Celestial Path, one could actually cultivate at any time. It was just that the efficiency was the highest in the morning. In fact, it was a hundred times more efficient than at other times.
After he finished cultivating, Ling Han began to eat breakfast, planning to continue concocting alchemical pills later.
Peng, peng, peng! At this moment, a knock sounded from outside.
The servant went to open the door, but when he returned, he did not report who had come, but rather directly brought him in.
Ling Han was instantly displeased. He hadn’t decided whether to see the visitor or not, so how could he directly bring the person over?
He turned to look at the person who had arrived. This was a young man with a domineering aura. He had a dignified appearance, and there was also an air of arrogance about him.
Hehe, they were all just hostages. Was there any need to be so overbearing?
When he looked at the servant again, there was an obvious look of fear on his face.
The young man was in the Foundation Building Tier. If he forcefully barged in, even the servants wouldn’t be able to stop him.

“You know how to concoct alchemical pills?” the young man asked directly. “My name is Tan Zhengjie, and you can call me Brother Tan. If you need anything in the future, you can look for me. In this manor, I still have some face. I heard Sister Liu say that you have also concocted Foundation Dissolution Pills. Give me a few, and you can give me your Galaxy Network account. I will transfer the money to you later.”
If this person was more polite, Ling Han would still consider it. However, from the very beginning, he was already showing such a condescending attitude. Ling Han was displeased. Who are you?
What Tan Zhengjie, do I know you?
Ling Han smiled, “Can I look for you for anything?”
“Of course,” Tan Zhengjie nodded proudly.
Ling Han nodded, “All right, then I’ll have to trouble Brother Tan to help me to leave this place immediately.”
‘Hah?’
Tan Zhengjie’s expression instantly froze. ‘You want to leave this place? Pei, I want to too, but the crux of the matter is, is this realistic?’
They were all hostages, and even if they had some ability, it would only be limited to a small place like Jia Yuan Manor.
“Are you deliberately toying with me?” His expression immediately darkened.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Didn’t you say yourself that you could help me with anything?”
Of course, even so, you can’t make such an exorbitant demand.
Tan Zhengjie suppressed his anger, “All right, I will now discuss business with you. One Foundation Dissolution Pill for 10,000 Dao Stones. Give me ten of them.”

Ling Han almost laughed in spite of himself. The market price of the Foundation Dissolution Pill was 50,000 per pill, and there was no lack of buyers. For example, he had put up a price of 100,000 per pill on the Galaxy Network Trading Platform, but what was the result? There was no one bargaining at all, and it was directly bought at the first instant.
You want to take it away with just 10,000 Dao Stones?
What a colossal joke.
“I’ll offer 20,000 Dao Stones for one. I’ll take however many you have,” Ling Han replied.

“Ling Han!” Tan Zhengjie raised his voice a notch higher, “Don’t think that there is anything special about being able to concoct alchemical pills. This is Jia Yuan Manor, and you are only a prisoner!”
“You speak as if you’re not.” Ling Han shook his head.
“You—” Tan Zhengjie pointed at Ling Han, “I will give you one more chance! You have to know, if you offend me, you would not be able to move a single step here.”
“Oh, you have that much ability?” Ling Han asked with a smile.

Tan Zhengjie declared proudly, “The Vanguard Planet that Sister Liu is from has been on good terms with the Dong Yuan Planet that I am from for generations. Furthermore, they are in- laws. Thus, if I say a few words to Sister Liu, I guarantee that you will not have a good time!” Ling Han sighed and said, “You’re a man, after all, so why don’t you have any accomplishments at all? You still need a woman to stand up for you?”
Tan Zhengjie’s face instantly flushed red. He appeared to be very furious. These words were really too hurtful.
“Humph, do you think I can’t deal with you?” he asked coldly.
Ling Han chuckled, shook his head, and said, “It’s really not that I’m looking down on you, but for someone like you, I can fight ten single-handedly.”
“Arrogant! You are really arrogant!” Tan Zhengjie said coldly, “Come out, and let’s go to the battlefield for a spar.”

The battlefield was a place that was specifically used for martial arts and sparring in the Jia Yuan Manor, because the destructive power of the Foundation Building Tier was too great. If they really went all out and sparred, this Jia Yuan Manor would be shattered in a few moves. “There’s no need to go to so much trouble. It’s just a matter of stretching out a hand,” Ling Han said with a smile. As expected, he stretched out a hand towards Tan Zhengjie. “Impudence!” Tan Zhengjie was furious. This brat was really arrogant, to actually dare to take the initiative to make a move on him. Furthermore, who did he think he was? He would be able to take him down in a few moves, so there was no need for him to even go to the
battlefield?
But he had just stretched out his hand, when his expression changed drastically.
When Ling Han stretched out this hand, it was like the suppression of heaven and earth,
causing him to actually feel that he was no match.
This was too terrifying. They were both in the Foundation Building Tier, so why was the gap between them so wide?
He wanted to put his life on the line. If he exploded with power, he would at least shatter this courtyard. That way, he would attract the attention of others, and they would save him.
However, when his power surged out, he shockingly discovered that his power was actually
limited to a very small range.
How was this possible?
Though he was only in Heavenly Dao Foundation, even if he was facing an Ultimate Dao Foundation, it was impossible for him to have such a powerful suppressive ability.
Could it be that he was in the Cauldron Forging Tier?
No, no, no, that was definitely impossible.
He hurriedly shook his head in his mind. The aura that Ling Han was exuding was definitely
only that of a Foundation Building cultivator. It was impossible that he was a Cauldron
Forging Tier elite.
However, they were both in the Foundation Building Tier, so how could the gap be so wide?
How high was his ranking in the Galaxy Network? Top 10,000? Or even top 1000 in fact?
He had not even finished this thought, when he was already captured by Ling Han.
Ling Han carried him all the way to the main doors. Then, with a toss, pa, Tan Zhengjie was
thrown onto the ground.
He did not even cast a second look, closed the doors and walked back.
“In future, without my permission, no one is allowed to enter,” he said calmly to his three
servants.
This was the first time, so he would let it go for now.
“Yes, Young Master Han!” The three servants were all trembling.
That was Tan Zhengjie, and he had actually been kicked out like a dog. This guy was really too
awesome.
“However, Young Master Han, that Tan Zheng-”
One of the servants wanted to remind Ling Han of Tan Zhengjie’s background, yet when Ling
Han glanced coldly at him, he immediately shut his mouth obediently, not daring to say
another word.

You are really arrogant!” Tan Zhengjie said coldly, “Come out, and let’s go to the battlefield for a spar.”
The battlefield was a place that was specifically used for martial arts and sparring in the Jia Yuan Manor, because the destructive power of the Foundation Building Tier was too great.
If they really went all out and sparred, this Jia Yuan Manor would be shattered in a few moves.
“There’s no need to go to so much trouble.
It’s just a matter of stretching out a hand,” Ling Han said with a smile.
As expected, he stretched out a hand towards Tan Zhengjie.
“Impudence!” Tan Zhengjie was furious.
This brat was really arrogant, to actually dare to take the initiative to make a move on him.
Furthermore, who did he think he was?
He would be able to take him down in a few moves, so there was no need for him to even go to the
battlefield?
But he had just stretched out his hand, when his expression changed drastically.
When Ling Han stretched out this hand, it was like the suppression of heaven and earth,
causing him to actually feel that he was no match.
This was too terrifying.
They were both in the Foundation Building Tier, so why was the gap between them so wide?
He wanted to put his life on the line.
If he exploded with power, he would at least shatter this courtyard.
That way, he would attract the attention of others, and they would save him.
However, when his power surged out, he shockingly discovered that his power was actually
limited to a very small range.
How was this possible?
Though he was only in Heavenly Dao Foundation, even if he was facing an Ultimate Dao Foundation, it was impossible for him to have such a powerful suppressive ability.
Could it be that he was in the Cauldron Forging Tier?
No, no, no, that was definitely impossible.
He hurriedly shook his head in his mind.
The aura that Ling Han was exuding was definitely
only that of a Foundation Building cultivator.
It was impossible that he was a Cauldron
Forging Tier elite.
However, they were both in the Foundation Building Tier, so how could the gap be so wide?
How high was his ranking in the Galaxy Network?
Or even top 1000 in fact?
He had not even finished this thought, when he was already captured by Ling Han.
Ling Han carried him all the way to the main doors.
Then, with a toss, pa, Tan Zhengjie was
thrown onto the ground.
He did not even cast a second look, closed the doors and walked back.
“In future, without my permission, no one is allowed to enter,” he said calmly to his three
servants.
This was the first time, so he would let it go for now.
“Yes, Young Master Han!” The three servants were all trembling.
That was Tan Zhengjie, and he had actually been kicked out like a dog.
This guy was really too
awesome.
“However, Young Master Han, that Tan Zheng-”
One of the servants wanted to remind Ling Han of Tan Zhengjie’s background, yet when Ling
Han glanced coldly at him, he immediately shut his mouth obediently, not daring to say
another word.

chapters.title: Chapter 3753: Dazzling Battle
paragraphs: Chapter 3753: Dazzling Battle
Outside the door, Tan Zhengjie got up, his face filled with fury and shame.
He had actually been thrown out the door!
This was a great humiliation.
Though no one outside had witnessed his humiliating scene, Ling Han and his three servants had seen it, and he too would remember this scene forever.
He definitely had to get his revenge!
However, how was he supposed to get his revenge?

“Oh, that’s right. The Dazzling Tournament will be held in nine days’ time. At that time, I will ask a few people to join forces to deal with him!” Tan Zhengjie’s eyes turned, and he had already thought of an idea. He chuckled coldly, “So what if you are strong? I am no match for you in a one-on-one battle, but if I get ten people to gang up on you, I don’t believe that you won’t collapse!”
Ling Han wasn’t worried about Tan Zhengjie’s revenge. This was the Political Hostage Manor, so who would dare to mess around?
Moreover, he did not take Tan Zhengjie seriously at all. In his eyes, what was Tan Zhengjie worth?
Two days later, Liu Xunyu ran over again, and told Ling Han to attend an event.
“Seven days later, the Dazzling Tournament will be held,” she said.
“What is the Dazzling Tournament?” Ling Han asked.

“Oh, this is an event organized by our Jia Yuan Manor. The main purpose is to promote everyone’s friendship,” Liu Xunyu said with a smile. “It’s a competition for a colourful ball. Whoever can snatch it will be the winner.”
“How much is the prize money?” Ling Han asked again.
Liu Xunyu’s expression involuntarily darkened. Are you a money grubber?
‘I’ve already said that the main purpose is to promote the friendship between us. Why are you suddenly thinking about money?’
“There is no prize money.” She shook her head, then continued, “However, the prize of the winner surpass all other treasures. Every time it is held, it would be fought over extremely fiercely.”
“Oh, what is it?” Ling Han’s interest was piqued.

Liu Xunyu first kept him in suspense, and merely pursed her lips in a smile. After a while, she said, “The person who finally wins the colourful ball will be able to leave Jia Yuan Manor, and gain a day of freedom.”
A day’s freedom?
This sounded very pitiful and cheap. When had the value of a day of freedom surpassed all other treasures?
However, for hostages like Ling Han, a day’s freedom was a valuable prize.
No wonder they would fight tooth and nail every time.

Ling Han glanced at Liu Xunyu. There were three Cauldron Forging Tier cultivators in this Jia Yuan Manor, so who would be able to compete with the three of them? Though Ling Han was very confident in himself, he did not think that he could defeat a Cauldron Forging Tier.
This wasn’t the Werewolf High Priest. In order to survive, he had gone all out.
Furthermore, there had been a great many people helping at the time, impeding the attention of the Werewolf High Priest, which allowed the Heavenly Pattern Jade to succeed.
Under normal circumstances, no matter how freakish a Foundation Building cultivator was, they wouldn’t be able to rival a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator.
-Perhaps, after Ling Han had reached the Ultimate Dao Foundation, he could challenge the impossible.
Liu Xunyu smiled, shook her head and said, “Don’t worry, the three of us Cauldron Forging Tier elites won’t even participate.”
This made things easier. In the Foundation Building Tier, Ling Han was invincible.
However, Ling Han was pondering the hidden meaning of these words.
For hostages like them, freedom was an incomparable luxury, even if it was only a short day. However, the three Cauldron Forging Tier cultivators actually gave up such an opportunity? Why?
This meant that they should have other channels to leave Jia Yuan Manor.
Then, since this was an event hosted by hostages like them, what right did they have to obtain the right from the Clan Mansion to let the victor leave the manor?
Interesting.
Ling Han nodded, and said, “Alright, I’ll participate then.”
Liu Xunyu smiled beautifully, then suddenly paused, “Is there some kind of conflict between you and Tan Zhengjie?”
“No.” Ling Han pretended to be surprised, “I have always been very concerned about the relationship between myself and my teammates, so how could there possibly be any
conflict?”
“That’s good.” Liu Xunyu nodded, turned and left.
Ling Han stroked his chin as he watched her leave.

Liu Xunyu had suddenly asked him if there was any conflict between him and Tan Zhengjie, so it was obvious that she was already aware of the enmity between him and Tan Zhengjie. After all, Tan Zhengjie kept calling her Sister Liu, but Liu Xunyu did not expose him. Why was that?
Thinking about it, it should be related to his alchemy skills.
An alchemist who could concoct the Foundation Dissolution Pill, Ling Han’s future prospects were definitely boundless.

What Ling Han needed was only an opportunity. He would take the Foundation Dissolution Pill and walk around, and he would definitely be able to form a network, and soon be able to walk out of Jia Yuan Manor.

On the other side, the empress, Lin Luo, and the others had also arrived at the Moonlight Planet. They had communicated with Ling Han through the Galaxy Network, and informed Ling Han of where they had settled down.

They would think of a way to join some sects, and get themselves a “legal” identity. Theoretically speaking, they were all unregistered, and needed to use this to clear their name. Moreover, they couldn’t always rely on Ling Han to obtain cultivation resources. One had to know that they were all true overlords in the Genesis World, and which of them wasn’t extremely proud and arrogant?

Ling Han waited patiently. He concocted alchemical pills every day, concocting at least four cauldrons a day, and had already saved up a great many Foundation Dissolution Pills. Furthermore, the Foundation Dissolution Pills that he had sold through the Galaxy Network had also gained the approval of those ten customers. Thus, aside from the nickname of a money grubber, Ling Han also gained the title of a prodigy alchemist on the Galaxy Network, and this title was quite positive.
In the blink of an eye, seven days had passed.
The Dazzling Tournament was about to begin.
There were a total of 20 Foundation Building cultivators in the Jia Yuan Manor, and they were all participating in this competition.

This naturally was set on the battlefield, and a colourful ball was placed right in the centre. There were rules in the Dazzling Tournament. Firstly, one was not allowed to fly on a Spirit Tool, and was not allowed to leap over 30 meters in a single bound. Secondly, snatching the colourful ball did not mean that one had won, but rather had to be brought out of the battlefield. However, others could snatch it, and could even destroy the colourful ball. Once the colourful ball was destroyed, the tournament would be paused, and a new one would be substituted before starting again.𝚏𝕣𝕖𝚎𝚠𝚎𝚋𝚗𝐨𝐯𝕖𝕝.𝕔𝐨𝕞
In principle, deliberate injury was not allowed, but since this was a contest, there would definitely be a fierce clash, and it was inevitable that they would suffer some injuries.
Ling Han swept an eye over, and saw that Tan Zhengjie was presently looking at him coldly, killing intent seeping from him.
He, looks like this person had not learnt his lesson, and still wanted to cause trouble. Whatever. Worse come to worst, he would just give him a beating.
Liu Xunyu, Han Bing and Zhao Xiao had also come. The three of them had also taken on the role of referees, and were standing at three corners of the battlefield respectively.
“Begin.” Liu Xunyu waved her hand.
Instantly, everyone rushed towards the centre of the battlefield. There was presently a
colourful ball of bright red there.
Ling Han’s speed was the fastest. He had no time to dawdle. Shua, shua, shua! His feet flew,
and he was the first to arrive at the side of the colourful ball. Then, he crouched down, and was
just about to pick up the colourful ball.
Yi?
He shockingly discovered that the colorful ball seemed to have been rooted into the ground. If
he forcefully pulled it up, this ball would definitely explode.
This was made from very ordinary materials, so how could it withstand the power of a
Foundation Building cultivator?

chapters.title: Chapter 3754: Armor Penetration
paragraphs: Chapter 3754: Armor Penetration
Formation technique.

Ling Han came to his senses at the first instant. This colorful ball was protected by a formation. If he were to use brute force to retrieve it, the only result would be that the colorful ball would explode. That would be equivalent to having fought for nothing.
He swept an eye over it, and saw that there were a few veined patterns glowing underneath the colourful ball. Instantly, multiple corresponding formation patterns appeared in his mind.
This was a very simple formation. Even if it wasn’t a Formation Master, he could still easily break through it, because there were too many loopholes left behind.
In truth, it was meant for others to break through the formation, and its purpose was only to drag out the time, so that others could catch up to them and launch an attack.
However, to Ling Han, this formation was too simple.

It should be known that he had already crossed the threshold of Formation Master level, and could even set up formations with steps, so how long would it take to resolve this kind of practically child’s play formation?
He only stretched out a hand to touch it, and the light of the formation dimmed. The weak aura of heaven and earth was changed by him.
Ling Han grabbed out at the air again. Xiu, the colorful ball flew up by itself, and fell into his hand.
This action took a long time to describe, but it actually happened in an instant. Merely less than a millisecond had passed.
If Ling Han was willing, he could completely charge back, and it was guaranteed that no one would be able to stop him.
However, on second thought, since Tan Zhengjie was unwilling to learn his lesson, he would teach him a lesson today.
“Yi?”

Liu Xunyu and the other two Cauldron Forging Tier elites all exclaimed in surprise. Being able to unravel the formation on the colorful ball was really too easy. Anyone could do it, but to undo the formation with a single wave of their hand, wasn’t that a little too easy?
Unless… Ling Han was a Formation Master!
How was this possible?
Wasn’t this guy a prodigy alchemist? Who would be freakish enough to be skilled in both formations and alchemy?
Right at this moment, Tan Zhengjie and the others had already charged over.
Ling Han’s left hand gripped the colorful ball, and he placed it behind his back. He faced 19 aggressive opponents all by himself.

Tan Zheng Jie showed a hint of ruthlessness. In his plan, he would ask his other nine companions to join forces with him, and gang up on Ling Han together. However, if Ling Han didn’t get the colourful ball, it would be too obvious if the ten of them went to fight a person that didn’t have a colourful ball.

Now, everything was fine. Ling Han had obtained the colourful ball, so even if they ganged up on him, it was reasonable. The only difference was that the previous ganging up on him was for the sake of snatching the colourful ball, but now? They were naturally targeting Ling Han himself.
“Charge!” Tan Zhengjie roared loudly, and was the first to charge over.

Ling Han shook his head and said, “You still haven’t learnt your lesson. How stupid.” Xiu, xiu, xiu! The others also attacked one after another, all of them aiming for Ling Han. Ling Han was completely unafraid. He had a considerable number of ways to insta-kill these nineteen people in an instant, but after some thought, he activated the Starlight Screen, and then began his counterattack against Tan Zhengjie.
He suppressed his power for a while, and showed that he was just barely able to suppress Tan Zhengjie.

Peng, peng, peng! Over a dozen attacks landed on the Starlight Screen, yet they were completely unable to penetrate the Starlight Screen. Meanwhile, Ling Han’s counterattack was something that Tan Zhengjie couldn’t withstand. He continued to retreat continuously, appearing to be in an extremely sorry state.
Tan Zhengjie felt extremely vexed. Why was he only targeting him?
He just barely managed to parry, but he was completely unable to withstand Ling Han’s attacks. One punch after another landed on his body, causing him to feel extreme pain.
“Interesting,” Zhao Xiao said calmly. There was a sliver of a strange light in his eyes. Was the Secret technique released by Ling Han a cultivation technique or a rare treasure?
If it was a rare treasure, what level would it be?

If it was a One Star Celestial Tool, he naturally would not take it to heart. It was no longer suitable for him, but if it was a Two Star Celestial Tool or even a higher level Celestial Tool, his heart would naturally throb wildly.
And if it was a cultivation technique… then he would use all means necessary to obtain it. The strength of one’s own body surpassed the strength of external objects.
For example, in the ranking battles of the Galaxy Network, no treasure could be relied on. Even if he had an Imperial Weapon, it was useless.

“Hehe.” Han Bing also smiled. His thoughts were more or less the same as Zhao Xiao’s. Even Liu Xunyu was very surprised. She only knew that Ling Han was an alchemy prodigy, and could concoct Foundation Dissolution Pills. Furthermore, he was not weak in martial arts either, and could even suppress Tan Zhengjie. However, when she saw Ling Han’s Starlight Screen, she was still extremely shocked. This guy seemed to have mastered an incredibly awesome cultivation technique.
She sneered internally. Since he had entered into Jia Yuan Manor, it was equivalent to falling into her hands, and there was no way he could escape.

Peng, peng, peng! The attacks transformed into brilliant light that continued to strike the Starlight Screen. However, even though the Starlight Screen was on the verge of collapse, it didn’t shatter at all. One couldn’t help but sigh at the tenacity of its vitality.

This rendered the people who were ganging up on him speechless. They only felt that Ling Han was like a turtle shell. No matter how many of them there were, and how explosive their attacks were, they were completely helpless.

Tan Zhengjie was even more miserable. Others could only feel depressed because they were unable to blast through Ling Han’s defenses, but he was constantly being beaten by Ling Han. Every punch and palm strike landed on his flesh, and the pain was agonizing.
Finally, he could no longer bear it, and turned to flee.
He was done fighting, all right?
He wanted to flee?

Ling Han, on the other hand, chuckled. He shot forwards like an arrow, and gave Tan Zhengjie a violent beating. Though he had only used his right hand, the speed at which he delivered his punches was even faster than the speed at which most people swung their fists continuously. Every punch landed heavily on Tan Zhengjie’s body. Pieces of cloth flew in the air, and Tan Zhengjie’s clothes were forcefully torn apart by Ling Han.
“This is called… Armor Penetration!” Ling Han said with a smile.
Armor Penetration?
When everyone heard this, they all had strange expressions.

Armor Penetration, shouldn’t be something that could break through one’s opponent’s defenses, such as armor, Battle Armor, and other defensive items. You shattered his clothes, and this was called Armor Penetration as well?
“Ah-“Tan Zhengjie released a terrible scream of shame. He had actually been beaten naked by Ling Han in public. What kind of humiliation was this?
“Tsk, tsk, tsk!” Someone’s eyes swept over his crotch, and couldn’t help but look surprised.
This was a colossal creature.
Ling Han also felt that it was a little blinding, so he raised a foot. Peng, his foot landed on Tan Zhengjie’s behind, kicking the latter out of the battlefield.
He turned around and looked at the others. “Who was the one who hit me the hardest just
now?” Everyone was astounded. This guy withstood their firepower, and forcibly beat Tan Zhengjie to the point of tearing his clothes apart and leaving the arena in shame, and now he had his
eyes on them… who could bear that?
This was a monster.
Ling Han’s eyes swept over them, and all of them revealed expressions of fear. If they were targeted by Ling Han, they would be in deep trouble.
You b@stard, you’ve already gotten the colourful ball, so why aren’t you leaving quickly?
“You!” Ling Han pointed at a person.
“No, no, no, it wasn’t me.” That person’s face turned green with fear, and he hurriedly turned around and fled.
I won’t fight anymore, all right?
You are deluding yourself! Ling Han caught up to him with a single step and gave him a good beating.
After he had had his fun, he turned to look at the others, and instantly, those people had all
turned pale with fear.
‘You’re f*cking invincible, and your skin is as thick as can be. How am I supposed to fight
you?’
Without another word, they all turned around and fled.
Ling Han caught up with one of them, grabbed hold of one, and thrashed them, but the others
had all fled.
Hehe, you guys are too naive.
With a pa, Ling Han crushed the colourful ball.
According to the rules, the tournament had to be restarted.
F***, everyone was about to break down.

Now, everything was fine.
Ling Han had obtained the colourful ball, so even if they ganged up on him, it was reasonable.
The only difference was that the previous ganging up on him was for the sake of snatching the colourful ball, but now?
They were naturally targeting Ling Han himself.
“Charge!” Tan Zhengjie roared loudly, and was the first to charge over.
Ling Han shook his head and said, “You still haven’t learnt your lesson.
How stupid.” Xiu, xiu, xiu!
The others also attacked one after another, all of them aiming for Ling Han.
Ling Han was completely unafraid.

He had a considerable number of ways to insta-kill these nineteen people in an instant, but after some thought, he activated the Starlight Screen, and then began his counterattack against Tan Zhengjie.
He suppressed his power for a while, and showed that he was just barely able to suppress Tan Zhengjie.
Peng, peng, peng!
Over a dozen attacks landed on the Starlight Screen, yet they were completely unable to penetrate the Starlight Screen.
Meanwhile, Ling Han’s counterattack was something that Tan Zhengjie couldn’t withstand.
He continued to retreat continuously, appearing to be in an extremely sorry state.
Tan Zhengjie felt extremely vexed.
Why was he only targeting him?
He just barely managed to parry, but he was completely unable to withstand Ling Han’s attacks.
One punch after another landed on his body, causing him to feel extreme pain.
“Interesting,” Zhao Xiao said calmly.
There was a sliver of a strange light in his eyes.
Was the Secret technique released by Ling Han a cultivation technique or a rare treasure?
If it was a rare treasure, what level would it be?
If it was a One Star Celestial Tool, he naturally would not take it to heart.
It was no longer suitable for him, but if it was a Two Star Celestial Tool or even a higher level Celestial Tool, his heart would naturally throb wildly.
And if it was a cultivation technique… then he would use all means necessary to obtain it.
The strength of one’s own body surpassed the strength of external objects.
For example, in the ranking battles of the Galaxy Network, no treasure could be relied on.
Even if he had an Imperial Weapon, it was useless.
“Hehe.” Han Bing also smiled.
His thoughts were more or less the same as Zhao Xiao’s.
Even Liu Xunyu was very surprised.
She only knew that Ling Han was an alchemy prodigy, and could concoct Foundation Dissolution Pills.
Furthermore, he was not weak in martial arts either, and could even suppress Tan Zhengjie.
However, when she saw Ling Han’s Starlight Screen, she was still extremely shocked.
This guy seemed to have mastered an incredibly awesome cultivation technique.
She sneered internally.
Since he had entered into Jia Yuan Manor, it was equivalent to falling into her hands, and there was no way he could escape.
Peng, peng, peng!
The attacks transformed into brilliant light that continued to strike the Starlight Screen.
However, even though the Starlight Screen was on the verge of collapse, it didn’t shatter at all.
One couldn’t help but sigh at the tenacity of its vitality.
This rendered the people who were ganging up on him speechless.
They only felt that Ling Han was like a turtle shell.
No matter how many of them there were, and how explosive their attacks were, they were completely helpless.
Tan Zhengjie was even more miserable.
Others could only feel depressed because they were unable to blast through Ling Han’s defenses, but he was constantly being beaten by Ling Han.
Every punch and palm strike landed on his flesh, and the pain was agonizing.
Finally, he could no longer bear it, and turned to flee.
He was done fighting, all right?
He wanted to flee?
Ling Han, on the other hand, chuckled.
He shot forwards like an arrow, and gave Tan Zhengjie a violent beating.
Though he had only used his right hand, the speed at which he delivered his punches was even faster than the speed at which most people swung their fists continuously.
Every punch landed heavily on Tan Zhengjie’s body.
Pieces of cloth flew in the air, and Tan Zhengjie’s clothes were forcefully torn apart by Ling Han.
“This is called…
Armor Penetration!” Ling Han said with a smile.
Armor Penetration?
When everyone heard this, they all had strange expressions.
Armor Penetration, shouldn’t be something that could break through one’s opponent’s defenses, such as armor, Battle Armor, and other defensive items.
You shattered his clothes, and this was called Armor Penetration as well?
“Ah-“Tan Zhengjie released a terrible scream of shame.
He had actually been beaten naked by Ling Han in public.
What kind of humiliation was this?
“Tsk, tsk, tsk!” Someone’s eyes swept over his crotch, and couldn’t help but look surprised.
This was a colossal creature.
Ling Han also felt that it was a little blinding, so he raised a foot.
Peng, his foot landed on Tan Zhengjie’s behind, kicking the latter out of the battlefield.
He turned around and looked at the others.
“Who was the one who hit me the hardest just
now?” Everyone was astounded.
This guy withstood their firepower, and forcibly beat Tan Zhengjie to the point of tearing his clothes apart and leaving the arena in shame, and now he had his
eyes on them… who could bear that?
This was a monster.
Ling Han’s eyes swept over them, and all of them revealed expressions of fear.
If they were targeted by Ling Han, they would be in deep trouble.
You b@stard, you’ve already gotten the colourful ball, so why aren’t you leaving quickly?
“You!” Ling Han pointed at a person.
“No, no, no, it wasn’t me.” That person’s face turned green with fear, and he hurriedly turned around and fled.
I won’t fight anymore, all right?
You are deluding yourself!
Ling Han caught up to him with a single step and gave him a good beating.
After he had had his fun, he turned to look at the others, and instantly, those people had all
turned pale with fear.
‘You’re f*cking invincible, and your skin is as thick as can be.
How am I supposed to fight
you?’
Without another word, they all turned around and fled.
Ling Han caught up with one of them, grabbed hold of one, and thrashed them, but the others
had all fled.
Hehe, you guys are too naive.
With a pa, Ling Han crushed the colourful ball.
According to the rules, the tournament had to be restarted.
F***, everyone was about to break down.

chapters.title: Chapter 3755: One day of freedom
paragraphs: Chapter 3755: One day of freedom
At this moment, everyone’s hearts were about to collapse.
You are too f****** ruthless, aren’t you?
Hadn’t thrashed them enough, so he deliberately tore the colourful ball and started again?
F***, this was really not just a bit black-hearted.
However, the rules were the rules. If the colorful ball exploded, this round would be equivalent to having been for nothing. They would have to start again.
Everyone looked as if they had eaten dead children, their expressions ugly to the extreme.
Even Liu Xunyu and the others bore strange expressions. The victor himself had crushed the colourful ball. It was only today that such a strange event had happened.
‘Fine, let’s start again.’
The Dazzling Tournament began again, but not one person walked into the battlefield.
Who wanted to be beaten? Were they stupid?
Ling Han crossed his arms behind his back, and slowly walked forwards. His appearance was extremely aggravating. He was basically mocking all of them.

But no matter how much they hated him, so what? Which of them could match Ling Han? “Sigh, it’s really lonely to be invincible.” Ling Han shook his head, walked into the middle of the battlefield, and picked up the colourful ball. Then, he slowly walked back.
Everyone was furious, especially Tan Zhengjie. This time, he had been beaten harshly. The old grudge had been added onto the new grudge.
One step, two steps, though Ling Han was walking slowly, the battlefield was only so big. After a few minutes, he still walked out.
The victor was Ling Han.
This result was the same as the last time, but if this happened again, everyone would grit their teeth in hatred, wanting to swallow Ling Han whole and skin him alive.
“Congratulations, Ling Han, for winning this competition,” Liu Xunyu said with a smile. There was a meaningful look in her eyes as she looked at Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled at the people around him, “Thank you for your generosity.”
Being generous your sister. If I could beat you, I would definitely skin you alive.
Everyone was already in a bad mood in the first place, and when they saw Ling Han mocking them, they were all furious. They felt like how could there be such a toxic person in this world?
Ling Han turned around and asked Liu Xunyu, “Captain, when can I go out?”
“Tomorrow.”
Ling Han nodded, and strode off.
“Hehe, this person seems to be a bit of a troublemaker.” Zhao Xiao walked over, and looked at Ling Han’s receding back.
“Very unruly,” Han Bing said as well.
Liu Xunyu showed a smile filled with confidence, “I will make him do as I say!”
When these words fell, Zhao Xiao and Han Bing revealed jealous expressions at the same time, their expressions extremely strange.
Zhao Xiao couldn’t help but say, “Xunyu, that’s merely a Foundation Building Tier cultivator. Give him a little lesson, and he’ll listen obediently.”
“That’s right. To be more realistic, this place is a prison. As long as no one is killed, who would care about a hostage from another country?” Han Bing nodded as well. “Let me deal with him first.”

Liu Xunyu shook her head, “Nothing good comes out of forceful persuasion. That guy is an alchemy prodigy, so he must be arrogant and domineering. If we coerce him, his heart must be resistant, so how could he possibly do things seriously?”
“But!” Han Bing still wanted to persuade her further.
“I know what I’m doing,” Liu Xunyu said calmly.
Han Bing and Zhao Xiao did not speak further, but there was a hint of hatred in their
expressions. It was unknown what they had to hate Ling Han for.
This night, Ling Han was slightly excited. Although he had only entered Jia Yuan Manor for a few days, this was prison, so he naturally felt a sense of repression.
The night passed, and after Ling Han finished cultivating, he immediately walked towards the main doors.
This time, the guard did not stop him. Instead, he said, “You must return before midnight. Otherwise, we will report this to the Clan Mansion, and place you on the wanted list as a fugitive.”
Ling Han nodded. This was the rules, and he had no intention of arguing with such a minor character. He strode out of Jia Yuan Manor.
He was still under the same sky, but after walking out of the high walls, Ling Han’s mood suddenly relaxed.
Time was short, and Ling Han had a clear goal. He did not reunite with the empress and the others, but rather headed directly to the Saint Pill Hall.

This was the Moonlight Planet’s Holy Land of alchemy, which gathered the highest level alchemists of the entire planet. Meanwhile, the senior elder of the Saint Pill Hall also had an official rank bestowed on him by the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire. He was a dignified first rank duke, and this was the highest official rank that non-royalty could obtain. Naturally, this boosted the status of the Saint Pill Hall to an extremely high level.
Because this Three Herbs Elder was an Earth Tier High Grade alchemist, even Sect Master- level great elites had to ask him to concoct alchemical pills for them, so his status was
naturally revered.

In the city, movement techniques naturally couldn’t be used, and flying on a tool was even more impossible. This would be seen as great disrespect, so Ling Han walked on foot. In any case, his speed was also very fast.
Twenty minutes later, he arrived at the Saint Pill Hall.
This was a glorious group of buildings, occupying an extremely large area. There were multiple towers standing tall, some silver, and some gold.

Ling Han found out from the Galaxy Network that the silver tower was where Human Tier alchemists lived, and the golden tower was where Earth Tier alchemists lived. Whether it was martial arts, alchemy, formations, or so on, the hierarchy was strict.
He strode into the Saint Pill Hall. After entering, there was a large hall, and there was a large volume of alchemical pills for sale.

The shop assistants here were all very proud. Though Ling Han was looking around, not one of them asked him if he needed alchemical pills for certain areas, looking like it was up to him whether he wanted to buy them or not.
Ling Han had no intention of communicating with the staff either. He directly passed through the lobby, planning to enter the area further inside.
“Unauthorized personnel are not allowed.” Immediately, someone stepped out to stop him.
Ling Han smiled, “I want to be certified as an alchemist.”

“You?” That person looked at Ling Han in surprise, because Ling Han was too young. He looked to be in his early twenties; how could there be such a young alchemist? However, the alchemist certification was open to all. As long as you prepared your own ingredients, the Saint Pill Hall would provide an alchemy chamber.
“All right, come with me.” That person led Ling Han towards the back, “Don’t look around. There are a great many alchemists here, and they very much dislike being stared at. That
would be very rude,” he reminded.
Ling Han nodded in understanding.
They arrived at a very large room. There were a great many people inside, and they were all
staring at a wall.

This was a projection wall, and there was an alchemist presently concocting alchemical pills. Ling Han could confirm with a single glance that this cauldron of alchemical pills was about to be successfully concocted.
The person who had led Ling Han in hurriedly ran to the front, muttering to someone. After a while, he returned, and said, “Just wait here. Someone will arrange for you to be certified.”
“All right.”
Ling Han sat down and closed his eyes to rest. He was completely uninterested in the alchemy
process that was underway.
“Tsk, what are you acting for? You’ve already come all the way here, and you’re actually still resting with your eyes closed!” someone sneered.
Ling Han was astonished. ‘Am I bothering you by closing my eyes to rest?’

“That’s right. Our Saint Pill Hall’s number one prodigy, Luo Jun, is trying to break through to become an alchemist today, and has deliberately invited everyone to come and observe, and you are actually not taking it seriously?” Another person said to Ling Han, his tone slightly
stern.

Luo Jun was only 29 years old this year, but he was talented and intelligent. In 15 years, he had advanced from an Elementary Level alchemy apprentice to a High Level alchemy apprentice, and now, he was even breaking through to become a Human Tier Low Grade Alchemist. This natural talent was practically astonishing.
And now, Luo Jun was willing to let everyone observe his alchemy techniques, and you
actually closed your eyes to rest?
Was he showing off or deliberately mocking them?

chapters.title: Chapter 3756: Prized Son of the Tang Clan
paragraphs: Chapter 3756: Prized Son of the Tang Clan
Hehe, he had just closed his eyes and rested for a while, and the issue had actually risen to such a height?
Ling Han shook his head, and couldn’t be bothered to pay attention to these people.

However, even if he didn’t drop down to the same level as these people, these people wouldn’t give up. Moreover, the news spread like wildfire, and many people knew that there was someone here who actually didn’t take Luo Jun seriously and closed his eyes to rest while he was being certified as an alchemist.
-Since you have come here, and you are not properly watching others concoct alchemical pills, wasn’t that a deliberate mockery?
“Who is this person?”
“I don’t know him.”
“Perhaps it’s some newly promoted apprentice that still doesn’t know Luo Jun’s name, right?”
“En, that must be the case.”

Everyone nodded one after another, certain that Ling Han must be some rookie that had just advanced into the threshold of alchemy, and did not even recognize an incredibly dazzling new star like Luo Jun.
Ling Han acted as if he had not heard anything. Did he need to take the words of others to heart?
Moreover, once he began concocting alchemical pills later, he would be able to slap their faces with reality.
“It’s done!”
“Luo Jun has formed his alchemical pill.”
“Heavens, a twenty-nine-year-old Human Tier Low Grade alchemist, this is a new record!”

“En, previously, the youngest alchemist on the Moonlight Planet was 31 years old. This time, not only has he broken a new record, he has also pushed the limit of the youngest alchemist to the level of twenties in age.”
“As expected of Luo Jun. He will definitely have boundless future prospects.”
Everyone exclaimed in shock, all of them incredibly excited, as if they were the ones who were concocting alchemical pills inside.
At this moment, the alchemy chamber opened, and a young man walked out. It was Luo Jun, who had just been concocting alchemical pills.
“Congratulations, Alchemist Luo!”
“Congratulations!”
“He’ll definitely become a Grandmaster in the future.”

There was a round of congratulations, and everyone squeezed in. At this time, they naturally had to show themselves. If Luo Jun remembered them, they may be able to worm their way into being friends with this prodigy alchemist.
“Haha, Brother Luo, congratulations!” There was a long bout of laughter, and a man strode in. He was striding and leaping like a dragon, exuding an astonishing aura.
“Hiss, Little Marquis Tang Yan!”
“He’s the son of the Tang Clan, a prodigy of martial arts. When he was born, he attracted the senses of heaven and earth. He’s an Innate Divine Physique!”

“The Tang Clan is a force on the level of Spirit Transformation True Lord. Furthermore, they are deeply favoured by His Majesty. Tang Yan has been conferred the title of Marquis since birth. Though it is because he has an Innate Divine Physique, it is also because the Tang Clan is presently flourishing in imperial favour.”
Everyone exclaimed in shock. This young man that was walking over was really too extraordinary.
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head. The prodigy of the Tang Clan?
He also walked up. Of course, he was not heading for Tang Yan. He was going to immediately begin the verification of alchemist.
“Yi, who is this brat?”
“What are you squeezing in for?”
Some people still didn’t recognize Ling Han, and when they saw him force his way forwards, they were all very displeased.
Ling Han squeezed forward. Most of the people here were Foundation Building cultivators, so who could stop him?
“Can I begin?” he asked.
There were three Human Tier alchemists in charge of witnessing here, and they naturally knew that there was another person who wanted to be certified as an alchemist. The
expressions on their faces were all not very pleased.
F***, they had just stared fixedly for an alchemist verification for three hours, and he still wanted them to continue?
However, for such a young guy, it was very likely that his cauldron would soon explode and fail.
“All right, begin.” One of them nodded.
“What pill will you concoct?” another person asked.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Foundation Dissolution Pill.”
Instantly, the surroundings fell silent, and then raucous laughter arose.
Hahaha, this was really too funny. An alchemist that had not even advanced into the Human Tier actually said that he wanted to concoct the Foundation Dissolution Pill?
Where did he get such courage from?

Tang Yan and Luo Jun had already walked some distance away, so they did not hear Ling Han’s words. They only discovered the laughter of the masses, which made Tang Yan appear slightly curious. He asked, “What’s going on?”
“Oh, there’s an idiot here to verify that he’s a Human Tier Low Grade alchemist. He actually said he wanted to concoct the Foundation Dissolution Pill,” the alchemy apprentice beside
him replied with a smile.
Luo
instantly snickered. This was the Foundation Dissolution Pill. Even he didn’t dare to think about it, because prodigies who could concoct the Foundation Dissolution Pill could
possibly become Heaven Tier alchemists.
“Just grandstanding. Brother Tang, let’s go,” Luo Jun said.
Yet Tang Yan’s interest was piqued, “There is no harm in taking a look.”
Since he had already said so, Luo Jun naturally could not say anything else.
Though he was a prodigy alchemist, the extent of his prodigy talent was completely incomparable to Tang Yan’s background. Thus, in their interactions, he was naturally in a
disadvantageous position, and needed to submit to Tang Yan’s will.
Meanwhile, the alchemy apprentice beside him continued to add fuel to the fire as he recounted how Ling Han had purposefully closed his eyes to rest just then. He had
deliberately drawn animosity toward Ling Han.
Luo Jun’s expression was dark, but he said calmly, “Everyone has their own freedom. No one
begs him to watch.”
Tang Yan laughed loudly, “This guy seems to have quite a personality.”
Luo Jun had not thought that Tang Yan would make such a comment about Ling Han. He
faltered for a moment, then answered sheepishly, “Yes, that’s right.”
There was a ball of fire burning in his heart, and he wanted nothing more than to drag Ling
Han out and give him a good beating.
Who was he?
The prodigy alchemist Luo Jun, the person who had created the record for the youngest alchemist on Moonlight Planet. You, a nameless nobody, actually dare to be so
condescending!
On the other side, Ling Han also began to concoct alchemical pills.
There was a ready-made formation and alchemy cauldron here, which saved Ling Han some
trouble. He stimulated the formation, then with a wave of his hands, medicinal ingredients
were thrown into the alchemy cauldron.
Boom! The power of heaven and earth surged over.
For Ling Han, he had been concocting Foundation Dissolution Pills all these days, so he
couldn’t be too proficient.
His movements were like flowing water, incredibly smooth.
Outside, everyone had initially wanted to watch a joke, but as they watched, they were
dumbfounded.
F***, so smooth?
Are you really here to be certified as an alchemist? Are you sure that you are not a veteran alchemist that has long since crossed over into this threshold?

But looking at Ling Han’s expression, everyone shook their heads. He was so young, and was definitely even younger than Luo Jun. How could he possibly be an experienced alchemist? Everyone couldn’t help but turn to look at Luo Jun. This person had just created the record for the youngest alchemist on Moonlight Planet. How could it be that it would be broken in the blink of an eye?

If such a thing really happened, then Luo Jun would become a joke. In future, he would also become nothing more than a background for another, and it might be that this story would be passed down through the ages.
This was the shortest-lived record holder in history, and it was a humiliating sight.

chapters.title: Chapter 3757: Goodwill from everyone
paragraphs: Chapter 3757: Goodwill from everyone
“Can he really succeed?” someone mumbled.
“If he really succeeds, this guy will become the youngest alchemist in history.”
“Uh, Luo Jun hasn’t even warmed up this position, and he’s already giving it up?”
“Where did such a monster come from? I don’t believe that such a prodigy would appear out of thin air.”

Everyone was about to go crazy. Though there was a large number of alchemy disciples in the Saint Pill Hall, there were only a few hundred alchemists. It was clear how difficult it was to become an alchemist. Thus, every alchemy disciple that had hopes of advancing to become an alchemist was well-known, and their names could be counted on the fingers of one’s hand. There were just a few of them.

Now, however, a completely unfamiliar guy had suddenly appeared, and it just so happened that he was overwhelmingly freakish. From the very beginning, he was concocting a Foundation Dissolution Pill, showing the potential of becoming a Heaven Tier alchemist. Tang Yan’s interest was piqued even further. He was the son of the Tang Clan, and it was destined that he would inherit the position of clan leader of the Tang Clan in the future. Thus, he had long since placed himself in the shoes of the future clan leader of the Tang Clan, Ling Han. In his eyes, Ling Han was a rare commodity.
He didn’t understand alchemy, but he wasn’t deaf, so he could naturally hear the words of others. He knew what concocting the Foundation Dissolution Pill meant.
If the Tang Clan could be on good terms with an Earth Tier High Grade alchemist, or even a Heaven Tier alchemist, they would naturally be even steadier and stronger.
The reason why he wanted to be on good terms with Luo Jun was naturally because of this.
Time continued to pass, and Ling Han was still stabilizing the situation. There was no sign of the furnace exploding at all.
Luo Jun’s expression was livid. He had a premonition that Ling Han would really succeed. He was filled with hatred.

For a prodigy like you, which planet couldn’t you go to? No matter where you went, you would be able to become a prodigy, an incredibly dazzling star, yet he just had to come his, causing his glory to go from brightness to dimness. In fact, he was about to become a joke.
Why? Why? Why?
He clenched his fists tightly. If he could, he would definitely charge into the alchemy chamber and kill Ling Han.

Three hours were about to pass, and Ling Han suddenly stretched out a hand to grab at empty air. Instantly, eight alchemical pills floated into the air. He immediately injected the power of the Celestial Foundation into them, and then fused them in. This was the final step of concocting the Foundation Dissolution Pill.
For others, this was a difficulty in concocting the Foundation Dissolution Pill, but for Ling Han, this was a piece of cake, easily completed.
“The pill is completed!”
“The cauldron didn’t explode, it really succeeded.”
“Foundation Dissolution Pill!”
“A prodigy, a supreme prodigy!”
Everyone exclaimed in shock, as if they had seen a ghost.

In truth, that was indeed the case. In the history of the Moonlight Planet, there had really never appeared one that could concoct the Foundation Dissolution Pill – by the time some alchemist had the ability to concoct it, he would have already surpassed the Foundation Building Tier in terms of cultivation level. Without the power of the Foundation Building Tier, how could he concoct the Foundation Dissolution Pill?
This was unprecedented, and was extremely awesome!
When Ling Han came out, a dead silence fell. Everyone looked at him with a sliver of admiration.

No one was an idiot. Though Ling Han and Luo Jun had both become alchemists for the first time, and had broken the record for the youngest alchemist, the comparison was very clear. Ling Han was younger than Luo Jun, and Ling Han had concocted the Foundation Dissolution Pill, and could at least become an Earth Tier High Grade alchemist in the future.
Who else would dare to offend Ling Han?
“Congratulations!”
“A super genius, he’s too young!”
“There’s a chance he’ll become a Heaven Tier alchemist in the future.”
Everyone praised him one after another, daring to say such disgusting words. They had completely forgotten how they had previously mocked Ling Han.
“Congratulations,” an alchemist clasped his hands and said in congratulations to Ling Han. “I still don’t know your name.”
“Ling Han.”
The alchemist nodded, then asked, “And where did Alchemist Ling come from?”
“Jia Yuan Manor.” Ling Han smiled faintly.
Yi?
Everyone was stunned upon hearing this.

No wonder they ad never heard of Ling Han before. It was clear that his natural talent in alchemy was absolutely terrifying, but they had never heard of him and that was because Ling Han was a hostage of Jia Yuan Manor.

Yet Luo Jun’s eyes lit up. Immediately, he walked forwards, and exclaimed harshly, “How dare you. You are clearly a hostage, yet actually dare to come out without permission. This is practically treason!”

This was a very big crime. If Ling Han was really implicated, then not only would Ling Han not be able to become an alchemist, he would not be able to become an Alchemy Grandmaster in future, and would even be executed.
Ling Han glanced at this person. Was there any need to be so resentful? His limelight had been stolen, so what need was there for him to be so resentful?
How petty, how intolerant.

Ling Han shook his head, and said, “Don’t rush to pin the blame on others. Firstly, I am an envoy from the Dark North Nation, yet you keep saying that I am a hostage. Are you stoking the flames of anger in the relations between the two Majestic Empires? Hehe, in my opinion, you are the one who has committed treason, and should be punished for such motives.”
Speaking of bickering, who had he ever been afraid of?

These words caused Luo Jun to be stupefied. That was because the words ‘political hostage’ was spoken in private. On the surface, the people of the Political Hostage Manor were all envoys from various nations. Furthermore, they were not called Political Hostage Manor, but rather Jia Yuan Manor, in all seriousness.
He had only spoken in a moment of carelessness. Who asked this matter to be too ridiculous? A hostage was actually an alchemy prodigy?

“Secondly, I didn’t run out on my own volition. Instead, I walked out in broad daylight. What is it? I’m not a prisoner, so can’t I come out for a stroll or something?” Ling Han said slowly. He did not weaken his aura at all. I am here as envoy, and my status is even higher than yours. “You’re spouting nonsense!” Luo Jun came back to his senses and immediately rebuked. He didn’t believe that anyone could come out of the Political Hostage Manor. Who didn’t know that it was a prison?
“Hehe, Grandmaster Ling, was is it?” Tang Yan walked over, and with a casual push, Luo Jun
was pushed aside.
He was at Cauldron Forging Tier, so how could Luo Jun, a Foundation Building cultivator,
possibly rival him?
The reason why Ling Han had begun to verify his status as an alchemist so quickly was naturally so that he could attract Tang Yan’s attention.
He smiled, “I dare not be called Grandmaster. You can just call me Ling Han.”
“My name is Tang Yan, and you can also directly call me by my name.” Tang Yan appeared very amiable, but if these words were heard by his friends, their eyeballs would definitely pop
out of their sockets.
Who did not know that Tang Yan was proud and arrogant? It was difficult to befriend him, and it was even more difficult to become a friend that could gain his approval.
Yet now, Tang Yan actually had Ling Han address him directly by name. This was the kind of treatment that only his closest friends would receive.
How could it not be frightening?
But in Tang Yan’s eyes, this was a very natural thing to do.𝙛𝒓𝓮𝒆𝔀𝒆𝙗𝓷𝒐𝙫𝒆𝙡.𝒄𝓸𝓶

That was because Ling Han’s lowest accomplishment would be Earth Tier High Grade alchemist, at least. This was completely equivalent to elites of Sect Master-level, or even slightly superior to that. That was because there were really too few alchemists at this level. There was only one such alchemist on Moonlight Planet. All the Sect Master-level elites would have to ask Three Herbs Elder for help when they needed him to concoct alchemical pills for them.

If the Tang Clan could make such a friend, the significance would naturally be extraordinary. Furthermore, Earth Tier High Grade alchemist was Ling Han’s lowest accomplishment. If he could take another step further, and become a Heaven Tier alchemist, then no matter where he was in the universe, Ling Han would still be greatly respected.
So, how could Tang Yan not be polite?

chapters.title: Chapter 3758: Discovered
paragraphs: Chapter 3758: Discovered
Ling Han smiled faintly, “No problem.”
“You really are from the Jia Yuan Manor?” Tang Yan was still in slight disbelief. What force would be so willing to hand over an alchemy prodigy as hostage?

It should be known that a genius that could concoct the Foundation Dissolution Pill would at least be able to become an Earth Tier High Grade alchemist in the future, and what kind of concept was this kind of existence?
Even a Sect Master great elite had to treat him as an esteemed guest!
This was truly strange, and completely baffling.

Indeed, if Ling Han was really just an ordinary alchemist, then he would definitely be protected by Chen Fengyan at all costs. Even if he had to hand over his own son as a hostage, he could not possibly hand Ling Han over.
An alchemist with boundless future prospects had too great an influence on a force.

However, who told Ling Han to have such a powerful identity? He was Chen Fengyan’s uncle. If he said he wanted to come here, would Chen Fengyan dare to stop him? Wouldn’t he be afraid that Brother Monkey would come back and beat him to the point of doubting life?
Ling Han nodded, “That’s right. I only arrived about ten days ago.”
“Which planet did you come from?”
“Celestial Sea Planet.”

“Oh.” Tang Yan nodded. As it turned out, it was that declining planet. The natives had just stepped onto the path of cultivation. If it was not for the fact that the criminals that were originally imprisoned had all escaped, this planet would still be in a state of confusion about cultivation.
He thought for a moment, then said solemnly, “Don’t worry, I will definitely have you brought out of Jia Yuan Manor as soon as possible.”
What Ling Han wanted was precisely these words from him. He did not deliberately try to be polite, but rather nodded, “Thank you.”
The two of them exchanged a smile, and there was a kind of tacit understanding between them.
Tang Yan immediately said what Ling Han wanted, and Ling Han didn’t pretend to be polite either. Although thanking him was simple, how could it be that Tang Yan wanted to listen to Ling Han’s tirade?

What he wanted was Ling Han’s favor. While Ling Han was still only a Human Tier Low Grade alchemist, he wanted to lay the foundations of their friendship, especially when Ling Han was presently in dire straits. If he lent him a helping hand now, the significance would naturally be different.
-The significance of sending coal in the snow and adding icing on the cake were completely different.

A rookie alchemist had concocted the Foundation Dissolution Pill. This naturally alerted the entire Saint Pill Hall. No matter what level of alchemist it was, as long as he was in the Saint Pill Hall, they all came out upon hearing the news, and congratulated Ling Han.
Though Ling Han was presently only a Human Tier Low Grade alchemist, Ling Han’s future prospects were too bright, and they had no choice but to swallow their pride.

Ling Han didn’t put on airs. Firstly, he wasn’t that kind of person, and secondly, he only had high potential. However, there were many people in this world with high potential who died early. Thus, it was best to keep a low profile, because there would always be those who were short-sighted. Even if they didn’t have any enmity with him, he would still step on others out of jealousy.
Thus, before he had powerful strength, he had to keep a low profile.

recognize him.

Yi?

the problem.

was he going to complain to?

want to eat him alive.

investigate my strength first?”

power as much as possible, and practically did not seep out any sliver. Otherwise, the houses
here would all collapse in an instant.

Divine Metal, and could not be pulled out at all.
