chapters.title: Chapter 3759: The funeral bells of the Pang Clan
paragraphs: Chapter 3759: The funeral bells of the Pang Clan
“Do you regret it now?” Ling Han asked.
That person gritted his teeth, and did not answer.

He did indeed regret it. He had only thought that Ling Han had just entered the Foundation Building Tier and was an easy target to bully. After receiving the news, he had come alone. He had not thought that he would actually be no match for Ling Han.
“If I told you that I was the one who sold you the Water Element Crystals, would your eyeballs pop out?” Ling Han said with a smile.

That person was startled, and his first reaction was naturally that it was impossible. However, upon further thought, the fact that the Pang Clan had been screwed over had not been leaked out, and only a limited number of people knew about it. More importantly, only the higher- ups of the Pang Clan knew that the problem lay with the Water Element Crystal. He had only found out by chance because his grandfather was a Cauldron Forging Tier elite.
If Ling Han was not personally involved, how could he possibly know a secret that even the majority of the Pang Clan did not know?
“It’s you!” His eyes were spitting fire.

Originally, Pang Yunfei should have already leaped into the Foundation Building Tier by now. With his freakishness, Pang Yunfei would definitely be ranked in the top 100,000 of Galaxy Network in the future. On the Celestial Sea Planet, he would definitely be one of the top existences.
However, the Pang Clan’s hopes for the future were forcefully extinguished by Ling Han. “You’re despicable! You’re shameless!” he roared in fury.

Ling Han shook his head, “Before you insult others, reflect on whether you have such a position or not. What is it? Only you people are allowed to hunt me down, and I am not allowed to counter? Don’t worry, the Pang Clan will not exist for too long. I will personally destroy them!”

“You’re dreaming!” the person said with his head held high. Even though he couldn’t withstand a single blow, Ling Han was only a mere Foundation Building Tier cultivator. Just what kind of existence was the Pang Clan?
A clan with a Core Formation Tier grand elder.
“Come on, let’s see how you’ll die!” he provoked Ling Han.
“Don’t be anxious. This day won’t be too far away.” Ling Han stretched out a hand and placed
it on that person’s forehead. A massive mystical power immediately surged in, heading straight for his mind.
“What are you trying to do?” The person was shocked.

Ling Han ignored him completely, and merely shook the two Celestial Foundations in his body lightly. Pa, the effects were immediately apparent. Cracks appeared on that person’s Celestial Foundation, as if it had been in disrepair for too long.
‘What?’
That person’s expression was ashen. How was this possible? He had not released the Celestial Foundation at all, so how could it possibly collapse?
This must be an illusion!
However, this was not the case.

Ka, ka, ka! The cracks on the Human Dao Foundation became more and more severe, and finally, it could no longer hold on, turning into pieces. Immediately, it crumbled, turning back into the energy of heaven and earth and the mystical appreciation of martial arts. “No-” he screamed tragically. Once the Celestial Foundation was broken, he had directly fallen from the Foundation Building Tier to the mortal level. He had to leap over the Celestial Gate and build a Celestial Foundation again.
However, this wasn’t the end. Ling Han’s mystical power was still surging through his body, shattering his meridians, Mystery Realms, and apertures.
In this way, that person was a complete mortal, aside from having a slightly longer lifespan.

However, his cultivation level was completely gone, so his lifespan wouldn’t be much longer than ordinary people. Moreover, he had already lived for more than 200 years, so he could only live for another 10 years at most.
He was originally in his prime, but now, he had to count the days and wait for death. Furthermore, he was a cripple. How could he accept this in this moment?
He was in a daze, appearing extremely confused.
“Don’t worry. In your lifetime, the Pang Clan will definitely be destroyed,” Ling Han said.
Through these words, he expressed a strong confidence.𝘧𝓇ℯ𝑒𝓌𝑒𝑏𝓃𝘰𝘷𝘦𝘭.𝒸ℴ𝓂
What force was the Pang Clan?
Core Formation Tier-level.
Thus, to destroy the Pang Clan, the cultivation level of Core Formation Tier would naturally be needed, and how many more years could the Pang Clan have left to live? More than ten
years.
In other words, Ling Han was confident that he could advance into the Core Formation Tier within ten years.

If others knew this, they would definitely say that he was too conceited. What Core Formation Tier cultivator hadn’t reached this level when they were several hundred years old? To complete such a leap in just over a dozen years, wasn’t that too conceited?
Ling Han patted that person’s shoulder, “Take care.”
After saying this, he leaped into the distance.

The person from the Pang Clan instantly collapsed onto the ground. His name was Pang Feiran, and in the Pang Clan, he could not be considered a prodigy, but being able to advance into Celestial Path was naturally already very impressive.
“Did you all see and hear that?” he asked, his voice carrying a sobbing tone.
Just now, he had activated the recording function of the connecting device. Everything he saw and heard would be simultaneously transmitted to the Pang Clan.
At first, this was to allow the members of the Pang Clan to witness the death of their enemy, but they had never imagined that things would actually develop in the opposite direction.

On the other side, the Pang Clan had naturally exploded long ago. Previously, they had taken the video, and allowed their own juniors to watch through the projection. They naturally had to participate in such a matter to vent their anger. Just when Pang Feiran was crippled, the Pang Clan had already gone to inform the Cauldron Forging Tiers and the only Core Formation Tier elite in the Clan, their Ancestor.
In a virtual space of the Galaxy Network, the members of the Pang Clan were all seated, their expressions cold, extremely furious.
“Who can tell me why that brat has such high battle prowess?” The Core Formation Tier grand elder of the Pang Clan slammed his hand on the table, so angry that even his beard was
trembling.
This brat had already caused the Pang Clan to lose two Foundation Building Tier cultivators. One was killed, and the other was crippled. If Pang Yunfei was taken into account as well,
there would be a total of three people.
How many Celestial Path elites did the Pang Clan have in total?

Everyone was speechless. Previously, Ling Han was only an Enlightenment Tier, but how much time had passed? Not only had he advanced into the Foundation Building Tier, he could even easily insta-kill an Ultimate Dao Foundation cultivator.

One of them revealed a focused expression, then opened his mouth and said, “I just received news that the despicable brat is a member of the Political Hostage Manor. His name is Ling Han, and he comes from the Celestial Sea Planet’s Dark North Nation. Previously, he even concocted the Foundation Dissolution Pill in the Saint Pill Hall, and became an alchemist there. He is greatly revered.”
“What!” Everyone exclaimed in shock.
This brat was actually an alchemist? No, no, no, was he an alchemist prodigy?
“So what if you are an alchemy prodigy? Since you are a great enemy of our Pang Clan, your only fate would be destruction,” the ancestor of the Pang Clan said balefully.
Everyone’s discussions stopped one after another, and they all nodded.
Ling Han had also made his stand clear. He wanted to destroy the Pang Clan. The two sides
were already in a situation where neither side would rest until the other was dead.

“We definitely can’t give this brat any more room to grow,” a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator from the Pang Clan said. His name was Pang Tong, and he was Pang Feiran’s grandfather. Thus, he was naturally even more resentful of Ling Han.

“That’s right.” Another white-haired elder nodded. “That despicable brat is ab alchemy prodigy. If he becomes an Earth Tier alchemist, then as long as he stands and raises a hand, there would definitely be a great many True Self Tier elites willing to work for him. At that time, our Pang Clan would really be in danger.”
“But our Pang Clan does not have any force in the Imperial Capital, so what can we do to
him?” One of them raised the most realistic question.
The Pang Clan was not even in the Imperial Capital.
“Go and ask the Tang Clan for help,” the ancestor of the Pang Clan suddenly said. “In the past,

the Tang Clan was once a member of the Pang Clan. When the Pang Clan declined, the Tang Clan’s ancestors traveled to the Imperial Capital. Although there hasn’t been much improvement, there are still elites at the Core Formation Tier. I’ll ask the Tang Clan for help and have them send elites to kill that despicable brat.”

If he becomes an Earth Tier alchemist, then as long as he stands and raises a hand, there would definitely be a great many True Self Tier elites willing to work for him.
At that time, our Pang Clan would really be in danger.”
“But our Pang Clan does not have any force in the Imperial Capital, so what can we do to
him?” One of them raised the most realistic question.
The Pang Clan was not even in the Imperial Capital.
“Go and ask the Tang Clan for help,” the ancestor of the Pang Clan suddenly said.
“In the past,
the Tang Clan was once a member of the Pang Clan.
When the Pang Clan declined, the Tang Clan’s ancestors traveled to the Imperial Capital.
Although there hasn’t been much improvement, there are still elites at the Core Formation Tier.
I’ll ask the Tang Clan for help and have them send elites to kill that despicable brat.”

chapters.title: Chapter 3760: Revenge
paragraphs: Chapter 3760: Revenge
The members of the Pang Clan all nodded, but their expressions were very solemn.

The Tang Clan owed the Pang Clan a favor, so as long as the Pang Clan spoke up, and that was only to deal with a Foundation Building cultivator, the Tang Clan would definitely be too embarrassed to say no.

However, favors would be decreased every time they were used. In the future, if they wanted to trouble the Tang Clan to do something for them, it would not be something that could be done with just a word.
“Detestable brat!” The elites of the Pang Clan said hatefully.

“Go and retrieve Feiran first.” The ancestor of the Pang Clan continued, “If the conditions permit, we will capture him alive. I have a premonition that there may be a colossal secret hidden on that brat. This time may be a turning point for our Pang Clan.”
Hearing these words, the members of the Pang Clan finally showed an expression of delight.
That’s right. Ling Han’s strength was a little inconceivable. This boy must be hiding an astonishing secret. If the Pang Clan could obtain it, the Pang Clan might be able to profit from
this misfortune.
“We definitely can’t let the Tang Clan know about Ling Han.”
“En, then ask them to capture him alive. Even if they can’t capture him alive, they have to get the corpse back.”

They all chattered among themselves, appearing to be very excited. However, they had forgotten one thing, and that was Ling Han himself was in the Jia Yuan Manor. Even if it was the Tang Clan, would they dare charge into the Jia Yuan Manor to commit murder and
kidnapping?
This was practically a great humiliation to the Majestic Empire of the Meng Clan. Just thinking about it, the Tang Clan would not dare to do such a thing.
They were only repaying a favor, so how could they be willing to involve their clan in this matter?
…𝑓𝓇𝘦ℯ𝘸𝘦𝑏𝓃𝑜𝘷ℯ𝑙.𝑐𝑜𝓂
Ling Han returned to Jia Yuan Manor. At this time, there was still some time until midnight. He stood at the door for a while before stepping into the manor.
Though Tang Yan had promised that he would soon get him out of here, that was a matter for the future, after all.
Ling Han returned to his quarters. He had not even gone to rest, when he heard a servant report that Liu Xunyu was requesting an audience.
En, so late?
Ling Han pondered for a moment, before saying, “Show her in.”
He sat down in the living room, and in a short while, he saw a servant leading Liu Xunyu over.
“Greetings, Captain Liu.” Ling Han stood up and clasped his hands in greeting.
Liu Xunyu smiled beautifully, “How does it feel to be free?”
“Very good.” Ling Han nodded. Indeed, those who had not lost their freedom could not imagine how precious freedom was.
Liu Xunyu was very satisfied with Ling Han’s answer, and asked again, “Then do you want to continue possessing your freedom?”
Ling Han’s eyes twitched. What was the meaning of this?
“As long as you sincerely work for me, I can guarantee that you will be granted the privilege of going out for a day every month,” Liu Xunyu said slowly, having a strong confidence in herself.
For people like them who had lost their freedom, they had a short taste of freedom, and their yearning for freedom naturally surpassed all else.
This was a massive temptation. Liu Xunyu did not believe that Ling Han would be able to resist.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “What is considered sincere?”

“Concoct ten Foundation Dissolution Pills for me every day.” Liu Xunyu finally revealed her true colors, “Don’t worry about medicinal ingredients. I will prepare them for you. You only have to concoct alchemical pills.”
For her, the Foundation Dissolution Pill was too useful.

She had no plans to sell it, but rather wanted to use it to befriend those true second- generation young masters and enter into the highest social circle in the Imperial Capital. Ling Han shook his head, “Apologies, I am unable to accept this condition!”
Liu Xunyu smiled faintly, and did not seem to be angry, as she asked, “Then what if the conditions include me?”
‘Hmm?’
Ling Han looked at Liu Xunyu in surprise. What was the meaning of this?
“As long as you work for me, I am yours,” Liu Xunyu said in a seductive tone, her peach blossom eyes seeming to be covered with a layer of mist.

Ling Han seemed to understand slightly. Why was it that it was she who had become the leader when there were clearly two Cauldron Forging Tiers here? Furthermore, they were all hostages, so what right did she have to fight for a chance for everyone to have a day of freedom? Previously, she had even said that as long as Ling Han listened to her, he could go out once a month.
-Was she the one who owned the Clan Mansion?
She was only a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator. On the Moonlight Planet, such a person couldn’t even be regarded as an elite, so how could she be so confident?
However, if one used beauty as bait, it would be a different story.
So dirty.
Ling Han felt disgusted, and said calmly, “Please behave yourself.”
Liu Xunyu was surprised. She had not thought that Ling Han would actually reject her.

It should be known that firstly, she was a beauty among beauties in the first place, and secondly, they were all imprisoned here, and could not come into contact with women. How could it be that they would make a move on those forty-year-old aunties?
Now, she was willing to take the initiative to throw herself into his arms, and you are actually not the slightest bit moved?
“I’m at the Cauldron Forging Tier. Have you played around with women who are at the same cultivation level as me?” Liu Xunyu tried to tempt him.

Ling Han scoffed. This woman still had the face to say that she was a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator? She was practically a prost!tute that was still trying her best to promote herself. “I’m going to rest now. Please leave.” He stood up and walked straight to his bedroom. Liu Xunyu did not move, but her pretty face had become incredibly cold.
She had been rejected, she had actually been rejected!
This was something that had never happened before. Furthermore, the person who had rejected her was actually only a Foundation Building Tier cultivator.

“Humph, if it was not for the fact that you still have value to exploit, just because you have humiliated me, I will not spare you!” she said through gritted teeth, “From tomorrow onwards, you will know the consequences of opposing me. I don’t know how long you can last,”
She humphed, and strode off.
The next morning, Ling Han started to cultivate under the sunlight.
He discovered that cultivating under the sunlight would speed up his advancement slightly, though it was only a slight bit.
Under the sunlight, the energy of heaven and earth would be even more energetic. However, this had never shown when he had been cultivating before.

Could it be that this was because he had switched to cultivating the Ancient Sun Divine Scroll? After Ling Han finished cultivating, a servant came to find him, his expression very ugly. “Young Master Han, I didn’t get the cultivation resources today. I didn’t even get the food for
three meals a day,” he said.
Yi, it had come so quickly?
Ling Han knew that he had rejected Liu Xunyu, and would definitely suffer her revenge, but he had not thought that it would come so quickly.
Hehe, she had the right to distribute resources in her hands, and she was just going to misuse it?
Ling Han nodded, “I understand.”
“Young Master Han,” the servant couldn’t help but say. “Why don’t you lower your head to
Lady Liu? I heard that Lady Liu has an extremely good relationship with a mighty figure of the
Clan Mansion.”
Ling Han frowned upon hearing this. Since when had those close to him become lobbyists?
“You may leave.” He waved his hand.
“Han-“The servant still wanted to persuade him further.
“Leave!” Ling Han’s voice became harsh.
The servant was exasperated, and could only step back. However, the gaze he directed at Ling
Han was clearly filled with displeasure.
-You are a Foundation Building Tier, and as long as you absorb the energy of heaven and earth, you would not die, but what about us? We are only mortals, and without food, what
would they eat!
He left resentfully. He was going to join forces with the other two servants to go on strike.

chapters.title: Chapter 3761: Tang Yan is here
paragraphs: Chapter 3761: Tang Yan is here

Ling Han wasn’t worried about the cultivation resources. He knew how to refine pills himself, and there was no shortage of Dao Stones either. Thus, he didn’t need to worry about Liu Xunyu docking his cultivation resources, at least not for the time being.𝑓𝘳𝑒𝑒𝓌𝘦𝘣𝘯ℴ𝑣𝘦𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝑚
To say the least, even if Tang Yan did not manage to get him out of here after so long, he would still be able to obtain what he wanted through the large black dog.
The morning passed very quickly. When it was close to mealtime, Han Bing barged in boldly.
He had really barged in. Without any notification from his servant, he had forcefully barged in just like that, extremely domineering.
“Brat, seeing as you have refused, I won’t hit you today,” Han Han said coldly. “However, you actually not doing as commanded has made me very unhappy. What should be done?”
The first sentence was very contradictory, and when combined with the second sentence, it became even stranger.

Ling Han thought for a moment, then understood. This Han Bing should be in a relationship with Liu Xunyu, so when he refused to become Liu Xunyu’s patron, his jealousy naturally subsided considerably. However, he and Liu Xunyu were on the same team in terms of benefits. Him rejecting Liu Xunyu was equivalent to rejecting him, so Han Bing was still displeased.
“Your circle is really chaotic,” Ling Han said sincerely.

This Han Bing was definitely not Liu Xunyu’s only lover. Judging by the fact that Liu Xunyu did not mind using her physical body just to make a Foundation Building cultivator work for her, it was clear how loose this woman was.
“Ling Han, are you seeking death?” Han Bing raised his voice, looking furious.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “We’re all hostages. We’re brothers in distress, so what’s there to be smug about? If you can, go outside and shout a few times.”
Why should I go outside and shout?

Han Bing felt an urge to rush up and beat Ling Han up, but when he recalled how he had just said that he would not hit anyone today, he couldn’t help but feel depressed. If he had known that this person would not know what was good for him, he would not have sealed his path.
No, if they continued to converse like this, he would go crazy.
“Humph!” He flicked his sleeves and left. The next time he came, he would definitely beat Ling Han to a pulp.
Ling Han’s expression was cold. He was the one being bullied, so why did it seem like Han Bing was the one who had been wronged?
‘Tang Yan, you have to hurry up and get me out of this place.’

However, there were still some worrying matters. In the afternoon, Ling Han had the large black dog buy some ingredients for the Foundation Dissolution Pill for him. In the end, the large black dog was actually stopped. Then, Ling Han was told that as long as it was related to a hostage, even if a mosquito flew in or out, it would have to obtain the approval of the Clan Mansion.
Hehe, why hadn’t he mentioned this a few days ago?
This was naturally Liu Xunyu’s tricks.
Ling Han didn’t argue. He simply had the large black dog put on the Void Beast hide, and quietly exited the Political Hostage Manor.

-If a Foundation Building cultivator were to wear the hide of a Void Beast, then even if a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator was here, it would be very difficult to discover it unless he was particularly close.
The large black dog successfully entered and exited, buying ingredients for Ling Han. However, Ling Han had already become extremely, extremely displeased.
The day passed just like that, and the following days were still the same. Ling Han was strictly confined in the Political Hostage Manor, and continued to have no food or cultivation resources.
Ling Han could endure it, but his servants were all mortals. After barely enduring for three days, they all fled, unwilling to work at his place any longer.

Hadn’t they come here to reap some benefits, so that they could have a chance to break through to the Celestial Path in the future? But now, it was great. The master that they had followed could barely protect himself. He was so poor that he was about to starve them to death, so what was the point of talking about the Celestial Path?
These three people weren’t prisoners, so they naturally could leave as they pleased. Worse come to worst, they could just leave without being paid any wages.
Right now, Ling Han was nothing but a joke in the Political Hostage Manor. Even his servants had fled. As a master, he was truly a failure.

Unfortunately, they did not know that Ling Han knew how to concoct alchemical pills, nor did they know that Ling Han had already gained some fame in the Imperial Capital. After all, the area covered by the Galaxy Network was too large. What was the little incident that had happened on the Moonlight Planet worth in the Galaxy Network?
Liu Xunyu came over again. She smiled faintly at Ling Han, “Have you changed your mind?”

Ling Han ignored her completely. This kind of woman who could be with as many men as she liked was really disgusting. He felt that even taking a second look at her was dirtying his eyes. Liu Xunyu did not force him, and merely revealed a proud expression, “So what if you have natural talent in alchemy? Without the ingredients for you to cast your talent, you would be a cripple. Even if you have outstanding natural talent in martial arts, without cultivation resources, and merely depend on yourself to draw on the power of heaven and earth, you would soon fall from the ranks of prodigies and in the very end, disappear among the masses.”
“Whenever you’ve thought it through, come find me again. The conditions I offer are still valid.”
She turned around and left, leaving Ling Han with an enchanting back view, swaying her hips gently, her grace boundless.
How could Ling Han pay any heed to her? Even without Tang Yan, there was no way he would submit. Worse come to worst, he could just summon the Heavenly Dao Flames, and he would make a big fuss first.
Speaking of which, where the hell had Tang Yan gone?
Another day passed.
Tang Clan.

“Brother Pang, it’s not that we don’t want to help, but that person is in the Political Hostage Manor. If we forcefully barge in and kill him, that would be equivalent to making an enemy of the Meng Clan,” a middle-aged man with a large belly complained to Pang Feiran.

Pang Feiran shook his head, “Brother Tang Ming, you have misunderstood. What Ancestor means is that he hopes that the Tang Clan can mobilize elites of Cauldron Forging Tier, and stand guard around the Political Hostage Manor. Once that despicable brat leaves the manor, they would immediately move and apprehend him.”

The middle-aged man with the big belly was called Tang Ming. He was also a Foundation Building Tier like Pang Feiran, but the present Pang Feiran was already a cripple. If it was not for the fact that he had the Pang Clan’s background, Tang Ming would definitely not be calling
him brother.
“Alright, since the ancestor of the Pang Clan has said so, we will definitely help.” Tang Ming nodded, as if he had made an extremely difficult decision.
Pang Feiran naturally knew that this expression was just for show, and also meant that from now onwards, the Tang Clan would no longer owe the Pang Clan anything.

He smirked coldly in his mind. It was just capturing a Foundation Building cultivator, and he had already done them a favor. Yet, they were acting as if they had been taken advantage of. Humph, they were truly taking advantage of the Pang Clan’s decline. Otherwise, how could the Tang Clan dare to disobey the Spirit Transformation True Lord from the Pang Clan?
‘Just you wait. If the Pang Clan obtains a precious technique from Ling Han and rises again, I’ll definitely let your Tang Clan know what regret is.’
The scene switched to Jia Yuan Manor.
A tall, slender, and incredibly handsome man was presently striding over. He was striding boldly, and though he was only one person, he actually gave rise to a powerful aura that even
an army of thousands could not compare to.
Tang Yan had come.
This Little Marquis never brought any servants with him when he came and went. In any case,
in this Imperial Capital, he only needed to show his face. There were many people who would
flatter him.
“Stop right there! Jia Yuan Manor doesn’t allow trespassers!” the guard at the door
immediately shouted.
Tang Yan’s expression involuntarily darkened, and his aura immediately crumbled.
Didn’t he say that it was fine as long as he showed his face?

Liu Xunyu did not force him, and merely revealed a proud expression, “So what if you have natural talent in alchemy?
Without the ingredients for you to cast your talent, you would be a cripple.

Even if you have outstanding natural talent in martial arts, without cultivation resources, and merely depend on yourself to draw on the power of heaven and earth, you would soon fall from the ranks of prodigies and in the very end, disappear among the masses.”
“Whenever you’ve thought it through, come find me again.
The conditions I offer are still valid.”
She turned around and left, leaving Ling Han with an enchanting back view, swaying her hips gently, her grace boundless.
How could Ling Han pay any heed to her?
Even without Tang Yan, there was no way he would submit.
Worse come to worst, he could just summon the Heavenly Dao Flames, and he would make a big fuss first.
Speaking of which, where the hell had Tang Yan gone?
Another day passed.
Tang Clan.
“Brother Pang, it’s not that we don’t want to help, but that person is in the Political Hostage Manor.
If we forcefully barge in and kill him, that would be equivalent to making an enemy of the Meng Clan,” a middle-aged man with a large belly complained to Pang Feiran.
Pang Feiran shook his head, “Brother Tang Ming, you have misunderstood.
What Ancestor means is that he hopes that the Tang Clan can mobilize elites of Cauldron Forging Tier, and stand guard around the Political Hostage Manor.
Once that despicable brat leaves the manor, they would immediately move and apprehend him.”
The middle-aged man with the big belly was called Tang Ming.
He was also a Foundation Building Tier like Pang Feiran, but the present Pang Feiran was already a cripple.
If it was not for the fact that he had the Pang Clan’s background, Tang Ming would definitely not be calling
him brother.
“Alright, since the ancestor of the Pang Clan has said so, we will definitely help.” Tang Ming nodded, as if he had made an extremely difficult decision.
Pang Feiran naturally knew that this expression was just for show, and also meant that from now onwards, the Tang Clan would no longer owe the Pang Clan anything.
He smirked coldly in his mind.
It was just capturing a Foundation Building cultivator, and he had already done them a favor.
Yet, they were acting as if they had been taken advantage of.
Humph, they were truly taking advantage of the Pang Clan’s decline.
Otherwise, how could the Tang Clan dare to disobey the Spirit Transformation True Lord from the Pang Clan?
‘Just you wait.
If the Pang Clan obtains a precious technique from Ling Han and rises again, I’ll definitely let your Tang Clan know what regret is.’
The scene switched to Jia Yuan Manor.
A tall, slender, and incredibly handsome man was presently striding over.
He was striding boldly, and though he was only one person, he actually gave rise to a powerful aura that even
an army of thousands could not compare to.
Tang Yan had come.
This Little Marquis never brought any servants with him when he came and went.
In any case,
in this Imperial Capital, he only needed to show his face.
There were many people who would
flatter him.
“Stop right there!
Jia Yuan Manor doesn’t allow trespassers!” the guard at the door
immediately shouted.
Tang Yan’s expression involuntarily darkened, and his aura immediately crumbled.
Didn’t he say that it was fine as long as he showed his face?

chapters.title: Chapter 3762: Try dodging again
paragraphs: Chapter 3762: Try dodging again
“I am Tang Yan,” Tang Yan said darkly.

“And my name is Liu Yan!” the guard retorted. This was the Political Hostage Manor. He was a guard of the Political Hostage Manor, which meant that he was a member of the Imperial Court. Even if he encountered the Young Masters of some minor clans, he would still dare to rebuke them. Who would dare to make a move on a member of the Imperial Court? Were they planning to rebel?
Pa!

He had just finished his words, when the guard was slapped. He turned around, wanting to rebuke him, but when he saw the appearance of that person, he immediately cowered, and said with a charming smile, “Leader.”

The person who had hit him was the leader of the guards, and also the only Foundation Building cultivator. His face was all smiles, and it was as if flowers were about to bloom. He paid no heed to his underling, and merely smiled apologetically at Tang Yan, “Young Lord Marquis, this guy has just joined the army. He’s just a country bumpkin, so he doesn’t have much insight. Please don’t take it to heart.”
What!
The guard couldn’t help but pale in shock. “Little Marquis”? There was only one Little Marquis in the Imperial Capital, and that was the son of the Tang Clan, Tang Yan.
He couldn’t help but tremble in fear. If Tang Yan wanted to target him, he wouldn’t even know that he had died.
Tang Yan’s expression did not change, and merely asked, “I can’t enter?”

“Of course you can, of course,” the leader of the guards hurriedly said with a smile. To say nothing of the Political Hostage Manor, even if it was the Clan Manor, this little marquis would probably dare to barge in.
Tang Yan flicked his sleeves and strode into the Political Hostage Manor.
Only then did the guard heave a sigh of relief, feeling cold sweat on his back.
The Little Marquis’s aura was really frightening, he thought to himself.
However, why had this person suddenly come to the Political Hostage Manor?
“Ling Han!”

A shout came from outside the door. Ling Han had just finished cultivating not too long ago. After so many days, he was about to cultivate Heavenly Dao Foundation to Consummate level. The gap between the second Celestial Foundation and the first was not too big, and he would be able to reach Consummate level in about another ten days or so.

Thus, he was in a good mood. When he was a Heavenly Dao Foundation, he was already able to sweep aside all other Ultimate Dao Foundations. Then, after he advanced into Ultimate Dao Foundation, would he be able to match Cauldron Forging Tier?
Even if it was only the weakest Cauldron Forging Tier.
However, when this shout rang out, it greatly affected Ling Han’s good mood.
Without any servants, Ling Han could only go out. He opened the doors, and saw Liu Xunyu, Han Bing and Zhao Xiao were standing outside, all of them looking at him coldly.
“What is it? You’re here to see me so early?” Ling Han asked calmly.

“It hasn’t been easy these past few days, has it?” Liu Xunyu smiled faintly, “Without the service of servants, without cultivation resources, and without ingredients to concoct alchemical pills, this is what a real prisoner is like.”
Ling Han smiled and said, “It’s very quiet, so there’s no need to worry.”

“You’re just pretending!” Han Bing said coldly. “We don’t have that much patience to wait for you either. You only have two choices today. Either you listen to us obediently, or… we’ll add a scene of us beating you up every day on this basis!”
“I know that you’re invincible in the Foundation Building Tier, but in front of three of us Cauldron Forging Tier cultivators, what are you worth?” Zhao Xiao’s expression was also cold.

“To say nothing else, once our Celestial Cauldron appears, even standing is a luxury for you.” Han Bing continued. He released his own Celestial Cauldron, which appeared above his head. Then, it enlarged. Weng, the bronze Celestial Cauldron was ancient and filled with holiness.

The Cauldron Forging Tier was divided into three minor levels-Human Cauldron, Earth Cauldron, and Heaven Cauldron. It was very easy to distinguish. Human Cauldron was a single cauldron, Earth Cauldron was two, and Heaven Cauldron was three.

However, it was said that this wasn’t the limit of the Cauldron Forging Tier. It was just like how an Enlightenment Tier could break through to Mystery Realm Tier after opening at least thirty-six apertures. Cultivating three cauldrons was indeed enough to break through to the Core Formation Tier. However, a Cauldron Forging Tier elite could also cultivate four cauldrons, five cauldrons… or even nine cauldrons.

Since ancient times, those who could form four cauldrons could be called prodigies. Eight cauldrons was a supreme prodigy, and as for nine cauldrons… hoho, there may not even be one in hundreds of thousands of years. This kind of person possessed the potential to become a Saint.
Han Bing had summoned a cauldron, which meant that he was only standing on the first stage of the Cauldron Forging Tier, the Human Cauldron Tier.
Furthermore, his cauldron only had two legs, which meant that he had not cultivated to Consummate level even in Human Cauldron Tier – Consummate level was three legs.
Where had the Celestial Cauldron come from?

That was the foundations of the Celestial Path. Thus, the Celestial Cauldron looked like bronze, silver, or gold. They were all directly related to the foundations of the Celestial Path that had been formed after leaping over the Celestial Gate.
His Celestial Cauldron was bronze. Hehe, this was the weakest Celestial Cauldron.
However, wasn’t it a one-sided suppression for a Cauldron Forging Tier to face against a Foundation Building Tier?
Ling Han stood upright and proud. Not even the corner of his robes fluttered.
Yi?
Liu Xunyu and the others were all surprised. How was this possible? The Celestial Cauldron actually had no effect on a Foundation Building Tier at all?
No matter how weak the Celestial Cauldron was, it was still a Celestial Foundation. In terms of Celestial Path, it was superior to the Foundation Building Tier.
“Something’s off!” Zhao Xiao said, his eyes burning with greed.

He was sure that Ling Han must be hiding an astonishing secret. Merely that Starlight Screen was enough to make his eyes red with envy, and now added with the fact that Ling Han was unafraid of the Celestial Cauldron’s suppression, it further convinced him that it was very possible that Ling Han had obtained the inheritance of an ancient elite.
“If you don’t listen… I’ll apprehend you directly!” He strode towards Ling Han, wanting to apprehend Ling Han at the first instant and directly search his soul.
This involved the problem of strengthening himself. He naturally cast Liu Xunyu aside, and placed himself first.

Ling Han was solemn. He had not yet advanced into Ultimate Dao Foundation, and was not even qualified to match the weakest Cauldron Forging Tier – even if he had advanced into Ultimate Dao Foundation, whether he could match the Cauldron Forging Tier would only be known after a battle.
Could it be that he would have to use the Heavenly Dao Flames?

Ling Han was slightly depressed. His trump card was really too high-level, being able to burn Venerate Tier elites to death at the drop of a hat. Could it be that there was no trump card that just happened to be enough to deal with Cauldron Forging Tier?
“Humph, what do you want to do?” A cold laugh rang out, bringing with it a baleful chill.
Tang Yan!
When Ling Han saw this, he couldn’t help but smile. Very good, there was no need for him to
reveal his trump card.
“Who do you think you are!” Han Bing rebuked directly.
Liu Xunyu also took a look, and couldn’t help but pale.
Unlike Han Bing and Zhao Xiao, she was a smooth-talker, and had extremely great ambitions.

Thus, she had some understanding of those important heirs of the Azure Dragon Empire, as well as the descendants of the various great clans. Even if she had never met them before, she would definitely have seen their images before. It was not to the extent that she would not recognize them even if they had met.

This was Tang Yan, a top-notch existence among the second-generation young masters of the Majestic Empire. He had been conferred a title of nobility at birth, and this kind of prestige was also unique in the Azure Dragon Empire.
“Shut up!” Liu Xunyu hurriedly rebuked, “This is Young Marquis Tang Yan, don’t be
impudent!”
When Han Bing heard this, his heart instantly trembled. He had never seen Tang Yan, but he
must have heard of such a person in the Imperial Capital.
“I’m sorry, Little Marquis.” He hurriedly put on a humble attitude.
Tang Yan strode over, and suddenly raised his hand, delivering a slap at Han Bing.
Instinctively, Han Bing hurriedly turned his head to the side to dodge.
Tang Yan’s palm missed its target, and a baleful expression appeared on his face as he said,
“Try dodging again?”
After saying this, he raised his hand again.

chapters.title: Chapter 3763: Tang Yan’s Rage
paragraphs: Chapter 3763: Tang Yan’s Rage

Han Bing couldn’t help but feel angered as well. Though he was a hostage, he was not a prisoner in the true meaning of the word. Furthermore, those that could be hostages were all very important figures in a force. It was very possible that they were princesses, Imperial Princes or the like. Now that someone wanted to slap him, he had to stand up straight and let the other party slap him a little easier. How could that be reasonable?
“Han Bing!” Liu Xunyu called out loudly.
Han Bing’s heart trembled. Liu Xunyu had a very strong influence on him.
Thus, he had initially planned to dodge, but in the end, he still did not move. Pa, a crisp slap landed on his face.
Hiss, how domineering.
Zhao Xiao saw this, and couldn’t help but grimace internally. He was also glad that he had not spoken. Otherwise, this kind of treatment would probably be unavoidable.
However, it was too early for him to feel happy.
Tang Yan had already strode towards him, and as for Han Bing, he was already ignoring him.. Yi, what do you want to do?
Zhao Xiao was slightly flustered. ‘Why are you walking towards me? Why are you so close? F*ck!’
He had not even finished this thought, when he saw Tang Yan raise his hand again.
‘What? I didn’t offend you, so why did you slap me?’
Shua, when Tang Yan delivered a slap, Zhao Xiao hurriedly dodged quickly. Even if Liu Xunyu shouted at him, he would definitely not allow anyone to slap his face.
-He was not a guy with weak willpower like Han Bing, and was completely dominated by Liu Xunyu.𝕗𝐫𝚎𝗲𝘄𝐞𝕓𝐧𝕠𝘃𝕖𝐥.𝐜𝚘𝚖

However, Tang Yan was serious this time. With a single palm strike, he immediately launched a series of attacks, unleashing his celestial aura without any reservations. Peng, peng, peng! A great many holes immediately appeared in the surrounding walls.
“You’ve gone too far!” Zhao Xiao roared in fury. He went all out, battling fiercely with Tang Yan.
Tang Yan was neither enraged nor shocked, pressing forwards with every move. In just a few moves, Zhao Xiao was completely at a disadvantage.
The gap in strength between the two of them was too wide, and very soon, Zhao Xiao had lost all ability to resist, and was beaten up madly by Tang Yan.
What made Zhao Xiao even more depressed was the fact that he had absolutely no idea why Tang Yan had hit him.
He had clearly not said anything to offend the other party. Furthermore, Han Bing had only suffered a slap, but he had been completely thrashed.
Oh, the person who scolded you had only suffered a slap, but the person who had not scolded you had been given a good thrashing. What kind of logic was that?
Liu Xunyu naturally could not bear to watch any longer, and hurriedly advised, “Little Marquis, may I know how Zhao Xiao has offended you?”
Tang Yan stopped what he was doing, gave an ‘oh’, and said, “So this person’s name is Zhao Xiao?”
‘F*ck you!’
Zhao Xiao really wanted to cry. You don’t even know my name, and you have already thrashed me so harshly. How wronged am I?
Peng!
Tang Yan’s fist fell, and he began to pummel Zhao Xiao again. Zhao Xiao screamed in pain. Aside from not delivering a fatal strike, he had really pummeled him quite harshly.

It was only when he was tired from the beating that he clapped his hands and stopped. Then, he said slowly, “Do you know why you only suffered a slap, yet he has to be beaten by me?” he asked Han Bing.
‘There’s probably something wrong with your brain.’
Han Bing mumbled internally, but he would definitely not say it out loud. In fact, he did not even open his mouth to speak.

Tang Yan did not want him to answer either, and immediately gave an answer, “Because you have offended me, I will just slap you, and give you a light punishment. But if you have offended my friend, hoho, then I will definitely not be reserved!”
What friend?
An inconceivable guess instantly rose up in Liu Xunyu’s heart, but how was this possible?
Ling Han had clearly only been out for a day, so how could he possibly have a relationship with the Little Marquis, Tang Yan?
The two of them were not from the same world at all!
“Ling Han, it’s been a few days.” Tang Yan greeted Ling Han.
F***, that really was the case.

Liu Xunyu, Han Bing and Zhao Xiao’s hearts jolted. This was not going to be easy. Tang Yan was actually friends with Ling Han, and this kind of person could not even be controlled by the Clan Mansion, so how were they supposed to oppose him?
Would they still be able to bully Ling Han in future?

Liu Xunyu felt even more regretful. If she had known earlier, even if Ling Han won, she would have deprived Ling Han of the chance to go out. Now, what could she do? He actually had a relationship with the Little Marquis, Tang Yan. Who would dare touch a single hair on his head?

But now, it was not the problem of how they were going to deal with Ling Han in future, but rather how they were going to deal with the fury of this Little Marquis if Tang Yan wanted to seek vengeance for Ling Han.
Tang Yan glanced at Liu Xunyu again, and said, “You should feel fortunate that I do not hit women! All of you, get lost!”
Liu Xunyu and the others did not even dare to fart, as they all turned around and left.

Firstly, they were hostages, and were far too inferior to the Little Marquis, who was very influential. Secondly, Tang Yan was at least an Earth Cauldron. Even if the three of them worked together, they would still be no match for Tang Yan.
Then what was the point of not leaving?
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Thank you.”
“What are you thanking me for? Are you treating me like an outsider?” Tang Yan asked,
pretending to be displeased.

“Haha, come, please come in. I’ll make you a cup of Silver Phoenix Tea, the specialty of the Celestial Sea Planet.” Ling Han led him into the house. Though the outer walls were already in shambles, but thankfully, the inside of the house was not damaged.

He returned with two cups of tea. Tang Yan picked up the cup and took a sniff, and couldn’t help but say, “The fragrance of the tea wafts over. Needless to say, the taste of this tea is definitely excellent.”
After taking a sip, he revealed a nostalgic expression, and remained silent for a long time.
He soon finished his cup of tea, and Ling Han picked up the teapot to refill his cup.
“Yi, where are your servants here?” Tang Yan asked in surprise.
“They ran,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“How could they have possibly left?” Tang Yan was even more confused.
Ling Han recounted how his cultivation resources had been docked, causing Tang Yan’s
expression to gradually darken.

“Who would’ve thought? So it turns out that woman is the main culprit!” Tang Yan said with a humph. He was a chauvinist, and he believed that women were the subordinates of men. Thus, he had instinctively believed that Zhao Xiao and Han Bing were the masterminds. “Just bear with it for a few more days. I have more or less established relations, and in a few days, you will be able to move out of Jia Yuan Manor.” He continued, “As for that Liu Xunyu, humph, I will let her suffer the consequences of her own actions.”
Ling Han nodded, but didn’t say thank you. This was a huge favor, and he kept it in mind.
“Come, let’s go out for a walk,” Tang Yan said with a smile.
“Sure,” Ling Han said with a nod.
The two of them walked side by side. When they exited Jia Yuan Manor, the guards at the entrance obviously saw them, but deliberately pretended to be blind.
-Logically speaking, they should have stopped Ling Han from going out, but Tang Yan was right beside them, so how could they possibly dare?
And not too far away, Pang Feiran suddenly became excited.

“Senior Tang Hong, it’s that brat!” he said, pointing at Ling Han. At this moment, he was standing beside the window of a tall building with an old man with a hooked nose. Tang Hong nodded, and was just about to make a move, but when he saw Tang Yan, he was shocked, and his movements naturally came to an abrupt halt.
Pang Feiran, however, did not recognize Tang Yan, because Pang Clan’s base was not here. He

had also come to the Imperial Capital because he had some matters to attend to, and had not come especially for Ling Han. When he saw that Tang Hong had not made a move, he couldn’t help but feel anxious, and urged, “Senior Tang Hong, that is only a mere Foundation Building cultivator. You can easily apprehend him with a stretch of your hand!”
“Apprehend your sister!” Tang Hong immediately glared at Pang Feiran. If it was not for the fact that the latter was already a cripple, he would definitely have delivered a slap.
“You want to harm me and our Tang Clan, right?” he asked harshly.

Zhao Xiao saw this, and couldn’t help but grimace internally.
He was also glad that he had not spoken.
Otherwise, this kind of treatment would probably be unavoidable.
However, it was too early for him to feel happy.
Tang Yan had already strode towards him, and as for Han Bing, he was already ignoring him..
Yi, what do you want to do?
Zhao Xiao was slightly flustered. ‘Why are you walking towards me?
Why are you so close?
F*ck!’
He had not even finished this thought, when he saw Tang Yan raise his hand again.
‘What?
I didn’t offend you, so why did you slap me?’
Shua, when Tang Yan delivered a slap, Zhao Xiao hurriedly dodged quickly.
Even if Liu Xunyu shouted at him, he would definitely not allow anyone to slap his face.
-He was not a guy with weak willpower like Han Bing, and was completely dominated by Liu Xunyu.𝕗𝐫𝚎𝗲𝘄𝐞𝕓𝐧𝕠𝘃𝕖𝐥.𝐜𝚘𝚖
However, Tang Yan was serious this time.
With a single palm strike, he immediately launched a series of attacks, unleashing his celestial aura without any reservations.
Peng, peng, peng!
A great many holes immediately appeared in the surrounding walls.
“You’ve gone too far!” Zhao Xiao roared in fury.
He went all out, battling fiercely with Tang Yan.
Tang Yan was neither enraged nor shocked, pressing forwards with every move.
In just a few moves, Zhao Xiao was completely at a disadvantage.
The gap in strength between the two of them was too wide, and very soon, Zhao Xiao had lost all ability to resist, and was beaten up madly by Tang Yan.
What made Zhao Xiao even more depressed was the fact that he had absolutely no idea why Tang Yan had hit him.
He had clearly not said anything to offend the other party.
Furthermore, Han Bing had only suffered a slap, but he had been completely thrashed.
Oh, the person who scolded you had only suffered a slap, but the person who had not scolded you had been given a good thrashing.
What kind of logic was that?
Liu Xunyu naturally could not bear to watch any longer, and hurriedly advised, “Little Marquis, may I know how Zhao Xiao has offended you?”
Tang Yan stopped what he was doing, gave an ‘oh’, and said, “So this person’s name is Zhao Xiao?”
‘F*ck you!’
Zhao Xiao really wanted to cry.
You don’t even know my name, and you have already thrashed me so harshly.
How wronged am I?
Peng!
Tang Yan’s fist fell, and he began to pummel Zhao Xiao again.
Zhao Xiao screamed in pain.
Aside from not delivering a fatal strike, he had really pummeled him quite harshly.
It was only when he was tired from the beating that he clapped his hands and stopped.
Then, he said slowly, “Do you know why you only suffered a slap, yet he has to be beaten by me?” he asked Han Bing.
‘There’s probably something wrong with your brain.’
Han Bing mumbled internally, but he would definitely not say it out loud.
In fact, he did not even open his mouth to speak.
Tang Yan did not want him to answer either, and immediately gave an answer, “Because you have offended me, I will just slap you, and give you a light punishment.
But if you have offended my friend, hoho, then I will definitely not be reserved!”
What friend?
An inconceivable guess instantly rose up in Liu Xunyu’s heart, but how was this possible?
Ling Han had clearly only been out for a day, so how could he possibly have a relationship with the Little Marquis, Tang Yan?
The two of them were not from the same world at all!
“Ling Han, it’s been a few days.” Tang Yan greeted Ling Han.
F***, that really was the case.
Liu Xunyu, Han Bing and Zhao Xiao’s hearts jolted.
This was not going to be easy.
Tang Yan was actually friends with Ling Han, and this kind of person could not even be controlled by the Clan Mansion, so how were they supposed to oppose him?
Would they still be able to bully Ling Han in future?
Liu Xunyu felt even more regretful.
If she had known earlier, even if Ling Han won, she would have deprived Ling Han of the chance to go out.
Now, what could she do?
He actually had a relationship with the Little Marquis, Tang Yan.
Who would dare touch a single hair on his head?

But now, it was not the problem of how they were going to deal with Ling Han in future, but rather how they were going to deal with the fury of this Little Marquis if Tang Yan wanted to seek vengeance for Ling Han.
Tang Yan glanced at Liu Xunyu again, and said, “You should feel fortunate that I do not hit women!
All of you, get lost!”
Liu Xunyu and the others did not even dare to fart, as they all turned around and left.
Firstly, they were hostages, and were far too inferior to the Little Marquis, who was very influential.
Secondly, Tang Yan was at least an Earth Cauldron.
Even if the three of them worked together, they would still be no match for Tang Yan.
Then what was the point of not leaving?
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Thank you.”
“What are you thanking me for?
Are you treating me like an outsider?” Tang Yan asked,
pretending to be displeased.
“Haha, come, please come in.
I’ll make you a cup of Silver Phoenix Tea, the specialty of the Celestial Sea Planet.” Ling Han led him into the house.
Though the outer walls were already in shambles, but thankfully, the inside of the house was not damaged.
He returned with two cups of tea.
Tang Yan picked up the cup and took a sniff, and couldn’t help but say, “The fragrance of the tea wafts over.
Needless to say, the taste of this tea is definitely excellent.”
After taking a sip, he revealed a nostalgic expression, and remained silent for a long time.
He soon finished his cup of tea, and Ling Han picked up the teapot to refill his cup.
“Yi, where are your servants here?” Tang Yan asked in surprise.
“They ran,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“How could they have possibly left?” Tang Yan was even more confused.
Ling Han recounted how his cultivation resources had been docked, causing Tang Yan’s
expression to gradually darken.
“Who would’ve thought?
So it turns out that woman is the main culprit!” Tang Yan said with a humph.
He was a chauvinist, and he believed that women were the subordinates of men.
Thus, he had instinctively believed that Zhao Xiao and Han Bing were the masterminds.
“Just bear with it for a few more days.

I have more or less established relations, and in a few days, you will be able to move out of Jia Yuan Manor.” He continued, “As for that Liu Xunyu, humph, I will let her suffer the consequences of her own actions.”
Ling Han nodded, but didn’t say thank you.
This was a huge favor, and he kept it in mind.
“Come, let’s go out for a walk,” Tang Yan said with a smile.
“Sure,” Ling Han said with a nod.
The two of them walked side by side.
When they exited Jia Yuan Manor, the guards at the entrance obviously saw them, but deliberately pretended to be blind.
-Logically speaking, they should have stopped Ling Han from going out, but Tang Yan was right beside them, so how could they possibly dare?
And not too far away, Pang Feiran suddenly became excited.
“Senior Tang Hong, it’s that brat!” he said, pointing at Ling Han.
At this moment, he was standing beside the window of a tall building with an old man with a hooked nose.
Tang Hong nodded, and was just about to make a move, but when he saw Tang Yan, he was shocked, and his movements naturally came to an abrupt halt.
Pang Feiran, however, did not recognize Tang Yan, because Pang Clan’s base was not here.
He
had also come to the Imperial Capital because he had some matters to attend to, and had not come especially for Ling Han.
When he saw that Tang Hong had not made a move, he couldn’t help but feel anxious, and urged, “Senior Tang Hong, that is only a mere Foundation Building cultivator.
You can easily apprehend him with a stretch of your hand!”
“Apprehend your sister!” Tang Hong immediately glared at Pang Feiran.
If it was not for the fact that the latter was already a cripple, he would definitely have delivered a slap.
“You want to harm me and our Tang Clan, right?” he asked harshly.

chapters.title: Chapter 3764: Change
paragraphs: Chapter 3764: Change
What was going on here?
Pang Feiran’s expression was filled with confusion and grievance. When have I harmed you?
Wasn’t it already agreed upon that you would kill Ling Han or capture him alive before handing him over to the Pang Clan? Why didn’t you make a move and instead act as if you were the victim?
“S-Senior Tang Hong, I don’t understand what you’re saying,” he stammered weakly.
“That person, did you see him?” Tang Hong pointed at Tang Yan.
“I saw him.” Pang Feiran nodded. He had only lost his cultivation level, and had not become blind.

Tang Hong was almost angered to death by his words, and he asked coldly, “You’re not blind yet, are you? If you’re not blind, how could it be that you can’t recognize him? Isn’t that the Little Marquis of the Tang Clan?”
What Little Marquis?
Pang Feiran had not done his research in advance, so how could he know who the so-called Little Marquis was?

“Tang Yan, the most outstanding clansman of the younger generation of Tang Clan. He has an Innate Divine Physique. After he was born, he was bestowed the title of Marquis by His Majesty, and you want me to kidnap and kill someone in front of him?” Tang Hong sneered. If he really dared to make a move, the Tang Clan would probably be destroyed by the Tang Clan tomorrow.

Pang Feiran was given a great fright. He did not know Tang Yan, but he definitely knew of the Tang Clan. That was a clan of Spiritual Transformation Tier elites, and was deeply doted on by His Imperial Majesty, so their force was astonishingly powerful.
But this was too inconceivable. He was only a hostage, so how could he possibly be together with the little Marquis of the Tang Clan?𝑓𝘳𝑒𝑒𝓌𝘦𝘣𝘯ℴ𝑣𝘦𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝑚
Now, how was he going to capture Ling Han?
On the other side, Liu Xunyu and the others were all seated in their rooms, all of them wearing cold expressions. Aside from them, there was also Tan Zhengjie.
“Sister, that brat actually became friends with Tang Yan?” Tan Zhengjie still felt like he was in a dream, and could not believe it at all.

Han Bing had been slapped by Tang Yan, and was filled with displeasure. Seeing that Tan Zhengjie was still going to bring this up, he couldn’t help but feel angered. He shouted, “Are you retarded? Otherwise, how could we have suffered such great humiliation?”
“You—” Tan Zhengjie wanted to retort, but when he saw Liu Xunyu’s stopping gaze, he obediently shut his mouth.
“We are all a family, so there is no need for internal strife.” Liu Xunyu stretched out a hand to press down on him.
“But that brat has the protection of the Little Marquis, so how are we supposed to deal with him?” Zhao Xiao said hatefully. He was still coveting Ling Han’s secrets, and was very defiant.
“Don’t worry, I won’t let him leave Jia Yuan Manor,” Liu Xunyu said confidently.
“Oh?” Zhao Xiao and the others all turned to look at her.
That was Tang Yan, the son of the Tang Clan, a proper noble Little Marquis.

Liu Xunyu now had to calm the hearts of the army, so she revealed some secrets, and said, “We indeed have no way to contend with Tang Yan, but Jia Yuan Manor is under the jurisdiction of the Clan Mansion, so no matter how long Tang Yan’s influence is, he would not be able to reach in.”

Zhao Xiao and the others all shook their heads. As long as Tang Yan was willing to be Ling Han’s guarantor, then what big deal would it be to take Ling Han out of Jia Yuan Manor? How could it be that the Clan Mansion was willing to offend Tang Yan?
“Believe me, Tang Yan will not be able to save Ling Han! No one will be able to save him!” Liu Xunyu stated calmly, but her eyes were exuding a coldness, filled with maliciousness.
Two days passed, and Tang Yan came again. However, this time, his expression was a little ugly, as if he was hiding an extremely great fury.
“What is it? Has the sky collapsed?” Ling Han asked smilingly.

Peng, Tang Yan slammed a hand heavily on the table, and said, “Things have changed. Initially, I had already made arrangements. In these two days, the Clan Mansion will send someone over to announce the news that you can leave Jia Yuan Manor, but today, I actually received a letter from the Clan Mansion, blabbering nonsense about dog-sh*t rules to me. In short, they have changed their minds, and have no plans to let you leave.”

Ling Han was surprised. Since Tang Yan said that everything had been arranged, with his status, he naturally would not boast. This matter was already set in stone, but now, the Clan Mansion had suddenly gone back on their word. Why was that?
There had not been any major changes in the Imperial Family, so why had it suddenly become like this?
There was definitely something fishy about this!
Liu Xunyu?
Was this possible? She was only a hostage, so what right did she have to influence the decision of the Clan Mansion, and even offend a minor lord like Tang Yan?
Strange.

“I will go and investigate this matter, but in terms of time…” Tang Yan was slightly hesitant. Looking at the present firm attitude of the Clan Mansion, the difficulty level of changing their decision was not low.
He was only a minor marquis, and was not the Emperor, so he could decide things with just a
word.
“That’s right!” Tang Yan suddenly recalled something, and clapped his hands loudly. However, he paused for a moment, then immediately shook his head, “No, no, this will
definitely not work.”
“What did you think of?” Ling Han asked.
“There’s another way. We don’t have to pass through the Clan Mansion, but the possibility is
close to zero,” Tang Yan said.
“Oh, tell me about it,” Ling Han said with a smile. As long as there was a sliver of hope, he
could give it a try.

Tang Yan pondered for a moment, before saying, “In another 20 or so days, it’ll be His Majesty’s 30,000-year-old birthday. To celebrate this, the entire nation will be celebrating. Moreover, His Majesty loves young prodigies the most, so he’ll host a tournament for each cultivation level. If you’re able to rise above the others, you might even be bestowed an official position, what more leaving the Clan Mansion.”
Ling Han didn’t care at all whether he was conferred an official title or not, but to be able to come out of Jia Yuan Manor, this was very important.
He smiled slightly, “This is not a bad idea.”
“You’re only an alchemist, so battle prowess isn’t your forte!” Tang Yan said with a shake of
his head. “I’ll consider this as a backup plan. I’ll go and ask the Clan Mansion again. Which person is opposing me? I just want to fish someone out, and they are giving me all kind of
excuses.”
“All right.” Ling Han nodded, but he had already placed his hopes on the martial arts
competition.
With his strength, how could it be that he wasn’t powerful enough to defeat Foundation Building cultivators?

En, in the entire universe, he may not even be able to rank in the top ten. After all, there were so many freakish beings in this world, but in the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire and their subordinate forces? That was naturally no big deal.

Moreover, he would only need 10 or so days to advance to the Ultimate Dao Foundation. At that time, even if he were to battle against Origin or Myriad Dao, he would still have enough confidence that he could emerge victorious.

Tang Yan left. He naturally felt that it was very unreliable to have an alchemist go and fight. Thus, he naturally still had to go to the Clan Mansion to find out who was playing tricks on him, and reverse the decision that had previously been reached.
Only a day later, Tang Yan returned again.
“The Clan Mansion has a Deputy Mansion Leader called Meng Shuchang. It was he who
suppressed the matter of you leaving the Clan Mansion.”
Ling Han was surprised, “This is the first time I’ve heard of that person’s name. It should be impossible that I have offended him.”
“It is indeed not him, but rather Liu Xunyu,” Tang Yan said.
Yi, it really was this woman?
“She has such great power?” Ling Han asked in surprise.
“Hehe.” Tang Yan showed a disdainful smile, “Meng Shuchang did not say that it was related
to Liu Xunyu. Instead, I sent someone to investigate. Old Geezer Meng thought that he had
done it covertly, but at least half of the people in the Clan Mansion know that he has an affair
with Liu Xunyu.”
So it was this kind of adulterous relationship.

chapters.title: Chapter 3765: Breaking through into Ultimate Dao Foundation
paragraphs: Chapter 3765: Breaking through into Ultimate Dao Foundation
Ling Han finally understood why Liu Xunyu had so much power in the Political Hostage Manor, that she could even win a day of freedom for a hostage.
That was because she had a “person” in the Clan Mansion.

Thinking about it, it made sense. In order to recruit Ling Han, she didn’t mind using her own body as a bargaining chip. Then, for the sake of this relationship with the Clan Mansion, she was naturally even more willing to throw caution to the wind.
There was also Han Bing and Zhao Xiao. It was no wonder that they felt an indescribable jealousy. Clearly, they were all patrons of Liu Xunyu, and saw him as a rival in love.
Were they rivals in love? Uh, at most, they were just gigolos.
Disgusting, this was really disgusting.

“Old Geezer Meng has been besotted by that woman, and is gritting his teeth to disagree with me,” Tang Yan said in displeasure, “Though the Clan Mansion does not have much real power, and Old Geezer Meng is only an unimportant member of the Imperial Family, his surname is still Meng, after all. Even I cannot do anything to him. If this perverted old geezer does not relent, I really have no way.”
As he saw it, how difficult would it be for him, as the Little Marquis, to protect someone? But Meng Shuchang was determined not to relent, so there was nothing he could do.
After all, the Clan Mansion had authority over the internal matters of the Meng Clan, so it was taboo for Tang Yan to interfere.
“It’s all right. I’ll take the second path, and go fight!” Ling Han said with a smile.
“But-“Tang Yan frowned. He did not have the slightest bit of confidence in Ling Han.
You are an alchemist, so could it be that you would take out a few alchemical pills to bribe others during the martial arts tournament?
Ling Han laughed loudly, “Don’t worry, don’t worry. I will definitely get first place.” Fine then.

Tang Yan could only choose to believe Ling Han. After all, this was the only way now. He explained the details of participating in the martial arts tournament to Ling Han. The current emperor of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire was called Meng Yonghua, and he was a Sect Master great elite. He was already thirty thousand years old this year.

Theoretically speaking, Minor Advanced Tier possessed a lifespan of 40,000 years. However, cultivating and battling would definitely leave some hidden injuries. Thus, 40,000 years was only the theoretical limit. Generally speaking, Minor Advanced Tiers could only live for around 35,000 years.

… Unless one could ingest Saintly medicines that could extend one’s lifespan. However, those were treasures that even Saints would be tempted by, so how could Minor Advanced Tier elites possibly obtain them?

From this aspect, Meng Yonghua should only have about one seventh of his life left. Of course, this was about five thousand years’ time, which was even longer than the lifetime of a Core Formation Tier cultivator.

To Meng Yonghua, this was most likely the last 10,000 years of his life. Thus, he placed a lot of importance on this event. This banquet would also become extremely grand. Not only would the subordinate territories send representatives over, but even the Majestic Empires and great sects would send representatives over.
The only imperfection was the invasion of the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire, which added a shadow to the situation.
This birthday banquet would begin twenty days later, and would continue for ten days, and the last day would be Meng Yonghua’s birthday. This was the most important day.

Ling Han needed to fight his way out of the selection competition that would begin on the first day of the banquet. Finally, he and the other victor would hold the final battle at Meng Yonghua’s birthday banquet. If he could win, he would definitely be rewarded by Meng Yonghua.
This was indeed a very good opportunity.
The registration had already begun, and there was no restriction on the region. As long as one was in the Foundation Building Tier, they could participate.

Of course, Foundation Building Tier cultivators had auditions for them, and Cauldron Forging Origin Tier cultivators had auditions as well. However, these auditions were only limited to the two cultivation levels. When one reached the Core Formation Tier, they could be referred to as elites and great elites. It was practically impossible for them to lose face and perform for others.
When the empress, Hu Niu, and the others found out, they were all in high spirits, expressing that they too wanted to go and join in on the excitement.

Ling Han waited patiently, making the best use of his time to cultivate. In this kind of selection tournament, aside from Talisman Weapons, it was not allowed to use other means. Perhaps, it would turn a person whose battle prowess was originally mediocre into a great elite. Thus, Ling Han felt that it was safer to increase his cultivation level a step further. -If he could avoid using the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, he would. After all, there were definitely a lot of people here who knew what was what.
Another ten days later, Ling Han had already cultivated to the peak stage of Heavenly Dao Foundation. His second cornerstone of the Celestial Path was already flawlessly Consummate level.
He could break through now.
Ling Han had bought enough Treasured Fruits of Life through the Galaxy Network, so he naturally wouldn’t waste any time. He immediately started to break through to Ultimate Dao

Were they rivals in love?
Uh, at most, they were just gigolos.
Disgusting, this was really disgusting.

Even I cannot do anything to him.
If this perverted old geezer does not relent, I really have no way.”
As he saw it, how difficult would it be for him, as the Little Marquis, to protect someone?

You are an alchemist, so could it be that you would take out a few alchemical pills to bribe others during the martial arts tournament?

chapters.title: Chapter 3766: Battling a Cauldron Forging Tier
paragraphs: Chapter 3766: Battling a Cauldron Forging Tier
Ling Han chuckled, and said excitedly, “Come, let’s go to the battlefield.”
W-what?
Zhao Xiao thought that there was something wrong with his ears. He looked at Ling Han in surprise. Go to the battlefield? Yi, are you complaining that I can’t move freely here and can’t beat you up?
“I’ll oblige you,” he said calmly. In any case, Ling Han wouldn’t be able to escape from his grasp.
The two of them headed to the battlefield, and there were definitely people from the Political Hostage Manor that saw them, so they naturally followed them.
Ling Han was currently incompatible in the Political Hostage Manor. There were too many people watching him, hoping to watch a good show.
The battlefield was not far, and the two of them soon arrived at their destination.

The reason why the battlefield could be used for martial arts and sparring was not because this place was filled with sand, and it did not matter even if it was damaged, but rather because there was the protection of formations here. As long as it did not exceed its limits, there would be no power seeping out, and affect the outside world.
Thus, if they started a battle here, they could completely go all out.
Ling Han crooked a finger at Zhao Xiao, “Grandson, come.”
Zhao Xiao’s eyes were ice-cold, and he stated calmly, “You will definitely pay the price for this!”
Xiu, he charged out, his hands forming into claws that grabbed out at Ling Han. Boundless energy solidified, turning into three colours, azure, white and red, flowing with light, like three ribbons.

He was truly enraged now. A Foundation Building cultivator had actually provoked him time and time again, and it was also because of this Ling Han that he had been given a good thrashing by Tang Yan. It was obviously impossible for him to get his revenge on Tang Yan for this kind of great humiliation, so he could only take his revenge on Ling Han.
Ling Han was extremely excited. Could a Foundation Building Tier cultivator rival a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator?
Even if it was only the weakest Cauldron Forging Tier.
He unleashed his full power, and an incredibly rich power surged through his body. Then, he blasted out the Three Styles of the God of War.
It was as if the heaven and earth were using him as their core. Endless energy surged over, and he was the heaven and earth, the core of everything.
The first form was unleashed, heading towards Zhao Xiao.
“Has this guy gone mad?”
“He’s actually facing a Cauldron Forging Tier head-on?”
“Hehe, is there any difference whether it is a head-on confrontation or not?”
“True, Foundation Building Tier cultivators are like fish to be slaughtered in front of Cauldron Forging Tier cultivators. The only difference is how they’re slaughtered.”
Everyone exclaimed in shock, but when they thought about it, from the moment Ling Han walked onto the battlefield, his fate had already been decided.
A terrible defeat!
Boom, their attacks collided, and endless brilliance surged, incredibly dazzling.
Xiu, a figure flew out backwards.
It was Ling Han.
As expected, he was completely unable to match Zhao Xiao. This was an incredibly shocking disadvantage.
However, a hair-raising scene appeared. Ling Han had just landed, when he immediately charged back.
What!
This time, everyone was numb with shock.
How was this possible?
Ling Han had not been insta-killed by Zhao Xiao, and actually still had the ability to counter? ‘F*ck! F*ck! F*ck!’
Ling Han charged back, using the second form of the Three Styles of the God of War, which blasted towards Zhao Xiao.

Through the first exchange, Ling Han clearly understood that the power gap between him and the other was about three times, but he believed that Zhao Xiao probably didn’t use his full power just now, because the other definitely didn’t want to kill him – if a Cauldron Forging Tier used his full power, what Foundation Building Tier wouldn’t be blasted into smithereens?
However, Ling Han believed that with his current strength, he was completely capable of blocking attacks on the level of the Human Cauldron.
Zhao Xiao’s eyes were wide with shock. Ling Han had actually blocked his attack?
He hurriedly came back to his senses. Seeing that Ling Han’s attack was even more violent, he went all out, blasting towards Ling Han.
Peng, the two of them exchanged blows for the second time, creating an even more terrifying explosion. Everyone only felt a blinding light in front of their eyes, and could not see anything clearly.
Ling Han was sent flying again. He somersaulted in the air, dispersing the momentum of his retreat. Then, he charged back for the second time, and blasted out the Third Style of the God
of War.
This style was even more violent.

Zhao Xiao was both furious and flushed. A Foundation Building Tier actually managed to exchange a few blows with him. If this spread out, no one would say that Ling Han was heaven-defyingly powerful, but rather that he was too weak.
The weakest Cauldron Forging Tier in history.
Wasn’t it? If that wasn’t the case, how could he have been forced to this extent by a Foundation Building cultivator?
Boom!
He also channeled a powerful move, with cyan-coloured energy entwined around his hands,
as he counterattacked Ling Han.
Humph, have a taste of pain.
With a thought, Ling Han’s fists also burned with the Heavenly Dao Flames. In a battle of high-level energy, who would be afraid of whom?
Boom!
The two of them clashed for the third time, but this time, Ling Han didn’t fly backwards. When the brilliance completely dissipated, Ling Han stood proudly, and didn’t take even half
a step back.
On the sidelines of the battlefield, everyone was gaping, unable to say a single word.
It was a tie!
A Foundation Building cultivator was actually tied with a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator? Who could believe this?
Impossible, absolutely impossible. There was only one possibility, and that was Ling Han wasn’t some Foundation Building cultivator, but rather a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator.

As the person involved, Zhao Xiao knew better than anyone else that Ling Han didn’t have the slightest bit of the aura of the Cauldron Forging Tier on him. Thus, he must be a Foundation Building cultivator.
At first, he was confused and stunned, which then became incredibly fanatical.
For a Foundation Building cultivator to be so strong, he must have cultivated some kind of powerful secret technique, and if he could obtain it, then wouldn’t that mean…𝑓𝑟ℯ𝘦𝓌𝘦𝘣𝑛𝑜𝓋𝑒𝓁.𝑐ℴ𝓂
His heart beat wildly, as if it was about to jump out of his chest.

“Humph, you used all your ultimate moves to just barely manage a tie with me. For such a powerful move, could you continuously use it?” Zhao Xiao asked coldly. Being able to become a Cauldron Forging Tier elite, his insight was naturally extraordinary. With a single glance, he could tell that the Three Styles of the God of War was a powerful move, and definitely could
not be used continuously.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “Then bring it on.”
“Humph!” Zhao Xiao did not waste words, and directly launched a powerful offensive.

Ling Han indeed couldn’t cast the Three Styles of the God of War for a short period of time. He channeled the Starlight Screen as he unleashed the Eighteen Claws of the Golden Eagle, Celestial Crossing Finger, and exchanged blows with Zhao Xiao.

In all fairness, the Eighteen Claws of the Golden Eagle and Celestial Crossing Finger were both too ordinary, and could not compensate for the gap in cultivation level between Ling Han and Zhao Xiao at all. However, added with the Starlight Screen, Ling Han escaped unscathed. This layer of defense was truly powerful now. It was impossible for Zhao Xiao’s attack to
penetrate it with a single strike, and as long as it could not be penetrated with a single strike, then with the support of Ling Han’s incredibly abundant mystical power, he was completely
capable of repairing it in an instant.
In theory, he was completely capable of exhausting Zhao Xiao to death.
Ten moves, thirty moves, a hundred moves! Everyone was transfixed with shock and disbelief. It was as if they were in a dream.
Though Ling Han had always been at a disadvantage, they could tell that Ling Han was indeed
a Foundation Building cultivator. That kind of life fluctuation was completely different from
Zhao Xiao.
Was there really such a powerful Foundation Building cultivator?
“Impossible, the Cauldron Forging Tier can suppress the Foundation Building Tier-this is
an iron rule!”
“En, this is a truth that will never change, and cannot be broken.”
“Thus, it must be that Zhao Xiao is too weak.”
“Perhaps he exerted too much energy on our captain yesterday, so he’s out of energy today.”
“Hehe, it’s possible.”
Everyone knew that Ling Han was strong, but it was definitely impossible for him to be strong enough to match the Cauldron Forging Tier. Thus, this must be because Zhao Xiao was too
weak.
