chapters.title: Chapter 3767: The fourth big shot
paragraphs: Chapter 3767: The fourth big shot
Ling Han activated his ocular technique, and instantly, Zhao Xiao’s attacks were filled with flaws in front of him.
However, identifying weaknesses and exploiting them were two different things.
The attack speed of a Cauldron Forging Tier was too fast, and any flaws in attack would only be momentary, so how could he make use of it?

This kind of weak point would be fatal in a battle of equal cultivation levels, but now, the gap between their cultivation levels was too wide, and there was also an obvious gap in power. Even if Ling Han saw the weak point, he would not be able to grasp it.
However, this was still useful. Ling Han had a panoramic view of Zhao Xiao’s attack patterns.

When everyone attacked, there would be a sign. Every muscle tensed and relaxed would have a sign. For example, if you wanted to kick, you would definitely have to tighten the muscles in your waist and legs, and the mystical power would also condense more towards your legs.
After seeing this with his eye technique and exchanging a few more blows, Zhao Xiao’s attacks became completely transparent in front of Ling Han.
It was as if Ling Han possessed the ability to predict the future. The moment Zhao Xiao moved, he would be able to react in advance.
In this manner, Ling Han actually managed to slowly reverse the disadvantageous situation. Though it was not completely equal, he was no longer at a disadvantage.

Everyone was watching dumbfounded. Could it be that they would be watching a supreme show of a Foundation Building cultivator defeating a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator today? Zhao Xiao was extremely depressed. He really felt that Ling Han was like a worm in his stomach. No matter what kind of powerful move he prepared, Ling Han would be able to react in advance, causing his attacks to be unsuccessful. In fact, Ling Han would even take advantage of the opening to counterattack.
This battle was really too depressing, that he was practically about to go crazy.
It was about time.
Ling Han waited for the right moment, and finally used his trump card.
Heavenly Pattern Jade, go!
Xiu, the Heavenly Pattern Jade had already been compressed to about 100g. It was extraordinarily light, and with the boost of the colossal Spiritual Power, it instantly reached
40 times the speed of sound, blasting towards Zhao Xiao.
It was too fast, 40 times the speed of sound. Even if it was a Cauldron Forging Tier, his speed would only be around 30 times, and there was absolutely no way he could dodge.
Zhao Xiao was naturally unafraid. Was there any need for him to dodge the attacks of a Foundation Building cultivator?
He also activated his Spiritual Power, which transformed into a large net that wrapped around the Heavenly Pattern Jade, layer by layer.
However, his expression immediately changed drastically.

That was because when his net of Spiritual Power spread over, it would be like using an ordinary fishing net to catch a crocodile. How could he possibly catch it? Frightening power surged over, like a hot knife through butter, and he was completely unmatched.
This was a Spiritual Power Spirit Tool!

Zhao Xiao shouted internally. How could he dare to parry? He hurriedly dodged to the side. However, how could the Heavenly Pattern Jade at 40 times the speed of sound be dodged? Peng! He had just made a dodging motion, when the Heavenly Pattern Jade had already reached his waist, and instantly, a dazzling brilliance spread out.
‘Hmm?’

Ling Han looked slightly surprised, because the Heavenly Pattern Jade didn’t manage to break half of Zhao Xiao’s waist. Instead, it was blocked by a layer of light, and then slid sideways, crashing into the sandpit.

He hurriedly used his Spiritual Power as his hand and grabbed the Heavenly Pattern Jade back. He had not thought that Zhao Xiao actually had a treasure on him. Otherwise, he would not have been able to escape the fate of having half his body destroyed just now.

This was still because Ling Han hadn’t wanted to kill anyone. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have deliberately missed. However, killing an envoy of another nation was naturally a serious crime, unless he wanted to directly become hostile.

Zhao Xiao’s body was trembling. He had a rare treasure on him that would activate when he was in life-threatening danger, turning the crisis around. However, this rare treasure could only be used three times, and he treasured it extremely much.
However, who would’ve thought that he could use it once while cooped up in the Political Hostage Manor? Moreover, he had actually used it on a Foundation Building cultivator!
This, this, this, this, if word got out, he would become a joke for all eternity.

“Who would’ve thought? You actually have a Spiritual Power Spirit Tool!” he said through gritted teeth. His heart was bleeding. He hadn’t obtained anything, and he had even made a fool of himself. As a result, he had lost one use of the rare treasure instead.
Ling Han raised the Heavenly Pattern Jade slightly, “What is it? Want to do it again?”
Zhao Xiao’s expression changed drastically, filled with wariness.

Not only was Ling Han’s power so strong that it didn’t seem like a Foundation Building cultivator’s, but his insight was also far too terrifying. It was as if he didn’t have any secrets to speak of in front of Ling Han, and Ling Han knew his every move like the back of his hand. Added with the threat of the Heavenly Pattern Jade, he was no match for Ling Han at all.
If they continued fighting, not only would he not be able to suppress his opponent, he would instead exhaust all his rare treasures.
He suddenly turned around. Xiu, with a leap, he had already left the battlefield, and did not even leave behind a word of courtesy.
True, faced with a Foundation Building Tier cultivator, no matter what he said, it would only be embarrassing.
Ling Han smiled faintly. He turned around, and saw Liu Xunyu.
Her expression was quite ugly, because she had used all her tricks. She thought that she had already taken control of Ling Han, yet had forgotten the most crucial link, and that was Ling
Han’s own strength.
Originally, there was no need to consider this at all. How could a mere Foundation Building cultivator be as strong as the heavens?

However, how could there be such strange things in this world? This Foundation Building Tier cultivator was truly heaven-defyingly powerful. He could even scare off a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator.
-Though Zhao Xiao was only Human Cauldron Tier as well, and had even only formed two cauldron legs.
It should be known that her cultivation level was only that of a Human Cauldron. Though she had formed three legs, which was slightly superior to Zhao Xiao, the degree of superiority was
really limited.𝐟𝗿𝐞𝚎𝚠𝐞𝚋𝕟𝐨𝚟𝐞𝕝.𝕔𝕠𝚖
What was she supposed to do?
At first, she had thought that Ling Han was a trapped bird, but now, he was a trapped beast. Once this trapped beast wanted to fight to the death, that was definitely no joke.
For the first time, she felt that the situation had spiraled out of control.
Ling Han only gave her a meaningful smile before leaving.
Now, he was filled with confidence.

His individual battle prowess was already just barely close to reaching the level of the Cauldron Forging Tier. Though it still couldn’t be considered a match, it wouldn’t be to the extent that he would be insta-killed by a sneak attack from such an elite. Then, as long as he was given time to react, whether it was using the Heavenly Dao Flames to destroy the enemy, or using the Imminent Skyline to flee, it was all possible.

Everyone watched as Ling Han left. They knew that Liu Xunyu, Han Bing and Zhao Xiao, the three big shots, were not the only ones in the Jia Yuan Manor now. There was also Ling Han. Though he had not yet advanced into Cauldron Forging Tier, he was no longer inferior. Moreover, once Ling Han broke through to the Cauldron Forging Tier, who would be able to
rival him?
This was the most terrifying part!
Everyone looked at each other, and felt that they needed to change their way of thinking. They could no longer follow Liu Xunyu and the others all the way to the end. This was obviously
better to follow Ling Han.
Instantly, a great many people quietly slipped away.
Ling Han returned to his room, and saw seven people quietly arrive. Subtly and openly, they expressed their desire to follow him.
He neither accepted nor rejected them. He only said that he would make a decision based on the performance of these people.
He did not have much interest in this kind of opportunistic people, but it was fine to use them
to disgust Liu Xunyu.
What Ling Han cared about the most was still the competition that would be held in a few
days’ time.
Day after day passed, and Liu Xunyu and the others were all very silent. Perhaps they knew that they could do nothing against Ling Han, and were presently thinking of an even more
vicious plan.
However, the Emperor’s thirty thousandth birthday had finally arrived, and the Imperial
Capital was filled with jubilation.
Tang Yan came personally to pick Ling Han up. With him by his side, even if Meng Shuchang came, so what? He would still dare to bring him out.

chapters.title: Chapter 3768: You are about to meet your match
paragraphs: Chapter 3768: You are about to meet your match
Ling Han and Tang Yan left the Political Hostage Manor and headed to the location of the tournament.
Previously, Tang Yan had already registered for him. Thus, Ling Han only had to announce his name now, and after testing his cultivation level, he could begin the competition.

On the surface, the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire was a Sect Master-level force, but in secret, there was also a Venerate Tier overseer. From a certain aspect, this could even compare to the Holy Land of Metal Element. The difference was that the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire had too few Venerate Tiers, only one, and they didn’t have a Saint Tool, so they couldn’t be everlasting.
—Just look, what force would invade the Holy Land? Whether or not there was a Saint overseeing things, the Holy Land was still so high and mighty, and could not be violated.
This was their background.

The Azure Dragon Majestic Empire was already powerful enough. Not only had the various planets subordinate to it sent mighty figures over to celebrate His Majesty’s birthday, but even the forces of many galaxies had sent envoys.
Meanwhile, the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire also halted their invasion. In fact, they even sent envoys over.

On the surface, it was obviously to celebrate his birthday, but in truth, they wanted to investigate the situation of that old Venerate Tier from the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire, to see how serious his injuries were, and how much battle prowess he still had left.
If this Venerate Tier was already done for, then the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire would increase its offensive when it returned, swallowing more resources of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire.

Even though there were nine days of screening time, in truth, because there were too many people participating, they all wanted to show off in front of Meng Yonghua. Thus, the competition was still very fierce, and there were too many people who had to be eliminated.
In the first round, it would be a direct battle royale, and 90% of the participants would be eliminated.
The rules were very simple. There would be ten people in a group, and only one person would be able to walk out.
The tournament began, and Ling Han pounced out like a fierce tiger.

“Aiyo!” Tang Yan couldn’t help but press a hand on his forehead. You, an alchemist, have to be so fierce? Couldn’t you have kept a low profile, and let others fight to the death, and then calmly take advantage of the situation in the end? Now that you are the first to charge out, you naturally have become the first to stick out your head. If they don’t hit you, who would they hit?
As expected, the other nine people were on guard against each other at first, and no one dared to act rashly, but now that Ling Han had rushed out, he naturally became the target of everyone.
Everyone moved one after another, blasting towards Ling Han.

Ling Han laughed loudly, and with a sweep of his leg, peng, peng, peng, the force of the kick swept past. Like an autumn wind sweeping away fallen leaves, the nine people were all sent flying. Like a celestial maiden scattering flowers, they fell from the skies, and not one of them could get back to their feet.
It was just a kick, and he had dealt with all of them. F***!

Tang Yan couldn’t help but stare in shock. If it were him, even if he suppressed his cultivation level to Ultimate Dao Foundation, he would still be able to easily defeat those nine people. After all, there were all kinds of people mixed together. With so many Foundation Building Tier cultivators participating in the competition, how many prodigies could actually participate?
However, Ling Han was different. He was an alchemist, and a grandmaster that was destined to become an Earth Tier High Grade alchemist .
How could there be someone who was both dazzlingly talented in alchemy and brilliantly talented in martial arts?
He realized that he had still underestimated the value of Ling Han.
After Ling Han won, he had about ten minutes’ time to rest before starting the next battle.
This time, it was not a group fight, but a one-on-one battle. His opponent had also just emerged victorious from the ten-man battle.
Tang Yan was no longer worried, and merely watched quietly.

As expected, Ling Han was invincible, and there was no one that could match him in ten moves. Usually, he would be able to deal with his opponent in five to six moves, and even the hardest to deal with would not be able to block ten moves from him.

And this was still because Ling Han had deliberately gone easy on him. Otherwise, if he unleashed his full battle prowess, it was probable that only around a thousand people in the Foundation Building Tier of Galaxy Network would be able to block one move from him. A hundred people would be able to block ten moves from him, and there would only be about ten people that could truly fight him head-on.
However, Ling Han believed that he would definitely be the final victor.
After this day’s battle, Tang Yan did not send Ling Han back to the Political Hostage Manor, but rather to his Marquis Residence.
As a titled Marquis, he had his own manor. Though it was far from being comparable to the Tang Clan Manor, it still occupied an extremely large area and was glorious.
“It’s all right if I don’t go back?” Ling Han asked with a smile.

“It’s all right. I don’t believe that Meng Shuchang would dare to come to my place and demand for your return,” Tang Yan said domineeringly. He had already sent someone to inform Jia Yuan Manor that Ling Han would be a guest at his residence tonight.

On the second day, after Ling Han finished cultivating, he began to battle again. Sweeping, sweeping, sweeping. There was absolutely no one that could be Ling Han’s match, even if as time passed, the opponents he encountered became more and more powerful.
Nine days passed in the blink of an eye, and Ling Han also emerged victorious, becoming one of the final competitors.
And his opponent was Wang Yafei.

“You will meet your match tomorrow.” Tang Yan said seriously, “This Wang Yafei is not so simple. Though he is not an Innate Divine Physique, he has fused with the remains of an ancient great elite. His battle prowess is considerably frightening, and is at least comparable to a sixth grade Divine Physique. Furthermore, he has been suppressing his cultivation level without breaking through, and that is because he wants to become famous through a battle at His Majesty’s birthday banquet, so that his name would soar sky-high.” “Though the Wang Clan is only a True Self Tier force, they have clearly prepared for today for a very, very long time. Even if I step out… they probably won’t give me face either.” Ling Han cracked a smile, “It’s all right. I was worried that my opponent wasn’t strong enough. That would be so boring.”

Tang Yan couldn’t help but be rendered speechless. After a while, he finally said, “That guy has stayed at the peak stage of the Ultimate Dao Foundation for at least thirty years. It’s not that he doesn’t have the ability to cross over, but that he has been suppressing it all this while. Furthermore, the Wang Clan has even been preparing this matter since fifty years ago. Thus, they must have prepared a great many powerful rare treasures for Wang Yafei. Additionally, they must have studied the images of your battles these few days thoroughly.” Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh loudly. In the past few days, he had only been casually battling, because his opponent was too weak. He didn’t need to use his full strength at all. “You’re still in the mood to laugh?” Tang Yan shook his head, and said, “His Majesty is an extremely competitive person, so in his eyes, the second place is nothing but bullsh*t. Only the victor deserves to be rewarded. Thus, even if you fight so hard all the way to the finals, if you lose, you are still bullsh*t.”
Ling Han patted Tang Yan’s shoulder and said, “I said don’t worry, so just relax. It’s fine.
Believe me.”
Tang Yan pondered for a moment before saying, “Just you wait. I’ll return to the clan to see if
I can find you some rare treasures.”
He left just like that, energetically.
At midnight, Tang Yan returned again, stuffing a sword and a cloak into Ling Han’s hands.

“This is the Star Fragment Sword, and it’s extremely sharp. After you activate it with your mystical power, you’ll be able to unleash a devastating Sword Qi. It’s similarly indestructible,” Tang Yan explained. “Also, this is the Blood Moon Cloak. It was personally refined by the ancestor of the Tang Clan. It can activate the Blood Moon Shield, and even Cauldron Forging Tiers need some time to blast it open.”
“However, the Blood Moon Cloak needs to be instilled with power beforehand. At most, it can
only activate the shield twice. Take it easy.”
Ling Han didn’t need these two treasures at all, but since Tang Yan was so cordial, he couldn’t bring himself to refuse. Thus, he accepted them, and said, “All right.”

Furthermore, he has been suppressing his cultivation level without breaking through, and that is because he wants to become famous through a battle at His Majesty’s birthday banquet, so that his name would soar sky-high.” “Though the Wang Clan is only a True Self Tier force, they have clearly prepared for today for a very, very long time.
Even if I step out… they probably won’t give me face either.” Ling Han cracked a smile, “It’s all right.
I was worried that my opponent wasn’t strong enough.
That would be so boring.”
Tang Yan couldn’t help but be rendered speechless.
After a while, he finally said, “That guy has stayed at the peak stage of the Ultimate Dao Foundation for at least thirty years.
It’s not that he doesn’t have the ability to cross over, but that he has been suppressing it all this while.
Furthermore, the Wang Clan has even been preparing this matter since fifty years ago.
Thus, they must have prepared a great many powerful rare treasures for Wang Yafei.
Additionally, they must have studied the images of your battles these few days thoroughly.” Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh loudly.
In the past few days, he had only been casually battling, because his opponent was too weak.
He didn’t need to use his full strength at all.
“You’re still in the mood to laugh?” Tang Yan shook his head, and said, “His Majesty is an extremely competitive person, so in his eyes, the second place is nothing but bullsh*t.
Only the victor deserves to be rewarded.
Thus, even if you fight so hard all the way to the finals, if you lose, you are still bullsh*t.”
Ling Han patted Tang Yan’s shoulder and said, “I said don’t worry, so just relax.
It’s fine.
Believe me.”
Tang Yan pondered for a moment before saying, “Just you wait.
I’ll return to the clan to see if
I can find you some rare treasures.”
He left just like that, energetically.
At midnight, Tang Yan returned again, stuffing a sword and a cloak into Ling Han’s hands.
“This is the Star Fragment Sword, and it’s extremely sharp.
After you activate it with your mystical power, you’ll be able to unleash a devastating Sword Qi.
It’s similarly indestructible,” Tang Yan explained.
“Also, this is the Blood Moon Cloak.
It was personally refined by the ancestor of the Tang Clan.
It can activate the Blood Moon Shield, and even Cauldron Forging Tiers need some time to blast it open.”
“However, the Blood Moon Cloak needs to be instilled with power beforehand.
At most, it can
only activate the shield twice.
Take it easy.”
Ling Han didn’t need these two treasures at all, but since Tang Yan was so cordial, he couldn’t bring himself to refuse.
Thus, he accepted them, and said, “All right.”

chapters.title: Chapter 3769: Day of the Final Battle
paragraphs: Chapter 3769: Day of the Final Battle
For many people, this was a very difficult night to endure. Tomorrow was the day of Meng Yonghua’s birthday, and perhaps, it would decide the future prosperity and decline of the Majestic Empire.

It was not just the situation of that old Venerate Tier, but also the next generation of the Meng Clan. Would they be able to produce a prodigy? Otherwise, the Meng Clan would not be able to walk very far either. When the older generation of elites gradually withered, and there was no successor, the Meng Clan would naturally have no choice but to walk to the end of its line.
Yet Ling Han slept soundly. When he woke up the next day, he was very energized.
Meng Yonghua’s birthday banquet was scheduled for tonight, so he still had a lot of time to cultivate in the face of the rising sun. Then, he began to concoct alchemical pills.
In the battles of the last nine days, though his opponents were all weaklings, he had also completely familiarized himself with his own strength, and had already adapted to the new cultivation level.
When they were eating breakfast, Tang Yan’s expression was not very good.

“Yesterday, I sent someone to investigate Wang Yafei’s situation, and found out at least one of his trump cards,” he said solemnly. “He has a treasure called the Celestial Descent Silver Water Bottle. It was forged as a replica of a seven-star precious tool. Though its might cannot be compared to the original item, it is said that it can reach the might of Pseudo Cauldron Forging Tier.”
“Once you’re locked onto, you’ll be drawn into the treasure bottle and directly refined into a pool of blood!”
“Let me warn you, His Majesty… only cares about the victor. Thus, even if you’re taken into the treasure bottle and lost, His Majesty will still ignore you. In his eyes, there’s only the victor.”
“So, if you lose, it’s very likely that you’ll lose your life as well.”
“Furthermore, His Majesty hates cowards the most. If you admit defeat, you may be bestowed death by His Majesty.”
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself, saying, “In your eyes, I’m definitely dead, right? There’s nothing to look forward to at all.”

Tang Yan’s expression was solemn, “Now that things have come to this, there is no turning back for you. Sigh, I do not expect you to win either, as long as you can save your life. It is my fault. I should not have mentioned this matter to you at all.”
“Don’t, that Wang Yafei or whatever, I can deal with him with a single punch, so why is there so much fuss!” Ling Han smiled, comforting Tang Yan.
Yet Tang Yan could not let it go at all. This Celestial Descent Silver Water Bottle was only a rare treasure that he had found out about. Who knew how many more treasures Wang Yafei had on him?
The Wang Clan had already planned for a very, very long time for today. They were determined to get the final victory.
Soon, it was noon, then afternoon, and evening.
No matter how unwilling Tang Yan was, he had to bring Ling Han with him, and set out towards the Imperial Palace.
Not going?
That was a crime of deceiving the Emperor!
Oh, you have fought your way all the way here, yet dropped the ball at the most crucial moment. Wasn’t that a slap to His Majesty’s face?
After arriving at the Imperial Palace, Ling Han and Tang Yan separated. He had to make some preparations, change his clothes, and prepare to take the field for the final battle.
“Humph, humph!” Ling Han was just walking, when two cold laughs rang out from behind him.
He turned around to look. Oh, wasn’t this Ge Shuang?
“Ling Han, you’re dead meat today!” Ge Shuang’s face was filled with delight at Ling Han’s misfortune.

After returning to the Imperial Capital, he kept trying to make connections, hoping that he could enter into the Political Hostage Manor and give Ling Han a harsh beating. However, when others heard that it was the Political Hostage Manor, they all shook their heads in refusal.
Although it was a prison, it was imprisoning envoys from various nations. Moreover, it was under the jurisdiction of the Clan Mansion. The waters were very deep, so who would be willing to interfere?
Thus, he hated Ling Han to death, yet couldn’t do anything at all.
Right until now, when he discovered that Ling Han was actually a match for Wang Yafei, he was instantly amused.
He was dead. This time, Ling Han was definitely going to die.

He was afraid that Ling Han would be directly beaten to death by Wang Yafei, so he hurriedly ran over. He wanted to use this time to strike a blow on Ling Han’s pride. Otherwise, he would not have another chance in the future.
Ling Han merely smiled faintly, “When did you become a fortune-teller? Furthermore, with your standards, I guarantee that you will starve yourself to death.”
Ge Shuang couldn’t help but choke. This guy still had such a toxic tongue.
“Humph, you can only talk tough for a while now. After a while, you will become a corpse. Furthermore, hehe, who knows, you may not even be able to leave a whole corpse behind,” he
said, smiling.
“Don’t worry, you’ll definitely see me again.” Ling Han waved his hand, indicating for the person leading the way to continue walking.
Ge Shuang didn’t stop him. He had already said what he needed to say. Next, he only had to admire Ling Han’s death.
Ling Han stroked his chin as he walked. Was this Wang Yafei really so powerful? There was actually no one that had high hopes for him?

Additionally, the underground casino had also placed bets on the final battle between him and Wang Yafei. There were no stakes for Wang Yafei’s victory at all, but rather stakes for winning within ten seconds, winning within a minute, and so on, which showed just how pessimistic they were about him.
Ling Han had already told the large black dog to bet on his victory. This was a good opportunity to make money.
Looks like he had been too low-key.
He prepared himself in the resting room. Even if there were a great many walls separating them, he could still hear the noise outside. Clearly, this was a very lively time.
After a while, someone came over to call out that he could go up onto the stage to battle.
He walked out. There was no need for anyone to lead the way, because there was only one
path.
“…He is, Ling Han!” Someone was presently introducing him outside. The instant Ling Han stepped out, his name had also spread throughout the entire tournament grounds.

Ling Han swept his gaze around. He was presently in the area where the tournament was held. The tournament ground was surrounded by a high platform, which had formed a circle, layered on top of each other. And on his left side, there was a platform sticking out of the air, at least a few hundred meters off the ground. If one’s vision was slightly poorer, they would not be able to see the situation below if they were to sit on it.
The person seated on it was the current emperor of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire, Meng Yonghua, who was also the main character of today’s birthday celebration.
“Now, let us welcome the other contestant, Wang Yafei from the Wang Clan!” the host called out again, slightly hysterical.
At this moment, the doors to the other passageway of the tournament ground opened, and a young man with a dark expression walked out.
The moment Wang Yafei appeared, he knelt towards the high platform, and shouted at the loudest volume, “This subject, Wang Yafei, will definitely obtain victory for Your Majesty!”
‘F*ck you! What do you mean by achieving victory for Your Majesty? You’re clearly doing this
for yourself!’
Ling Han mocked internally. This guy really knew how to curry favor. It was practically
sickening.
“Hahaha!” A loud laugh rang out from the high platform. Obviously, Meng Yonghua was in a
good mood.
“Then, let the tournament begin!” the host roared.

Wang Yafei immediately charged over from the other side. His speed was extremely fast. A second ago, he was at least a few thousand meters away, but an instant later, he had already appeared no more than thirty meters in front of Ling Han.
“Use your full strength. Otherwise, you won’t be able to show how powerful I am!” he said
haughtily.
This scene was captured and projected from the skies, magnified a few hundred times over. It was the same for the sound, which was seen and heard by everyone. Instantly, a great many
people screamed shrilly.
He was too domineering.

chapters.title: Chapter 3770: Collecting treasures
paragraphs: Chapter 3770: Collecting treasures
“That won’t do.” Ling Han shook his head seriously.
Everyone booed. This guy was too cowardly, wasn’t he? They hadn’t even started fighting, and he was already showing weakness.
On the high platform, Meng Yonghua also revealed an expression of displeasure. He had been an iron-blooded ruler all his life, and hated this kind of spineless person the most.
Furthermore, he actually cowered at his birthday banquet, causing his killing intent to instantly rise.
Ling Han said slowly, “I’m afraid that if I go all out, I’ll accidentally beat you to death.”
Everyone faltered for a moment before bursting into laughter.
This was too funny. As it turned out, this guy was not afraid, but had rather laid out a trap with his words.
Meng Yonghua also revealed a smile, and said to the person beside him, “Young people nowadays are quite interesting.”
The person next to him was none other than Tang Lei, the current clan leader of the Tang Clan. He was also Tang Yan’s grandfather.
To be able to sit beside Meng Yonghua at this time, it was clear how much the Tang Clan and Tang Lei were doted on with imperial favour.
“Your Majesty is right,” Tang Lei said with a smile, but he was complaining internally. Who was the one who had said that he would drag Ling Han out and kill him after the tournament was over?
Below him, Wang Yafei revealed a baleful expression. This guy actually dared to snatch his limelight?
How long had the Wang Clan prepared for today’s battle? And how much suffering had he suffered because of this?
He should be the only star, and be the sole focus of everyone’s attention.
“Damn guy!” he said in a low voice. Xiu! With a flash, he charged towards Ling Han.
This despicable guy, just die.
He dismissed the idea of pretending that the two of them were evenly matched, and only after gaining everyone’s attention, would he then defeat Ling Han.

Boom, his whole body was exuding blazing light. Multiple seals bloomed, some complete, and some shattered. However, the strange thing was that the shattered seals actually looked even more terrifying than the complete seals, filled with astonishing destructive power.

On the spectators’ seats, even Meng Yonghua nodded. “This brat from the Wang Clan is quite diligent. It’s not easy to cultivate such battle prowess at the Foundation Building Tier.” “Hehe, His Majesty is really praising him too much.” Tang Lei laughed loudly, “If it was you back then, wouldn’t you be a hundred times stronger than this brat from the Wang Clan?”
Meng Yonghua couldn’t help but stroke his beard and smile, feeling very pleased with this flattery.
Boom! Wang Yafei charged over with this attack.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and casually threw a punch in response.
He did not need to use any kind of celestial technique. It was just the most ordinary and simple punch.
Peng, Wang Yafei was instantly sent flying, flying back at a faster speed than he had come. Furthermore, multiple seals exploded, as if fireworks had been lit.

At first, the whole area was filled with cheers, cheering for Wang Yafei. After all, this was a proper citizen of the Imperial Capital, and Ling Han was only a hostage that had come from another planet. Thus, when they saw this scene, everyone’s mouths were half-gaping, completely dumbfounded.
That was Wang Yafei, and he had actually been sent flying with a single punch!
It should be known that Ling Han did not look like he had used any kind of celestial technique. He had sent Wang Yafei flying with an ordinary punch. How could they accept this?
“You-“Wang Yafei turned around, and steadied his footing. He glared fiercely at Ling Han, revealing a powerful expression of fury.
He had not been injured by this blow, but felt even worse than if he had been severely injured.
In full public, especially when Meng Yonghua was still watching from above, he was sent flying with a single punch, revealing an ugly side of him.
How humiliating.
“You deserve to die!” he roared loudly, and directly used his trump card. A white jade bottle appeared in his hand.
Celestial Descent Silver Water Bottle.

Xiu, he only felt his vision blur, and saw that Ling Han was already standing in front of him. He paled in shock, and was just about to draw out the treasure bottle to suck Ling Han in, when he felt that his hand was empty.
Yi, where was the treasure bottle?
“How do I use this?” Ling Han asked Wang Yafei as he toyed with the Celestial Descent Silver Water Bottle that he had just snatched.
‘F*ck! When was it taken?’
Wang Yafei paled in shock. The treasure in his hands had actually been taken without his knowledge. Just how wide was the gap in strength?
How was this possible?
He had made so many preparations for today, and had also entered into the final battle as expected, but why had he encountered such a freak?
On the spectators’ seats, everyone was also stunned.

Why did they feel like Wang Yafei was just a child in front of Ling Han? He was completely no match for him. Wang Yafei had been sent flying with a single punch, and his treasure had been snatched away in a single move. How was he supposed to fight him?
“Give it back to me!” Wang Yafei shouted loudly.
“I can hear you. There’s no need to be so loud,” Ling Han said with a smile, as he continued to play with the treasure bottle.
“Retrieve!” Wang Yafei revealed a baleful expression. Do you think that this treasure bottle can only show its might in his hands?
Wrong, he had long since infused a sliver of divine sense into the treasure bottle, so he could activate it with a single thought.
Instantly, a field of light surged out of the treasure bottle, wrapping around Ling Han.
Wang Yafei laughed loudly. As long as he was enveloped by this light, he would be drawn into the treasure bottle. Terrifying formation patterns would intertwine, forcibly melting him
into a pool of blood.
“What are you laughing at?” Ling Han’s voice suddenly traveled over. “Have you gone stupid, child? You can laugh for no reason.”
What!
Wang Yafei revealed a terrified expression. Why hadn’t Ling Han been taken into the treasure
bottle yet?

“Truly disappoints me.” Ling Han shook his head. Pa, he squeezed hard, and this treasure bottle was forcibly crushed by him. This couldn’t reach the might of the Pseudo Cauldron Forging Tier at all. At most, it was equivalent to a four star Ultimate Dao Foundation.

A battle prowess of four stars was already very impressive. That was why Tang Yan had said that this was the might of Pseudo Cauldron Forging Tier, because there were only a handful of people in the Azure Dragon Empire that had reached the level of a four-star genius in the
Majestic Empire.
“Is there any more?” Ling Han casually tossed the shards of the treasure bottle onto the ground as he looked at Wang Yafei expectantly.
What kind of mockery was this?
Wang Yafei roared loudly, and retreated continuously, putting an absolute distance between
himself and Ling Han. Then, he took out a fan. As mystical power surged in, it immediately
emitted a black light.
He raised his hand, wanting to fan Ling Han. However, there was a blur before his eyes, and a
person had already appeared before him.
‘Motherf*cker!’
An ominous feeling welled up in his heart. As expected, the fan in his hand was already gone.
“It shouldn’t be difficult to use this, right?” Ling Han also injected his mystical power into the fan. The fan that had just dimmed immediately lit up again, and then waved lightly at
Wang Yafei.
Peng, Wang Yafei was sent flying again.
The powerful hurricane winds turned into multiple small blades that sliced at Wang Yafei’s
body. In just an instant, his clothes had all turned into pieces, and countless wounds had also appeared on his body. Thankfully, because of these wounds, his body was covered with blood,
blocking some important parts.
Oh, this fan was quite powerful.
Ling Han put away the fan. He didn’t need it, but he could leave it for the empress, Hu Niu,
and the others.
“Is there anything else?” he asked.
“Give it back to me!” Wang Yafei’s face turned green. Do you think I’m a wealth-delivering
boy?
He charged over without any regard for anything else. Multiple veined patterns were glowing on his body, making it seem as if he had become a demon god.

He had not been injured by this blow, but felt even worse than if he had been severely injured.
In full public, especially when Meng Yonghua was still watching from above, he was sent flying with a single punch, revealing an ugly side of him.
How humiliating.
“You deserve to die!” he roared loudly, and directly used his trump card.
A white jade bottle appeared in his hand.
Celestial Descent Silver Water Bottle.
Xiu, he only felt his vision blur, and saw that Ling Han was already standing in front of him.
He paled in shock, and was just about to draw out the treasure bottle to suck Ling Han in, when he felt that his hand was empty.
Yi, where was the treasure bottle?
“How do I use this?” Ling Han asked Wang Yafei as he toyed with the Celestial Descent Silver Water Bottle that he had just snatched.
‘F*ck!
When was it taken?’
Wang Yafei paled in shock.
The treasure in his hands had actually been taken without his knowledge.
Just how wide was the gap in strength?
How was this possible?
He had made so many preparations for today, and had also entered into the final battle as expected, but why had he encountered such a freak?
On the spectators’ seats, everyone was also stunned.
Why did they feel like Wang Yafei was just a child in front of Ling Han?
He was completely no match for him.
Wang Yafei had been sent flying with a single punch, and his treasure had been snatched away in a single move.
How was he supposed to fight him?
“Give it back to me!” Wang Yafei shouted loudly.
“I can hear you.
There’s no need to be so loud,” Ling Han said with a smile, as he continued to play with the treasure bottle.
“Retrieve!” Wang Yafei revealed a baleful expression.
Do you think that this treasure bottle can only show its might in his hands?
Wrong, he had long since infused a sliver of divine sense into the treasure bottle, so he could activate it with a single thought.
Instantly, a field of light surged out of the treasure bottle, wrapping around Ling Han.
Wang Yafei laughed loudly.
As long as he was enveloped by this light, he would be drawn into the treasure bottle.
Terrifying formation patterns would intertwine, forcibly melting him
into a pool of blood.
“What are you laughing at?” Ling Han’s voice suddenly traveled over.
“Have you gone stupid, child?
You can laugh for no reason.”
What!
Wang Yafei revealed a terrified expression.
Why hadn’t Ling Han been taken into the treasure
bottle yet?
“Truly disappoints me.” Ling Han shook his head.
Pa, he squeezed hard, and this treasure bottle was forcibly crushed by him.
This couldn’t reach the might of the Pseudo Cauldron Forging Tier at all.
At most, it was equivalent to a four star Ultimate Dao Foundation.
A battle prowess of four stars was already very impressive.

That was why Tang Yan had said that this was the might of Pseudo Cauldron Forging Tier, because there were only a handful of people in the Azure Dragon Empire that had reached the level of a four-star genius in the
Majestic Empire.
“Is there any more?” Ling Han casually tossed the shards of the treasure bottle onto the ground as he looked at Wang Yafei expectantly.
What kind of mockery was this?
Wang Yafei roared loudly, and retreated continuously, putting an absolute distance between
himself and Ling Han.
Then, he took out a fan.
As mystical power surged in, it immediately
emitted a black light.
He raised his hand, wanting to fan Ling Han.
However, there was a blur before his eyes, and a
person had already appeared before him.
‘Motherf*cker!’
An ominous feeling welled up in his heart.
As expected, the fan in his hand was already gone.
“It shouldn’t be difficult to use this, right?” Ling Han also injected his mystical power into the fan.
The fan that had just dimmed immediately lit up again, and then waved lightly at
Wang Yafei.
Peng, Wang Yafei was sent flying again.
The powerful hurricane winds turned into multiple small blades that sliced at Wang Yafei’s
body.
In just an instant, his clothes had all turned into pieces, and countless wounds had also appeared on his body.
Thankfully, because of these wounds, his body was covered with blood,
blocking some important parts.
Oh, this fan was quite powerful.
Ling Han put away the fan.
He didn’t need it, but he could leave it for the empress, Hu Niu,
and the others.
“Is there anything else?” he asked.
“Give it back to me!” Wang Yafei’s face turned green.
Do you think I’m a wealth-delivering
boy?
He charged over without any regard for anything else.
Multiple veined patterns were glowing on his body, making it seem as if he had become a demon god.

chapters.title: Chapter 3771: Broke through? Still beat him flat
paragraphs: Chapter 3771: Broke through? Still beat him flat
“Yafei, Yafei has cultivated to the fourth level of the Blood God Path!” On the spectators’ seats, an old man shouted, filled with pleasant surprise.
He was the clan leader of the Wang Clan, Wang Haowen. At first, his face was already as black as ink, but when he saw this scene, it suddenly bloomed, filled with pleasant surprise.

The Wang Clan was not a very strong, or very weak clan on the Moonlight Planet. In these tens of thousands of years, there had been no improvement. In Wang Haowen’s generation, he worked hard to change the current situation, and when Wang Yafei was born, he felt that his dream could be realized.
Wang Yafei, his natural talent in cultivation was astonishing, and his potential was boundless.

For his sake, the Wang Clan had paid an unknown price. They had practically gone bankrupt, and had gotten him a bone from an ancient elite. Then, they had asked a great elite to move, and fuse that bone with Wang Yafei, so that it would become a part of him.

It was definitely not a waste to pay such a great price. Wang Yafei perfectly fused with this bone, and also obtained a secret technique from within. It was called the Blood God Path, and was the celestial technique that the original owner of the bone had cultivated when he was alive.

There were a total of 36 levels in the Blood God Path. With every additional level he grasped, his battle prowess would double, or even more. However, even if Wang Yafei’s natural talent in martial arts was astonishing, after so many years, he had only grasped the first three levels of the Blood God Path. And if he cultivated the Blood God Path, it would be the most perfect thing for him to cultivate the first four levels in the Foundation Building Tier.

The reason why Wang Yafei had not broken through to the Cauldron Forging Tier was firstly, for the sake of this tournament, and secondly, because he had not cultivated to the fourth level of the Blood God Path.
Of course, to outsiders, it definitely could not be said to be the latter reason.

And now, Wang Yafei actually broke through during battle, and cultivated to the fourth level of the Blood God Path. Not only did this give him hope of turning the tables, he had also cultivated the Foundation Building Tier to Consummate level.
With this double happiness, Wang Haowen would definitely be filled with endless, pleasant surprise.
He looked at Ling Han balefully. This brat was definitely going to die.
In the arena, Wang Yafei was also taken aback. He had broken through in his fury, and even he himself had not realized it. When he realized it suddenly, he even stopped his attack.
Boom, the power in his body surged, making him feel that he was inconceivably strong.
Ling Han or whatever, would all be killed with a single palm strike.
“Humph, I really have to thank you!” Wang Yafei said calmly. Now, he felt that everything had returned to his control.
Ling Han smiled and said, “You keep gifting me things, and you still want to thank me? This child, has his head been smashed? Forgive me for my sins!”

“You can talk tough now, but when I dismember you piece by piece, you’ll know regret.’ Wang Yafei roared fiercely, and grabbed his left wrist with his right hand. With a sudden pull, the entire left hand, along with the bones in his arm, was pulled out.

Strangely, there was actually not the slightest bit of blood spewing out from the severed wrist. Furthermore, it was as white as jade, and strangely shaped like a sword. Not only was it sharper than the normal bone, it was also longer.

This was the bone of the elite that he had fused together with. After so many years, he had actually cultivated it into a Spirit Tool. Furthermore, it had completely fused with his own body. It was his personal Spirit Tool, and he was more proficient in using it than any other weapon.

“This is the Blood Bone Sword, which I have refined with my own blood essence. No one has ever seen it before,” Wang Yafei declared proudly, “You are the first person to have seen it, and also the first person to have had your blood drunk by it!”

Ling Han sighed, “Your brain is indeed damaged! There are at least tens of thousands of people here, and they all saw this sword at the same time. It’s not just the two of us. Sigh, your intelligence is worrying!”
Wang Yafei was furious. Even at a time like this, Ling Han still dared to joke around. Really!
Gritting his teeth, he said, “When the flesh on your body is sliced off piece by piece, I hope you can still have such a toxic mouth!”
He raised the Blood Bone Sword high, and streams of black Qi surged out of his body, boiling, making him seem as if he had turned into a Demon God.
Ling Han smiled faintly. He used the Imminent Skyline, and instantly appeared in front of Wang Yafei. Then, with a light stretch of his hand, he snatched the Blood Bone Sword.
Wang Yafei was stunned. Why had his sword been snatched?
‘How the f*ck are you so fast?’

I have clearly already broken through in battle, and reached the fourth level of the Blood God Path. My abilities have improved astonishingly, but why am I still unable to see how Ling Han approaches, or how he makes his move?

“So disgusting!” Ling Han originally wanted to study the bone sword, but this sword hilt was actually a hand, and the fingers were still moving, desperately trying to break free, making Ling Han feel extremely disgusted.
Pa, with a toss, he threw out the bone sword.
This!
When everyone saw this scene, their faces twitched, feeling an indescribable pain in their b*lls.

At this moment, there were definitely 10,000 curse words racing through Wang Yafei’s mind. He had clearly used an ultimate move and was about to explode, but in front of Ling Han, it was like child’s play.

This wasn’t a confrontation on the same level at all. It was like a child being aggressive and taking out all kinds of toy weapons to threaten the adult, but in the eyes of the adult, this was just playing house and playing around.
Shouldn’t the finals be evenly matched and extremely exciting? Why was it now so one-sided?𝑓𝘳𝑒𝑒𝓌𝘦𝘣𝘯ℴ𝑣𝘦𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝑚
On the spectators’ seats, Wang Haowen looked like he had swallowed a fly, feeling extremely
terrible.
If he could, he would definitely charge into the arena and tear Ling Han to shreds.
How could this be?
Just how many resources had the Wang Clan invested in Wang Yafei? Yet in the end, he couldn’t even be considered Ling Han’s opponent, and had completely become a laughing
stock.
This was definitely not because Wang Yafei was not strong, but rather because Ling Han was freakishly strong.
-How could there be such a freak in this world?
Was the heavens planning to stop the rise of the Wang Clan?

Wang Yafei roared, and even the Celestial Foundation was summoned. It was a silver square stone, with ancient patterns on it. He controlled the Celestial Foundation to smash it towards Ling Han, a tragic expression on his face.

The Celestial Foundation was the core of the Foundation Building Tier. Once the foundation stone of the Celestial Path was damaged, the cultivator’s cultivation level would also drop, and he might even decline to the mortal level.
Thus, unleashing his Celestial Foundation to battle was also the cultivator’s final gamble.

Ling Han was cold, and shot out a punch, which landed on the Celestial Foundation. Peng, the Celestial Foundation was instantly sent flying, and Wang Yafei also looked as if he had been severely injured, his face incredibly pale.
He and the Celestial Foundation were one and the same. There was no need to look to know that at this moment, a few cracks had already appeared on the Celestial Foundation.
What terrifying power of the punch.

The toughness of the Celestial Foundation was comparable to a Celestial Foundation of the same cultivation level. Yet, Ling Han’s punch was able to cause cracks to appear on the Celestial Foundation. Just how terrifying was his power, and just how terrifying was its
sturdiness?
He gritted his teeth, and summoned the Celestial Foundation back, which then blasted towards Ling Han.
He had lived his whole life for today. If he didn’t become number one, he would rather die
tragically.

Ling Han shook his head internally. He was a little impressed by Wang Yafei’s determination, but he actually built his life on the words of appreciation from others. This was too stupid. Furthermore, Wang Yafei was not a good person either. Every time he opened and closed his mouth, he would say that he wanted to kill him, and cut off his flesh, which made him unable
to feel any sympathy at all.
He threw another punch, and added a little more force. Peng, Wang Yafei and the Celestial Foundation were both sent flying. This time, he could no longer get back to his feet.

chapters.title: Chapter 3772: Crimson Captain
paragraphs: Chapter 3772: Crimson Captain
“What an exciting battle, too exciting!” The host called out loudly, “And now, the top victor of today has finally appeared, and that is Ling – Han—”
Following his near-hysterical roar, thunderous cheers also sounded from the spectators’ seats.

“Ling Han performed very well. I am very pleased, and bestow upon him the title of Crimson Captain, serving in the Heaven Military Manor.” An incredibly majestic voice rang out from the spectators’ seats, booming and mighty. It was the current emperor of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire, Meng Yonghua.

A smile tugged at the corners of Ling Han’s lips. He had been conferred the title of Captain, and was now working in the government. Thus, he naturally had a grand reason to leave the Political Hostage Manor.
He raised his clasped hands, and said, “Thank you, Your Majesty.”
“En?” On the spectators’ seats, Meng Yonghua showed a hint of displeasure.
Tang Lei, who was beside him, hurriedly said, “Your Majesty, the Dark North Nation is primitive and uncivilized. When the citizens see the emperor, they all clasp their hands in greeting.”
Meng Yonghua finally felt at ease, and said with a smile, “As expected of an outsider.”𝙛𝒓𝓮𝙚𝔀𝒆𝒃𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝓵.𝙘𝒐𝒎
“In future, the Dark North Nation will be able to bask in the blessings of our Empire, and will definitely develop gradually, and would not be so primitive and backward,” Tang Lei said with a smile.
He knew that Tang Yan was on good terms with Ling Han, and Ling Han was indeed worth befriending. That was why he had repeatedly exonerated Ling Han.
“Hahaha!” Meng Yonghua laughed loudly, appearing to be very happy.

On the spectators’ seats, some were shouting in excitement, but there were also some that were incredibly dejected. That was because they had all betted on how much time Wang Yafei would win in the underground gambling house. They had not thought that not only would Wang Yafei not win, he would lose so terribly instead. It could be said that they had been horribly screwed over.
There was also Ge Shuang, whose expression was dark, almost dripping ink.
At first, he had hoped that Wang Yafei would kill Ling Han and avenge him, but who would have thought that Wang Yafei would actually be so weak?
And he called himself the top elite of the Foundation Building Tier? This was absolute
nonsense.

And in the Imperial Family seats, Meng Yangcheng’s expression was also incredibly ugly. He naturally recognized Ling Han. In the past, in order to compete for the Buddhist Race’s opportunity, he had come to blows with Ling Han. In the end, he had almost been killed. If it was not for the fact that he had a few subordinates who were desperately blocking for him, he would have long since died—he naturally would not admit that it was he who had actually sucked dry the mystical power of the few servants.
This brat was really outrageously bold. He actually dared to come here?

He wanted nothing more than to immediately step forward and kill Ling Han, but what kind of place was this? Furthermore, Meng Yonghua had personally bestowed an official rank on Ling Han. If he dared to make a move, then losing the right to inherit would be a small matter. If it was serious, he might even be executed.
-With Meng Yonghua’s temperamental nature, this was not impossible.

Thus, he could only endure for now. However, since he had discovered Ling Han, he would definitely not let Ling Han have a good time in the following days, right until… Ling Han died. The battle had ended, but Meng Yonghua’s birthday banquet naturally didn’t. Afterward, there was still the final battle of the Cauldron Forging Tier elites, as well as the activities of the diplomatic missions of the various nations. In short, the commotion would continue until midnight tonight, at least.
Ling Han was fine. He returned to the resting area.
After a long time, Tang Yan finally came to look for him.
“You, so your battle prowess is actually so high!” He punched Ling Han’s chest, “You hadn’t told me earlier, making me worry for so long.”
Ling Han laughed loudly, “I have always told you not to worry, yet you insist on worrying for no reason.”

“All right, all right, all right. It’s my fault, all right?” Tang Yan said with a smile. He was also in a very good mood. Ling Han had gotten the first place, and had even been bestowed an official position by the Emperor. Now, would the Clan Mansion still dare to control Ling Han? “You’re leaving tomorrow to assume your post immediately. Do you want me to send you off?” he asked.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “As the Little Marquis, you aren’t a very idle person, so I won’t trouble you with everything.”
“All right, I’ll find you for some tea later.” Tang Yan nodded. In any case, Ling Han had already left the Political Hostage Manor and become a free man, so it would be easy for them to get together.
After the birthday banquet ended, Ling Han returned to the Political Hostage Manor. He had just entered, when he saw a great many people offering their congratulations.
As it turned out, the fact that he had been appointed as an official by Meng Yonghua had already spread throughout the entire Imperial Capital. Even this Political Hostage Manor was no exception.

This was awesome. Just look, everyone were still hostages, but Ling Han had already been personally bestowed the title of an official by the emperor of the Majestic Empire. The gap between them was as wide as the gap between heaven and earth.
They definitely had to befriend this kind of person. To say nothing else, it would be good for them to have a few more days of freedom.
On the other hand, Liu Xunyu and the others all bore ugly expressions, wanting nothing more than to swallow Ling Han whole and skin him alive.
How could they have imagined that even the Clan Mansion could not stop the rise of Ling
Han?
Now, they could only sit by and watch as Ling Han became stronger and stronger. An alchemy prodigy that could concoct the Foundation Dissolution Pill, Ling Han, had boundless future
prospects.
Ling Han swept an eye over these people, not bothering to stop at all. How could he possibly treat these few people as his opponents?
He stayed for a night, and on the morning of the second day, cultivated for a while. Then, he left proudly.
“Lord Ling!” The guards at the entrance naturally would not stop him. Instead, they greeted him obsequiously.
This young man was really too incredible. How many days had it been? And he had already walked out of the Political Hostage Manor. Who knows, he may be able to become a Marquis or Minister in future.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and strode away.
Behind him, Liu Xunyu, Zhao Xiao, Han Bing and Tan Zhengjie were all staring at him, their expressions icy cold.
“What should we do? Could it be that we are just going to sit by and watch him grow?” Tan Zheng Jie asked, unwilling to give up.

“If you have the ability, you can assassinate him tonight and drag him down with you.” Han Bing made a sarcastic remark, “Haven’t you always said that you want to sacrifice your life for Sister Liu? This is an extremely good opportunity, right?”

Tan Zhengjie’s expression instantly crumbled. Firstly, he did not want to die at all, and secondly, even if he did not care about his own safety, there was absolutely no way that he would be a match for Ling Han. He would only be committing suicide.
“All of you, speak less.” Liu Xunyu said in displeasure, “I will definitely think of a way. I will definitely not allow him to leave just like that!”
Zhao Xiao and Han Bing looked at each other, and both shook their heads secretly. By now, it was clear that Ling Han was out of control. Could it be that you want to go to the Heaven
Military Manor and solicit him again?

The Heaven Military Manor was the department that oversaw the security of the Imperial Capital, and the Imperial Capital was very, very big. Thus, the Heaven Military Manor had also established a considerable number of subbranches, each managing a small area.
Ling Han was bestowed the title of Crimson Captain. This was only a minor eighth-rank official position, and was not even qualified to be a leader at a branch of the Heaven Military
Manor.

He was assigned to the Great Peace Division. The leader of the division was a seventh-rank captain named Yan Lesheng. After meeting Ling Han, he appointed Ling Han as a captain of the division. However, because no captain had left the division previously, Ling Han’s current role as captain was actually an empty post. He didn’t have a single subordinate.
“A murder happened in Long Li, I’ll hand it over to you.” Yan Lesheng tossed over a scroll.
On the first day of work, there was already a mission.
Ling Han didn’t refuse. He accepted the scroll and started to flip through it.
“A murder has taken place in the Imperial Capital, and the nature of this crime is extremely
vile. I will give you ten days’ time. If you are unable to catch the culprit, you can resign on your own!” Yan Lesheng set a deadline for Ling Han.

It was the current emperor of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire, Meng Yonghua.
A smile tugged at the corners of Ling Han’s lips.
He had been conferred the title of Captain, and was now working in the government.
Thus, he naturally had a grand reason to leave the Political Hostage Manor.
He raised his clasped hands, and said, “Thank you, Your Majesty.”
“En?” On the spectators’ seats, Meng Yonghua showed a hint of displeasure.
Tang Lei, who was beside him, hurriedly said, “Your Majesty, the Dark North Nation is primitive and uncivilized.
When the citizens see the emperor, they all clasp their hands in greeting.”
Meng Yonghua finally felt at ease, and said with a smile, “As expected of an outsider.”𝙛𝒓𝓮𝙚𝔀𝒆𝒃𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝓵.𝙘𝒐𝒎
“In future, the Dark North Nation will be able to bask in the blessings of our Empire, and will definitely develop gradually, and would not be so primitive and backward,” Tang Lei said with a smile.
He knew that Tang Yan was on good terms with Ling Han, and Ling Han was indeed worth befriending.
That was why he had repeatedly exonerated Ling Han.
“Hahaha!” Meng Yonghua laughed loudly, appearing to be very happy.
On the spectators’ seats, some were shouting in excitement, but there were also some that were incredibly dejected.
That was because they had all betted on how much time Wang Yafei would win in the underground gambling house.
They had not thought that not only would Wang Yafei not win, he would lose so terribly instead.
It could be said that they had been horribly screwed over.
There was also Ge Shuang, whose expression was dark, almost dripping ink.
At first, he had hoped that Wang Yafei would kill Ling Han and avenge him, but who would have thought that Wang Yafei would actually be so weak?
And he called himself the top elite of the Foundation Building Tier?
This was absolute
nonsense.
And in the Imperial Family seats, Meng Yangcheng’s expression was also incredibly ugly.
He naturally recognized Ling Han.
In the past, in order to compete for the Buddhist Race’s opportunity, he had come to blows with Ling Han.
In the end, he had almost been killed.

If it was not for the fact that he had a few subordinates who were desperately blocking for him, he would have long since died—he naturally would not admit that it was he who had actually sucked dry the mystical power of the few servants.
This brat was really outrageously bold.
He actually dared to come here?
He wanted nothing more than to immediately step forward and kill Ling Han, but what kind of place was this?
Furthermore, Meng Yonghua had personally bestowed an official rank on Ling Han.
If he dared to make a move, then losing the right to inherit would be a small matter.
If it was serious, he might even be executed.
-With Meng Yonghua’s temperamental nature, this was not impossible.
Thus, he could only endure for now.
However, since he had discovered Ling Han, he would definitely not let Ling Han have a good time in the following days, right until…
Ling Han died.
The battle had ended, but Meng Yonghua’s birthday banquet naturally didn’t.
Afterward, there was still the final battle of the Cauldron Forging Tier elites, as well as the activities of the diplomatic missions of the various nations.
In short, the commotion would continue until midnight tonight, at least.
Ling Han was fine.
He returned to the resting area.
After a long time, Tang Yan finally came to look for him.
“You, so your battle prowess is actually so high!” He punched Ling Han’s chest, “You hadn’t told me earlier, making me worry for so long.”
Ling Han laughed loudly, “I have always told you not to worry, yet you insist on worrying for no reason.”
“All right, all right, all right.
It’s my fault, all right?” Tang Yan said with a smile.
He was also in a very good mood.
Ling Han had gotten the first place, and had even been bestowed an official position by the Emperor.
Now, would the Clan Mansion still dare to control Ling Han?
“You’re leaving tomorrow to assume your post immediately.
Do you want me to send you off?” he asked.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “As the Little Marquis, you aren’t a very idle person, so I won’t trouble you with everything.”
“All right, I’ll find you for some tea later.” Tang Yan nodded.
In any case, Ling Han had already left the Political Hostage Manor and become a free man, so it would be easy for them to get together.
After the birthday banquet ended, Ling Han returned to the Political Hostage Manor.
He had just entered, when he saw a great many people offering their congratulations.
As it turned out, the fact that he had been appointed as an official by Meng Yonghua had already spread throughout the entire Imperial Capital.
Even this Political Hostage Manor was no exception.
This was awesome.
Just look, everyone were still hostages, but Ling Han had already been personally bestowed the title of an official by the emperor of the Majestic Empire.
The gap between them was as wide as the gap between heaven and earth.
They definitely had to befriend this kind of person.
To say nothing else, it would be good for them to have a few more days of freedom.
On the other hand, Liu Xunyu and the others all bore ugly expressions, wanting nothing more than to swallow Ling Han whole and skin him alive.
How could they have imagined that even the Clan Mansion could not stop the rise of Ling
Han?
Now, they could only sit by and watch as Ling Han became stronger and stronger.
An alchemy prodigy that could concoct the Foundation Dissolution Pill, Ling Han, had boundless future
prospects.
Ling Han swept an eye over these people, not bothering to stop at all.
How could he possibly treat these few people as his opponents?
He stayed for a night, and on the morning of the second day, cultivated for a while.
Then, he left proudly.
“Lord Ling!” The guards at the entrance naturally would not stop him.
Instead, they greeted him obsequiously.
This young man was really too incredible.
How many days had it been?
And he had already walked out of the Political Hostage Manor.
Who knows, he may be able to become a Marquis or Minister in future.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and strode away.
Behind him, Liu Xunyu, Zhao Xiao, Han Bing and Tan Zhengjie were all staring at him, their expressions icy cold.
“What should we do?
Could it be that we are just going to sit by and watch him grow?” Tan Zheng Jie asked, unwilling to give up.
“If you have the ability, you can assassinate him tonight and drag him down with you.” Han Bing made a sarcastic remark, “Haven’t you always said that you want to sacrifice your life for Sister Liu?
This is an extremely good opportunity, right?”
Tan Zhengjie’s expression instantly crumbled.
Firstly, he did not want to die at all, and secondly, even if he did not care about his own safety, there was absolutely no way that he would be a match for Ling Han.
He would only be committing suicide.
“All of you, speak less.” Liu Xunyu said in displeasure, “I will definitely think of a way.
I will definitely not allow him to leave just like that!”
Zhao Xiao and Han Bing looked at each other, and both shook their heads secretly.
By now, it was clear that Ling Han was out of control.
Could it be that you want to go to the Heaven
Military Manor and solicit him again?
The Heaven Military Manor was the department that oversaw the security of the Imperial Capital, and the Imperial Capital was very, very big.
Thus, the Heaven Military Manor had also established a considerable number of subbranches, each managing a small area.
Ling Han was bestowed the title of Crimson Captain.
This was only a minor eighth-rank official position, and was not even qualified to be a leader at a branch of the Heaven Military
Manor.
He was assigned to the Great Peace Division.
The leader of the division was a seventh-rank captain named Yan Lesheng.
After meeting Ling Han, he appointed Ling Han as a captain of the division.
However, because no captain had left the division previously, Ling Han’s current role as captain was actually an empty post.
He didn’t have a single subordinate.
“A murder happened in Long Li, I’ll hand it over to you.” Yan Lesheng tossed over a scroll.
On the first day of work, there was already a mission.
Ling Han didn’t refuse.
He accepted the scroll and started to flip through it.
“A murder has taken place in the Imperial Capital, and the nature of this crime is extremely
vile.
I will give you ten days’ time.
If you are unable to catch the culprit, you can resign on your own!” Yan Lesheng set a deadline for Ling Han.

chapters.title: Chapter 3773: Investigating the case
paragraphs: Chapter 3773: Investigating the case
Wasn’t this making things difficult for him?
Ling Han didn’t have a single soldier under his command. Moreover, he had just arrived here, yet he actually wanted him to solve the crime within 10 days? How was he supposed to solve the crime?
Ling Han looked at Yan Lesheng, thinking that there was no animosity between them, so why was he digging a trap for him right from the start?
This wasn’t taking him down a notch, but rather giving him a hard time.
However… hoho.
Ling Han looked up, and said with a smile, “All right, I promise to complete the mission.”

“Then you may go.” Yan Lesheng waved his hand, “Make the most of your time. After all, human life is of utmost importance. As long as the culprit is not caught, who knows, there may be even more victims.”
Ling Han nodded, took the file, and left.

After Yan Lesheng left, he immediately opened the connection device and said, “Lord Ma, I’ve already handed the case over to him as per your wishes. In ten days, he definitely won’t be able to catch the culprit. I’ll immediately make him resign.”

Ling Han finished flipping through the file, and a thoughtful expression appeared on his face. Actually, there was not just one case of murder within this jurisdiction, but rather seven cases, and they had all happened within half a month’s time.

The first murder took place fifteen days ago, the second was ten days ago, and the third was seven days ago. Then, it became more and more frequent. In the last four days, a murder happened every day.
These murders were all believed to have been committed by the same culprit, because all the blood in the bodies of the victims had been drained.
The strange thing was that there was actually no drop of blood near the corpse.
Ling Han immediately set off, heading to the location of the first murder.

This was a man who lived alone. He was in his thirties, and his corpse had naturally been carried away long ago. Furthermore, because he didn’t have any family, this place was empty, filled with emptiness and coldness.

Ling Han circled around the room. The furnishings here were very simple, and very messy at that. However, it was not disorder caused by battle, but rather disorder caused by carelessness in tidying up.
After walking around for a while, he did not find any clues.
However, this didn’t matter.
Ling Han retrieved the Jade Toad. Right now, he could already use this treasure to perfection.
He placed the jade toad on the ground for a while, then put it away. He left the house, and headed to the quarters of the second victim.
The victim of this house was not single, but rather there was another man living there. The victim was his wife.
“Who are you?” Seeing Ling Han walk straight into the house, the man hurriedly asked.
Ling Han smiled and said, “I’m from the Heaven Military Manor, and I’ve come to investigate your wife’s case.”
“Another investigation,” the man muttered. “You guys come here every few days to investigate, but there’s still no result. What are you guys doing?”
“Don’t worry. Within three days, I will definitely give you justice,” Ling Han said calmly. That man raised his head to look at Ling Han, his face filled with disbelief.

What kind of joke was this? Previously, he had been given excuses and when he asked for progress, the reply was that they were investigating the case, yet you suddenly said that you would be able to find the culprit in three days?
Could this person… be a conman?
Ling Han smiled faintly, “I am not a conman. In any case, there are only three days, and you will soon find out.”
He took out the jade toad, and began to extract the aura of this place.
-The use of this jade toad was very simple, and that was to allow it to first absorb the smell, and then it would be able to follow the traces of aura, and he could begin his pursuit.
However, Ling Han made a comparison, and there were as many as eleven auras that overlapped.
The majority of them should be from the Heaven Military Manor, but was there any among them that had been left behind by the culprit?

Ling Han couldn’t be sure, because how long the smell could be preserved was determined by many conditions, such as whether the space was empty, the flow of air, or temperature. Perhaps the killer’s scent had long since disappeared, so these eleven auras were all left
behind by the guards of Heaven Military Manor.
He left, and went to the home of the third victim.
At this moment, only seven identical auras remained.
Ling Han spent half a day’s time to visit all the places where the seven victims had died, using the jade toad to memorize many auras.
Then, he returned to the branch division, and called over all the people who had participated in the investigation of the seven victims’ cases.
“Captain Ling, isn’t it a little unruly to call my subordinates over without asking first?”
Someone immediately came over and protested to Ling Han.
There were a total of thirteen small teams in this branch, and this person was the captain of the fourth team.
Ling Han smiled and said, “I’ll just borrow them for one minute.”
He used the jade toad to absorb their scents, then waved his hand, indicating that they could leave.
“What’s the meaning of this?” the captain of the fourth team asked in displeasure. Oh, he had called his subordinates over. Was it fun to cause so much trouble and then just dismiss them?
These are my people!
Ling Han glanced at him coldly, “I am investigating the case, yet you are holding me back. Could it be that you have some relation with the murderer?”

“You’re slandering me!” the captain of the fourth team shouted as he pointed at Ling Han. He couldn’t be blamed for this. Otherwise, not only would he lose his official position, but he would even be executed.
“Then shut up, and don’t hold me back!” Ling Han said balefully.
The captain of the fourth team was stunned by Ling Han’s aura, and actually forgot to refute
him. When he came back to his senses, his face was instantly flushed red.
They were both captains, and you are only a general without an army. What right do you have
to be fierce to me?
Ling Han summoned another soldier in charge of the case, comparing his aura.
It wasn’t long before he recorded everyone’s aura.
The captains of the 13 small teams were all extremely displeased. Ling Han didn’t even greet
them and directly called them over. It was unknown what he was doing.

But no matter what the matter was, you are stretching your hand too far! Usually, those captains would also be fighting over power, and their relations were actually very bad, but now, because of Ling Han, these people were all standing together.
“We can’t just let it go like this.”
“That’s right. Otherwise, this brat would think that we are easy to bully, and want to ride on
top of us.”
“We have to teach him a lesson!”
These small captains nodded one after another, then walked towards Ling Han.
“Captain Ling, let’s spar a bit,” someone said with a smile.
“That’s right, let’s go to the training ground.” Immediately, someone agreed.
“That’s right, that’s right. Let’s spar a bit, and improve our relations.”
Ling Han glanced at these 13 people, and asked with a smile, “You really want to spar?”
“What is it? Captain Ling is afraid now?” someone provoked.
“All right, let’s go.”
The group walked towards the training ground. When the ordinary soldiers saw this, they hurriedly followed to watch the excitement.
“How many battles do you guys think this new captain can last?” a soldier asked curiously.
“Three rounds, at most,” someone said with a smile.
“Maybe five rounds,” another person said.
Right at this moment, someone said slowly, “All these captains added together would not be
enough for the new captain to fight.”
After an instant of silence, everyone laughed.
How was this possible? What a colossal joke!
“Could it be that you guys don’t know that this new captain is the man who defeated Wang
Yafei at His Majesty’s birthday banquet yesterday and won the title of the strongest
Foundation Building Tier?”
Ah?
