chapters.title: Chapter 3774: Found the murderer
paragraphs: Chapter 3774: Found the murderer
This new captain was so powerful?
“Really?”
“Of course it’s true. I have an uncle working in the main division. When we had lunch today, my uncle personally told me that this fierce man has been assigned to our branch division.” “F***!”
The soldiers all shook their heads. Looks like their captains were going to be out of luck.
In the arena, Ling Han smiled and said, “You guys can attack together.”
“You really know how to show off!”
“However, since you’ve said so, I’ll oblige you!”

These captains didn’t take any sense of honor to heart. In the first place, they wanted to teach Ling Han a lesson, and as for what methods they used, they didn’t mind at all. Moreover, wasn’t this what Ling Han had requested himself?
Their expressions were all smiles, but they had already spread out, ready to attack at any time. “Let’s go!”
Someone called out, and instantly, the 13 captains moved at the same time, attacking Ling Han.
Ling Han stood proudly and unmoving.
‘Show-offs die quickly!’ these 13 captains all thought, but their offensive did not slow down in the slightest.
Then we will oblige you.
Just when the attack was about to reach him, with a thought from Ling Han, weng, the murderous aura shot out.
Pa, pa, pa, pa! This aura surged past, as if it could topple mountains and overturn seas. Those thirteen people involuntarily paused, and then collapsed onto the ground.
Pu!
The soldiers watching from the sidelines were all gaping, completely dumbfounded.
No way, thirteen captains collapsed just like that?
They knew that Ling Han was powerful, and had even defeated Wang Yafei, but he had not even made a single move, and the 13 captains seemed to have been possessed, and collapsed on their own.
F***, this was too shocking.

There was a smile on Ling Han’s face as he casually walked forwards. However, every step he took was on the backs of those captains, causing these captains to groan. It was so heavy that even their bones were groaning.
They were astounded. How could Ling Han be so powerful?
“Did you enjoy the spar?” Ling Han asked.
What was there to enjoy about? Was there anything to be happy about when they were lying on the ground and being stepped on?
However, when they saw the dangerous expression on Ling Han’s face, how could they dare to say this? They hurriedly nodded in agreement.
“Do you still want to play?” Ling Han asked.
The 13 captains hurriedly shook their heads in unison.
Ling Han nodded, and walked out of the training ground.
He was extremely busy, and he still had to find the culprit.
Right now, there were still two auras that hadn’t been eliminated. However, the sky was already dark, so Ling Han decided to call it a day and continue tomorrow.
He didn’t return to the Political Hostage Manor and stayed in the sub-division.
In terms of conditions, it was actually the Political Hostage Manor that was better, but no matter how luxurious the prison cell was, how could it compare to the air of freedom?
A night passed, and Ling Han woke up early, greeting the morning sun to cultivate. Not long after he finished, he saw that the division had suddenly become noisy.
He ran out to take a look, but his expression darkened, because someone else had died the night before, and their blood had been sucked dry.
“Where is it?” he hurriedly approached and asked.
“Xiuhua Village, third alley, number four.”
Ling Han immediately moved out, heading towards Xiuhua Village. He was practically running at full speed, and soon arrived at the crime scene.
The surroundings had already been sealed off by the soldiers, and unauthorized people were forbidden from entering.
Ling Han walked in, only to see a corpse lying on the ground. There was a look of terror on the corpse’s face.
There were two rows of teeth marks on the neck of the corpse. They were very deep, but should not be fatal. Thus, the cause of death was still excessive blood loss.
He took out the jade toad and extracted auras again. Then, he eliminated them one by one.
In the first place, there were only two suspects left, and after comparison, there was only one left.
Ling Han had the jade toad start tracking the aura, and this toad immediately moved, heading in a certain direction.
“You, you, you, follow me.” Ling Han pointed at three people.

The three of them hurriedly followed behind him. Ling Han had defeated all 13 of the captains yesterday, and he had instantly established a powerful prestige. Thus, they did as he said without a second thought.
Every time Ling Han turned a corner, he would use the jade toad to relocate the trace of aura.
When the three soldiers saw Ling Han fiddle around with a toad, they were all very confused. What was he playing at? Furthermore, he wanted them to follow him.

After about half an hour, Ling Han stopped in front of a very small, dilapidated courtyard. The direction that the Jade Toad was presently pointing in was precisely this courtyard. Ling Han walked over and knocked on the door. However, no one answered.
He knocked again, and still no one answered.
Ling Han released his divine sense, and with a sweep, he discovered that this courtyard was
empty.
He directly pushed open the doors and entered. Mystical power merely vibrated slightly, and the door was broken.
“Captain Ling!” The three guards hurriedly followed him in, feeling even more baffled.
Why are you barging into the home of a commoner for no reason?
Ling Han drew out a chair and sat in the courtyard, waiting patiently. The three soldiers had no choice but to squat at the corner of the wall and keep him company.
At noon, a door creaked open, and the half-closed door was pushed open. A tall man walked
in.
This man looked to be in his thirties, and there was a vigilant expression on his face. He shouted at Ling Han and the others, “Who are you people? Why have you barged into my
house?”
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “We’re from the Heaven Military Manor. As for why we’re here, don’t you know?”

“I don’t know what you’re talking about,” the middle-aged man said with a shake of his head. “Even if you’re from the Heaven Military Manor, you still can’t enter my room as you please. I didn’t do anything wrong! Leave, I want you to leave immediately.”
Ling Han stood up and walked toward the middle-aged man.
The man stepped aside, “Leave!”
Ling Han shook his head, “Why do you suck the blood of others?”
The man’s expression changed drastically.
At first, he had thought that Ling Han had only come in by chance, but when these words
entered his ears, he understood that Ling Han had come with a clear target.
But how had the Heaven Military Manor discovered him?
When he had committed the crime, he had clearly confirmed that the other party was only one person, and it was absolutely impossible that there would be any witnesses.
No, he was going to kill them to keep the secret.
A thought flashed through his mind, and he immediately opened his mouth, revealing two
rows of eerie white teeth. He bit down on Ling Han’s neck, and his hands also spread open,
grabbing out at Ling Han’s shoulders.
He had revealed his true colors so quickly?
“Captain Ling, be careful!”
“He is a blood-sucking demon!”
The three soldiers hurriedly called out. At this moment, they didn’t think about how Ling Han
had found the culprit.
Ling Han stretched out a hand. Pa, he had grabbed hold of the man’s neck. Under the suppression of his vigorous power, that man could not even dream of moving a single muscle.
…This man was only in the Enlightenment Tier.
“Strange!” Ling Han used his eye technique to scan the surroundings, and couldn’t help but look surprised. “Where did the blood you sucked go?”

This man’s face was extraordinarily pale. Thus, Ling Han used his eye technique to scan him, yet discovered that there was pitifully little blood in this man’s body. It only looked to be a few tenths of the blood of an ordinary person.
Being able to cultivate to Blood Transformation Tier, one’s blood and Qi should be extremely vigorous, so how could it possibly decline like this?

sentences.text: Chapter 3774: Found the murderer
This new captain was so powerful?
“Really?”
“Of course it’s true.
I have an uncle working in the main division.
When we had lunch today, my uncle personally told me that this fierce man has been assigned to our branch division.” “F***!”
The soldiers all shook their heads.
Looks like their captains were going to be out of luck.
In the arena, Ling Han smiled and said, “You guys can attack together.”
“You really know how to show off!”
“However, since you’ve said so, I’ll oblige you!”
These captains didn’t take any sense of honor to heart.
In the first place, they wanted to teach Ling Han a lesson, and as for what methods they used, they didn’t mind at all.
Moreover, wasn’t this what Ling Han had requested himself?
Their expressions were all smiles, but they had already spread out, ready to attack at any time.
“Let’s go!”
Someone called out, and instantly, the 13 captains moved at the same time, attacking Ling Han.
Ling Han stood proudly and unmoving.
‘Show-offs die quickly!’ these 13 captains all thought, but their offensive did not slow down in the slightest.
Then we will oblige you.
Just when the attack was about to reach him, with a thought from Ling Han, weng, the murderous aura shot out.
Pa, pa, pa, pa!
This aura surged past, as if it could topple mountains and overturn seas.
Those thirteen people involuntarily paused, and then collapsed onto the ground.
Pu!
The soldiers watching from the sidelines were all gaping, completely dumbfounded.
No way, thirteen captains collapsed just like that?
They knew that Ling Han was powerful, and had even defeated Wang Yafei, but he had not even made a single move, and the 13 captains seemed to have been possessed, and collapsed on their own.
F***, this was too shocking.
There was a smile on Ling Han’s face as he casually walked forwards.
However, every step he took was on the backs of those captains, causing these captains to groan.
It was so heavy that even their bones were groaning.
They were astounded.
How could Ling Han be so powerful?
“Did you enjoy the spar?” Ling Han asked.
What was there to enjoy about?
Was there anything to be happy about when they were lying on the ground and being stepped on?
However, when they saw the dangerous expression on Ling Han’s face, how could they dare to say this?
They hurriedly nodded in agreement.
“Do you still want to play?” Ling Han asked.
The 13 captains hurriedly shook their heads in unison.
Ling Han nodded, and walked out of the training ground.
He was extremely busy, and he still had to find the culprit.
Right now, there were still two auras that hadn’t been eliminated.
However, the sky was already dark, so Ling Han decided to call it a day and continue tomorrow.
He didn’t return to the Political Hostage Manor and stayed in the sub-division.
In terms of conditions, it was actually the Political Hostage Manor that was better, but no matter how luxurious the prison cell was, how could it compare to the air of freedom?
A night passed, and Ling Han woke up early, greeting the morning sun to cultivate.
Not long after he finished, he saw that the division had suddenly become noisy.
He ran out to take a look, but his expression darkened, because someone else had died the night before, and their blood had been sucked dry.
“Where is it?” he hurriedly approached and asked.
“Xiuhua Village, third alley, number four.”
Ling Han immediately moved out, heading towards Xiuhua Village.
He was practically running at full speed, and soon arrived at the crime scene.
The surroundings had already been sealed off by the soldiers, and unauthorized people were forbidden from entering.
Ling Han walked in, only to see a corpse lying on the ground.
There was a look of terror on the corpse’s face.
There were two rows of teeth marks on the neck of the corpse.
They were very deep, but should not be fatal.
Thus, the cause of death was still excessive blood loss.
He took out the jade toad and extracted auras again.
Then, he eliminated them one by one.
In the first place, there were only two suspects left, and after comparison, there was only one left.
Ling Han had the jade toad start tracking the aura, and this toad immediately moved, heading in a certain direction.
“You, you, you, follow me.” Ling Han pointed at three people.
The three of them hurriedly followed behind him.
Ling Han had defeated all 13 of the captains yesterday, and he had instantly established a powerful prestige.
Thus, they did as he said without a second thought.
Every time Ling Han turned a corner, he would use the jade toad to relocate the trace of aura.
When the three soldiers saw Ling Han fiddle around with a toad, they were all very confused.
What was he playing at?
Furthermore, he wanted them to follow him.
After about half an hour, Ling Han stopped in front of a very small, dilapidated courtyard.
The direction that the Jade Toad was presently pointing in was precisely this courtyard.
Ling Han walked over and knocked on the door.
However, no one answered.
He knocked again, and still no one answered.
Ling Han released his divine sense, and with a sweep, he discovered that this courtyard was
empty.
He directly pushed open the doors and entered.
Mystical power merely vibrated slightly, and the door was broken.
“Captain Ling!” The three guards hurriedly followed him in, feeling even more baffled.
Why are you barging into the home of a commoner for no reason?
Ling Han drew out a chair and sat in the courtyard, waiting patiently.
The three soldiers had no choice but to squat at the corner of the wall and keep him company.
At noon, a door creaked open, and the half-closed door was pushed open.
A tall man walked
in.
This man looked to be in his thirties, and there was a vigilant expression on his face.
He shouted at Ling Han and the others, “Who are you people?
Why have you barged into my
house?”
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “We’re from the Heaven Military Manor.
As for why we’re here, don’t you know?”
“I don’t know what you’re talking about,” the middle-aged man said with a shake of his head.
“Even if you’re from the Heaven Military Manor, you still can’t enter my room as you please.
I didn’t do anything wrong!
Leave, I want you to leave immediately.”
Ling Han stood up and walked toward the middle-aged man.
The man stepped aside, “Leave!”
Ling Han shook his head, “Why do you suck the blood of others?”
The man’s expression changed drastically.
At first, he had thought that Ling Han had only come in by chance, but when these words
entered his ears, he understood that Ling Han had come with a clear target.

No, he was going to kill them to keep the secret.

grabbing out at Ling Han’s shoulders.

At this moment, they didn’t think about how Ling Han

Pa, he had grabbed hold of the man’s neck.
Under the suppression of his vigorous power, that man could not even dream of moving a single muscle.
…This man was only in the Enlightenment Tier.

“Where did the blood you sucked go?”

It only looked to be a few tenths of the blood of an ordinary person.

chapters.title: Chapter 3775: Ended abruptly
paragraphs: Chapter 3775: Ended abruptly
Ling Han swiped out a finger like a blade, easily slicing open the middle-aged man’s skin. Wisps of blood seeped out of the wound, as if there was no blood in this person’s body at all.
A blood-sucking monster, logically speaking, should have a lot of blood in his body, but why did he look like a dried corpse?
“Yi!” The three soldiers all exclaimed in shock, an expression of intense shock on their faces. This kind of scene was not something that could be seen every day.
Ling Han picked up the middle-aged man a bit, and said, “Tell me, why exactly did you kill him?”
The middle-aged man suddenly changed his previously fearful expression, and bared his teeth at Ling Han, looking extremely vicious and evil.
Ling Han’s fingers clenched slightly, and instantly, a cracking sound was heard. However, the middle-aged man did not react at all, as if the person Ling Han was squeezing was not him at
all.
Yi, didn’t he feel any pain?
“Do you want to know? Let me take a bite, and you’ll understand everything,” the middle- aged man said. His eyes emitted a crimson light.

Ling Han instantly felt a consciousness invading his mind, wanting to control him. However, the three Celestial Foundations in his mind all vibrated slightly, and this evil thought of invasion immediately vanished without a trace.
Shua, shua, shua! However, behind Ling Han, the three soldiers all moved, grabbing out at Ling Han’s neck.
The eyes of these three people… had all become bloodshot.
They had been controlled.

Ling Han’s Celestial Foundations could be considered supreme in quality, so no evil could penetrate him. However, these three soldiers did not have such strong abilities, and were immediately bewitched.
“An!” Ling Han opened his mouth and spat out a Buddhist chant.

Peng! Black smoke billowed from the bodies of the three guards, and was instantly annihilated. Meanwhile, the eyes of the three guards immediately returned to normal. They were all at a loss. In fact, there was a strong sense of fear in their eyes.
“Just now, I seemed to have been possessed by a ghost.”
“I can’t control my body at all.”
“No, it’s a willpower that affected me, causing me to completely lose myself.”
Fear lingered in their hearts. If Ling Han hadn’t dispelled the evil aura for them, who knew what they would have done.

“You are actually the heir of the Buddhist Race!” The middle-aged man also looked shocked. This Six Characters Bright King Curse was one of the Buddhist Sect’s two ultimate techniques, purifying all beings and expiating evil. Now, it was actually seen from a young man. This was really extremely unexpected.
“Are you surprised? Are you shocked?” Ling Han asked with a smile.

“Brat, don’t be so smug. You can’t possibly know anything!” the middle-aged man said. Pa, his entire head exploded like a watermelon, white-colored brain matter splashing everywhere, almost without blood.

Ling Han instantly activated the Starlight Screen, blocking all the filth. However, the three soldiers didn’t have that kind of strength. Caught off guard, they were splattered all over. Some had good immunity, while others didn’t. Immediately, they threw up on the sidelines. Ling Han frowned upon seeing this. The culprit had actually self-destructed!
In this way, the clues came to an abrupt stop.
This middle-aged man was indeed the culprit. However, why did he suck blood? Where did the blood he sucked go?
These doubts had not been resolved.
“Take him back to the sub division,” Ling Han said, casually tossing the headless corpse onto the ground.

“Yes, milord!” The three guards hurriedly straightened their backs and replied respectfully. Ling Han returned to the division. He had a feeling that the middle-aged man’s death was not the end of the blood-sucking incident. On the contrary, it was very likely just the beginning.
When the three soldiers brought the middle-aged man’s corpse back, the entire division was in an uproar.
How could it not be shocking?

Seven blood-sucking cases had already happened before, and the length of time had surpassed half a month, but no one had solved the case. However, when it was Ling Han’s turn, he had just arrived at the division, and did not have a single soldier under his command. He actually used only a day and a half to solve the case and catch the culprit.
Of course, the only flaw was that the culprit had committed suicide.
The 13 captains all wore dark expressions. The more capable Ling Han was, the more it highlighted their incompetence.
‘F*ck! You clearly already have a clue, so why didn’t you bring them along when you captured the culprit?’

Someone immediately tattled on Ling Han, saying that Ling Han had no concept of teamwork, and only knew how to play the role of a hero. Otherwise, with the other captains going together, they would definitely be able to capture him alive and prevent him from committing suicide.

It wasn’t just one of them. The other captains all joined in, completely ignoring the fact that Ling Han had solved the case. Instead, they talked about how he had not captured him alive, and rebuked him harshly.
More importantly, it was as if Yan Lesheng had gone blind as well, giving Ling Han a heavy reprimand.

Ling Han smirked coldly. On his first day here, this guy had deliberately made things difficult for him, having him take over a troublesome case, and even requested that the case be solved within ten days. Now that he had solved the case, he was making a huge fuss over a minor issue. This was practically going too far.
The other party was still babbling, and Ling Han directly turned around and left.
“Ling Han! Ling Han!” Yan Lesheng shouted loudly, but Ling Han acted as if he had not heard him, and had already walked out.

“F***!” He couldn’t help but feel like he was about to go crazy, throwing things around. He was also so terrifying that the soldiers who had wanted to come in to take a look at the situation retreated one after another.
After being angry for a while, he opened the connection device, “Lord Ma, that brat actually solved the murder!”
“… Yes, don’t worry. I will definitely cause trouble for him, and make him obediently resign, and get back to the Political Hostage Manor.”
“Alright, I’ll report to you when the matter is settled.”
Ling Han rented a courtyard nearby, then brought the large black dog and pervert pig over from the Political Hostage Manor.
He logged onto the Galaxy Network again, and sent the address to the empress. After another half an hour, the empress, Hu Niu, and the babies all appeared.
Lin Luo, Zhou Heng, and the others had already joined various sects. With their natural talent,
it was definitely no problem for them to be nurtured as key disciples. In fact, they would even become Dao Child-level disciples in the future.
“Ling Han!” Hu Niu was the first to jump over and hug him, like a koala.
A smile appeared on Ling Han’s face. A large part of the reason why he was so determined was because of the people around him. This was his motivation.
“Greetings, Father!” The seven babies giggled. After so long, they still looked like babies, as
if they wouldn’t grow up.
However, their strength increased very quickly. They had all advanced into Ultimate Dao Foundation, and were not the slightest bit inferior to Ling Han.
Meanwhile, Tang Yun’er pouted. The appearance of this Handsome Brother had caused the
empress to ignore her. This was taking things too far!
The family reunited. Unfortunately, those like Liu Yutong and the others could only be
trapped in the inner world.
Ling Han believed that when he became stronger, even if these people hadn’t reached the Heavenly Venerable Tier yet, he would still have the ability to safely send them out.
On this night, the Ling Clan was filled with joy.𝗳𝐫𝚎𝗲𝚠𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝘃𝚎𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝗺

The next morning, everyone welcomed the rising sun to cultivate. The empress, the large black dog, and the others were about to reach the peak stage of Human Dao Foundation. Coincidentally, Ling Han had a large number of Foundation Dissolution Pills in his possession, which was enough to help them cultivate the foundations of the Celestial Path to
perfection when they broke through.
After he had finished cultivating, Ling Han logged onto the Galaxy Network and began the
ranking battles.

chapters.title: Chapter 3776: New case
paragraphs: Chapter 3776: New case
Ling Han had initially wanted to challenge Origin to a battle to earn more money from tickets, but he had never imagined that Origin would actually break through.
He was now a Cauldron Forging Tier elite.

Although the Galaxy Network could suppress cultivation level and a relatively fair battle at the same cultivation level could be achieved, suppressing one’s own cultivation level was unjust in the first place for a true prodigy.
-If he did not fight on the cultivation level that he should have, no matter what, it would have an effect.
Thus, Origin refused his invitation to battle, and only told him to break through to the Cauldron Forging Tier as soon as possible, so they could start another supreme battle.
Not only Origin, but Myriad Dao and Heaven Crushing also broke through to Cauldron Forging Tier, unwilling to battle Ling Han at the same cultivation level.
Alright, if he couldn’t earn this money, then he would break records. He could also earn some money in that manner.

Ling Han started to break all kinds of records. Records of power, records of speed, he would break any record. Breaking any record would earn him a reward of 1000 Universe Coins, which added together was quite a lot.
By now, he was already in the Ultimate Dao Foundation, and his strength had reached a pinnacle level. He had broken practically all the records.𝚏𝕣𝐞𝗲𝐰𝕖𝐛𝐧𝕠𝕧𝚎𝚕.𝐜𝚘𝗺

Though he had not truly battled Origin at the same cultivation level, and had not even battled Myriad Dao or Heaven Crushing, everyone now agreed that in terms of aptitude and natural talent, Ling Han was definitely the strongest in all eternity.

Although Ling Han’s power was the strongest and his speed was the fastest, this didn’t mean that his battle prowess was the highest. However, when one reached the heights of Ling Han and Origin, who would be weaker than the other in terms of battle awareness?
Ling Han could surpass Origin and the others in all aspects, and was definitely the strongest prodigy of all eternity.

Right now, the entire galaxy was searching for the four of them. Some of them wanted to take them as disciples, while most of them wanted to capture them and slowly investigate their secrets. The freakish nature of their existence was inconceivable, and it was definitely impossible for them to appear out of thin air.

However, fortunately, Ling Han and the others had concealed their identities very well. They were clearly famous throughout the Galaxy Network, and the entire universe had heard of their names, but no one knew their true identities.

For example, Ling Han. Who would have thought that a hostage that Dark North Nation had sent over would actually be the freakish freak that was even more freakish than Origin and the others, “Number One in the Galaxy”?

The following two days passed very calmly. Aside from cultivating, Ling Han spent his time concocting alchemical pills, accompanying his wives and children, and watching the large black dog and pervert pig look at each other in disdain. Though it was simple, it was filled with warmth, making Ling Han feel as if he was leaving behind all the troubles, and was just going to spend the rest of his life like this.
However, this thought only flashed through his mind, and he immediately became serious. In this world where martial arts were paramount, where was the true land of peace?
Only by possessing absolute strength would he be able to protect the people by his side, and only then would he be able to safeguard the peace that he had now.
But on the fourth day, something happened.
Ling Han went to the division as usual, but was immediately called to Yan Lesheng’s place.
Peng, the moment the other saw him enter, he slammed the report in his hands onto the table, pointed angrily at him, and said, “Ling Han, do you know what the crime of deceiving the Emperor is?”
Ling Han smiled faintly, and sat down on the chair. “Don’t accuse me for no reason.”
The other only had the cultivation level of Human Cauldron, so he was unafraid.

Yan Lesheng suppressed his anger, and said, “Last night, another blood-sucking murder case appeared, and it was three consecutive cases at that! So, the corpse you brought back isn’t the culprit at all!”
“Oh?” Yet Ling Han’s eyes lit up. Previously, when that blood-sucking person had committed suicide, all the clues were cut off, and a great many doubts were buried with him.
Now, a new blood-sucking murder had happened. Though it was a tragedy, it also meant that the answer could be found again.

He picked up the murder report and examined it, then said, “These are three new murderers.” “What makes you so sure that there are three people?” Yan Lesheng said. The cause of death for the three victims were completely the same, and all of them had had all their blood sucked out, which was shockingly similar.
“Instinct,” Ling Han said. “The person I brought back was definitely the culprit of the previous eight murders. Now, there are three new culprits. Hehe, what’s hidden behind them?”

“Since you’ve solved the first serial blood-sucking murder case, then I’ll hand these three cases over to you. I’ll give you three days’ time. If you can’t solve the case on time, I’ll punish you,” Yan Lesheng said in an overbearing manner.
Ling Han did not speak, and merely stared at him, which made Yan Lesheng feel slightly uncomfortable.
“Lord Yan, please don’t ruin yourself!” he said calmly.
“Are you threatening me?” Yan Lesheng exploded in anger. You are merely in the Foundation Building Tier, and you actually have such a big mouth?

chapters.title: Chapter 3777: Trap
paragraphs: Chapter 3777: Trap
“Tell me quickly, why do you suck human blood!” Yan Lesheng put on his authority as an official, and shouted loudly.
“A mere Cauldron Forging Tier dares to be impudent, humph!” the middle-aged woman said coldly.
Yan Lesheng was already furious to begin with, and with her words, his face instantly turned livid.
Where was his authority?
First, it was Ling Han, a Foundation Building cultivator, who dared to talk back to him, and now it was this mere Inscription Tier cultivator. Which of them took him seriously?
“Beat her!” He waved his hand.

The middle-aged woman released a strange howl, and her eyes suddenly lit up. Weng, instantly, the eyes of every single person in the room turned red, exuding an aura of madness. Their reason was instantly drowned out, and only one thought remained – to kill.

Only two people were unaffected. One was Ling Han, and the other was Yan Lesheng, but he wasn’t completely unaffected. His eyes were also slightly red, but compared to the others, he only became more irritable, but didn’t lose control to the point of wanting to kill.

Ling Han’s heart clenched. This kind of bewitching technique was truly powerful. Even Foundation Building cultivators wouldn’t be spared. Moreover, the one who cast this kind of technique was only a measly Inscription Tier cultivator.
Could an Inscription Tier cultivator be as strong as this?
That was absolutely impossible. If such an existence really existed, then the whole world would be in complete chaos.
Then… what was the real reason?
Peng! Peng! Peng!
Right at this moment, everyone was already fighting fiercely.
Those captains had all had their minds controlled, and launched attacks at Yan Lesheng and Ling Han.

“Humph!” Yan Lesheng roared in fury, and the battle prowess of the Cauldron Forging Tier was activated. He merely raised his hand, and those captains and soldiers were all subdued. “Freak, who exactly are you!” he shouted at the middle-aged woman.
Obviously, he didn’t think that a mere Inscription Tier could possess such massive power that it could even bewitch a Foundation Building cultivator.
The middle-aged woman laughed loudly, extremely crazed, but as she laughed, pa, her head exploded.
It was exactly the same as the previous murderer.
However, this time, Ling Han spread out his divine sense, carefully capturing it.
He keenly discovered that a sliver of soul fluctuation had shot out, but it was too fast, so he couldn’t catch up at all.
As expected.

Ling Han nodded internally. Why was it that this middle-aged woman had never seen him before, yet could recognize him with a single glance? Why was it that she was clearly only an Inscription Tier, yet could bewitch Foundation Building Tier elites?
That was because she, as well as the blood-sucking man from before, had all been taken over by an elite through a sliver of his divine sense. They were not themselves at all.
This elite’s cultivation level should be very high. Otherwise, it was impossible that a sliver of divine sense could affect a Foundation Building cultivator.
Moreover, where had the blood of this middle-aged woman and the blood-sucking man gone?
Had all the blood been delivered to that elite?
However, since he was so powerful, why didn’t he attack himself?

There were two possible reasons for this. Firstly, that person had been severely wounded, so it was inconvenient for him to move. Thus, he could only use his divine sense to affect others and have them bring him blood to heal his injuries. Secondly, it was also possible that the identity of that person was too sensitive, so he could not take the risk of being discovered, even if there was the slightest bit of chance.
Ling Han thought for a moment, and ruled out the second possibility.
Because if it was a sensitive identity, how was he supposed to get blood from the “blood slaves”?
Whether it was a blood slave going to his place, or him coming to find the blood slave, or a third location for them to meet up, it was possible that he would be seen.

Perhaps this was also possible, but Ling Han was more inclined towards the first possibility. Some elite was severely wounded, and he needed blood to heal himself. However, he couldn’t move, so he could only use his divine sense to affect others and have them bring blood to him. If that was the case… just how many blood slaves were there in this city?

Ling Han couldn’t help but let his thoughts wander. That was because that elite could even affect Foundation Building Tier cultivators, and it was too convenient for Foundation Building cultivators to kill people. It was also very easy to destroy the evidence.
There should be more than eleven victims. In fact, the number of victims should be several times, dozens of times, or even hundreds of times this number.
This matter was more serious than he had imagined.
Ling Han set out again to catch the remaining two murderers. However, he found their home, yet after a long while, the two of them had still not returned.
‘Heh, he knows that I have a special tracking technique, so he’s hiding and not coming back?’ Ling Han continued his pursuit, but he lost all clues when he reached the banks of a large river.
The two of them should have jumped into the river and used the river water to wash away their aura. It was unknown where they had landed.
Ling Han walked along the bank, continuously using the jade toad to search for a scent. After half a day, he still did not find anything.
He switched to the other bank of the river, and continued his search.
Found it!
A smile appeared on Ling Han’s face. He had captured two auras at the same time. Clearly, the two of them had reunited after coming ashore.
He followed the trail, and after going around in circles for a long time, he actually arrived in
front of a large cemetery.
The jade toad was pointing at this place.
Ling Han didn’t act rashly. Instead, he retrieved the Void Beast hide and draped it over his
body, concealing his tracks.
Things had progressed too smoothly. Those two people had both thought of using the river water to conceal their aura, so how could he have found them so easily?
Moreover, the two of them were moving together, as if they were afraid that he would not be
able to find them.
Thus, this could possibly be a trap.
Perhaps there was a super elite hidden in the dark, so Ling Han had to be careful.
He entered into the mausoleum, and quietly circled around, but did not discover anything.
He released his divine sense, and searched inch by inch.
‘Hmm?’
He had found something!
In a tomb, he discovered the fluctuations of life.
How could there be fluctuations of life in a tomb?

The auras of the two people from before had disappeared here, but he had already searched the entire cemetery, yet did not find anything. Thus, the possibility that the two of them were hiding in the cemetery was very high.
Ling Han remained calm and collected. He was naturally unafraid of those two people, but that mysterious elite might also be lying in ambush here.
He waited quietly, filled with patience.
It wasn’t long before the sky darkened. The moon hung in the middle of the sky, radiating
with a silvery glow.
Peng, a hand suddenly stretched out of the mud, and then another hand broke out of the
ground.
If Ling Han had been unprepared, he would probably have been shocked, but now, he only
smiled faintly.
Peng, another person broke out of the ground.
The two blood slaves had appeared, so where was that elite? Was he also here?
Ling Han was very patient, and continued to wait.
Another few hours passed, and when a sliver of white appeared on the horizon, peng, another
pair of hands broke through the mud at the same time.
Ling Han was shocked, because he had not discovered beforehand that there was actually a living person buried underneath.
It must be that elite that managed to deceive his divine sense.
Ling Han was internally shocked. This was indeed a trap. If he had not been very careful, and
exposed himself, he would naturally be dead now.
Peng, the dirt split apart, and the third person also sat up.
This was an old man with crimson red hair, two sharp fangs, and bloodshot eyes. Looking at This fingernails, they were sharp and long, as if they were small knives.

chapters.title: Chapter 3778: The real culprit
paragraphs: Chapter 3778: The real culprit
Ling Han activated his eye technique and looked at the elder.
He couldn’t see through him!

If the other was in the Foundation Building Tier, then Ling Han would be able to clearly see his cultivation level. If he was in the Cauldron Forging Tier, then he would at least be able to vaguely see the appearance of the Celestial Cauldron, but from the Core Formation Tier
onwards, he wouldn’t be able to see anything.
It was not that his eye technique was not strong, but rather that his cultivation level was too low.
However, his eye technique couldn’t see through him at all, meaning that he was at least at the Core Formation Tier, or perhaps even stronger.

There was shockingly a hole in the old man’s chest, as if it had been pierced through by someone’s hand. Blood was still flowing from it, but the speed was extremely slow. Furthermore, this blood was like crystal, as if it was about to solidify.

“Damn it, I need more blood!” The old man coughed. He rubbed lightly at the top of the wound, while his eyes revealed a baleful killing intent, “Five Dao, when I recover from my injuries, find the Mystery Realm, and my cultivation level goes up another level, it will be the time of your death!”
“There’s also that damn brat. He actually has a treasure that can track scents, almost exposing where I’m hiding.”
“That brat is quite smart. Logically speaking, he should have found this place long ago, yet has not appeared for a long time. Clearly, he knows that this is a trap.”
“I have to change locations. If he seeks out an elite, with my cultivation level that has just recovered to Cauldron Forging Tier-level, it would not be easy to block them.”
As he spoke to himself, the two blood slaves stood solemnly at the side, as if they were stone statues.

“The two of you, come and help me up,” the old man commanded the two blood slaves. The two of them hurriedly went to help him up. When they helped the old man out of the pit, Ling Han shockingly discovered that this old man actually lost a leg.
The wound was very new, and just like his chest, blood was still dripping from it.
Ling Han’s heartbeat sped up slightly. He was thinking about whether he should take the chance to make a move.
This was a very good opportunity. The enemy’s ambush had failed, and they were about to leave in disappointment. This was the time when their defenses were at their weakest.
His opponent had the strength of the Cauldron Forging Tier. If he suddenly activated the Heavenly Pattern Jade to launch a sneak attack on him, there was a very high chance that he would succeed.
The question was, would this be another trap?
That old man may already know that he was nearby, and those words previously were deliberately spoken for him to hear, in order to draw him to make a move.

‘No, if he wanted to bait me, he should say that he’s in the Foundation Building Tier. Otherwise, if there’s a gap of a major tier, so what if I launch a sneak attack? How many people can succeed?’ Ling Han immediately thought. After all, such a powerful Foundation Building Tier like him was extremely rare. If that old man could even predict this, then he was truly kickass.
Ling Han pondered internally, and thought that his judgement was correct.
‘Alright, I’ll take a gamble.’
Ling Han took out the Heavenly Pattern Jade, and after injecting his Spiritual Power into it, it became extraordinarily light.
He approached quietly, and when he was within fifteen meters of the old man, he did not come any closer. With a thought, the Heavenly Pattern Jade had already shot out.
“Die!” Ling Han also activated Imminent Skyline and charged forward.
This was really too sudden. Who would have thought that an attack would suddenly appear in an empty place?
The Heavenly Pattern Jade streaked through the air at 40 times the speed of sound.
The old man couldn’t help but feel astonished.

If he had been prepared, with his current Cauldron Forging Tier cultivation level, he would still have space to dodge. However, this was too sudden, and the distance was too close, so he couldn’t dodge.
This old man was quite ruthless. With a grab of both hands, he had already thrown the two blood slaves as a shield in front of him.

Peng, peng! The Heavenly Pattern Jade smashed into their bodies, immediately blasting out. Under the powerful shockwaves, the bodies of the two blood slaves also exploded, as if they were balloons that had been popped.

“That brat is quite smart.

chapters.title: Chapter 3779: Suck yourself to death
paragraphs: Chapter 3779: Suck yourself to death
Weng, a precious tower appeared above Ling Han’s head, pouring down tens of thousands of Primal Chaos Qi. There were flashes of lightning flickering, and it was indescribably divine.
Peng!
The elder’s attack arrived, and his palm pressed down. However, it was blocked by the Primal Chaos Qi, which brought his hand directly downwards.
The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, an Imperial Weapon!
However, the old man’s battle prowess was still Heaven Cauldron-level, after all. He immediately roared loudly, and exerted strength in both his hand and foot, stopping the sinking of his body.

He was astonished. Although he only had the power of the Heaven Cauldron, what Foundation Building Tier cultivator wouldn’t he be able to completely crush? This kind of crushing power was definitely not something that any Spirit Tool could reverse. Limited by cultivation level, even if it was a Four Star or Five Star Spirit Tool, the might it could unleash would be limited. But why was it that the aura of Primal Chaos was actually enough to make him stumble?
Unless… he couldn’t help but feel a jolt in his heart.
Could it be that this was a Saint Tool?

Materials that could be forged into Saint Tools naturally possessed indescribable might. Thus, even in the hands of low cultivation level cultivators, they would often be able to unleash might that surpassed their cultivation level.
“Give it to me!” The old man changed his target of attack and grabbed at the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, planning to forcibly capture it.
Zi, the light of lightning surged madly, striking towards the old man.
This light was too fast, and even the elder couldn’t dodge it. Instantly, he was hit head-on. Under the surging of the electric current, his whole body shivered, and even his hair stood on end.
How could the might of an Imperial Weapon be underestimated?

Ling Han let out a battle cry, and took advantage of the opening to launch a counterattack. That old man was really strong. Under the circumstance of missing one hand, one leg, and two fingers, numbed by electricity, he was still able to send out a palm strike towards Ling Han.

Peng, the two of them exchanged a blow, and Ling Han once again cried out loudly, throwing up blood madly. Meanwhile, the old man was not having a good time either. His face was completely pale, and blood was gushing from the wounds on his chest, elbow, fingers and leg. The amount was a little frightening.

The elder paled in shock. The cultivation technique he cultivated was unique, and blood was the source of his energy. This was also why he had used his divine sense to infiltrate those blood slaves when he was severely injured. A large amount of blood could speed up the recovery of his injuries.
However, on the other hand, he was losing a lot of blood now. Not only would this affect his battle prowess, but in serious cases, it might even kill him.
He was both greedy and furious.𝒇𝙧𝙚𝓮𝔀𝓮𝒃𝙣𝓸𝒗𝒆𝒍.𝙘𝒐𝒎

How much he wanted to obtain this “Saint Tool”. To have it fall into the hands of a measly Foundation Building cultivator was practically a huge waste. However, this measly Foundation Building cultivator was actually about to force him into desperate straits, which made him extremely furious.

He was a Spirit Transformation True Lord, and he could kill this ant with a single breath. After he recovered from his injuries, he would suck this brat dry of his blood and turn him into a corpse slave without any willpower.
The elder decided to retreat. With a turn of his body, he was just about to flee.
However, he only had one leg now, so how fast could he run?

Ling Han activated the Imminent Skyline and instantly caught up to him. He threw a series of attacks at him, especially the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. Every streak of Primal Chaos Qi was as heavy as a mountain, and every bolt of lightning was incredibly fierce.
The old man shouted loudly, but there was nothing he could do.
Who asked him to be severely injured, and only have one leg left?
“Brat, you forced me to do this!” the old man said through gritted teeth. He finally summoned his own Spirit Tool, a small rattle-drum.
He bit his lip, and with a ‘pu’, spat out a mouthful of blood at the rattle-drum.
“Huh? You’re clearly covered in blood, so why did you bite yourself?” Ling Han asked in
confusion.
Right, right!
The elder was also taken aback. ‘Why do I have to bite my own tongue? Although my Spirit Tool can only be activated with blood, aren’t I bleeding continuously now?’
What a loss, a great loss!
He was extremely depressed. He had actually been laughed at by a minor character like this. This was utterly humiliating.
“Die!” He flew into a humiliated rage. He didn’t care anymore. As long as he killed this brat, all his humiliation would disappear without a trace.
Boom, with his full power, that rattle-drum instantly rang out.
Tong! Tong! Tong!
Multiple sounds rang out, directly stabbing into Ling Han’s heart, instantly causing him to bleed from all his apertures.

This was originally a Spiritual Transformation Tier precious tool. If it unleashed its full power, Ling Han would instantly turn into a pool of blood. However, the old man was severely injured now, so he couldn’t unleash its full power. Moreover, he knew how he himself was suffering now, because once this precious tool channeled, it would endlessly extract his blood and Qi.
Under normal circumstances, it wouldn’t matter. He would just suck the blood of others, but now that he had lost too much blood, how could he bear such torment?
He would die at the slightest provocation.
Thus, he had first thought of escaping, and was forced into desperate straits. Only then was he willing to put his life on the line.
Tong! Tong! Tong!
The old man shook his rattle-drum. He himself was not much better, and his face was also becoming paler and paler. It was not that he had lost all rosiness in his face, but he really
looked like a white candle.
‘F*ck! I’m about to die!’

Weng, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower sent down endless streaks of Primal Chaos Qi. This coudl greatly weaken the destructive power from the sounds released by the Spirit Tool, and Ling Han was also shouting the Six Characters Bright King Curse loudly in his mind. Though that sound was not an evil existence, but rather pure destructive power, using sound to oppose sound, there should still be some effect.

Ling Han gave a loud shout, and used the Demonic Monkey Fists. A boundless air of violence circulated, and he shot out a punch. A seven-coloured brilliance spread out, and it was as if the whole world had turned into an endless darkness. Only a single fist shot out, and even the stars that filled the skies were dazzlingly bright, this punch was capable of shattering them
with a single punch.
When the Battle Saint Emperor had used it before, it would have definitely possessed the might to shatter stars with a single punch. However, in Ling Han’s hands, it only possessed a
kind of aura.
But even if it was just an aura, it still caused the old man to pale in shock.
This was a real Imperial Technique!
The punch landed, and the old man was instantly hit. A heavy punch landed on his chest. Thankfully, it was not where the original wound was. Otherwise, this punch would probably
take his life.
The old man was blasted back 90 meters. He looked down, and there was another groove in his chest. At least three of his ribs had been broken by this punch, causing his chest to cave in.
What kind of precious technique was this? It was too terrifying. The might of a single punch could actually reach such an extent.
This was definitely a Saint’s technique. This brat’s luck was heaven-defying, and he had obtained the inheritance of a Saint. Thus, he had wielded a Saint Tool and delivered a Saint’s
technique with his fist!
The elder’s eyes were bloodshot. He was going to fight with his life on the line. The
inheritance of a Saint was worth this risk.

“Die!” He shook the rattle-drum even more intensely. The little bit of Qi and blood that he had in the first place was continuously drawn away, and not only had his whole body lost its colour, it was also shriveling, as if he had turned into a skeleton.
This Spirit Tool was truly sinister.
It shouldn’t have been forged by the old man himself, right? Otherwise, there was really something wrong with this old man’s brain.

The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower floated above Ling Han’s head, chanting the Six Characters Bright King Curse, resisting the attacks of this Spirit Tool. Though he was still bleeding from his seven apertures, his body was brimming with life, far from being killed by
the shockwaves.
A few minutes later.
“I… f*ck your entire family!” the old man said in defiance. He was like a dried corpse as he was actually sucked to death by his own Spirit Tool.

chapters.title: Chapter 3780: Threat from an unknown source
paragraphs: Chapter 3780: Threat from an unknown source

The old man crashed to the ground. A mighty Spirit Transformation True Lord had actually died at the hands of a Foundation Building cultivator because he had been severely wounded. This was truly an incredible injustice.
He died with remaining grievances. His eyes were still wide open, and there was a hint of greed in his expression.

It was very likely that he was still thinking about the “Saint’s inheritance” before he died, and if he knew that it wasn’t the Saint’s inheritance at all, but rather the Imperial Weapon and Imperial Technique, who knew how pained and resentful he would be.
Ling Han also flopped onto the ground. The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was automatically retracted and sank into his forehead.
His personal Spirit Tool could be stored inside one’s body.
This battle was really fatal. He was bleeding from all his apertures, and more than half of his internal organs had been destroyed. At least, his lifespan would be shortened by a dozen over years.

It was no wonder that Foundation Building Tier cultivators could live for 1000 years, while Minor Advanced Tier cultivators could live for 40,000 years. This was because it was inevitable that one would be severely wounded in battle. This was all at the cost of expending one’s life essence. Even if one’s injuries recovered, these hidden wounds would still remain. They couldn’t be healed.
… Unless he could ingest Saintly medicine and recover to a perfect body.

Ling Han ingested a healing alchemical pill, and channelled the Ancient Sun Divine Scroll. After quite a while, he finally suppressed the boiling inside his body. The damaged organs were already beginning to recover under the dual nourishment of the medicinal effects and mystical power, but if they were to completely recover, it would take at least a few days.
Right at this moment, the old man’s body suddenly lit up.
What the heck, was it a reanimated corpse?
Ling Han was already prepared to pour out the Heavenly Dao Flames. In his current state, he definitely wouldn’t be able to defeat a Cauldron Forging Tier elite.
Weng, that rattle-drum floated up by itself. Xiu, it tore through the air and left.
Yi?
Ling Han was confused. This Spirit Tool that had lost its owner could fly away on its own? Absolutely impossible! Unless-

He had not even finished the thought, when he saw a ball of light suddenly appear beside the old man’s corpse. It was continuously kneading, as if it was about to take form, yet had not taken form all this while.
“You dare ruin my plans, ant!” A voice rang out mentally.

Ling Han was shocked, and instantly understood. That rattle-drum Spirit Tool belonged to the owner of this voice, and for some unknown reason, it was given to the old man to use. Now that the old man was dead, it was taken back by the owner of this voice. It was even manifesting a sliver of intent here, issuing a threat to him.
Hehe, do you think I’m afraid of you!
With a thought from Ling Han, he threw a rock at it. However, divine sense was invisible, and the rock passed through the shadowy image.
“How dare you!” That was obviously a super elite, capable of manifesting his thoughts from some unknown corner of the universe. Perhaps, he was even more powerful than a Sect Master.

Peng! The reply was an even larger rock that passed through the shadowy image before heavily crashing into the ground, causing a cloud of dust and dirt to billow into the air. “Good! Good! Good!” That elite had probably exploded in fury, and could not even speak. Peng, a larger, larger rock smashed over again, landing directly on the old man’s corpse. In this way, even that shadowy image could not be seen.
However, in an instant, the ball of light floated out of the rock.
“You’re dead!” the super elite said in a cold voice that was transmitted through divine sense.
However, after saying this, the ball of light dissipated, as if it was afraid that Ling Han would throw another rock at it.
-He had never seen such a hothead, that even that elite felt exasperated.

Ling Han smiled faintly. He was naturally unafraid. If that elite could make a move, he would not have spoken so much nonsense, and directly captured or killed him. Obviously, the latter too could not reach him, and could only use his mouth.
He rested for a while, stabilizing the injuries in his body. Then, he stood up. With a thought, the stone on the old man’s corpse was snatched away by his Spiritual Power.

On the ground, the old man’s corpse hadn’t suffered any damage. Being able to cultivate to the Spiritual Transformation Tier, his bones and skin were naturally extremely tough. At the very least, they couldn’t be crushed by a rock… In fact, even if his body was crushed under a mountain, it might not be damaged.
Ling Han searched the old man’s body and found a Spatial Spirit Tool.
There were… not many things inside. There were only about a hundred Dao Stones and a thin metal plate.
The material of this metal was unknown, and was incredibly thin. There was a painting on it, and it looked like a map.
Being able to be stored away by a Spirit Transformation True Lord, it shouldn’t be anything ordinary.
Ling Han thought for a moment, then put away the thin plate. He would study it slowly in
future.
Aside from that, there was nothing else. He was really poor.
What kind of Spirit Transformation True Lord was this? How pitiful.

Ling Han could also guess that the majority of the old man’s wealth should be in the Galaxy Network, where it existed in the form of Universe Coins. Undoubtedly, with his death, this wealth would belong to the Chang Clan.

In this world, who knew how many people died arbitrarily every day. Their wealth in the Galaxy Network would naturally be pocketed by the Chang Clan – there was no need to write them off. The Universe Coins were virtual in the first place, and so what if the Chang Clan issued trillions of trillions? It would not affect them at all.
Only when the Universe Coins were exchanged for Dao Stones would the Chang Clan Clan pay
out.
Sigh, the Chang Clan had really profited greatly.
Ling Han once again sighed with emotion. The Four Directions Great Emperor had left a
golden rice bowl for their descendants.
Thankfully, the Chang Clan was an Imperial Clan. Otherwise, even if it was a Holy Land, they
would not be able to keep such great wealth to themselves.
Ling Han sighed ruefully, and returned with the old man’s corpse.
After arriving at the division, he took the corpse to Yan Lesheng’s place, threw it on the
ground, and said, “Here, this is the real culprit behind this blood-sucking case.”
Yan Lesheng had no time to care about Ling Han’s attitude. He merely swept an eye over this old man, and all the pores on his body couldn’t help but close tightly.
This was an elite, far surpassing him. The aftershock of a tiger’s death still lingered, causing him to practically tremble in fear.
“How could this be!” he finally spoke, his face filled with shock. He looked towards Ling Han, his eyes filled with deep wariness.
Ling Han actually managed to kill such an elite. Just look, the battle situation was too intense.

The old man had a broken arm and a leg, and there was also a pierced through hole and groove in his chest. This definitely could not have been caused by a sneak attack. From this, it could be seen just how exaggerated Ling Han’s strength was.
My gods!
“You, you killed him?” he asked in a trembling voice, thinking that he was extremely stupid, to actually become enemies with such a powerful person.

Ling Han smiled and said, “I was indeed the one who killed him. However, when I found him, he was already severely injured. He only had the strength of a Foundation Building cultivator, and I took advantage of that.”
He suppressed the old man’s strength by a level. Otherwise, if a Foundation Building Tier cultivator killed a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator, he would probably be captured and
studied.

Now that it was a Foundation Building Tier that had killed a person with Foundation Building Tier-level battle prowess, there was no problem. He was originally the strongest Foundation Building Tier cultivator of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire in the first place.
Yan Lesheng breathed a sigh of relief, then felt slightly awkward. He was actually shocked by
a Foundation Building cultivator.
He coughed, and pretended to be stern, “How do you know that he is the real culprit in the blood-sucking murder?”

“Have an elite examine the corpse, and you’ll know,” Ling Han said calmly. “I also killed two blood slaves, but I don’t know how many people this old geezer has bewitched… En, he’s dead now, so the spiritual control should have lost its effect. Even if there are other blood slaves, they should have recovered by now.”

chapters.title: Chapter 3781: Treasure Map
paragraphs: Chapter 3781: Treasure Map

Yan Lesheng hurriedly searched the old man’s body, but naturally couldn’t find anything. He couldn’t help but glare at Ling Han, “Where are the things on him? Hand them over, these are all evidence, and you can’t take them for yourself.”
Haha, what a colossal joke.
I killed him with my own abilities, so why hand it over?

Ling Han knew that this old man was just being greedy. After all, this old man was a Spirit Transformation True Lord. Just thinking about it was enough to know that this kind of elite definitely had an astonishing background.
He shook his head, “Nothing.”
“Do I look like an idiot?” Yan Lesheng asked coldly, daring to tell such a super low-level lie. Ling Han nodded, “Looks like it.”

“You know I’m not-yi!” Yan Lesheng didn’t expect Ling Han to be so bold and direct, to actually nod. He couldn’t help but look livid. You’ve gone too far, haven’t you? I’m your superior, and I’m more so a Cauldron Forging Tier elite. You dare to insult me right in front of my face?
“Ling Han, do you want to die?” he asked balefully.

‘You’re ignoring me time and time again. Do you really think I don’t dare to deal with you?’ “Heh, I’ve already apprehended the culprit. You can deal with the matters in the future on your own.” Ling Han waved his hand before turning around to leave.
Yan Lesheng wanted to make a move, but when he recalled that Ling Han still had a Little Marquis behind him, he forcefully suppressed the fury in his heart.

He could not afford to trifle with Tang Yan. At most, he could only make things difficult for Ling Han, and make use of the rules to scheme against Ling Han, but for him to step out and oppose Tang Yan directly?
Firstly, he did not dare, and secondly, he was not qualified either.
Ling Han returned home, and took out that thin metal plate to study with everyone.
“Yi, this is an extremely rare Cold Water Metal,” Second Baby immediately said.
“It should be, I can’t break it.” Eldest Baby bared her teeth. She was trying to break the metal plate.

Ling Han couldn’t help but break out in a cold sweat. This little maniac’s power was explosive. If it wasn’t for the fact that this plate could withstand breaking, it would probably have already turned into pieces by now.
“Give it to me!” The large black dog darted out, biting down on the plate, “Just nice, it can be made into a new pair of underpants for me.”
“Scram!” Ling Han shot out a foot, blocking the large black dog’s attack.
He placed the metal plate on the table, and said, “This is very likely a treasure map.”
“Oh, that’s right. There are mountains and rivers.” Hu Niu was also studying it, feeling around with her fingers. “So strange. These aren’t carved on, and there’s no unevenness at all.”

“Mother Hu, Cold Water Metal only needs to be injected with Spiritual Power, and it can form various images. Furthermore, it also has a very strong interaction effect. You will see different images in specific places,” Second Baby explained.
Yi, this was really amazing.
Ling Han was also very interested, and lightly stroked the metal plate.

“Unfortunately, we’re not from the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire. We lack understanding of this place, and can’t find a corresponding place.” He shook his head. “I think that the blood sucking Spirit Transformation True Lord should have come for some place on this map.” The empress and the others had also heard about the blood-sucking murder from Ling Han. Thus, the empress immediately said, “That Spiritual Transformation Tier cultivator should have suffered serious injuries when he fought over this map with others. Thus, he’s recuperating here, and when his injuries are healed, he’ll look for the treasure trove.”

“Treasure trove, treasure trove!” Hu Niu’s eyes lit up. She loved the excitement the most. “If we really want to find the treasure trove, we have to find someone first,” Ling Han said. “Tang Yan?” the empress asked.

Ling Han nodded, and said, “He’s a native, so he should know better than us. Moreover, he’s a Little Marquis, so he’s in possession of many resources. It should be very easy for him to find the location of this place. If this is really on the Moonlight Planet.”
After such a long time together, he also felt that Tang Yan was a friend that he could depend on. If that really was a treasure trove, Ling Han wouldn’t mind bringing Tang Yan along with him.
Moreover, Tang Yan was at Cauldron Forging Tier, after all, so he could also be considered a powerful contributor of battle prowess.

On the second day, he went to find Tang Yan. As for the blood-sucking murder case, he couldn’t be bothered to deal with it anymore. If Yan Lesheng wanted to snatch the credit, he could do as he liked. He didn’t have the slightest interest in being rewarded by the Azure Dragon Empire.
He soon arrived at the Marquis Manor, and had someone report his arrival to Tang Yan.
“Lord Ling, please wait for a moment.” The guard recognized Ling Han, and hurriedly went in to report.
In a short while, Tang Yan personally came out to receive him.
“You finally know to come see me?” Tang Yan pretended to rebuke him.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “Previously, there was a case that I had been busy with, so I did not
have the time to pay a visit.”
“What case? It can’t be the blood-sucking murder case, right?” Tang Yan asked.
“That’s right.” Ling Han nodded.
“Then you’re going to have a hard time. This case isn’t something that can be solved in a short amount of time,” Tang Yan said with a smile.
“Then I’m really sorry. I already caught the culprit yesterday.”
“Ah?” Tang Yan was very surprised.
“Furthermore, I have another gain, and have deliberately invited you to come with me.”
“Yi?”
As the two of them walked into the manor, Ling Han talked about the treasure trove, causing Tang Yan’s expression to quickly turn from inattentive to solemn.

To be treated like a treasure by a Spirit Transformation True Lord, or even in fact, it was extremely likely that the Spirit Transformation True Lord would be severely injured because of this, the treasure trove corresponding to this treasure map should be incredibly shocking.
“Haha, you’re really something!” Tang Yan said.
Ling Han smiled and said, “Actually, it’s mainly because I’m not familiar with the Moonlight Planet. Otherwise, I wouldn’t have thought of you.”
“Haha!” Tang Yan laughed loudly. He naturally would not take these words seriously. If he really wanted to find someone familiar with the Moonlight Planet, where could he not find
them?
After arriving at the study, Ling Han retrieved the Cold Water Metal and handed it over to
Tang Yan.
“Yi, I seem to have some recollection of this place.” Tang Yan rubbed his chin, and a thoughtful expression appeared on his face.
After a while, he opened the connection device and brought up the map of the Moonlight Planet. Then, he projected it.

In the Moonlight Planet, ordinary people could only buy a simplified version of the map. There were large blank areas, and the exact ratio was also very different, but the map in Tang Yan’s hands was extremely complete.
“It’s here.” Tang Yan pointed at a spot, then enlarged it. That was a massive lake.
“Calm Mountain Lake?” Ling Han was surprised.
Tang Yan nodded, “The surrounding terrain is extremely similar, but this lake doesn’t match.
However, this map may have been drawn tens of thousands of years or even longer ago. Thus, the seas have changed, and it is possible that the original mountains and rivers have become
lakes.”
“That’s very likely,” Ling Han expressed his agreement.
“When do you want to set out?” Tang Yan asked.
“In any case, the blood-sucking murder case has been solved. I don’t have much to do
recently, so I can do it at any time,” Ling Han said.
“Then as soon as possible?” Tang Yan asked again.
Ling Han nodded, “All right, then let’s do it tomorrow.”
“So soon?”
“Didn’t you want to do it as soon as possible?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
“Then it’s a deal,” Tang Yan said.
The matter was already agreed upon, and Ling Han returned to his quarters. Though he had a
Spatial Spirit Tool, the place he was going was possibly an ancient site, so he still had to make
some preparations.

To be treated like a treasure by a Spirit Transformation True Lord, or even in fact, it was extremely likely that the Spirit Transformation True Lord would be severely injured because of this, the treasure trove corresponding to this treasure map should be incredibly shocking.
“Haha, you’re really something!” Tang Yan said.
Ling Han smiled and said, “Actually, it’s mainly because I’m not familiar with the Moonlight Planet.
Otherwise, I wouldn’t have thought of you.”
“Haha!” Tang Yan laughed loudly.
He naturally would not take these words seriously.
If he really wanted to find someone familiar with the Moonlight Planet, where could he not find
them?
After arriving at the study, Ling Han retrieved the Cold Water Metal and handed it over to
Tang Yan.
“Yi, I seem to have some recollection of this place.” Tang Yan rubbed his chin, and a thoughtful expression appeared on his face.
After a while, he opened the connection device and brought up the map of the Moonlight Planet.
Then, he projected it.
In the Moonlight Planet, ordinary people could only buy a simplified version of the map.
There were large blank areas, and the exact ratio was also very different, but the map in Tang Yan’s hands was extremely complete.
“It’s here.” Tang Yan pointed at a spot, then enlarged it.
That was a massive lake.
“Calm Mountain Lake?” Ling Han was surprised.
Tang Yan nodded, “The surrounding terrain is extremely similar, but this lake doesn’t match.
However, this map may have been drawn tens of thousands of years or even longer ago.
Thus, the seas have changed, and it is possible that the original mountains and rivers have become
lakes.”
“That’s very likely,” Ling Han expressed his agreement.
“When do you want to set out?” Tang Yan asked.
“In any case, the blood-sucking murder case has been solved.
I don’t have much to do
recently, so I can do it at any time,” Ling Han said.
“Then as soon as possible?” Tang Yan asked again.
Ling Han nodded, “All right, then let’s do it tomorrow.”
“So soon?”
“Didn’t you want to do it as soon as possible?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
“Then it’s a deal,” Tang Yan said.
The matter was already agreed upon, and Ling Han returned to his quarters.
Though he had a
Spatial Spirit Tool, the place he was going was possibly an ancient site, so he still had to make
some preparations.

chapters.title: Chapter 3782: Jin Yexue
paragraphs: Chapter 3782: Jin Yexue

On the second day, Ling Han went to find Tang Yan alone. The empress, the large black dog, and the others were all at the crucial moment of breaking through to Heavenly Dao Foundation. Thus, they did not move out this time.
“Let’s go.”
After the two of them left the city, they both flew on their respective Tools.

With their cultivation level, the speed of flying on a Tool would not be any slower than the speed of a flying vehicle. A shuttle like Tang Yun’er’s was more suited to traversing through the galaxy, but if they were to fly on a planet, it may not be that much faster.
Tang Yan’s flying Spirit Tool was a sword. Stepping on it, he appeared very carefree.

Ling Han actually had a considerable number of Spirit Tools, but flying on a Tool required instilling a portion of one’s divine sense into it, and even if it was just a sliver, or a little bit, it would affect oneself.
For normal people, this little bit of influence wouldn’t matter at all, but Ling Han wanted to pursue the strongest and perfection, so he naturally couldn’t be the slightest bit affected.
Thus, he used the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. However, the Imperial Weapon was keeping a low profile, so at least with Tang Yan’s insight, it was impossible for him to notice anything off.
“Haha, most people would fly on their swords, yet you’re using a tower. How unconventional,” Tang Yan said with his divine sense.
Ling Han smiled, and also said with his divine sense, “This is called being different from the norm.”
They could only communicate through their divine sense. Otherwise, with their present speed, their voices couldn’t possibly enter the other party’s ears.

Unlike Celestial Sea Planet, which was actually a shattered planet, Moonlight Planet was much larger. Thus, even if Ling Han and Tang Yan were both flying at more than 20 times the speed, they still flew for seven days before finally arriving at their destination.
This was a colossal lake, and there were mountains on all sides. Under the sunlight, the waves were dazzling, like golden snakes dancing wildly.

Ling Han took out the “map”, and shockingly discovered that the images on it had changed. Furthermore, they were animated. It was a person spinning a golden pillar, turning left three times, and right nine times, repeating endlessly.

Obviously, Tang Yan had not led them the wrong way. The unique trait of this Cold Water Metal was that when they arrived at a unique location, it would display the images that had been left behind beforehand.
Precisely because they had found the place, the map had changed.
“Go into the water?” Tang Yan looked towards Ling Han.
Ling Han nodded earnestly, “Let’s go.”
With their cultivation levels, there was naturally nothing for them to be afraid of. They both jumped into the water.
The lake water was not cold. Instead, it was warm, making one feel comfortable all over.

The two of them dived downwards. Now that they had advanced into Celestial Path, there was no need for them to worry about the problem of breathing. As long as they could absorb the power of heaven and earth, cultivators would be able to continue living.
After swimming for a while, a large fish suddenly swam over from ahead of them. It was more than thirty meters long, and was completely dark green in colour. Every fish scale was the size of a bowl.
This fish demon was very fierce. The moment it came up, it opened its mouth wide and bit at the two of them, its teeth as sharp as sabers.
Tang Yan moved, and with a tap of his finger, pa, a bloody hole appeared on the head of that giant fish. Its stomach turned upwards, and it was completely dead.

Once this giant fish died, small fish immediately popped out from who knows where, and began to eat around it. In just a short while, this giant fish had turned into a skeleton, and was sinking towards the bottom of the lake.
They continued to advance, and not long after, a black eel swam over. From afar, it arched its body, and zi, a bolt of lightning struck over.
This was a Foundation Building Tier fish demon. This bolt of lightning was as thick as an arm, and it formed the shape of a zigzag.
Ling Han directly shot out a murderous aura attack. Weng, that eel immediately fainted.
“Yi?” Tang Yan was surprised.

If Ling Han had killed the demonic fish with a single punch or kick, he wouldn’t have found it strange at all. After all, he knew just how powerful Ling Han was. In fact, he could be regarded as number one among Foundation Building Tier cultivators. However, he had knocked the demonic fish unconscious without even needing to attack physically. This was simply unfathomable.
“I have discovered that you really have hidden depths,” he said.

When Ling Han heard these words, he couldn’t help but think of the large black dog. Presumably, if this guy was here, he would probably look at his crotch, and mutter something along the lines of “as expected, it didn’t show”, instantly making people not know whether to laugh or cry.
“Then you can slowly discover them,” he said with a smile.

The two of them continued to swim towards the bottom of the lake. The light instantly dimmed, and in the end, this place became completely dark. However, there was a mysterious marine creature here. It was very small in size, but it would emit a weak light. Once there were too many of them, this lake would also become hazy, so it was not like they couldn’t even see the fingers of their own hands.
“Hmm?”
Ling Han and Tang Yan exclaimed in surprise at the same time. They saw a white object float over from ahead of them.
Very soon, they could see clearly. It was actually a woman. She was dressed in white, and her black hair spread out like water plants, possessing a kind of messy beauty.
There was actually a woman floating in such deep waters?
Was this place haunted?
“She’s injured.” Ling Han’s eyes swept over her, and saw that behind this woman, there was a slight red in the lake waters.
The two of them swam over. As expected, this woman was injured, and there were also signs
of life.
Ling Han stretched out a finger and tapped on the woman’s head. A mystical power surged in, instantly causing the woman’s delicate body to tremble, and she regained consciousness.
“Who are you people?” she asked through divine sense. She immediately went into a
defensive stance.

Tang Yan’s eyes involuntarily lit up. This woman was truly beautiful. Her eyes were bright like water, and her brows were slender like a painting. Moreover, she had an indescribable bearing, making her appear extremely noble. He hurriedly replied, “My name is Tang Yan, and he is Ling Han. Don’t be afraid. We have just saved you!”
The woman looked him and Tang Yan over several times, then nodded, and said, “Thank
you.”
“Beauty, how did you get injured?” Tang Yan was very proactive, “Did you get injured by someone? Tell me, and I will avenge you!”
As the son of the Tang Clan, what kind of beauty had he not seen before? Yet now, he actually took the initiative to curry her favour, which showed how beautiful this woman was.

The woman paused slightly, then said, “I wanted to come here to hunt a kind of treasure fish, but accidentally discovered a golden pillar. Out of curiosity, I turned it around, and in the end, suffered a serious injury, and passed out. If I had not been saved by you guys, it is very possible that I would have died in the stomach of the fish.”
Golden pillar?
Ling Han and Tang Yan exchanged looks. Was there really such a coincidence?
“Where is that pillar? Can you bring us there?” Tang Yan asked.
Seeing that he was chatting happily with this woman, Ling Han remained silent all this while,
acting as a spectator.
A hesitant expression appeared on the woman’s face, and she said, “That place is extremely
dangerous…”
“It’s fine. We have heard you talk about it, so we’re already prepared,” Tang Yan interrupted.
He still hadn’t been overwhelmed by her beauty. He didn’t say that he and Ling Han were actually looking for this golden pillar.
“All right,” the woman nodded.
The three of them swam forward together. The woman had only suffered some light injuries,
but they were not serious. She was fine now that she had woke up.
The journey was relatively peaceful. After more than half an hour, a massive clump of water
grass appeared ahead of them.
“Right here,” the beauty said, pointing at the seaweed.
“Oh, that’s right. How should I address you, beautiful woman?” Tang Yan asked shamelessly.
The woman pondered for a moment, then said, “Jin, Jin Yexue.”
