chapters.title: Chapter 3783: What a coincidence
paragraphs: Chapter 3783: What a coincidence
“Jin Yexue, what a good name!” Tang Yan praised, as he pushed aside the water plants and continued onwards.
This was a stretch of water grass, which was tall and dense. After travelling for half a minute, the eyes of the three lit up, and a golden pillar appeared.
It was about six meters tall, and as thick as a thigh.
“Ling Han, it’s here!” Tang Yan said to Ling Han.
“Yi, you guys are looking for this thing?” Jin Yexue asked curiously.
Tang Yan chuckled, “This is all thanks to you. Otherwise, if we had to find this place on our own, we would probably have to search for a good few days.”
Visibility was greatly affected at the bottom of the lake, and the golden pillar was standing in the dense underbrush, which was really hard to find.
Ling Han glanced at Jin Yexue, and a question flashed through his mind. However, he didn’t say it out loud.

At present, Tang Yan was very keen on expressing himself. Though he was the Little Marquis, now that he had met the woman he liked, his performance was also like all men in love. His intelligence had seriously declined, and his desire to express himself was soaring.
He gripped the golden pillar, and began to spin it.
Three on the left, nine on the right.
Ka, ka, ka! Suddenly, there was the sound of gears turning. That golden pillar slowly descended, right until it had completely disappeared.
Boom, a louder sound was heard, like an earthquake.
No, this really seemed like an earthquake. A powerful wave rose up in the water, causing the three of them to tremble slightly.

However, Ling Han and Tang Yan were both elites of Celestial Path, and Jin Yexue was not inferior either. She was shockingly also a Cauldron Forging Tier. When the waves crashed onto her, she was completely unaffected, and only swayed slightly.

Ling Han didn’t use his eyes to observe, but he continued to observe with his divine sense. When Tang Yan spun the golden pillar just then, her eyes narrowed slightly, and a hint of pleasant surprise appeared on her beautiful face.
At present, Ling Han was not sure what this pleasant surprise actually meant, but he was sure that it was definitely not as simple as she had said, how she had accidentally come here for fishing.
Hong long long, the mountains shook and the ground shook, incredibly intense.
“Yi, it seems like the bottom of the lake is rising!” Tang Yan said.
At first, they were floating in the water, but now, their feet were standing on the mud. There was a force pushing them upwards at an extremely fast speed, causing them to feel a clear pushing force.
About ten minutes later, a loud splash was heard, and the three of them actually broke through the water surface!
Hiss!

They looked ahead, and all of them looked stunned. That was because there was a group of buildings ahead of them. The walls of gold were brilliant, and they were presently standing in the plaza of this group of buildings. At this moment, the mud was dispersing like water, revealing floor tiles that were as white as jade.

It was not the whole lake that had risen, but rather an area within the lake. It was like an island had suddenly risen up in the lake, and its surface area was really not small either.𝒇𝒓𝙚𝒆𝔀𝓮𝓫𝒏𝓸𝙫𝓮𝓵.𝓬𝙤𝙢
“This is… what ancient site is this?” Tang Yan murmured.

The three of them walked forwards. After walking past this plaza, a wall blocked their path. They turned towards the main doors, and saw two words were written on the plaque of the doors: “Jin Manor”.
Jin Manor?
Ling Han and Tang Yan both turned to look at Jin Yexue, their expressions filled with strong questions.

This was the Jin Manor, and this woman’s surname was Jin. Moreover, she had been injured because of the golden pillar from before… With all this added together, how could Ling Han and Tang Yan not suspect that this woman had no relationship with the Jin Manor?

Jin Yexue took a deep breath, then nodded, and said, “That’s right. This is the ancestral grounds of our Jin Clan. I have not come to catch some treasure fish, but rather to find our lost ancestral grounds.”
“It’s fine, it’s fine. Who doesn’t have a bit of vigilance?” Tang Yan smiled and played mediator, “No wonder you were able to find this place. We followed the map and searched for a very long time.”

Jin Yexue smiled bitterly, and said, “In order to find the lost ancestral grounds, the clan has been searching for generation after generation. It was only in my generation that I finally found the location. However, I was unable to enter. Instead, I was knocked unconscious.” She paused, then continued, “When I saw you guys, I was suspicious. This place is so remote, so how did you guys come here? Could it be that you guys have obtained the lost ancestral map of the Jin Clan? Thus, after you guys invited me, I took advantage of the situation and brought you guys here.”
F***, how could things be so coincidental? They actually encountered the descendant of this treasure trove while searching for it.
Ling Han and Tang Yan exchanged looks. Then what were they now? Thieves?

Yet Jin Yexue took the initiative to say, “Though this is the ancestral grounds of our Jin Clan, it has been too many years, and secondly, I do not have the slightest understanding of this place either, so I am not qualified to call myself owner of this place at all. Come to think of it, it is still because of you that I have been able to see the ancestral grounds again. So, why don’t we explore together, and share the gains we obtain?”
“All right.” Ling Han and Tang Yan exchanged a look, and nodded at the same time.
“Alright,” Jin Yexue said with a smile. It was as if 100 flowers had bloomed at the same time, and she appeared especially captivating.
Tang Yan was slightly dazed, and only came back to his senses after being nudged by Ling
Han.
“Let’s take a look now.” Ling Han took out the Cold Water Metal, because he wasn’t sure if opening this door required a special technique.

There was indeed a change in the image on the Cold Water Metal, but it was not focused on the main doors. Going by the look of things, there was no need for any special technique to enter the main doors.
“I’ll go,” Tang Yan said. He was very willing to show off in front of beautiful women. After he knew that there was no danger at the main doors, he immediately rushed forwards to push the
doors open.

A creak was heard, and there was a rustle of dust as the great doors were slowly pushed open. The three of them walked through the doors, and what appeared in front of them was a garden that had already withered. In the past, this place should have been very beautiful. Multiple flowerbeds were decorated in a unique manner, and had an indescribable charm to them.
Ling Han gave a ‘yi’, and said, “Don’t move.”
“What is it?” Tang Yan did not mind, and took a step forwards.
Shua, a streak of light blasted towards him at an astonishing speed.
Tang Yan was unable to dodge, and he was instantly struck head-on. However, a ball of light also flickered on his body, turning into a screen of light that blocked the light that was
assailing him.

Tang Yan’s face paled in fright, and he hurriedly stepped back. “F*ck! I almost died once!” He had a life-saving treasure on him, and it would only activate automatically when he encountered life-threatening danger. It was that treasure that had activated just now, saving
his life.
“That attack definitely reached the level of the Core Formation Tier. If it weren’t for the treasure my grandfather gave me, I would definitely be dead!” He was filled with lingering
fear.
Ling Han sighed, “Can’t you take it easy?”
This guy’s behavior was a little abnormal. Looks like if one met someone he liked, his brain
would really fail.
“Hehe, wasn’t it because I didn’t see any danger either?” Tang Yan argued. From the image on the Cold Water Metal just now, they were still far from reaching that place, so he had been
a little careless.

Ling Han said with a serious expression, “There’s a formation set up here. If one doesn’t think of a way to break through it, or doesn’t follow the rules, they’ll be attacked. Just calculate how many more times that treasure can be used.”

Tang Yan smiled sheepishly. Though there was no limit to the number of times he could use the treasure on him, a shield could only be activated every minute. Thus, as long as the attacks were concentrated, it would definitely be unable to block them.
“Yi, you’re also a Formation Master?” He suddenly turned around.

Jin Yexue took a deep breath, then nodded, and said, “That’s right.
This is the ancestral grounds of our Jin Clan.
I have not come to catch some treasure fish, but rather to find our lost ancestral grounds.”
“It’s fine, it’s fine.
Who doesn’t have a bit of vigilance?” Tang Yan smiled and played mediator, “No wonder you were able to find this place.
We followed the map and searched for a very long time.”
Jin Yexue smiled bitterly, and said, “In order to find the lost ancestral grounds, the clan has been searching for generation after generation.
It was only in my generation that I finally found the location.
However, I was unable to enter.
Instead, I was knocked unconscious.” She paused, then continued, “When I saw you guys, I was suspicious.
This place is so remote, so how did you guys come here?
Could it be that you guys have obtained the lost ancestral map of the Jin Clan?
Thus, after you guys invited me, I took advantage of the situation and brought you guys here.”
F***, how could things be so coincidental?
They actually encountered the descendant of this treasure trove while searching for it.
Ling Han and Tang Yan exchanged looks.
Then what were they now?
Thieves?

Yet Jin Yexue took the initiative to say, “Though this is the ancestral grounds of our Jin Clan, it has been too many years, and secondly, I do not have the slightest understanding of this place either, so I am not qualified to call myself owner of this place at all.
Come to think of it, it is still because of you that I have been able to see the ancestral grounds again.
So, why don’t we explore together, and share the gains we obtain?”
“All right.” Ling Han and Tang Yan exchanged a look, and nodded at the same time.
“Alright,” Jin Yexue said with a smile.
It was as if 100 flowers had bloomed at the same time, and she appeared especially captivating.
Tang Yan was slightly dazed, and only came back to his senses after being nudged by Ling
Han.
“Let’s take a look now.” Ling Han took out the Cold Water Metal, because he wasn’t sure if opening this door required a special technique.
There was indeed a change in the image on the Cold Water Metal, but it was not focused on the main doors.
Going by the look of things, there was no need for any special technique to enter the main doors.
“I’ll go,” Tang Yan said.
He was very willing to show off in front of beautiful women.
After he knew that there was no danger at the main doors, he immediately rushed forwards to push the
doors open.
A creak was heard, and there was a rustle of dust as the great doors were slowly pushed open.
The three of them walked through the doors, and what appeared in front of them was a garden that had already withered.
In the past, this place should have been very beautiful.
Multiple flowerbeds were decorated in a unique manner, and had an indescribable charm to them.
Ling Han gave a ‘yi’, and said, “Don’t move.”
“What is it?” Tang Yan did not mind, and took a step forwards.
Shua, a streak of light blasted towards him at an astonishing speed.
Tang Yan was unable to dodge, and he was instantly struck head-on.
However, a ball of light also flickered on his body, turning into a screen of light that blocked the light that was
assailing him.
Tang Yan’s face paled in fright, and he hurriedly stepped back.
“F*ck!
I almost died once!” He had a life-saving treasure on him, and it would only activate automatically when he encountered life-threatening danger.
It was that treasure that had activated just now, saving
his life.
“That attack definitely reached the level of the Core Formation Tier.
If it weren’t for the treasure my grandfather gave me, I would definitely be dead!” He was filled with lingering
fear.
Ling Han sighed, “Can’t you take it easy?”
This guy’s behavior was a little abnormal.
Looks like if one met someone he liked, his brain
would really fail.
“Hehe, wasn’t it because I didn’t see any danger either?” Tang Yan argued.
From the image on the Cold Water Metal just now, they were still far from reaching that place, so he had been
a little careless.
Ling Han said with a serious expression, “There’s a formation set up here.
If one doesn’t think of a way to break through it, or doesn’t follow the rules, they’ll be attacked.
Just calculate how many more times that treasure can be used.”
Tang Yan smiled sheepishly.
Though there was no limit to the number of times he could use the treasure on him, a shield could only be activated every minute.
Thus, as long as the attacks were concentrated, it would definitely be unable to block them.
“Yi, you’re also a Formation Master?” He suddenly turned around.

chapters.title: Chapter 3784: Destroying the Formation
paragraphs: Chapter 3784: Destroying the Formation
Ling Han smiled, “What is it? Can’t I become a Formation Master?”
Meanwhile, Jin Yexue was slightly confused. You, a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator, brought a Foundation Building Tier cultivator into an ancient site. That must be because of his
formation skills. Otherwise, why would you bring a burden?
This was not a senior bringing a junior for training.
But looking at Tang Yan’s expression, it seemed like he had completely no idea that Ling Han was a Formation Master. This was very strange.

“Of course!” Tang Yan hurriedly said. “Have you forgotten that you’re an alchemist? Have you forgotten that you just obtained the title of the strongest Foundation Building Tier during His Majesty’s birthday celebration? And now you’re telling me that you know formation techniques? F***, are you trying to scare me to death?”
Was this for real?
Jin Yexue’s small mouth was half-gaping, as she surveyed Ling Han. This time, she was extremely serious.

Previously, though she had also observed Ling Han, he was merely a Foundation Building cultivator, so how could she possibly spend too much effort on him? She only took a glance, and after confirming his cultivation level, she naturally stopped paying attention.
She really couldn’t tell that such a young man actually cultivated three fields at the same time.
Ling Han smiled faintly and said, “There’s no harm in learning more skills. It’s not a bad idea to learn more.”

Tang Yan instantly suffered a blow. He was not very old either, but with his talent and the support of his clan, he had already charged up to the Cauldron Forging Tier. This had always made him self-satisfied. This accomplishment was incredible. But compared with Ling Han? That’s right. He was indeed inferior to him in terms of cultivation level, but firstly, his potential was not the slightest bit inferior. Secondly, he had also dabbled in alchemy and formation techniques at the same time, and had even concocted Foundation Dissolution Pill, so his future achievements in alchemy and formation techniques were boundless.
Dual cultivation in alchemy and martial arts was already kickass enough. Now, another identity popped up, and he was actually a Formation Master?
‘Holy f*ck!’
To compare oneself with another, it was really infuriating.

“Sigh!” He sighed, “I too want to learn another skill, but I don’t have the time at all!” “Alright, stop moaning. I’ll go break the formation first,” Ling Han said. “Come, continue forward and stimulate the formation. I need to observe more to make a judgement.”
Tang Yan’s expression instantly darkened. ‘You f*cking want me to be beaten?’
“Then should I go?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
Tang Yan waved a hand dismissively, “Then forget it. It’s better for me.”
He had rare treasures that could save his life, but did Ling Han have rare treasures?
He walked forward again, and instantly, a ray of light shot over. This time, it could be seen clearly, and turned into a sword of light.
Tang Yan couldn’t block it at all. Peng! He was struck head-on, and then he hurriedly retreated.
Ling Han took everything in. Then, he closed his eyes, and his eyeballs trembled slightly. This was him performing a high-speed deduction.
What he saw was not only the strike of a sword of light, but also the changes that had taken place in the whole garden before that.

“Combined with the arrangement of the flowerbed, I can conclude that this is the Gauze King White Bird Formation,” Ling Han thought. Then, he opened his mouth and said, “Brother Tang, go out again. This time, stand on the second brick in the third row.”
“… Left or right?” Tang Yan asked. There were four bricks in that row.
“Left!” Ling Han really wanted to kick him. Did he count from right to left?
Tang Yan didn’t dare to act rashly. A minute passed, and the rare treasure could be activated again. He then leaped out, landing on the brick that Ling Han had mentioned.
Yi, no light shot out.
He faltered at first, then was overjoyed, “Ling Han, you have really broken through the formation!”

“Don’t be happy too early. There are a lot of changes to the Gauze King White Bird Formation. I need to observe it a few more times to be able to confirm which change it is,” Ling Han said calmly, instead of cheering.
“All right, all right.” Tang Yan nodded. He was not being attacked now, which already proved that Ling Han’s strength in formations was very extraordinary.
Jin Xuesha also saw this, and her beautiful eyes lit up. It was as if she were thinking about something.
Tang Yan walked forward again. Xiu, the sword of light shot over again. After sustaining a strike, he hurriedly retreated to a safe place.
Ling Han pondered for a moment, then said, “The third brick on the fifth row ahead of you.”
“All right.” Tang Yan leaped out, and landed on the brick that Ling Han had mentioned. True enough, he had not been attacked.
“Good job!” He gave Ling Han a thumbs up.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “Enough with the show. Let’s continue forward.”
“I still have to be beaten?” Tang Yan was a little depressed. He was the Little Marquis!
Ling Han merely chuckled, and ignored him.
Tang Yan was only joking. He took another step forwards.
Yi, no attack had reached him?
Tang Yan had already prepared himself to retreat, but he had never imagined that this brick
that he had randomly chosen would actually be a safe area.
Ling Han was also rendered speechless. This guy’s luck was really quite good.
“Haha, I am indeed blessed by the heavens!” Tang Yan laughed loudly.
“Yes, yes, yes.” Ling Han also smiled, and began to walk forwards. At the same time, he turned his head and said to Jin Yexue, “Follow the bricks that I have stepped on.”
“All right,” Jin Yexue nodded. Though she was a descendant of the Jin Clan, she lacked understanding of this place.

After taking two steps, Ling Han was already standing behind Tang Yan. At this moment, he had already completely grasped this formation. It was impossible for him to break through, but it was completely no problem for him to find a safe path from within.
With another leap, he landed on the fourth brick.
This caused Tang Yan’s heart to skip a beat. Ling Han didn’t have a rare treasure, and if he were swept by that light, a Core Formation Tier-level attack, it would be enough to insta-kill
him several hundred times over.
Thankfully, it did not just strike out.
Tang Yan breathed a sigh of relief, and discovered that there was actually some sweat on his
palms.
Xiu, Ling Han leaped out again, and landed on the fifth brick.
“Follow,” he said.
Tang Yan and Jin Yexue hurriedly moved as well, moving in unison. You jump, I jump. One
landed behind Ling Han, while the other landed behind Jin Yexue.
-Tang Yan had Jin Yexue go first, while he brought up the rear.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! It was at this moment that several figures flew past in the skies, and all of them
landed on the plaza outside.
“Yi, someone actually activated the mechanism, making the ancient site reappear!”
“Who are you people to the Old Geezer Gu?”

There were a total of five people in that group, and they were three men and two women respectively. They all looked very young, but every single one of them was in the Cauldron Forging Tier, exuding a powerful aura.
What Old Geezer Gu?
Tang Yan and Jin Yexue were both at a loss, but a thought flashed through Ling Han’s mind.

The blood sucking Spirit Transformation True Lord that he had killed was very likely to have a fierce battle with someone over the treasure map. In the end, he lost a leg, and his chest was also severely wounded. His battle prowess dropped drastically, and he actually had to control others to bring him blood to heal his injuries.
Then, could his competitors have also seen the treasure map?
That would at least be a Spirit Transformation True Lord. With the memory of such an elite, it shouldn’t be difficult for him to remember everything he saw.
Perhaps that elite had also been severely wounded, and that was why he had sent his juniors
over. In any case, he remembered where it was.
Of course, this was only Ling Han’s deduction.
“How dare you! You actually dare to disrespect our Lord!” Ling Han decided to trick him, and
immediately shouted.

chapters.title: Chapter 3785: Advantage of Time
paragraphs: Chapter 3785: Advantage of Time

“Haha, what Lord? One of his legs was broken by my Founder, and he almost dug out his heart. If Old Geezer Gu dares to come out now, I’ll kill him,” a red-robed man said, his face filled with disdain.
As expected, it had been tricked out.

This was caused by the unequal information that both sides knew. When the other party saw that not only had Ling Han and his group found the place, they had also activated the mechanism, they must have thought that they were the blood sucking Spirit Transformation True Lord’s people. They had never thought that it was actually Ling Han who had killed him and snatched his treasures.
Ling Han continued to bluff, “Humph, Milord’s recovery rate is extremely good. Just a few nobodies like you dare to come here; you’re really courting death!”
Hearing these words, the expressions of the five people changed slightly.

After all, that was a Spirit Transformation True Lord. Even if a tiger died, its might was still there. Moreover, he was not dead yet. What if he really recovered to the strength of Core Formation Tier, or even True Self Tier? Then wouldn’t they just be seeking death?

“Humph, don’t try to trick me!” Among the five of them, the man in black clothing smirked coldly, “Our Founder has returned to the sect, and has a large amount of Celestial medicines to support him. He has just recovered the battle prowess of the Core Formation Tier, and Old Monster Gu has fled into Moonlight Planet. How could it be that he would dare to publicly suck blood to heal his injuries, and is not afraid of being killed by the elites of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire?”
Ling Han smiled faintly. These words revealed a lot of information.
Firstly, the elite who had competed with the blood sucking Spirit Transformation True Lord for the treasure map was also severely wounded, so he couldn’t take the treasure himself.
But why had only a few Cauldron Forging Tiers been sent?

Because they were not the people of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire, sending elites over would attract the attention of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire. It should be known that it was presently the time when the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire was invading, and the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire would definitely not allow unfamiliar elites to come to their base.

There were other considerations as well. Perhaps that so-called Founder was worried about elites of the same cultivation level as him. What if someone really took the treasure and did not hand it over to him?
When it concerned precious cultivation techniques and rare treasures, who would even consider the friendship of fellow sect members?
Moreover, the higher one’s cultivation level was, the higher the teleportation fee would be. This should also be one of the reasons.

“Alright, I won’t trick you,” Ling Han said with a smile. “What do you guys want to do now?” “Needless to say, I’m naturally going to kill you!” The red-robed man laughed loudly. “Since we’ve confirmed that Old Monster Gu isn’t here, the three of you… should just die!”
Ling Han was trying to trick them, and they were also trying to get information out of him. Tang Yan laughed loudly, and crooked a finger, “Come on then!”
“I’ll kill you!” A woman in green leaped over, sword in hand. She directly burst through the doors, and charged towards Tang Yan.
“Sigh!” Tang Yan didn’t dodge, and he remained as calm as could be.
“Junior Sister Wu, be careful!” the red-robed man suddenly shouted.
However, it was already too late.

Though the woman in green had not stepped on the ground in the garden, after she had flown a certain distance in the air, she had also activated the formation. Xiu, a flash of sword light immediately slashed towards her.
It was incredibly fast, and it was equivalent to the attack of a Core Formation Tier elite. How could a Cauldron Forging Tier dodge it?
Pa, a ball of blood exploded, as if a rose had bloomed in fury.

“Ah!” The woman in green screamed in pain. She had already retreated, but her left arm had been severed from the shoulder. Blood was gushing out, and she looked extremely miserable. “Junior Sister!” The other four people all surrounded her, all of them concerned and furious. “You people are so ruthless!” the man in black chided harshly.
Tang Yan shrugged, “Oh, you guys can kill us, and we are ruthless just because we counterattack? Hehe, this has nothing to do with us. We were not the ones who set up the formation.”

“Humph, do you really think that we cannot kill you just because of this?” The man in green robes who had not spoken all this while finally spoke up. He took out a sculpture. It was only about a foot tall, and was as white as jade.

He recited an incantation, and his eyes suddenly burst with silver light. Weng, the eyes of that statue actually turned the same lustre white. Xiu, a pillar of light suddenly shot out, striking out at Tang Yan.
Peng!
Light clashed fiercely, dazzling and brilliant.

Tang Yan was given a fright. This was because the Light of Dao had struck him too quickly, and he had not managed to dodge or block in time at all. Furthermore, it was the rare treasure on him that had automatically activated, saving his life.
What if he delivered another shot?
“Quick, follow me!” Ling Han obviously thought of it as well, and hurriedly shouted.
Moreover, it was fortunate that it was Tang Yan who had been shot. What if it had been him or Jin Yexue?

Jin Yexue hurriedly followed, and Tang Yan also followed closely behind. However, it was clear from this how meticulously Tang Yan was thinking. As he walked, he sent out a palm strike, stimulating the power of heaven and earth, which turned into a dazzling brilliance, blurring the position where they had landed, so that the green-robed man and the others would not remember their route.
The man in green was also astonished. He hadn’t expected that he would still fail to kill Tang Yan even after unleashing his most powerful weapon.
Moreover, this Spirit Tool was actually at the level of the Core Formation Tier. With his strength, he couldn’t activate it continuously, so he hurriedly handed it over to the red-robed
man beside him.
The red-robed man injected his mystical power into the statue. Weng, the eyes of the statue lit up again. Xiu, a pillar of light shot out.𝐟𝕣𝕖𝐞𝐰𝕖𝚋𝐧𝗼𝚟𝐞𝕝.𝗰𝐨𝐦
Unfortunately, Ling Han and the others had already made a turn in time, and circled behind a flowerbed. This pillar of light landed on the stones of the flowerbed, and did not hit them.
In this way, Ling Han and the others had already left them far behind. Firstly, it was not easy to aim, and secondly, there were even more obstacles on their way, so it was impossible to hit
them.
“Junior Sister Nangong, it’s up to you now,” the man in green said to the woman at the end.
Her name was Nangong Qian, and aside from being a cultivator, she was also a Formation
Master.
“All right!” She nodded, “I will break through the formation as soon as possible, and make those three pay the price for Junior Sister Wu’s injuries!”
The woman in green held a sword, her face pale, her eyes filled with killing intent.
She had lost an arm, and from now onwards, she had become a cripple!
And all this was because of those three people.
Ling Han led the way, and soon walked through this garden.

“This isn’t good. Not only do they have more Cauldron Forging Tier elites than us, but they also have a rare treasure with astonishing destructive power.” Tang Yan frowned. “I still have the ability to protect myself, but if you guys take a hit, you’ll probably be in trouble.” Ling Han and Jin Yexue both nodded. They did not have a life-saving treasure like Tang Yan. “We still have some advantage in time. Let’s move quickly,” Ling Han said.
“En!”

They hurriedly walked forwards. After passing through the garden, there was a hall ahead of them. Ling Han first observed it, and after confirming that there was no danger, it was still Tang Yan who took the lead. Then, Ling Han and Jin Yexue followed him in. Though there were no treasures here, Jin Yexue was slightly distracted. She looked left and
right, her eyes slightly drifting, as if she was picturing how when the ancestors of the Jin Clan were still alive, this place was filled with guests.
They passed through the Main Hall, and when they came out, three paths appeared at the
same time.
“One leads to the inner courtyard, one leads to the training ground, and one leads to the Cultivation Technique Library,” Jin Yexue said.
This should be a memory left behind by their ancestors. Even in their dreams, they dreamt of returning to their ancestral grounds.

How could it be that he would dare to publicly suck blood to heal his injuries, and is not afraid of being killed by the elites of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire?”
Ling Han smiled faintly.
These words revealed a lot of information.
Firstly, the elite who had competed with the blood sucking Spirit Transformation True Lord for the treasure map was also severely wounded, so he couldn’t take the treasure himself.
But why had only a few Cauldron Forging Tiers been sent?
Because they were not the people of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire, sending elites over would attract the attention of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire.

It should be known that it was presently the time when the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire was invading, and the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire would definitely not allow unfamiliar elites to come to their base.
There were other considerations as well.
Perhaps that so-called Founder was worried about elites of the same cultivation level as him.
What if someone really took the treasure and did not hand it over to him?
When it concerned precious cultivation techniques and rare treasures, who would even consider the friendship of fellow sect members?
Moreover, the higher one’s cultivation level was, the higher the teleportation fee would be.
This should also be one of the reasons.
“Alright, I won’t trick you,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“What do you guys want to do now?” “Needless to say, I’m naturally going to kill you!” The red-robed man laughed loudly.
“Since we’ve confirmed that Old Monster Gu isn’t here, the three of you… should just die!”
Ling Han was trying to trick them, and they were also trying to get information out of him.
Tang Yan laughed loudly, and crooked a finger, “Come on then!”
“I’ll kill you!” A woman in green leaped over, sword in hand.
She directly burst through the doors, and charged towards Tang Yan.
“Sigh!” Tang Yan didn’t dodge, and he remained as calm as could be.
“Junior Sister Wu, be careful!” the red-robed man suddenly shouted.
However, it was already too late.
Though the woman in green had not stepped on the ground in the garden, after she had flown a certain distance in the air, she had also activated the formation.
Xiu, a flash of sword light immediately slashed towards her.
It was incredibly fast, and it was equivalent to the attack of a Core Formation Tier elite.
How could a Cauldron Forging Tier dodge it?
Pa, a ball of blood exploded, as if a rose had bloomed in fury.
“Ah!” The woman in green screamed in pain.
She had already retreated, but her left arm had been severed from the shoulder.
Blood was gushing out, and she looked extremely miserable.
“Junior Sister!” The other four people all surrounded her, all of them concerned and furious.
“You people are so ruthless!” the man in black chided harshly.
Tang Yan shrugged, “Oh, you guys can kill us, and we are ruthless just because we counterattack?
Hehe, this has nothing to do with us.
We were not the ones who set up the formation.”
“Humph, do you really think that we cannot kill you just because of this?” The man in green robes who had not spoken all this while finally spoke up.
He took out a sculpture.
It was only about a foot tall, and was as white as jade.
He recited an incantation, and his eyes suddenly burst with silver light.
Weng, the eyes of that statue actually turned the same lustre white.
Xiu, a pillar of light suddenly shot out, striking out at Tang Yan.
Peng!
Light clashed fiercely, dazzling and brilliant.
Tang Yan was given a fright.
This was because the Light of Dao had struck him too quickly, and he had not managed to dodge or block in time at all.
Furthermore, it was the rare treasure on him that had automatically activated, saving his life.
What if he delivered another shot?
“Quick, follow me!” Ling Han obviously thought of it as well, and hurriedly shouted.
Moreover, it was fortunate that it was Tang Yan who had been shot.
What if it had been him or Jin Yexue?
Jin Yexue hurriedly followed, and Tang Yan also followed closely behind.
However, it was clear from this how meticulously Tang Yan was thinking.

As he walked, he sent out a palm strike, stimulating the power of heaven and earth, which turned into a dazzling brilliance, blurring the position where they had landed, so that the green-robed man and the others would not remember their route.
The man in green was also astonished.
He hadn’t expected that he would still fail to kill Tang Yan even after unleashing his most powerful weapon.
Moreover, this Spirit Tool was actually at the level of the Core Formation Tier.
With his strength, he couldn’t activate it continuously, so he hurriedly handed it over to the red-robed
man beside him.
The red-robed man injected his mystical power into the statue.
Weng, the eyes of the statue lit up again.
Xiu, a pillar of light shot out.𝐟𝕣𝕖𝐞𝐰𝕖𝚋𝐧𝗼𝚟𝐞𝕝.𝗰𝐨𝐦
Unfortunately, Ling Han and the others had already made a turn in time, and circled behind a flowerbed.
This pillar of light landed on the stones of the flowerbed, and did not hit them.
In this way, Ling Han and the others had already left them far behind.
Firstly, it was not easy to aim, and secondly, there were even more obstacles on their way, so it was impossible to hit
them.
“Junior Sister Nangong, it’s up to you now,” the man in green said to the woman at the end.
Her name was Nangong Qian, and aside from being a cultivator, she was also a Formation
Master.
“All right!” She nodded, “I will break through the formation as soon as possible, and make those three pay the price for Junior Sister Wu’s injuries!”
The woman in green held a sword, her face pale, her eyes filled with killing intent.
She had lost an arm, and from now onwards, she had become a cripple!
And all this was because of those three people.
Ling Han led the way, and soon walked through this garden.
“This isn’t good.
Not only do they have more Cauldron Forging Tier elites than us, but they also have a rare treasure with astonishing destructive power.” Tang Yan frowned.
“I still have the ability to protect myself, but if you guys take a hit, you’ll probably be in trouble.” Ling Han and Jin Yexue both nodded.
They did not have a life-saving treasure like Tang Yan.
“We still have some advantage in time.
Let’s move quickly,” Ling Han said.
“En!”
They hurriedly walked forwards.
After passing through the garden, there was a hall ahead of them.
Ling Han first observed it, and after confirming that there was no danger, it was still Tang Yan who took the lead.
Then, Ling Han and Jin Yexue followed him in.
Though there were no treasures here, Jin Yexue was slightly distracted.
She looked left and
right, her eyes slightly drifting, as if she was picturing how when the ancestors of the Jin Clan were still alive, this place was filled with guests.
They passed through the Main Hall, and when they came out, three paths appeared at the
same time.
“One leads to the inner courtyard, one leads to the training ground, and one leads to the Cultivation Technique Library,” Jin Yexue said.
This should be a memory left behind by their ancestors.
Even in their dreams, they dreamt of returning to their ancestral grounds.

chapters.title: Chapter 3786: Library
paragraphs: Chapter 3786: Library
There was nothing much to say. They definitely should go to the cultivation technique library. Jin Yexue led the way, and they chose a left turn.

They had to pass through a bamboo garden first. After so long, and furthermore, it had been buried deep at the bottom of the lake all this while, this bamboo garden was actually still verdant and dark green.
“Yi, this is Nine Patterns Bamboo!” Tang Yan exclaimed in shock, “This is something that can be forged into a Three Star precious tool!”

“This thing only grows a bit every 10,000 years, and can wait for a dead person,” he said endlessly. “Growing it for 90,000 years is the limit. There are a great many that have rotted away from old age here, and they are all bamboos that have exceeded 90,000 years old. This is really a great waste! This needs to be submerged in Boundless Water for three years first, and it would be sturdy and uncorroded, which would last a million years.”
“What a waste, what a real waste,” he lamented bitterly.

Ling Han took a look, and cut off a few Nine Patterns Bamboo that had reached maturity. He gave two to each of them, and said with a smile, “The ones planted along the path are all Nine Patterns Bamboo, used for ornamental purposes. Lady Jin, your family’s ancestors must be incomparably glorious.”
Jin Yexue nodded implicitly, “My clan does indeed have some reputation.”
“You’re making me look forward to it even more.” Tang Yan rubbed his hands together, “It can’t be a Saint Technique, right?”
“Of course not,” Jin Yexue said with a shake of her head. “The Jin Clan has never produced a Saint before. I’m sorry to disappoint you.”
“How could that be!” Tang Yan hurriedly replied. “You didn’t in the past, but you definitely will in the future.”

Jin Yexue faltered upon hearing this. Only then did she realize that he was talking about her. She couldn’t help but smile beautifully, and her ice-cold demeanor instantly disappeared. She was extremely graceful, and Tang Yan couldn’t help but stare at her.
This guy forgot his friends when he saw the woman he was in love with.
Ling Han shook his head, and walked straight ahead.
The Jin Manor was huge, and after walking for a while, they finally arrived at their destination.
Ahead of them was a small building, and in front of the small building, there was a fierce- looking stone Pixiu keeping watch.
Ling Han took out the Cold Water Metal for a look, and said, “To open the doors, the mechanism is behind that Pixiu.”
“I’ll open it.” Tang Yan hurriedly ran over.
However, he hadn’t reached it yet, when he saw that stone Pixiu actually came back to life. It opened its bloody mouth and bit at him.
There was a snapping sound, and before Tang Yan could even dodge, he had already been bitten.

The stone Pixiu swayed left and right, and after chewing a few times, it finally threw Tang Yan out. With a bang, he fell onto the ground. Meanwhile, the stone Pixiu returned to its original position, and flopped down, turning back into a stone statue.

“F***!” Tang Yan struggled to get to his feet. The rare treasure he had on him had already been activated, but it was completely useless. He had been bitten through by the stone Pixiu, but the strange thing was that he had only suffered a light injury.

Theoretically speaking, it should have been able to crush a Core Formation Tier-level shield with a single bite, so what difference did Tang Yan have with a small fish? He would have become a dead fish with a single bite.
Thus, it wasn’t that Tang Yan was lucky, but rather that the stone Pixiu had no intention of killing him.
“What do we do now?” Tang Yan was dumbfounded.
“Let’s attack together. You’re in charge of attracting its attention, and I’ll open the mechanism,” Ling Han said.
Tang Yan wore a dark expression, and he asked, “Why don’t I open the mechanism?”
“Because you’re more compatible with it,” Ling Han said with a smile.
Pei, you are the one who is compatible.

Tang Yan grumbled internally. However, his cultivation level was higher than Ling Han’s, and he also had the rare treasure to protect him. No matter what, he would be able to withstand a beating better than Ling Han. Thus, it was definitely him.
“Come!”
As he said this, he immediately charged out. The stone Pixiu also responded, and suddenly stood up.
“Come and chase me!” Tang Yan had successfully drawn its attention, and hurriedly broke into a run.
The stone Pixiu chased after him, which was slightly dumb.
Ling Han hurriedly leaped out as well, but he had just leaped out, when he saw the stone Pixiu’s body tremble, and another one actually appeared in its original position.
This stone Pixiu immediately charged out, biting towards Ling Han.

Its abilities were far too terrifying, and it was extremely likely that it had already reached the True Self Tier. So what if Ling Han was freakishly powerful? He was only at the Foundation Building Tier, after all.
He couldn’t resist at all, and he was bitten and thrashed.
When the stone Pixiu had played enough, it opened its mouth and spat. Pu, Ling Han fell onto
the ground.
How tragic.
On the other side, the one that was pursuing Tang Yan had also completed its mission. It jogged back, and then fused with the other stone Pixiu, turning back into one.
“I say, what kind of terrible idea did you come up with?” Tang Yan came back, his hands on
his hips.
Ling Han spread his hands and said, “I didn’t know that would happen either.”
Thankfully, the stone Pixiu didn’t kill them, and only bit them painfully.
“What do we do now?” Tang Yan asked gloomily.
“I’ll do it,” Jin Yexue stepped forward and said.
“You’re no match for it!” Tang Yan hurriedly exclaimed. He had already activated his trait of
chivalry.
“I’m not going to fight it,” Jin Yexue said as she walked forward. When the stone Pixiu came back to life, she bit her finger, and blood instantly seeped out.
The stone Pixiu’s movements came to an abrupt stop. It looked dumbly at Jin Yexue, as if it
had turned back into a stone statue.
Jin Yexue walked over and wiped the blood on the stone Pixiu’s forehead.
She turned around again, and said, “The ancestral bloodline can freeze it for about half an hour. Let’s go in immediately.”
Tang Yan and Ling Han both nodded. They went to the stone statue’s location and pulled the trigger. Ka, ka, ka! The doors to the small building immediately opened.
They entered, and saw that it was filled with bookshelves. Some were filled with books, some were filled with jade plates, and there were also animal hides and stone tablets.
“There aren’t any valuable secret techniques on the first floor. Let’s go to the second floor,”
Jin Yexue said.

Ling Han and Tang Yan both nodded in understanding. Although Jin Yexue had never come here before, she was still a member of the Jin Clan, after all. Thus, she would naturally know more about this place than them.
They went up to the second floor. The layout here was more or less the same as the floor below. There were still rows of bookshelves, covered with dust.
Ling Han picked up a book, yet it immediately turned into dust. Too much time had passed.

Tang Yan and Jin Yexue were also searching, but without exception, ordinary books definitely could not be preserved for tens of thousands of years, and had long since decayed. However, this place had not been touched all this while, and that was why it maintained the appearance of a book, but would shatter at the slightest touch.
Then what about the stone plates and jade plates?
“Thirteen Blood Moon Palms.”
“Thousand Transformations Fist Scroll.”𝓯𝓻𝒆𝙚𝒘𝓮𝙗𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝒍.𝙘𝓸𝙢
“Night Scroll.”

They found a great many cultivation techniques, and they were all very first-class, but they were only limited to the level of the True Self Tier. There was no True Lord Tier cultivation technique or Sect Master Tier-level technique.
Could it be that even the strongest ancestor of the Jin Clan was only a True Self Tier elite?
If that was the case, then “Old Monster Gu” would die with remaining grievances.
A mighty Spirit Transformation True Lord had actually died for the treasure trove of a measly
True Self Tier elite?
Hehe.
Ling Han did not believe this. He had been secretly observing Jin Yexueall this while. This woman was a descendant of the Jin Clan. If there was a precious technique, she should know
where it was stored.

Though Jin Yexue did not make any unusual movements all this while, and was just like Ling Han and Tang Yan, rummaging through the bookshelves, every once in a while, she would use her gaze to look in a certain direction. It was very covert. If Ling Han had not been observing
her all this while, he would definitely not have noticed.
What… lay there?
Ling Han walked over, and his divine sense immediately discovered that Jin Yexue looked
slightly nervous.

chapters.title: Chapter 3787: Background of the Jin Clan
paragraphs: Chapter 3787: Background of the Jin Clan
There was a wall in front of Ling Han, and there was nothing else.
He stretched out a hand, and began knocking on the brick.
Tong, tong, tong, the sound was muffled.
Ling Han switched to another brick, and knocked again. It was still the same, and he moved again.
After switching to a dozen over bricks, the sound suddenly changed, becoming very crisp and clear.
He revealed a smile. This was hollow.
“Tang Yan, Lady Jin,” he called out.
Tang Yan walked over, a dazed expression on his face. However, Jin Yexue wore a smile of admiration as she said, “Sure enough, I wasn’t able to fool you.”
Ling Han merely smiled faintly.
“Yi, what kind of secret signal are you guys playing? Why don’t I understand?” Tang Yan’s expression was filled with confusion.
“If you don’t understand, that’s right.” Ling Han pointed at that brick, “Come, smash it open.”
Yet Jin Yexue shook her head, “Don’t worry. There is no danger here.”

She walked forwards, and delivered a palm strike. Pa, the brick immediately shattered. She stretched out her hand again, and when she took it out, there was an iron box in her hand. “Yi!” Tang Yan’s eyes instantly widened.
Jin Yexue opened the box. There were three items inside.
There were two thin books and a piece of animal hide.
When Ling Han’s eyes swept over this animal hide, his heart involuntarily beat wildly.
He had seen this thing once.
“Can I take a look first?” He pointed at the animal hide.
“As you wish,” Jin Yexue said with a nod. “We’ve already discussed this before. Everyone will have a share of the cultivation techniques that we obtain.”
Ling Han retrieved that piece of beast hide and unfurled it. Meanwhile, Jin Yexue and Tang Yan also retrieved a book each.𝒇𝒓𝒆𝒆𝙬𝒆𝒃𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝙡.𝒄𝓸𝒎

“Hiss, the Great Overarching Heaven Technique!” Tang Yan’s voice was trembling slightly. He suddenly stood up, pointed at Jin Yexue and said, “You, you are a descendant of the Jin Clan of the Eternal Prosperity Majestic Empire!”
“That’s right!” Jin Yexue nodded proudly, exuding an indescribable air of nobility.
Meanwhile, Ling Han’s heart trembled madly. That was because he had not guessed wrongly. What was recorded on this beast hide was the Spirit Diagram of Destruction Energy!
He had only grasped a portion of it, and this was another portion. Whether the two together could complete the Spirit Diagram, Ling Han did not know either, because he had yet to begin cultivating.
He suppressed the excitement in his heart, and asked, “What Eternal Prosperity Majestic Empire?”
“Let me explain,” Jin Yexue said as she pressed a hand down on Tang Yan. Her domineering aura caused Tang Yan to involuntarily shut up.

“Before the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire, the Eternal Prosperity Majestic Empire ruled over the Moonlight Planet and its thirty-six subordinate planets,” she said proudly, a flash of nostalgic glory appearing on her pretty face. “However, around sixty thousand years ago, the Eternal Prosperity Majestic Empire’s Emperor, Jin Yue, failed to break through to Saint Tier and died. The Meng Clan, which should have been loyal and devoted, suddenly betrayed and massacred the Jin Clan.”
“Fortunately, the Jin Clan’s Emperor had left a bloodline treasure in the outside world just in case. No one knew about it, and it was because of this that they managed to escape.”

“However, in order to prevent the Meng Clan from finding the ancestral grounds of our Jin Clan, the ancestors would rather oppose them and hide the ancestral grounds. It was also because of this that the Jin Clan’s branch family was also unable to find the ancestral grounds. Generation after generation, they hid their hatred for the Meng Clan while searching for the whereabouts of the ancestral grounds.”
Ling Han was astonished. He hadn’t imagined that Jin Yexue would have such a powerful background.
Meanwhile, Jin Yexue looked at Tang Yan, “Young Marquis, do you still dare to accept the precious technique here?”
“You know who I am?” Tang Yan was slightly surprised.
“Who hasn’t heard of the dignified Little Marquis?” Jin Xuexue asked calmly.
Tang Yan couldn’t help but frown.

The moment the Meng Clan rose to power, they immediately began to clear their name. Tens of thousands of years had passed, and ordinary people knew that the Moonlight Planet only had one Imperial Family, and that was the Meng Clan. However, in some powerful forces, the truth of the past still circulated. In fact, there was even a portion of forces that were loyal to the surviving dregs of the Jin Clan, and were just waiting for the day when the descendant of the Jin Clan would appear, and with a wave of his arm and a shout, destroy the Meng Clan.

If he obtained the inheritance of the Jin Clan’s cultivation technique, that would be equivalent to standing on the opposite side of the Meng Clan, unless he handed over the things here at the first instant.
And that included Jin Yexue.

This caused him to feel conflicted. Jin Yexue was the first woman that had moved his heart, and the ancestor of the Jin Clan was actually qualified to attempt breaking through to Saint Tier, which showed how awesome the inheritance of the Jin Clan Clan was.
The Meng Clan had not stopped their search for the Jin Clan. Firstly, they wanted to kill all of them, and secondly, they wanted to obtain the Jin Clan’s precious technique.
Would Tang Yan be willing to surrender his chance to become a Saint?
Moreover, even if he handed it over, would the Meng Clan believe that he didn’t have a reserve copy?
Even if it was just to be safe, they would still kill him.

ghost drawings?

whether he knew about the Spirit Diagram or not, but whether he could learn it was another matter. He had only mastered it because of the millions of dimensions in his body, which was
very strange.

He stretched out a hand, and began knocking on the brick.
Tong, tong, tong, the sound was muffled.
Ling Han switched to another brick, and knocked again.
It was still the same, and he moved again.

He revealed a smile.
This was hollow.
“Tang Yan, Lady Jin,” he called out.
Tang Yan walked over, a dazed expression on his face.

Pa, the brick immediately shattered.

chapters.title: Chapter 3788: Inheritance!
paragraphs: Chapter 3788: Inheritance!
“You can understand it?” Tang Yan asked Ling Han, unwilling to give up.
Ling Han nodded, “More or less.”
Tang Yan received a heavy blow. Ling Han could understand it, but why couldn’t he?
Was there such a large gap between their talent in martial arts and their ability to comprehend
Dao? Most importantly, this was a pile of drawings, so what did it have to do with comprehension ability?
Jin Yexue also looked doubtful, and thought that Ling Han was just boasting.

Ling Han did not explain, and merely flipped through the Great Overarching Heaven Technique in his hands. Though this technique could not compare to the Demonic Monkey Fists, it could just barely compare to the Three Styles of the God of War, which could enrich Ling Han’s library of techniques.
He soon finished flipping through the book, and the contents of the book were completely memorized, automatically manifesting in his mind.
The three of them exchanged again, and Ling Han obtained the Turbid Heaven Scroll.

He flipped through it. This was a cultivation technique created by an elite of the fourth pinnacle level, but it was only limited to the fourth pinnacle level. Unless someone from the Jin Clan advanced into Saint Tier, and continued to write this cultivation technique, only would they be able to possess the Saint Chapter.

In terms of Foundation Building Tier, the Turbid Heaven Scroll was definitely not as good as the Ancient Sun Divine Scroll, but Ling Han had only obtained the Foundation Building chapter. Now, he was actually not too far away from the Cauldron Forging Tier, but it was obviously impossible for him to return to the Celestial Sea Planet in a short while. Thus, it was temporarily impossible for him to obtain the Cauldron Forging Tier chapter of the Ancient Sun Divine Scroll.

This Turbid Heaven Scroll was just right for him, and he could temporarily cultivate it. Moreover, he could refer to two high-level cultivation techniques at the same time, so he could appraise each other’s strengths and weaknesses, and take advantage of their strengths and make up for their shortcomings.
After memorizing the Turbid Heaven Scroll, Ling Han placed the book back into the box. Tang Yan did the same, and Jin Yexue also put away the box.
The distribution was completed.
A relaxed expression appeared on Jin Yexue’s face. After regaining the ancestral technique, there was hope for the Jin Clan to rise again.
Tang Yan was also very satisfied. He could immediately switch to cultivating the Turbid Heaven Scroll, and his abilities would rocket in the short term.𝒇𝒓𝙚𝒆𝔀𝓮𝓫𝒏𝓸𝙫𝓮𝓵.𝓬𝙤𝙢

Ling Han was also very satisfied. He had unexpectedly obtained another portion of the Spirit Diagram for Destructive Energy. Once he successfully cultivated it, his battle prowess would definitely increase greatly.
“There should still be a Medicinal Garden and an alchemy chamber in this place. However, who knows how much will remain after so many years,” Jin Yexue said, feeling slightly rueful.
In the past, the Jin Clan had been glorious for a while, and had ruled over dozens of planets. Now, however, they were like drowning dogs, not daring to reveal their identities at all.

Tang Yan couldn’t help but sigh when he recalled Jin Yexue’s identity. It was clear that Jin Yexue and the Meng Clan were irreconcilable enemies. If he wanted to pursue Jin Yexue, he would definitely have to stand on the opposing side of the Meng Clan, which put him in a very difficult position.
If he went back and told his family, his legs would be broken, and he would never see Jin Yexue again. He would pretend that the two of them had never met.

The three of them plundered all the cultivation techniques and precious techniques on the bookshelves. Although their value was inferior to the Turbid Heaven Technique and the Great Overarching Heaven Technique, there was no reason for them to leave them here and waste them.
Then, they went downstairs and left.

They had just descended a few steps, when they saw five people arrive together. They were Nangong Qian and the others, who had previously had a conflict with Ling Han and the others. This was really the meeting of enemies, and their eyes were red with envy.
The green-robed woman’s eyes immediately became bloodshot. She drew her sword, and charged towards them.
There shouldn’t be any formations or restrictions here, right?
Unfortunately, there was no formation technique, but there was a stone Pixiu.
Half an hour had passed, and the trace of blood that Jin Yexue had left behind had already dried up. That stone Pixiu had already returned to normal.

It quickly charged out, biting onto the green-robed woman in a single bite. It shook its head repeatedly, and after chewing for a while, with a ‘pu’, spat the green-robed woman out. “Junior Sister!” The other four hurriedly rushed forwards, and saw that the wound that the woman in green had originally bandaged was bleeding again.

-The stone Pixiu didn’t kill people, and even the injuries it caused were very light, but it couldn’t hold up against the green-robed woman who was already heavily injured in the first place. With such torment, the wound naturally split open.
Tang Yan laughed loudly, “Come on, come on. The five of you can come at me together. I will take you all on alone.”
“Humph!” The man in green took out the sculpture again, causing the expressions of Ling Han and the others to change drastically.
This Spirit Tool’s destructive power was astonishing, and they couldn’t withstand it.

They hurriedly retreated back into the small building, but the man in green robes did not care at all. Xiu, a ray of light shot out, and landed on the small building. With a bang, a corner of the small building was instantly blasted open.
What depressed Ling Han and the others was the fact that the stone Pixiu was actually completely unmoved.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! Every once in a while, a ray of light would shoot over, and in a few moments, the whole building was on the verge of collapse.
“What do we do?” Tang Yan asked with a frown.

“We’ll split up later,” Ling Han said. There was no hope in battle. Firstly, the other side had five Cauldron Forging Tier elites, and secondly, they also had that terrifying deadly weapon. Only Tang Yan could withstand it for a while.
“Lady Jin and I are Cauldron Forging Tier elites, so it’s no problem for us to flee. But what about you?” Tang Yan shook his head, disagreeing with this plan.
“In terms of fleeing, I can still compare to the Cauldron Forging Tier.” Ling Han was filled
with confidence.
Tang Yan looked at him in disbelief.
Boom! The entire building was collapsing, causing rubble to fall and dust to fly everywhere.
Jin Yexue couldn’t help but urge them, saying, “Don’t look at each other so lovingly. What’s
your decision? Hurry up!”
“Let’s go!”
Ling Han did not give Tang Yan the chance to hesitate any longer, and was the first to charge out. He used Imminent Skyline, and his speed was astonishingly fast.
“F***!” Tang Yan couldn’t help but stare. Ling Han’s speed was not much slower than his.
“You hold the rear,” Jin Yexue said as she charged forward.
“Haha, Grandpa Tang is also coming!” Tang Yan used his movement technique, but
deliberately slowed down a bit.
He had a rare treasure that could protect him, so he had to absorb a wave of attacks first, creating an opportunity for Ling Han and Jin Yexue to escape.

With the three of them fleeing, Nangong Qian and the others were also slightly surprised. However, after only being startled for a moment, the man in green immediately said with divine sense, “Junior Sister Wu, you go and chase after that Foundation Building cultivator. Junior Sister Nangong and I will chase after that male Cauldron Forging Tier. Junior Brother Qian and Junior Brother Zhao, go and chase after that woman.”
“All right!” The other four nodded respectively, and each set off in pursuit of their own target.

His distribution was very reasonable. Ling Han was the weakest, so even if the woman in green had lost an arm, it would not be difficult to take him down, and Tang Yan should be the strongest. He had a rare treasure for defense on him, so he needed to mobilize the deadly
weapon to break through it.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! Everyone used movement techniques, their speed extremely fast.

Ling Han didn’t fly. The entire Jin Clan Manor was protected by formations, so he couldn’t fly too high. Otherwise, he would immediately be attacked by the formations. He simply ran on the ground, using one building after another to throw off the pursuer.
However, the woman in green had suffered a loss twice, and she had even lost an arm. This hatred could be said to be absolutely irreconcilable. She pursued him relentlessly, determined
to capture Ling Han.
Though Ling Han’s Imminent Skyline was fast, it was ultimately limited by his cultivation
level. After running for more than ten minutes, the other party gradually caught up to him.

“Die!” The woman in green slashed with her sword. Shua, a flash of sword light shot over, wrapped in icy energy. It was incredibly cold, as it rapidly pursued Ling Han. Ling Han humphed, and without even turning his head, shot out a punch. Peng, the force of
the punch landed on the sword light, and was instantly sliced apart. However, with this obstruction, the Sword Qi also slowed slightly, and did not catch up to him in the end.

chapters.title: Chapter 3789: An excellent alchemy cauldron
paragraphs: Chapter 3789: An excellent alchemy cauldron

“A mere Foundation Building cultivator actually has such strength, truly remarkable. Unfortunately, you are only a Foundation Building cultivator, and are destined to die by my hands,” the woman in green said coldly, chasing after him with all her might.
Ling Han smiled and said, “As a disabled person, it’s quite remarkable that you still have such battle prowess. Unfortunately, if you want to kill me, you can only dream.”
Hearing Ling Han mock her for being disabled, the woman in green couldn’t help but wear a frosty expression. This was the agonizing pain in her heart.
“Die! Die! Die!” She was about to go crazy, and struck repeatedly with her sword. Sword Qi danced, as dense as a spider’s web.

Ling Han was calm and composed as he unleashed a murderous aura attack. The woman in green instantly faltered, and a flaw appeared in her attack. Ling Han caught it and calmly tore a hole in her defenses. As the net of Sword Qi swept over him, he was completely unscathed. The woman in green was stunned. What kind of attack was this? It actually went straight into her mind, causing her mind to go blank for an instant. Though it was only an instant, in a battle, this was really too dangerous.

Thankfully, Ling Han wasn’t a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator. Otherwise, it was extremely likely that he would have seized the opportunity and insta-killed her at the very least, she would be at a huge disadvantage.
“Like I said, you’re just dreaming,” Ling Han said calmly.
“Is that so?” The woman in the green garment smirked coldly. She summoned the Celestial Cauldron, and two silver cauldrons floated above her head. One had three legs, while the other had two legs.
Two cauldrons meant that she was an Earth Cauldron, and one cauldron only had two legs, which meant that she had not cultivated Earth Cauldron Tier to peak stage.
However, the main point was not here.

-The Celestial Cauldron possessed an irresistible crushing effect on Foundation Building Tiers. Thus, as long as she summoned the Celestial Cauldron, Ling Han’s battle prowess would be weakened by at least half. In fact, it was even possible that he would directly sprawl out on the ground.
However, Ling Han was still running very quickly.
F***, how was this possible?
The woman in green was slightly dumbfounded. This was completely illogical. Once the Celestial Cauldron appeared, a Foundation Building Tier was actually unaffected?
What kind of freak was this?
She naturally could not possibly give up, and hurriedly set off in pursuit again.
It would be indecent to not reciprocate.
Ling Han thought. With a thought, xiu, Heavenly Pattern Jade shot out rapidly.

The Heavenly Pattern Jade could reach 40 times the speed of sound, and the green-robed woman was in hot pursuit at more than 20 times the speed of sound. This relative speed exceeded 60 times the speed of sound, and the green-robed woman couldn’t dodge at all. She didn’t even have the time to think of dodging, and merely slashed out instinctively.
Ding!

The Heavenly Pattern Jade smashed into the sword, and a terrifying power surged over. The woman in green felt the web between her thumb and forefinger go numb, and the sharp sword slipped from her hand.

A look of terror spread across her face. This was because the Heavenly Pattern Jade was still crashing toward her. However, the angle of her slash was slightly off. Peng! There was a splash of blood, and it was clear that a chunk of her left waist was missing. Blood was still flowing from her wound.
Ling Han charged back. When he used the Demonic Monkey Fists, there was only one move. However, the Imperial Technique was extremely awesome. Merely its aura alone was enough to crush all life.

The woman in green had just suffered a severe injury, and was still in a state of distraction. When this Demonic Monkey Fists flew towards her, it was like heaven’s might was issuing a punishment, making it difficult for her to even have the will to resist.
However, she was a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator, after all, so her instincts as a cultivator still allowed her to send out a palm strike in response to Ling Han’s attack.
Peng!
The punch landed, and the woman in green was instantly sent flying. Blood gushed from her shoulder injury and waist injury, and her whole person was extremely dispirited.
This injury added to her injury caused her condition to instantly drop to rock bottom.
Without hesitation, she turned around and fled.

Ling Han chased after her, but the woman in green was really putting her life on the line now. Ignoring the seriousness of her injuries, she ran madly, and her speed was actually slightly faster than before.
After chasing for a few steps, Ling Han finally stopped.
After all, there were still four people in the other party, so it was not appropriate to pursue her to desperation.

Although he had taken the green-robed woman by surprise and severely wounded her with the Heavenly Pattern Jade, it wouldn’t be as effective if he used it again. Moreover, they also had an extremely powerful Spirit Tool. This was something he couldn’t resist at the moment.
Let’s go.
Ling Han turned around, but didn’t leave. Instead, he went to find the alchemy chamber and Medicinal Garden.
Since he had entered into a mountain of treasure, how could he possibly return empty- handed?
He strode forward, searching for the location of the alchemy chamber and Medicinal Garden. Now, the others were in the midst of a great chase, and this was a good opportunity to make a
move.
He took out the Void Beast hide and draped it over his body. Instantly, he entered into the Void. No one could discover his existence.
He searched slowly, and after more than half an hour, he finally found the alchemy chamber.
However, there was a formation protecting the alchemy chamber.

Ling Han began to decipher the formation. Fortunately, this formation couldn’t be considered a high-level formation, and it had been buried at the bottom of the lake for too long. The power of heaven and earth had long since changed, and there was pitifully little power of heaven and earth that it could draw on, so it was very easy to decipher.
He entered the alchemy chamber, and the first thing he saw was an ancient-looking alchemy cauldron. It was completely purple-red in colour, and was not stained with the slightest bit of
dust.
This was good stuff.
Ling Han immediately confirmed that this alchemy cauldron wasn’t ordinary.

He reached out to touch the cauldron, feeling its texture. Then, he channeled mystical power slightly, and it was immediately transmitted into the alchemy cauldron. When he also instilled Spiritual Power into it, he shockingly discovered that the Spiritual Power would actually affect the power transmitted by the alchemy cauldron.
These was a Spiritual Power material!
He nodded internally. Spiritual Power could affect the transmission of power through materials. If this was used to concoct alchemical pills, it was practically indescribably
amazing.
Good stuff, this was really good stuff.
Ling Han was overjoyed, and he hurriedly put the alchemy cauldron away. His gains this time
were truly astonishing.
As expected of the ancestral grounds of a Venerate Tier-level force. This alchemy cauldron
was probably something that even Earth Tier High Grade alchemists would fight tooth and
nail over.
He searched around the room again, and discovered several bottles of alchemical pills.
He basically didn’t recognize these alchemical pills, but with his talent in alchemy, he only needed to smell them, and he would be able to roughly determine the effects of these
alchemical pills.
‘Hmm?’
He hurriedly put on the Void Beast hide again, because he heard footsteps coming from
outside.
Looking, it was Nangong Qian and the others.
“How detestable! Those three people actually managed to escape!” The man in green robes
wore a furious expression.
“I wonder what secret technique they obtained.” The man in black was filled with regret.
The man in green humphed, and said, “They’ve all been scared off, so there’s no one here to compete with us. I refuse to believe that the only valuable thing in this place are cultivation
techniques.”
“This is an alchemy chamber. Perhaps there is a supremely valuable medicine that can heal Junior Sister Wu’s injuries,” Nangong Qian said.

The woman in green did not speak. Her injuries were too severe, and she would be a cripple from now onwards, so how could she get used to it all of a sudden? Previously, she still had the thought of revenge to hold on, but now that there was no hope for revenge, her emotions had also fallen to rock bottom.
She could clearly feel that the attitudes of the other four people towards her had suddenly
turned cold.
“That’s not right. There are signs that someone has broken through the formation here!” Nangong Qian suddenly called out.
“Are you sure?” the man in green asked.
“Positive!” Nangong Qian was extremely certain.
“It must be that Foundation Building brat!” The green-robed man nodded. “He didn’t manage to escape, and is still here! Who knows… he might be in this alchemy chamber!”

chapters.title: Chapter 3790: Surrounded
paragraphs: Chapter 3790: Surrounded
When the woman in green heard this, she was instantly energized.

She had lost an arm, but she couldn’t actually blame Ling Han and the others for that. Although she had also lost her arm because of them, the fact that she had lost a piece of her waist was completely because of Ling Han.

Now that she heard that Ling Han was still here, she couldn’t help but feel her spirit soar. With a wave of her sword, she was just about to charge in. However, she had already suffered, so she hurriedly stopped abruptly, and asked Nangong Qian, “Senior Sister Nangong, the formations here have all been broken through?”
“En.” Nangong Qian nodded.

The woman in green no longer had any reservations. Wielding her sword, she charged out. With her three Senior Brothers and Senior Sister standing guard, she was naturally unafraid. But when she rushed into the alchemy chamber, she did not see anything.
“He escaped!” she said hatefully.

The other four naturally followed her in as well, and couldn’t help but look disappointed. That was because this place looked like it had been ransacked at first glance, and there was nothing good left?
“Damn it!” The man in black pressed down a palm on empty air. He was presently filled with anger, so how could he not vent it out?

Boom, boom, boom! He struck out repeatedly with his palms, naturally hitting a spot where there was no one, but when he had struck his seventh palm strike, a figure actually appeared out of thin air, greeting his attack.
This time, it was really too sudden. The man in black had completely not expected this. He had only casually delivered a palm strike to vent his anger, so how could he have blasted out a person?
In a rush, he had no way to increase his power, but Cauldron Forging Tier was Cauldron Forging Tier, and in such a critical moment, he still summoned a triangular shield to protect himself.
Peng!
Ling Han’s punch landed on his opponent’s shield, causing him to slide back a few steps. He didn’t linger in battle at all, and directly rushed out the door.
Nangong Qian and the others faltered for a moment before coming to their senses. “That Foundation Building brat!”
“Chase!”
“So he’s still here!”
“He must have taken away the treasures in the alchemy chamber.”
“Who knows, there may even be cultivation techniques!”
“Capture him!”

The five of them were all excited, and hurriedly chased after him. Meanwhile, the woman in green’s expression was filled with killing intent. At present, her hatred for Ling Han far surpassed her thirst for treasures.
She only had one thought, and that was to kill Ling Han!

Ling Han couldn’t do anything about it. He had dodged very well, but the man in black suddenly went crazy, launching a flurry of palm strikes. If he hadn’t made a move just now, he would have been hit by the palm strike, and he would still have to show himself.
It could not be helped. He was only wrapped in the Void Beast hide, and could not completely escape into the Void.
Ling Han activated the Imminent Skyline and fled.

Nangong Qian and the others were hot on his heels. At this moment, the difference in their strength could be seen. The man in green and the man in black were even faster, and were rapidly catching up to Ling Han, while the other three were slowly closing the distance between them.
“Hehe, you won’t be able to escape!” The man in green sneered. He had not thought that there would be another fish that had slipped through the net, and it was a big fish at that.
“Stop right there obediently. Hand over the cultivation technique and alchemical pills, and perhaps we can even reward you with a quick death,” the man in black said.
Ling Han ignored them. These two people only wanted to disturb his emotions, so he naturally wouldn’t fall for it.
“Then don’t blame me for being rude!” The man in green robes took out the sculpture.

“Senior Brother!” the man in black hurriedly shouted. They had to capture him alive, and the destructive power of this pillar of light was too terrifying. If they used it, it might destroy the alchemical pills and cultivation technique together.
“It’s fine. I’ll aim for his legs,” the man in green said with a grin, revealing a bloodthirsty expression.
The man in black nodded. As long as he didn’t die, and the treasure didn’t break, it was fine.

The man in green immediately began to channel the Spirit Tool. His eyes shone with white light, and it was at this moment that a terrifying spiritual attack struck, making him involuntarily feel an indescribable fear. Xiu, the pillar of light shot out, but it had completely lost its aim.
The man in black got a scare, because this pillar of light was more inclined to shoot towards him.
“Senior Brother, what’s wrong with you!” he roared. With his cultivation level, he would either die or be injured by the attack of the pillar of light. The destructive power was too
terrifying.
The green-robed man came back to his senses, and was slightly dazed, as he said, “I don’t know who was attacking my mind just now, and caused me to lose my wits.”
“Senior Brother, it’s that brat!” The woman in green transmitted a message from behind, “He has a kind of spiritual attack, which is very hard to block!”

“So that’s how it is!” The man in green sneered. He waited for a while, and when he recovered, he once again controlled the Spirit Tool in his hands, but this time, he used Spiritual Power to protect his mind, and formed a mystical power shield outside his body.
Weng!

He had not even launched his attack, when the barrage of murderous aura came again. Even with his heavy defenses, he was still unable to completely block the barrage of murderous aura. He felt a pain in his head, and his attack was involuntarily sent out, unreasonably
slanted.
“This brat is really f****** hard to deal with!” he couldn’t help but roar, and felt a kind of fear.

This Foundation Building cultivator was far too terrifying. In terms of speed, he could already rival Cauldron Forging Tier cultivators. In fact, with his relentless attacks, he had even forced his Junior Sister to abandon her pursuit and flee in disarray. If this kind of cultivator advanced to the Cauldron Forging Tier, just how terrifying would he become?
“Kill him! We definitely have to kill him today!” His killing intent became incredibly firm.
“There’s no need for all of us to pursue him. Spread out in every corner. This place is only so big, so we’ll definitely be able to intercept him!” he said.
“En!”
The man in black and the others all nodded, and dispersed at the same time, going in different directions. Only the man in green was still hot on his heels.

In this way, the pressure on Ling Han was greater, because as he ran, it was possible that a person would suddenly appear in front of him to attack him, and this kind of sneak attacker was even a Cauldron Forging Tier elite.
The more this was the case, the calmer Ling Han became.
He suddenly charged back, and looked like he was going to fight the man in green one-on-
one.
“Haha, how foolish!” The man in green sneered, “I am in Heaven Cauldron Tier!”
Naturally, he was unafraid. He charged out, and put away the statue. He switched to using a
staff, and as he swept it out, endless energy boiled, turning into a dazzling brilliance. There were seals everywhere, and the might was unimaginable.
That was because not only was he a Heaven Cauldron, he was also a silver cauldron. His battle prowess was much higher than a copper cauldron of the same level.

Ling Han did not hesitate in the slightest as he summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. Multiple flashes of Primal Chaos Qi descended to guard him, while flashes of lightning flickered violently towards the green-robed man.

Weng, the murderous aura attacks hit first, causing the man in green robes to pause slightly. Then, with a thought from Ling Han, the Heavenly Pattern Jade was also launched. Under his feet, he channeled the Imminent Skyline. The Demonic Monkey Fists wrapped with Destructive Energ followed closely behind.
In just a single exchange, Ling Han had revealed practically all of his trump cards – aside from the Heavenly Dao Flames inside the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
Peng!

The barrage of murderous aura reached him, but the man in green was already prepared, so the effect on him was negligible. Seeing that the Heavenly Pattern Jade was about to hit him, a cloth appeared in front of him. Pu, the Heavenly Pattern Jade crashed onto him, but was wrapped by the cloth. It actually couldn’t be torn open, but rather caught in the fabric.
