If this kind of cultivator advanced to the Cauldron Forging Tier, just how terrifying would he become?
“Kill him!
We definitely have to kill him today!” His killing intent became incredibly firm.
“There’s no need for all of us to pursue him.
Spread out in every corner.
This place is only so big, so we’ll definitely be able to intercept him!” he said.
“En!”
The man in black and the others all nodded, and dispersed at the same time, going in different directions.
Only the man in green was still hot on his heels.

In this way, the pressure on Ling Han was greater, because as he ran, it was possible that a person would suddenly appear in front of him to attack him, and this kind of sneak attacker was even a Cauldron Forging Tier elite.
The more this was the case, the calmer Ling Han became.
He suddenly charged back, and looked like he was going to fight the man in green one-on-
one.
“Haha, how foolish!” The man in green sneered, “I am in Heaven Cauldron Tier!”
Naturally, he was unafraid.
He charged out, and put away the statue.
He switched to using a
staff, and as he swept it out, endless energy boiled, turning into a dazzling brilliance.
There were seals everywhere, and the might was unimaginable.
That was because not only was he a Heaven Cauldron, he was also a silver cauldron.
His battle prowess was much higher than a copper cauldron of the same level.
Ling Han did not hesitate in the slightest as he summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
Multiple flashes of Primal Chaos Qi descended to guard him, while flashes of lightning flickered violently towards the green-robed man.
Weng, the murderous aura attacks hit first, causing the man in green robes to pause slightly.
Then, with a thought from Ling Han, the Heavenly Pattern Jade was also launched.
Under his feet, he channeled the Imminent Skyline.
The Demonic Monkey Fists wrapped with Destructive Energ followed closely behind.
In just a single exchange, Ling Han had revealed practically all of his trump cards – aside from the Heavenly Dao Flames inside the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
Peng!
The barrage of murderous aura reached him, but the man in green was already prepared, so the effect on him was negligible.
Seeing that the Heavenly Pattern Jade was about to hit him, a cloth appeared in front of him.
Pu, the Heavenly Pattern Jade crashed onto him, but was wrapped by the cloth.
It actually couldn’t be torn open, but rather caught in the fabric.

chapters.title: Chapter 3791: Escape
paragraphs: Chapter 3791: Escape
Ling Han charged over, and the lightning exploded at the same time. Meanwhile, the Demonic Monkey Fists wrapped in Destructive Energy also arrived.

“Haha, your courage is truly commendable!” The man in green sneered. His cultivation level was at the Heaven Cauldron. No matter how freakish you are, how could a mere Foundation Building cultivator resist?
He put away the cloth, and swept out with his staff.
Ling Han activated his ocular technique, and with a step, he actually broke through the multiple staff strikes of the green-robed man.
What!

The man in green was shocked. His sweep was not done casually, but was rather a staff technique. Even though it was only a sweep of the staff, it was covered densely with energy, as if a large net had been spread out.
In this kind of situation, the other party actually managed to seize that slight opening and rush out. This insight was really too brilliant, wasn’t it?
However, there was no time for him to feel rueful at this moment. He hurriedly abandoned his staff and clenched his hands into fists, greeting Ling Han’s attack.
As the saying went, it was out of reach. At this time, the staff was too long to hit him. If someone came close enough, the staff would not be able to turn around to strike him.
Boom!

Their fists clashed together, and a terrifying power collided. Ling Han was undoubtedly sent flying, and he crashed heavily into the wall, directly creating a large hole. He continued to fly backwards.
Only after crashing through seven walls did Ling Han finally fall to the ground. He felt as if all the bones in his body had been shattered, and he couldn’t move a single finger.
However, there was no time for him to rest now. He hurriedly forcibly got to his feet, drew out the Void Beast hide, and draped it over his body. He concealed himself, and left quietly.
Xiu, the man in green had already rushed over. He stared at where Ling Han had fallen, but there was no longer any trace of Ling Han.
Not good, he had escaped!
He was filled with hatred, and also wanted to vent his anger through random attacks, but shockingly discovered that there was actually a power corroding his fist.
What was this thing?

He was shocked. Though this energy was weak, it was incredibly tenacious. He had already used his mystical power to expel it, yet it was actually not completely expelled, and was still wreaking havoc on him.
Though the damage was not very great, it was like gangrene attached to one’s bones. It was extremely annoying.
Just how many secret techniques had this brat grasped?

The green-robed man’s eyes were filled with greed. The Spirit Tool that the other had summoned and the fist technique that he used contained a mysterious high-level energy. If he could obtain all of it… just how strong would he be?
“I will definitely find you!”
He sent out a signal to gather Nangong Qian and the others.
“Where is he?” The moment the woman in green arrived, she immediately questioned.

“He managed to flee from me,” the man in green said. “However, I also wounded him.” “Since he has been wounded by you, he still actually managed to slip away?” the man in black asked, his expression filled with suspicion.
When his words fell, Nangong Qian and the others all turned their eyes towards him.

The man in green couldn’t help but feel his expression darken, “You guys don’t believe me?” “Hehe.” The man in black sneered. He very much suspected that the other had taken the treasure for himself, and then lied about how Ling Han had snuck away.

The man in green took out the Heavenly Pattern Jade, and said, “That Foundation Building brat used this Spiritual Power Spirit Tool to attack me. I had no choice but to dodge, and that was how he managed to escape. You guys also know that the brat has a way to hide his tracks.”
That was true.
The other four people were skeptical. This sounded reasonable, but only this man in green knew the truth.

“Junior Sister Nangong, I’ll have to trouble you to guard the entrance. You know formation techniques, so you won’t let that brat slip away.” The green-robed man began to assign missions. “The four of us will split into groups of two, and continue to search for that brat.”
This distribution was quite reasonable, so the four of them nodded one after another, and for the moment, believed him.
They split up again, determined to find Ling Han.𝘧𝑟𝑒𝑒𝘸𝘦𝘣𝑛𝑜𝘷𝑒𝓁.𝘤𝘰𝓂
The rooms here stretched on and on. Ling Han casually entered into one of them, closed the doors, and found a corner to sit down in. He hurriedly took out alchemical pills which he
ingested.

In the final attack, he clashed with the man in green, breaking several of his bones from the impact. His internal organs were also severely damaged, and his injuries were considerably serious. He needed to immediately heal his injuries.

Ling Han shook his head, and said, “Right now, I can only barely rival the Human Cauldron. A strike from Heaven Cauldron was able to severely wound me.” This was something that couldn’t be helped. The gulf between him and Heaven Cauldron was far too great, so he was already extremely fortunate to be able to escape.
“The Heavenly Pattern Jade has fallen into his hands. I definitely have to get it back,” Ling
Han murmured.
The problem was, how was he supposed to obtain it?
“Unless… I break through to the Cauldron Forging Tier!”
Ling Han retrieved the alchemical pills that he had obtained from the alchemy chamber. After opening the bottles one by one, he carefully examined them.
Many alchemical pills were already disshapen, turning into a paste that stuck to the bottom of the bottle. Naturally, a lot of the medicinal effects were also lost.

“This bottle of pills should help one break through to the next cultivation level. The original medicinal effects should be enough to help a True Self Tier cultivator break through to the next cultivation level. Now, it should only be able to help a Foundation Building cultivator break through to the Cauldron Forging Tier.”
“This bottle is for increasing cultivation level. It has lost lost too much medicinal effects, so it should be just right for my current cultivation level.”
“Humph, I’ll break through to the Cauldron Forging Tier here, and then seek out those five people for an accounting!”
Ling Han was not the type to be willing to suffer losses. Being repeatedly hunted down by Nangong Qian and the others, how could he not be angered?
He dug out some medicinal paste from the pill bottle and swallowed it. This was medicine that could increase one’s cultivation level.
In a short while, he felt a heat in his stomach, as if it was about to burn.
Boom, vigorous energy surged within his body, as if it could topple mountains and overturn
seas.
“F***, I miscalculated. Though the medicinal effects have weakened, it has still surpassed
my current cultivation level.”
“I’ve already eaten, so I can only take it head-on!”
Ling Han gritted his teeth. The energy in his body was too terrifying, as if it was about to
burst him. In fact, he even felt his body expand.
This was naturally an illusion, but it also showed how astonishing the energy in his body was, that he could not control it at all.
Ling Han could only channel the Ancient Sun Divine Scroll, desperately converting this energy into mystical power to strengthen his Celestial Foundations.

Pa, pa, pa! Energy rampaged madly. His bones and internal organs had already been severely injured in the first place, and he had just barely managed to reconnect his bones and close up his injuries. However, with such an impact, they were instantly broken open again.
It was so bitter!
Ling Han forcefully endured the agonizing pain, and did his best to absorb the energy in his body. Only by enduring the medicinal effects would he be able to heal his injuries again.
Half a day later, the medicinal effects finally stabilized.
Ling Han panted heavily, cold sweat rolling down his forehead, mixed with blood.
He had really lost half his life. Now, his whole person was like mud. There was practically not
a single complete bone or muscle left in his whole body. However, his cultivation level had also increased greatly, so he had not suffered for nothing.

“The price for rapidly increasing one’s cultivation level in this manner is one’s own life!” Ling Han mused ruefully. Though the medicinal effects were dense, and contained a great amount of energy in itself, it was a destructive method to allow his cultivation level to advance so rapidly. It was definitely expending his future lifespan.
Ling Han didn’t regret it. What was the point of living a few more years, but living a coward’s
life?
As a man, he should be quick to repay debts of gratitude and revenge, and laugh proudly.
“I can’t stay here any longer,” Ling Han murmured. He had already stayed here for so long, so the five of them would definitely find him eventually. He needed to change locations.

chapters.title: Chapter 3792: Battling a Cauldron Forging Tier
paragraphs: Chapter 3792: Battling a Cauldron Forging Tier
Ling Han exited the room. He had not walked for too long, when he saw the man in green robes and the woman in green walk over from the distance, side by side.
He hurriedly hid in a corner, suppressing the flow of blood in his body to prevent the blood from flowing and exposing him.
Thankfully, the two of them were searching room by room, and did not pay any attention to the pathway.
Ling Han took advantage of the opening and hurriedly moved.
It wasn’t long before the man in green and the woman in green found the place where Ling Han had previously hidden. They discovered a large pool of blood on the ground.
“Found it!”
“This guy has indeed been severely injured.”
“Unfortunately, we were still a step too late.”
“It’s fine. Now that the main doors are guarded, he’s just a turtle in a jar. Sooner or later, he’ll fall into our hands.”
“Let’s go!”
The two of them continued their pursuit.
This time, Ling Han didn’t go into a room. Instead, he dug a hole in the dense forest and buried himself inside.
In any case, he was already a Foundation Building cultivator, so he didn’t need to eat or breathe anymore.
He suppressed his injuries, then took some medicinal paste. This time, he really only took a little.
Energy surged in his body again, but this time, it was still fine. It was within a controllable range.
In just one hour, Ling Han had completely absorbed the medicinal effects. His cultivation level had once again improved significantly.
Again.
Ling Han continued to take alchemical pills. At this moment, he was filled with fury. He definitely had to break through to the Cauldron Forging Tier and seek out those five people for an accounting.

The next morning, Ling Han didn’t take any more pills. Instead, he faced the rising sun and inhaled and exhaled the essence of heaven and earth. This was something that could not be found in the medicinal effects.
Then, he continued to take alchemical pills and continued to cultivate.
Ordinarily, even tonic medicines couldn’t be taken continuously, and immunity was only a secondary reason. Medicines had their poisons, and taking too many would only have disadvantages.
However, Ling Han didn’t care about this now. He only wanted to improve his cultivation level.

After continuous consumption, the medicinal effects naturally became weaker and weaker. However, this alchemical pill was fierce in the first place, so even if it decreased greatly, it still had a very strong effect on Ling Han.

Of course, the disadvantage was also very obvious. Now that the poison had accumulated, putting aside what effect it would have on his body, at least for the time being, it would no longer be effective for him to take other alchemical pills.
Five days later, Ling Han had already pushed his cultivation level to the peak stage of the Ultimate Dao Foundation. Moreover, his injuries had also recovered by more than half.

In these five days, he would move at night, leaving traces of blood in different rooms, creating the illusion that he had actually been healing his injuries indoors, confusing Nangong Qian and the others.
“I can attempt to break through to the Cauldron Forging Tier.”

“I’ve already tried. Even with the suppression of the Imperial Weapon, the living beings in the dimensions inside my body aren’t powerful enough to resist the shockwaves from the three Celestial Foundations. Thus, constructing four Celestial Foundations is an absolutely impossible task.”
“In truth, others only have one Celestial Foundation, but I have three. This is already inconceivable, breaking the impossible twice.”
“Now, I will attempt to break through to the Cauldron Forging Tier.”
“The Galaxy Network is really a good thing. As long as you’re willing to spend money, a Cauldron Forging Tier-level Treasured Fruit of Life will immediately be delivered to your doorstep.”

Ling Han didn’t immediately ingest the Treasured Fruit of Life. This was because he had only reached the peak stage of the Foundation Building Tier and still hadn’t obtained the opportunity to break through yet.

He simply lay on the ground, fused with the ground, and began to accumulate appreciation. From Foundation Building Tier to Cauldron Forging Tier, it was very simple to say. It was to transform the cornerstone of the Celestial Path into a Celestial Cauldron. However, the transformation of form was only a symbol. The true change was the leap in level of being. Ling Han released his divine sense, fusing with the ground and the heavens.
Images appeared in his mind. They were scenes of Ancestral King Pan Shi comprehending Dao all those years ago.

Ling Han didn’t obtain any techniques from Ancestral King Pan Shi. However, he obtained something even more precious, and that was the various difficulties and deviations that Ancestral King Pan Shi had gone through during his breakthrough.
This was like a cultivation scroll left behind by a great predecessor elite. It was extremely
precious.
From this, it could be seen that Ancestral King Pan Shi was truly broad-minded, imparting this kind of experience selflessly to the future generations.
What Ling Han saw was the multiple failures experienced by Ancestral King Pan Shi, so there was no need for him to take that path.
Two days later, his whole body did not release the slightest bit of aura, as if he had become a corpse. However, in his mind, an incredibly intense change was presently taking place, and
was about to happen.𝐟𝚛𝕖𝚎𝕨𝗲𝐛𝚗𝐨𝐯𝐞𝕝.𝐜𝗼𝗺
The three foundation stones of the Celestial Path were presently undergoing change!
They were evolving in the direction of the cauldron, and Ling Han’s body had also gone from a dead silence to spewing out astonishing energy.
Three cauldrons appeared at the same time!
Ling Han didn’t feel anything, but if outsiders saw this, they would definitely be shocked to
the extreme.
How was the Cauldron Forging Tier divided into minor levels?
Simple, just look at the number of Celestial Cauldrons. One cauldron was Human Cauldron Tier, two cauldrons was Earth Cauldron Tier, and three cauldrons was Heaven Cauldron Tier.

But now, Ling Han was going to forge three Celestial Cauldrons all at once. Didn’t that mean that he had skipped over the two stages of Human Cauldron and Earth Cauldron, and directly advanced into Heaven Cauldron?
Was there such a way to break through?
But was there a second person in this world that could form three foundation stones of the Celestial Path when he was only in Foundation Building Tier?
An impossible miracle had created even more impossible possibilities.
Boom! The energy of heaven and earth surged over. Originally, it could not be absorbed unless
it was morning, but now, it was actively surging into Ling Han’s body, replenishing his reserves of mystical power, speeding up the transformation of his Celestial Cauldron.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! Nangong Qian, the man in green robes and the others all rushed over.
The scene of heaven and earth here was too shocking. The power of heaven and earth was endlessly gathering here, and as long as one was a cultivator, it was impossible that he would
not have discovered it.

“Has precious treasures appeared?” There was an expectant look on the man’s face. When this kind of phenomenon happened, it was usually when precious treasures appeared. Furthermore, couldn’t you see that these energies were all gathered underground? The rare treasure naturally came out of the ground, which was reasonable.

“After obtaining this precious treasure, it’s about time for us to leave. Otherwise, we might encounter powerful enemies,” the man in green said after a moment of thought. Tang Yan and Jin Yexue had fled. It was highly possible that they would summon elites over. Furthermore, this “island” had surfaced, and as time passed, it would definitely attract
people over.
Thus, they couldn’t stay here forever. After all, they weren’t from the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire, so they didn’t want the tables turned on them.
“Let’s retrieve the treasure!”
They all gathered around, wanting to dig up dirt and retrieve treasures.
Though Ling Han was presently at the crucial moment of breaking through, his instincts as a
cultivator were naturally still there. He sensed the auras of the five of them, and immediately
burst out with power. Peng, he broke out of the ground.
“What kind of treasure is this!”
“Saintly medicine?” “It’s extremely likely. Otherwise, how could it be in human form?”
The man in green and the others were all excited, and rushed out, especially the woman in
green, whose face was slightly flushed.
-If she could obtain the Saintly medicine, she would be able to regrow her arm.
“What!”
However, they soon saw clearly that this wasn’t some Saintly medicine, but rather that
Foundation Building cultivator!
“Why is it you?!” The woman in green was extremely disappointed. To her, even the inheritance of the Saint couldn’t compare to a healthy body.
“Haha, we’ve finally found him. Capture him, and let’s leave quickly!” The man in green
laughed loudly.

In these five days, he would move at night, leaving traces of blood in different rooms, creating the illusion that he had actually been healing his injuries indoors, confusing Nangong Qian and the others.
“I can attempt to break through to the Cauldron Forging Tier.”
“I’ve already tried.
Even with the suppression of the Imperial Weapon, the living beings in the dimensions inside my body aren’t powerful enough to resist the shockwaves from the three Celestial Foundations.
Thus, constructing four Celestial Foundations is an absolutely impossible task.”
“In truth, others only have one Celestial Foundation, but I have three.
This is already inconceivable, breaking the impossible twice.”
“Now, I will attempt to break through to the Cauldron Forging Tier.”
“The Galaxy Network is really a good thing.
As long as you’re willing to spend money, a Cauldron Forging Tier-level Treasured Fruit of Life will immediately be delivered to your doorstep.”
Ling Han didn’t immediately ingest the Treasured Fruit of Life.
This was because he had only reached the peak stage of the Foundation Building Tier and still hadn’t obtained the opportunity to break through yet.
He simply lay on the ground, fused with the ground, and began to accumulate appreciation.
From Foundation Building Tier to Cauldron Forging Tier, it was very simple to say.
It was to transform the cornerstone of the Celestial Path into a Celestial Cauldron.
However, the transformation of form was only a symbol.
The true change was the leap in level of being.
Ling Han released his divine sense, fusing with the ground and the heavens.
Images appeared in his mind.
They were scenes of Ancestral King Pan Shi comprehending Dao all those years ago.
Ling Han didn’t obtain any techniques from Ancestral King Pan Shi.
However, he obtained something even more precious, and that was the various difficulties and deviations that Ancestral King Pan Shi had gone through during his breakthrough.
This was like a cultivation scroll left behind by a great predecessor elite.
It was extremely
precious.
From this, it could be seen that Ancestral King Pan Shi was truly broad-minded, imparting this kind of experience selflessly to the future generations.
What Ling Han saw was the multiple failures experienced by Ancestral King Pan Shi, so there was no need for him to take that path.
Two days later, his whole body did not release the slightest bit of aura, as if he had become a corpse.
However, in his mind, an incredibly intense change was presently taking place, and
was about to happen.𝐟𝚛𝕖𝚎𝕨𝗲𝐛𝚗𝐨𝐯𝐞𝕝.𝐜𝗼𝗺
The three foundation stones of the Celestial Path were presently undergoing change!
They were evolving in the direction of the cauldron, and Ling Han’s body had also gone from a dead silence to spewing out astonishing energy.
Three cauldrons appeared at the same time!
Ling Han didn’t feel anything, but if outsiders saw this, they would definitely be shocked to
the extreme.
How was the Cauldron Forging Tier divided into minor levels?
Simple, just look at the number of Celestial Cauldrons.
One cauldron was Human Cauldron Tier, two cauldrons was Earth Cauldron Tier, and three cauldrons was Heaven Cauldron Tier.
But now, Ling Han was going to forge three Celestial Cauldrons all at once.
Didn’t that mean that he had skipped over the two stages of Human Cauldron and Earth Cauldron, and directly advanced into Heaven Cauldron?
Was there such a way to break through?
But was there a second person in this world that could form three foundation stones of the Celestial Path when he was only in Foundation Building Tier?
An impossible miracle had created even more impossible possibilities.
Boom!
The energy of heaven and earth surged over.
Originally, it could not be absorbed unless
it was morning, but now, it was actively surging into Ling Han’s body, replenishing his reserves of mystical power, speeding up the transformation of his Celestial Cauldron.
Xiu, xiu, xiu!
Nangong Qian, the man in green robes and the others all rushed over.
The scene of heaven and earth here was too shocking.
The power of heaven and earth was endlessly gathering here, and as long as one was a cultivator, it was impossible that he would
not have discovered it.
“Has precious treasures appeared?” There was an expectant look on the man’s face.
When this kind of phenomenon happened, it was usually when precious treasures appeared.
Furthermore, couldn’t you see that these energies were all gathered underground?
The rare treasure naturally came out of the ground, which was reasonable.
“After obtaining this precious treasure, it’s about time for us to leave.
Otherwise, we might encounter powerful enemies,” the man in green said after a moment of thought.
Tang Yan and Jin Yexue had fled.
It was highly possible that they would summon elites over.
Furthermore, this “island” had surfaced, and as time passed, it would definitely attract
people over.
Thus, they couldn’t stay here forever.
After all, they weren’t from the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire, so they didn’t want the tables turned on them.
“Let’s retrieve the treasure!”
They all gathered around, wanting to dig up dirt and retrieve treasures.
Though Ling Han was presently at the crucial moment of breaking through, his instincts as a
cultivator were naturally still there.
He sensed the auras of the five of them, and immediately
burst out with power.
Peng, he broke out of the ground.
“What kind of treasure is this!”
“Saintly medicine?” “It’s extremely likely.
Otherwise, how could it be in human form?”
The man in green and the others were all excited, and rushed out, especially the woman in
green, whose face was slightly flushed.
-If she could obtain the Saintly medicine, she would be able to regrow her arm.
“What!”
However, they soon saw clearly that this wasn’t some Saintly medicine, but rather that
Foundation Building cultivator!
“Why is it you?!” The woman in green was extremely disappointed.
To her, even the inheritance of the Saint couldn’t compare to a healthy body.
“Haha, we’ve finally found him.
Capture him, and let’s leave quickly!” The man in green
laughed loudly.

chapters.title: Chapter 3793: Unbreakable
paragraphs: Chapter 3793: Unbreakable
After capturing Ling Han, they would leave quickly, to avoid another elite coming, who could easily wipe them out.
Ling Han ignored him. He was at the crucial moment of breaking through.
“Charge!” The man in green and the others charged over at the same time, wanting to capture Ling Han.
Ling Han activated Imminent Skyline and directly fled.

The man in green and the others naturally wouldn’t let Ling Han escape, so they hurriedly chased after him. This was especially the case for the woman in green. She had gone from filled with hope to disappointment. She was truly filled with so much hatred that she wanted to commit murder.
Previously, the five of them had already set up a siege. Thus, whether Ling Han barged left or right, he would always be surrounded by the five of them.
“This time, you won’t be able to escape!” the man in green said coldly.
The encirclement became smaller and smaller, and Ling Han finally had reached the point that was at the end of his rope.
“Die!” The woman in green brandished her sword in a mad slash, pouring out all her fury and despair.
Ling Han summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, which exuded a chaotic aura above his head.

An astonishing scene appeared. The green-robed woman’s Sword Qi slashed over, but was actually unable to break through the Primal Chaos Qi. Instead, she was counterattacked by the power of lightning, electrocuted until her whole body was numb.

“What kind of precious tool is this?!” The eyes of those who had never seen it before lit up. This precious tool was definitely extraordinary. It had an indescribably mighty aura, as if it could suppress the heavens and the underworld.
“S-Saint Tool!”
“It must be!”
“Hiss, this should be the treasure he obtained in this space. Previously, the phenomenon of heaven and earth appeared because of this precious tool.”
Even the man in green was suspicious. This was a treasure that Ling Han had obtained in this space, and it was only now that its true might had been developed.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

The green-robed man and the others attacked madly, wanting to break through the precious tool’s defenses and capture Ling Han. However, after much difficulty, when they managed to rip an opening in the Primal Chaos Qi, an endless stream of Primal Chaos Qi once again descended, making up for this gap. It was completely useless.
What were they supposed to do?
Under the protection of this precious tool, Ling Han was already invincible. How were they supposed to take him down?
“I’ll go!” the man in green said. He summoned the stone statue and aimed it at Ling Han.

Xiu, a pillar of light shot out, and the Primal Chaos Qi was instantly blasted apart, revealing a hole. However, it was only a short while, and another burst of Primal Chao Qi descended, and the hole disappeared.
“Shoot at that tower.”
“Good idea.”

The stone statue Spirit Tool was handed over to the man in black. He controlled his mystical power, and xiu, a pillar of light shot out, striking the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. Instantly, the Imperial Weapon shook lightly, as if it was about to capsize.

It was not that the Imperial Weapon was weak. In truth, when Ling Han broke through, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower had also improved by leaps and bounds. Otherwise, how could it have possibly withstood the combined attacks of five Cauldron Forging Tier elites? However, after all, Ling Han had not truly advanced into the Cauldron Forging Tier yet, so the might of the Imperial Weapon was naturally limited. Furthermore, the might of the stone statue was too terrifying. It had definitely surpassed the level of Heaven Cauldron. “I’ll go!”

The stone statue Spirit Tool was relayed and controlled by Nangong Qian and the others respectively, launching one terrifying attack after another that landed on the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.

The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was forged from an Imperial-level material, so it was naturally unafraid of attacks. However, one after another, fierce attacks were launched, causing the precious tower to deviate from its original position. Finally, it was sent flying, exposing Ling Han.
“Ha, this brat is trying to break through to the Cauldron Forging Tier!” the man in black said with a smile.
“Truly reckless, to actually dare to break through at such a time and place.”
“Kill him, and directly search his soul.”
The five of them attacked in unison again.
Right at this moment, Ling Han suddenly opened his eyes.
Instantly, it was as if a bolt of lightning had streaked across the incredibly dark sky, tearing open the darkness and dazzling the world.
The green-robed man and the others were all shocked, and involuntarily stopped their steps, as well as their attacks.
How was this possible? A Foundation Building cultivator had actually managed to scare them off just by opening his eyes?
What kind of might was this?
That’s not right.
“He’s not in the Foundation Building Tier, but has already succeeded in breaking through!”
“Cauldron Forging Tier!”
The five of them immediately came to a realization. Ling Han had already completed his breakthrough. Otherwise, he definitely couldn’t have been so powerful.
“It’s fine. I’ve just broken through, and I’m only in the Human Cauldron Tier.”
They quickly calmed down. So what if he broke through? They had five Cauldron Forging Tiers on their side, and three of them had reached the Heaven Cauldron Tier, and had a powerful
weapon in their hands.
“He hasn’t passed the Heavenly Dao Heart Tribulation yet, so this is a good opportunity to kill him!”
The five of them moved again, charging towards Ling Han.

“An!” Ling Han shouted lightly. It was indeed the Heavenly Dao Heart Tribulation for him now. However, he cultivated the Six Characters Bright King Curse, so an internal demon was completely nothing to him. Mainly, his divine sense was extremely sturdy in the first place, so even without the Six Characters Bright King Curse, he could still pass. This could only be considered as adding icing on the cake.
With a thought, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower had already flown back and hovered above his head again, sending down streaks of Primal Chaos Qi.
Peng, peng, peng! A series of attacks shot over, yet they were all in vain.
The five of them were exasperated, so they could only take out the stone statue again and launch a barrage of attacks at the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
After several consecutive attacks, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was once again
sent flying, revealing Ling Han.
“Come battle!” Ling Han crossed his arms behind his back, completely disregarding those five people.
He had already destroyed the internal demon in his heart, and had completely advanced into
the Cauldron Forging Tier.
He had never been this powerful before.
Breaking through to the next major tier was completely different from breaking through to
the next minor level. Ling Han had a feeling that even ten versions of himself before breaking through added together wouldn’t be a match for him now.
This caused him to be filled with confidence, looking down on these five people like an elite. “What a joke, a mere Human Cauldron!” the man in green said disdainfully.
“Is that so?” Ling Han released his Celestial Cauldron, and instantly, three footless cauldrons appeared. They were neither copper nor silver nor gold, and seemed to be made of stone,
exuding an ancient aura.
The man in green and the others were all stunned. What was going on?
Three cauldrons?
Wasn’t three cauldrons Heaven Cauldron Tier? But the problem was, this guy was clearly only
in the Foundation Building Tier previously. If he broke through, shouldn’t he be in the Human
Cauldron Tier?
Becoming a Heaven Cauldron the moment he broke through was practically a fantasy story. Additionally, the three cauldrons did not have any legs. What the hell was this?
Also, what was going on with this stone-like Celestial Cauldron? They had never heard of such
a Celestial Cauldron.

However, they immediately discovered that their auras were actually being suppressed. Ling Han’s Celestial Cauldron released an incomparably domineering aura, causing them to only have one thought, and that was to submit.
This caused them to break out in a cold sweat. In this state, their strength had been weakened
by at least half.
Did he have a chance of winning?
Faced with a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator who had just broken through, and with them
having an advantage in numbers on their side, the green-robed man and the others still felt a
chill from being outmatched.
“Kill him with the Spirit Tool!” The man in green was the first to react. He held the stone statue in his hand, and after injecting mystical power into it, xiu, a pillar of light shot rapidly
towards Ling Han.
Peng, he had hit his target. Brilliant light flashed wildly.
The man in green and the others faltered for a moment. They hadn’t expected that Ling Han,
who had been arrogant for so long, would actually be hit with a single strike. Then, they cheered. Being hit by this rare treasure, his only fate was death.

chapters.title: Chapter 3794: Killed All
paragraphs: Chapter 3794: Killed All
“What are you guys celebrating? Tell me, so I’ll be happy too.” Ling Han’s voice rang out.
The cheers of the man in green and the others suddenly stopped, as they looked at Ling Han in disbelief.
How was this possible?
Taking on he might of a Spirit Tool, he was actually unscathed.
They were all trembling in fear. What kind of monster was this? Why couldn’t they kill him?

Ling Han smiled faintly. The attack launched by the stone statue was indeed very powerful, and even a Heaven Cauldron couldn’t possibly withstand it. However, it was still far from reaching the level of the Core Formation Tier. If one were to compare the two, that would be equivalent to four cauldrons, or even five cauldrons.

But once Ling Han broke through, he had three cauldrons – though he had not cultivated every single cauldron completely, and he was a few stars prodigy, so after conversion, his battle prowess would at least be equivalent to five cauldrons. Thus, this attack from the Spirit Tool was indeed not something that he could underestimate, but if he went all out to neutralize it, it would not be too difficult.
“How could you possibly not have died!” the woman in green forced out through gritted teeth.

“Because I’m strong!” Ling Han said calmly. With a flash, he had already appeared in front of the woman in green. With a flick of his finger, pu, a gust of wind swept past, and blood immediately bloomed on the woman’s forehead. Her mind was instantly shattered, and she was completely dead.
“Charge!” The man in green hurriedly handed the Spirit Tool over to the man in black. The latter also activated the Spirit Tool at the first instant, blasting out a pillar of light at Ling
Han.
However, Ling Han shattered the pillar of light with a single punch.
He charged over and threw a punch at the man in black.
The man in black hurriedly drew out the triangular shield to shield himself.

Peng, the fist landed, and the shield could not block it at all. It was sinking at a frightening speed. Ka, ka, ka! The sound of bones being squeezed and broken rang out. The triangular shield had completely fused with the ground, and there was blood gushing out from all directions.

Nangong Qian and the others were all pale with fright. So what if he was holding a precious tool for defense? He had not used the power of his fist to attack empty air at all. Instead, he had directly delivered a punch in the most barbaric manner, and forcibly crushed him into a pancake.
What kind of astonishing power was this?
The three people’s courage to go all out vanished without a trace. The gap in strength was too wide; they were not even on the same level at all.

Ling Han frowned, and said, “Make your move. I don’t like to kill people who don’t resist.” When the three of them heard this, their eyes lit up, as if they had discovered a sliver of hope. All of them straightened their backs, looking like they were generously going to their deaths. Ling Han snapped his fingers. Pu! Blood instantly sprayed from the man’s forehead. His body then tilted, and he collapsed to the ground. His face was still filled with disbelief.
Didn’t you say that you wouldn’t kill those who didn’t resist?
“Just because I don’t like it doesn’t mean that I won’t kill them,” Ling Han said calmly.
‘Holy f*ck! Are you messing with me?!’
This was too deceiving, too devious.
Nangong Qian and the red-robed man hurriedly raised their lowered weapons again, aiming them at Ling Han. However, they couldn’t stop their bodies from trembling.

Their hearts were filled with despair. How could there be such a freakish guy? He had clearly just advanced into Cauldron Forging Tier, yet could kill a Heaven Cauldron with a snap of his fingers. It was as easy as the turn of a palm.
“Any last words?” Ling Han asked.
“I promise I won’t speak of today’s events. In the future, I won’t come to Moonlight Planet again, please spare my life,” the red-robed man said, lowering his head and begging for mercy.
Ling Han was unmoved. If they exchanged blows, and Tang Yan or Jin Yexue begged for mercy, would the latter be lenient?
He wouldn’t.
He threw a punch, and a powerful energy roared. The punch turned into a heavy hammer, and multiple seals exploded, blasting towards the red-robed man.
The red-robed man roared loudly, and brandished the large saber in his hand in a slash.𝑓𝘳𝑒𝑒𝓌𝘦𝘣𝘯ℴ𝑣𝘦𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝑚
Pu! The heavy hammer arrived, and the saber in the red-robed man’s hand was instantly sent flying. The remaining power did not dissipate, and continued to crush down on him.
The force of the punch swept over, and the red-robed man was also thoroughly killed.
Ling Han turned to look at Nangong Qian, his eyes cold.
Nangong Qian hurriedly threw away the weapon in her hand, knelt on the ground, and said, “I am willing to submit to you.”
“What use are you?” Ling Han asked calmly.
“I am a Formation Master, and am proficient in formations.”
Ling Han shook his head and said, “Unfortunately, I’m also a Formation Master myself, so I don’t need that.”

“Hehe, you are too arrogant!” Nangong Qian suddenly retreated rapidly, and at the same time that she retreated, her hands moved, and instantly, veined patterns lit up on the ground, “You didn’t realize, did you? Actually, I have been setting up formations all this while!”

Ling Han smiled, “With your formation skills, this little bit of time is not enough for you to set up a formation at all, so you should have long since set up the formation. Let me guess, this formation is actually not targeting me, but rather to kill your fellow disciples, so that you can take all the treasures for yourself, right?”
Nangong Qian’s expression changed drastically. Ling Han had guessed correctly.

Realizing that it was suspected that precious treasures were about to appear here, she secretly set up a formation nearby. Once the treasures appeared, she would kill the man in green and the others. In any case, when searching for treasures in an ancient site, it was very normal for
some people to die.
She had never imagined that Ling Han would be able to guess it with a single guess.
“So what if you guessed correctly? The formation is formed, so just wait for death!” Nangong Qian smirked coldly.
Ling Han smiled, “All right, then let me see just how powerful the formation you have laid
out is.”
He summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, which floated above his head. The air of Primal Chaos hung down, and it was as if he could not be penetrated by anything.
Ling Han took a step forward, and instantly, a flame rose up from the ground, burning
towards him.
“Earth’s Core Flames?” Ling Han shook his head. “They can’t be considered Earth’s Core Flames yet. At most, they’re only the outer flames of the Earth’s Core Flames. Their might is
too weak.”
When these flames came into contact with the Primal Chaos Qi, they were directly crushed and
extinguished.
He advanced further, and an ice arrow formed out of thin air, shooting rapidly towards him. Xiu, after one arrow, several dozen more formed.
Ding, ding, ding, ding! These arrows of ice shot onto the Primal Chaos Qi, yet were completely unable to penetrate through it.

—As Ling Han advanced into the Cauldron Forging Tier, this Imperial Weapon that had been cultivated with his life naturally also immediately advanced into Two Stars-level Furthermore, it was also one of the strongest among Two Stars Spirit Tools.

It couldn’t be helped. Who asked it to be forged from Origin Gold? Nangong Qian’s face became paler and paler. The formation that she had deliberately laid out was originally meant to kill all her companions through trickery. She had not thought that in front of Ling Han, she would not even be able to break through the defence of his Spirit Tool. “Don’t be sad. This Spirit Tool was forged from Origin Gold, and is a future Imperial Weapon. It is only natural that it is invincible among its peers,” Ling Han said calmly.
What, Imperial Weapon!
Nangong Qian’s heart beat wildly. No matter how courageous she was, she only dared to guess that it was a Saint Tool. She had not thought that it would be more than that.
A supreme Spirit Tool forged from Origin Gold.
No wonder it was so awesome!
Gritting her teeth, she turned around and fled. However, she had only taken two steps when
she saw a figure appear in front of her.
It was Ling Han.
After advancing into the Cauldron Forging Tier, Ling Han’s speed naturally increased to another level. He could even compete with the Core Formation Tier.
Nangong Qian’s pretty face was as white as a sheet. Ling Han had already revealed the secret

of the Imperial Weapon, so how could he possibly let her leave alive? Worse come to worst, even if she didn’t know that it was the Imperial Weapon, Ling Han still wouldn’t let her reveal the secret that he possessed a “Saint Tool”.
She sighed, and delivered a palm strike to the top of her head, choosing to commit suicide.

“What are you guys celebrating?
Tell me, so I’ll be happy too.” Ling Han’s voice rang out.
The cheers of the man in green and the others suddenly stopped, as they looked at Ling Han in disbelief.
How was this possible?
Taking on he might of a Spirit Tool, he was actually unscathed.
They were all trembling in fear.
What kind of monster was this?
Why couldn’t they kill him?
Ling Han smiled faintly.
The attack launched by the stone statue was indeed very powerful, and even a Heaven Cauldron couldn’t possibly withstand it.
However, it was still far from reaching the level of the Core Formation Tier.
If one were to compare the two, that would be equivalent to four cauldrons, or even five cauldrons.

But once Ling Han broke through, he had three cauldrons – though he had not cultivated every single cauldron completely, and he was a few stars prodigy, so after conversion, his battle prowess would at least be equivalent to five cauldrons.
Thus, this attack from the Spirit Tool was indeed not something that he could underestimate, but if he went all out to neutralize it, it would not be too difficult.
“How could you possibly not have died!” the woman in green forced out through gritted teeth.
“Because I’m strong!” Ling Han said calmly.
With a flash, he had already appeared in front of the woman in green.
With a flick of his finger, pu, a gust of wind swept past, and blood immediately bloomed on the woman’s forehead.
Her mind was instantly shattered, and she was completely dead.
“Charge!” The man in green hurriedly handed the Spirit Tool over to the man in black.
The latter also activated the Spirit Tool at the first instant, blasting out a pillar of light at Ling
Han.
However, Ling Han shattered the pillar of light with a single punch.
He charged over and threw a punch at the man in black.
The man in black hurriedly drew out the triangular shield to shield himself.
Peng, the fist landed, and the shield could not block it at all.
It was sinking at a frightening speed.
Ka, ka, ka!
The sound of bones being squeezed and broken rang out.
The triangular shield had completely fused with the ground, and there was blood gushing out from all directions.
Nangong Qian and the others were all pale with fright.
So what if he was holding a precious tool for defense?
He had not used the power of his fist to attack empty air at all.
Instead, he had directly delivered a punch in the most barbaric manner, and forcibly crushed him into a pancake.
What kind of astonishing power was this?
The three people’s courage to go all out vanished without a trace.
The gap in strength was too wide; they were not even on the same level at all.
Ling Han frowned, and said, “Make your move.
I don’t like to kill people who don’t resist.” When the three of them heard this, their eyes lit up, as if they had discovered a sliver of hope.
All of them straightened their backs, looking like they were generously going to their deaths.
Ling Han snapped his fingers.
Pu!
Blood instantly sprayed from the man’s forehead.
His body then tilted, and he collapsed to the ground.
His face was still filled with disbelief.
Didn’t you say that you wouldn’t kill those who didn’t resist?
“Just because I don’t like it doesn’t mean that I won’t kill them,” Ling Han said calmly.
‘Holy f*ck!
Are you messing with me?!’
This was too deceiving, too devious.
Nangong Qian and the red-robed man hurriedly raised their lowered weapons again, aiming them at Ling Han.
However, they couldn’t stop their bodies from trembling.
Their hearts were filled with despair.
How could there be such a freakish guy?
He had clearly just advanced into Cauldron Forging Tier, yet could kill a Heaven Cauldron with a snap of his fingers.
It was as easy as the turn of a palm.
“Any last words?” Ling Han asked.
“I promise I won’t speak of today’s events.
In the future, I won’t come to Moonlight Planet again, please spare my life,” the red-robed man said, lowering his head and begging for mercy.
Ling Han was unmoved.
If they exchanged blows, and Tang Yan or Jin Yexue begged for mercy, would the latter be lenient?
He wouldn’t.
He threw a punch, and a powerful energy roared.
The punch turned into a heavy hammer, and multiple seals exploded, blasting towards the red-robed man.
The red-robed man roared loudly, and brandished the large saber in his hand in a slash.𝑓𝘳𝑒𝑒𝓌𝘦𝘣𝘯ℴ𝑣𝘦𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝑚
Pu!
The heavy hammer arrived, and the saber in the red-robed man’s hand was instantly sent flying.
The remaining power did not dissipate, and continued to crush down on him.
The force of the punch swept over, and the red-robed man was also thoroughly killed.
Ling Han turned to look at Nangong Qian, his eyes cold.
Nangong Qian hurriedly threw away the weapon in her hand, knelt on the ground, and said, “I am willing to submit to you.”
“What use are you?” Ling Han asked calmly.
“I am a Formation Master, and am proficient in formations.”
Ling Han shook his head and said, “Unfortunately, I’m also a Formation Master myself, so I don’t need that.”

“Hehe, you are too arrogant!” Nangong Qian suddenly retreated rapidly, and at the same time that she retreated, her hands moved, and instantly, veined patterns lit up on the ground, “You didn’t realize, did you?
Actually, I have been setting up formations all this while!”
Ling Han smiled, “With your formation skills, this little bit of time is not enough for you to set up a formation at all, so you should have long since set up the formation.
Let me guess, this formation is actually not targeting me, but rather to kill your fellow disciples, so that you can take all the treasures for yourself, right?”
Nangong Qian’s expression changed drastically.
Ling Han had guessed correctly.
Realizing that it was suspected that precious treasures were about to appear here, she secretly set up a formation nearby.
Once the treasures appeared, she would kill the man in green and the others.
In any case, when searching for treasures in an ancient site, it was very normal for
some people to die.
She had never imagined that Ling Han would be able to guess it with a single guess.

out is.”

towards him.

Their might is
too weak.”
When these flames came into contact with the Primal Chaos Qi, they were directly crushed and
extinguished.
He advanced further, and an ice arrow formed out of thin air, shooting rapidly towards him.
Xiu, after one arrow, several dozen more formed.
Ding, ding, ding, ding!

chapters.title: Chapter 3795: Going home
paragraphs: Chapter 3795: Going home
Ling Han was neither sad nor happy. Defeating an opponent of this level was not enough to excite him — it was a matter of course, so what need was there for him to be especially happy?
However, the gains this time made him extremely satisfied.
An excellent alchemy cauldron, a Venerate Tier-level technique, and the Spirit Diagram of Destructive Energy were all extremely valuable.

He searched the corpses of the green-robed man and the others. He naturally had to retrieve the Heavenly Pattern Jade, as well as the stone statue Spirit Tool, which was also quite high- end. Probably more than 90% of Cauldron Forging Tiers wouldn’t be able to withstand a single strike from it. As for other items, there was just a small number of Dao Stones.

Ling Han mused ruefully. With the Galaxy Network, it would become difficult to rob others. He went to the Medicinal Garden to take a look. Unfortunately, this place had not been taken care of for a long time, and most of the Celestial medicines here had already withered. There were only a few that were still alive, but the fruits that grew were far from reaching maturity, and could not be used in medicine at all, so Ling Han could only reluctantly give up.
Forget it, let’s go.
After Ling Han left the Jin Manor, he rode his Tool and flew towards the Imperial Capital.
He journeyed through the night, and five days later, he had returned to the Imperial Capital. His cultivation level had increased by a level, so his speed had naturally increased by another level.
He had already contacted the empress and the others on the Galaxy Network. Thus, after returning to the Imperial Capital, he first went to look for Tang Yan.

“You’re finally back!” When Tang Yan saw him, he felt as if a heavy burden had been lifted from his shoulders, “Don’t you have a Galaxy Network account number? Hurry up and register one, it’ll also be easier to contact you.”

If it was convenient, Ling Han would have long since befriended Tang Yan on the Galaxy Network, but that would have exposed the secret that he was “Number One in the Galaxy”. For the moment, at least, Ling Han didn’t want the other party to know about this identity.
“Hehe.” He chuckled, and managed to bluff his way out of this matter. “How are things going between you and Jin Yexue?” He hurriedly diverted the cannon fire.
Tang Yan’s expression instantly darkened, “What else could it be? It is filled with difficulties.”

This was the honest truth. Even if the two of them fell in love with each other, just because of their backgrounds, there was not much chance that they would be able to get together, what more when Jin Yexue may not even like him.
Ling Han patted his shoulder, but did not speak.
Though he and Tang Yan hit it off very well, at least for now, he could not incite the latter to rebel against the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire.

“Oh, that’s right. Why have you only returned now?” Tang Yan asked. Because this involved the Majestic Empire of the last era, he could not report this matter either. Otherwise, if it was found out that he had possibly obtained the inheritance of the Jin Clan, and had an unclear relationship with the descendants of the Jin Clan, he would definitely be punished. In fact, the Tang Clan would be implicated as well.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “Didn’t you realize that I have broken through to Cauldron Forging Tier?”
“Yi, that really is the case.” Tang Yan slapped his forehead, his expression filled with shock, “How long has passed, and you have already broken through?”
“Impressive, right?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
“Impressive!” Tang Yan said sincerely, then smiled, “You can’t be saying that after you broke through, you showed your might and killed those guys, right?”
“What is it? Can’t I?”

“Hehe, firstly, you have just broken through. Secondly, they have five Cauldron Forging Tier elites, and thirdly, they also have a deadly weapon that can insta-kill all Cauldron Forging Tiers. Say, should I believe you?” Tang Yan countered.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “Come, let’s have a spar.”
“Forget it. I don’t want to bully you.” Tang Yan shook his head. He was an elite of Heaven Cauldron Tier.
“All right, I won’t bully you. I’ll use one hand,” Ling Han said. He placed his right hand behind his back, then stretched out his left hand, and delivered a palm strike at Tang Yan.
“Heh, you’re quite confident!” Tang Yan said with a chuckle. He also unleashed a palm strike at Ling Han.
As he saw it, the Heaven Cauldron would definitely crush the Human Cauldron.
However, his expression immediately changed drastically.
F***, this was a Human Cauldron? Was there such a powerful Human Cauldron?
He hurriedly activated the might of the Divine Physique, and a ball of fire gushed out of his body, covered with complicated seals.
Peng! He was instantly sent flying by Ling Han’s strike. However, Ling Han’s power was withdrawn upon contact, so it naturally didn’t cause him any damage.
“You…” Tang Yan’s head went numb with shock. “Are you even human? You’ve just advanced into the Cauldron Forging Tier, and you’re already so powerful. Even I’m almost no match for you.”
“Almost?” Ling Han rolled up his sleeves. Did this guy want to be harshly taught a lesson? Tang Yan hurriedly waved his hand, “You have just broken through, so I disdain from bullying you.”
Ling Han was rendered speechless. He really couldn’t tell that this Little Marquis had such a shameless side to him.
“You really killed all five of them?” Tang Yan approached. This was too hard to believe.
Ling Han retrieved the stone statue Spirit Tool and handed it over to Tang Yan.
This!
Tang Yan had to believe it even if he didn’t want to. This Spirit Tool had already appeared in Ling Han’s hands, so how could it not be an adequate explanation?

“I rarely admire people, but for you, there’s only one word for it-convinced!” He was completely convinced, but after some thought, he suddenly had an idea. “Brat, hurry up and get yourself a Galaxy Network account. With your freakishness, it’s enough to rank in the top 10,000 in the Cauldron Forging Tier.”
Martial arts were a pyramid, and the higher one’s cultivation level, the fewer people there would be.
With the vastness of the galaxy, even Foundation Building Tiers numbered in the billions, but

if it was upgraded to the next level, the Cauldron Forging Tier would only be over 100 million. And even if one could be ranked in the top 10,000,000 out of 100 million people, that was still very shocking. For example, in the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire, there were only two Cauldron Forging Tier elites that had advanced into the top 10,000.
“As long as you can squeeze into the top eight thousand, you would be the undisputed number one in the Cauldron Forging Tier in our Empire’s territory.”

Seeing that Ling Han was a little dazed, Tang Yan explained, “Right now, there are only two people from the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire that have squeezed into the top 10,000 of Galaxy Network. One is Xiong Zhao, ranked in the 9500s, and the other is Liu Yuyin, ranked in
the 8800s.”
Ling Han shook his head, and said with an expression of righteousness, “I have absolutely no interest in empty titles like rankings.”
This was really a serious nonsense, but Tang Yan just had to believe it, because he knew that Ling Han was also a prodigy alchemist. Who knows, Ling Han may be completely focused on
alchemy?
“Sigh!” He couldn’t help but sigh. If Ling Han had made a name for himself on the Galaxy Network, then as Ling Han’s friend, he would also feel honored.
“All right, I have to go back first.” Ling Han waved his hand dismissively.
“All right. Let’s keep in touch.” Tang Yan nodded. He had been provoked by Ling Han, and
was determined to cultivate diligently.
After re-cultivating the Turbid Heaven Scroll, the quality of his mystical power would definitely improve further. Who knows, he may be able to defeat Ling Han.
-That must be the case.
When Ling Han returned home, the empress and the others were already waiting for him. The
moment he entered, the seven toddlers surrounded him, causing Hu Niu to bawl loudly. ‘You little kids have already taken up all the space, so how am I supposed to hug Ling Han?’
“Out of the way, out of the way, Ling Han is Niu’s!”

“Father is everyone’s!” The seven babies naturally wouldn’t give up easily. “Childish,” Tang Yun’er said in disdain. She licked the lollipop, and it was quite tasty. Ling Han laughed loudly, feeling the warmth of home.

chapters.title: Chapter 3796: Return to Political Hostage Manor
paragraphs: Chapter 3796: Return to Political Hostage Manor

Ling Han taught the Turbid Heaven Scroll to the empress, Hu Niu, and the large black dog. Though the cultivation technique they were presently cultivating was of a higher level, it was still necessary just in case. If they advanced into Cauldron Forging Tier, yet did not have a corresponding cultivation technique to cultivate, then what could they do?

For example, Ling Han. At present, he could only switch to cultivating the Turbid Heaven Scroll, because the Foundation Building chapter of the Ancient Sun Divine Scroll was already insufficient for him to continue cultivating.
He decided to cultivate in seclusion for a few days to fully comprehend the Turbid Heaven Scroll. He also had to grasp the newly obtained Destructive Energy Spirit Diagram.

Comparatively speaking, the Turbid Heaven Scroll was the easiest to grasp. Though it had been created by a cultivator at the fourth pinnacle level, and could be considered both mysterious and profound, Ling Han had easily grasped even the cultivation technique of a Saint, so this Venerate Tier-level cultivation technique was naturally even easier.
Without spending too much time, he had already mastered the Cauldron Forging Tier chapter of the Turbid Heaven Scroll.

The comparison was clear. The mystical power that the Turbid Heaven Scroll had refined was not as pure as the mystical power that the Ancient Sun Divine Scroll had refined, but there was nothing that could be done. Who asked that Ling Han presently did not have the follow-up chapter of the Ancient Sun Divine Scroll?
He then went to cultivate the Spirit Diagram of Destruction Energy.
Strangely, this time, the Power of Dimension in his body stopped channeling.
There was nothing else that could be done. Ling Han could only do it himself.
These seals were incredibly complex, and they were practically baffling. It was as if they had been drawn randomly, and were completely meaningless.
If that had not been the case, Tang Yan and Jin Yexue would not have repeatedly said that they did not understand.
Ling Han used the Destructive Energy that he had mastered as reference, cross-referencing one seal after another. After spending three days, he finally cracked a seal, which filled him with joy.
This was an indescribable feeling of accomplishment.
He channelled the Destructive Energy, and immediately discovered that the Destructive Energy that he stimulated was slightly more powerful.
There was pitifully little, but there was indeed a little more.
The more threads of Destructive Energy there were, the more destructive power there would be.
All right, continue.

With the experience of his first success, it was much easier for Ling Han to decipher the remaining seals. Another two days later, he had mastered the second seal, and another day later, he had mastered the third seal. Another half a day later, he had mastered the fourth seal, but next, he could not further compress the time he needed to comprehend the seals.
There was indeed a slight improvement, but it was pitifully small.

Ling Han stayed in seclusion, and after a whole two months, he finally cracked all the seals. He stretched out his hand. Boom, Destructive Energy wrapped around him, and compared to before, the size had doubled.
This was far from the ultimate form of Destructive Energy.
Ling Han couldn’t help but click his tongue in wonder. Just where did this Destructive Energy come from? And just how terrifying was the ultimate form Destructive Energy?
However, two months had passed, so it was time for him to go out for a walk.
Firstly, since he had advanced into Cauldron Forging Tier, he should concoct some Cauldron Forging Tier alchemical pills.

chapters.title: Chapter 3797: Settling old debts
paragraphs: Chapter 3797: Settling old debts
That was Zhao Xiao, an elite of the Cauldron Forging Tier, and he had actually been knocked down with a single palm strike from a Foundation Building cultivator?
It was like a fantasy story.
Everyone was dumbfounded, completely unable to believe this.
You are indeed the number one cultivator in the Foundation Building Tier, but you can’t be this powerful, right?
“Haha!” The large black dog stretched out its paw and stepped on Zhao Xiao’s head, “I am Little Han’s master. You guys dare to bully my human pet, and today, I have come to teach you a lesson!”
Zhao Xiao wasn’t knocked unconscious. He clearly knew that a dog’s paw was pressing down on his head, and he was about to explode in fury.
He was a mighty Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator, yet he was actually being stepped on by a Foundation Building Tier dog demon. How could he accept this?
Ling Han smiled faintly, “I said I would come and beat you guys up!”
He strode forwards, approaching Liu Xunyu and Han Bing.
Liu Xunyu and Han Bing both involuntarily retreated. The pressure that Ling Han exerted on them was really too great. It was like a supreme god was walking towards them.
How was this possible? Just a Foundation Building cultivator… Huh!
“Cauldron Forging Tier!” the two of them exclaimed at the same time. Only now did they realize that Ling Han had already advanced into the Cauldron Forging Tier.

It was no wonder that they had not been able to tell at the first instant. That was because just how much time had passed? How could they possibly believe that Ling Han could become a Cauldron Forging Tier so quickly?
But even if they knew that Ling Han had advanced into Cauldron Forging Tier, this was still too shocking.
A Human Cauldron had destroyed an Earth Cauldron with a single strike?
Hiss, this continued Ling Han’s legend of being invincible among Foundation Building cultivators. Was there really someone who could be so freakish and invincible?
The two of them exchanged a look. Neither of them had any thought that they would be lucky, and hurriedly broke into a run and fled.
Xiu, Ling Han’s figure moved, and Imminent Skyline unfolded. How fast was that?
Pa, pa, with two slaps from him, Liu Xunyu and Han Bing were also sprawled out on the ground.
Ling Han turned around and said to the large black dog, “Little Black, aren’t you very excited? Give each of them a piss.”

“Get lost, I am a dog that cares about my pride!” The large black dog refused decisively, but there was a slight eagerness in his expression. Peeing on the head of a Cauldron Forging Tier was too tempting. After all, peeing to leave scent was the nature of a dog. Even if it had developed intelligence, it could not be changed.
Yet for Liu Xunyu and the others, their faces had turned green with fear. If they were peed on the head by a demonic dog, how would they be able to continue living in future?
“Humph, daring to bully Niu’s Ling Han, I’ll beat you all to death!” Hu Niu rushed out, and stomped fiercely on Liu Xunyu and the others.
When everyone saw this, they all felt rueful.

Ling Han was a miracle. He had only been in the Political Hostage Manor for a few days, and had already stirred up boundless storms. He had even stood out on the day of His Majesty’s birthday, and left the prison of the Political Hostage Manor all of a sudden.

At first, they had thought that this was the end of the miracle. They had not thought that only a month or so had passed, and Ling Han had already returned aggressively, defeating Liu Xunyu and the others.
Awesome, this was really too awesome.

Liu Xunyu and the others were both furious and regretful. If they had known that Ling Han would become so powerful, they would have targeted him with all their might from the very beginning, not giving Ling Han the chance to grow at all. However, it was naturally too late for regrets now. The only thing that did not exist in this world was medicine for regret.
After Hu Niu was satisfied with stomping, Ling Han left with her and the large black dog, heading to where he was assigned to work.

“Ling Han, do you still have me, the commander, in your eyes?” Yan Lesheng saw him appear, and immediately rebuked him with a straight face, “You actually disappeared without a sound. What kind of place do you think this is? You think you can come and go as you please?” Ling Han smiled calmly, and said, “I gave you face, so I accepted the blood-sucking murder case. Moreover, I solved the case in a short amount of time and apprehended the culprit. As far as I know, when you reported this murder to the higher-ups, you placed all the credit on yourself!”
“Forget it, I can’t be bothered to argue with you about this either.”
“However, I’m giving you face, so you can’t be shameless.”

Yan Lesheng instantly flew into a humiliated rage. Just as Ling Han had said, he had indeed placed the credit for the blood-sucking murder case on himself. This was killing a Spirit Transformation True Lord; the credit was practically heaven-defying.
However, it was one thing for him to embezzle this merit, and another for Ling Han to expose it directly.

In the first place, he was already very displeased with Ling Han, and now that his cover had been lifted, his blood rushed to his head. How could he still control himself? Immediately, he leaped out, and waved his hand to deliver a palm strike at Ling Han.
He wanted Ling Han to obediently shut up. In future, he would not be allowed to speak a single word about that blood-sucking murder.
Ling Han crossed his arms behind his back, disdaining to make a move at all.

Yan Lesheng’s attack arrived. Weng, Ling Han shot out a murderous aura attack. A terrifying aura surged out, and Yan Lesheng’s pupils suddenly contracted rapidly. The attack came to an abrupt stop. Then, his body fell forwards, and he instantly collapsed onto the ground.
If their cultivation levels were the same, it would be difficult to find even one in 10,000 people who could withstand the murderous aura of Ling Han.
Yan Lesheng’s face was filled with shock. He could not accept at all that he would be knocked down by Ling Han’s aura alone.
A Foundation Building cultivator… f***!
Cauldron Forging Tier, this guy actually advanced into the Cauldron Forging Tier.
“Old Black, I’ll leave it to you,” Ling Han said with a smile.
The large black dog walked over, stepped on Yan Lesheng’s face, and said, “Old brat, who commanded you to target my Little Han?”

“Ling Han, I am an eighth rank commandant of the Imperial Court, and you actually dare to humiliate me. I will definitely not let you off, and the Imperial Court will not let you off either!” Yan Lesheng roared in fury. He had really gone too far, to actually allow a dog to
humiliate him.
“What’s with that look? Are you looking down on Grandpa Dog?” The large black dog howled in anger, stomping repeatedly at Yan Lesheng.

“Ling Han, just you wait and see!” Yan Lesheng was very stubborn. Of course, perhaps it was because the background of the person who commanded him was too big, he did not dare to reveal it at all, so he could only keep his mouth shut.
“Heh, Grandpa Dog is still unable to deal with you?” The large black dog sneered, “Grandpa Dog likes people who are stubborn.”
It didn’t know where it had gotten a few yellow carp from, and then began to take off Yan Lesheng’s pants.
Yan Lesheng’s face instantly turned green, and he started to struggle violently, “What do you
want to do?”

“Of course, I’m going to put these yellow carp in.” The large black dog bared his teeth in a grin, looking indescribably sinister, “Do you know that yellow carp to crawl through holes the most? Put them in your pants… hehe, where do you think they’ll crawl to?”
Yan Lesheng’s whole body was trembling. This was too devious, wasn’t it? How could you come up with such a wicked idea?
“Yi, you’re still talking tough?” The large black dog grabbed a yellow carp and stuffed it into
his pants.

A mere yellow carp, even if it wormed into his body, Yan Lesheng wouldn’t have to worry about life-threatening danger. When he was at the mortal level, he had long since cultivated his organs to the level of steel and iron. However, if one, no, even several yellow carps wormed into his an*s, how terrifying would the psychological trauma left behind be? After a series of struggles, he finally couldn’t overcome the terror in his heart. He said dejectedly, “I’ll talk, I’ll talk!”
