When he was at the mortal level, he had long since cultivated his organs to the level of steel and iron.
However, if one, no, even several yellow carps wormed into his an*s, how terrifying would the psychological trauma left behind be?
After a series of struggles, he finally couldn’t overcome the terror in his heart.
He said dejectedly, “I’ll talk, I’ll talk!”

chapters.title: Chapter 3798: Summoned
paragraphs: Chapter 3798: Summoned
Yan Lesheng opened his mouth, and revealed the mastermind behind all this.
That person’s surname was Ma, and his name was Ma Qiyun. He was a Deputy Chief of the Heaven Military Manor, a dignified fifth rank high official.
However, Ling Han had clearly never offended this person before, so why would he be targeted by him?
Yan Lesheng didn’t understand this either. He was only following orders, so he didn’t dare to ask Ma Qiyun why he targeted Ling Han.
Yi, could it be that person?

Ling Han suddenly recalled that he had once formed a great enmity with Meng Yangcheng. Furthermore, Meng Yangcheng was an heir to the throne, so there was a 99% chance that he would attend Meng Yonghua’s birthday banquet. In that case, Meng Yangcheng would definitely know of his existence.

To publicly kill a hostage from another nation, even an Imperial Prince would not dare act so recklessly. Furthermore, Ling Han had just received a reward from Meng Yonghua. If anyone dared to make a move on Ling Han at this time, that would be equivalent to not giving Meng Yonghua any face.
-Meng Yonghua was a temperamental person. Who would dare go against him?
Thus, Meng Yangcheng couldn’t touch Ling Han on the surface. Thus, he used an underhanded move, making reasonable use of the rules to deal with Ling Han.
With this in mind, everything made sense.

A crown prince wanted Ma Qiyun to cooperate with him, so would Ma Qiyun dare to disobey him? Furthermore, there was no need for him to step out for this matter. He only had to inform a subordinate, and there would be no cost to him. Thus, Ma Qiyun would definitely be willing to help him.
Since he knew who the mastermind was, Ling Han couldn’t be bothered wasting time on Yan Lesheng. He directly turned around and left.
The large black dog smiled evilly, and stuffed all the yellow carp into Yan Lesheng’s pants.

“No…!” Yan Lesheng screamed in agony. However, his cultivation level had been sealed, so he couldn’t move at all. He couldn’t channel his mystical power either, so he could only scream in humiliation.

Ling Han calmly cultivated. Previously, he had forcefully broken through, leaving behind a lot of aftereffects. There was nothing he could do about the damage to his life force, but if other aspects could be healed, it definitely had to be healed as soon as possible.
On the other side, he was also continuing to fight in the level battles on the Galaxy Network. Of course, it was now the Cauldron Forging Tier that he had switched to.
In truth, he had not given up on fighting Foundation Building Tier-level cultivators either. In any case, he only had to suppress his cultivation level.

He issued a challenge to Origin. Right now, he was also a Cauldron Forging Tier elite. However, Origin raised two conditions. Firstly, they were going to battle this time, and Ling Han would definitely be collecting money for tickets, so he wanted half the profits. Secondly, he also wanted to take half of the profits from entrance fees from last time.
Ling Han did not want that.
If he split half of the entrance fees for the two times with Origin, wouldn’t that mean that he had worked for nothing this time?
Moreover, why did he have to bear the infamy while the money was divided equally among them?

Ling Han resolutely didn’t accept this challenge. Instead, he turned around to challenge Myriad Dao and Heaven Crushing. However, it was as if these two people had discussed this with Origin. They actually made the same request.
‘F*ck! Are they ganging up on me?’

Ling Han resolutely ignored them. He began to break records. However, though the three Celestial Cauldrons that he had cultivated were unlegged, he was still recognized as Heaven Cauldron Tier by Galaxy Network. Thus, this was naturally a great disadvantage. He had not been able to break any record, though he was all just a slight bit away.

Furthermore, Cauldron Forging Tier could even cultivate to the limit of the Nine Cauldrons. This meant that Ling Han was still far from reaching the peak stage of the Cauldron Forging Tier, so how could he possibly surpass the strongest prodigy of all eternity?
He turned his attention to pill recipes, searching for alchemical pills that were suitable for the Cauldron Forging Tier.
Very soon, he found a corresponding pill recipe, and it was called the Cauldron Forging Pill. After consumption, it could speed up the forging of the Celestial Cauldron.
This pill recipe was priced at three million Dao Stones, and Ling Han bought it without hesitation.

However, though he had a considerable amount of money on hand, it was also spent very quickly, because he still had the empress, the large black dog and the others by his side. Furthermore, if he used the Time Chamber, then no matter how many Universe Coins he had, there were still not enough for him to spend.
Hence, he had to think of some way to open up new channels of income, as he could not just sit by and do nothing.

He went to the Saint Pill Hall. There was naturally a large amount of medicinal ingredients there. As long as one was willing to spend money, and added with the fact that he was now a Human Tier Low Grade alchemist, there were naturally no medicinal ingredients that could not be bought.
As usual, he would first transfer the money to Hu Niu, and then make the transaction through Hu Niu’s account. He would not expose the secret that he was the “Number One in the
Galaxy”.
He began to concoct alchemical pills. His new alchemy cauldron was naturally useful.
Ling Han had studied it quite a few times these days, and had long since familiarized himself with how to use it.
In terms of alchemy, this was even better than the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. This was because the circulation and suppression of heaven and earth’s energy was far too
smooth.
However, after failing three times, Ling Han had already concocted the Cauldron Forging Pill. Unfortunately, he still couldn’t take it, as the immunity level in his body was too high.

For the sake of opening up new sources of income, he sold the Foundation Dissolution Pills in bulk on the Galaxy Network. Even though this was the lowest grade Celestial pill, there were a great many people who were willing to pay a high price for it. The price was far above that of
the Cauldron Forging Pill.
When Ling Han had bought this pill recipe, he had done so for its financial benefits.
However, it was a shame that his peaceful life didn’t last long. Ling Han was ordered to go to the military encampment tomorrow.
The official statement did not explain what was going on, but Tang Yan soon arrived.
“Come, let’s have a battle first.” This guy immediately pulled Ling Han to the arena.
Otherwise, if they battled inside the city, the destructive power of Cauldron Forging Tier
would be too great.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel speechless. After being defeated by him, this Little Marquis seemed to have a lot of pent up energy.
Fine, I’ll oblige you.
The two of them went to the arena. Tang Yan immediately asked for a battle room, and the
two of them began fighting.
Boom! Tang Yan unleashed a powerful attack from the very beginning. Flames entwined around his entire body, and there were multiple seals circulating around him. He charged out,
like the Divine Son of Flames.

Ling Han couldn’t help but nod internally. After switching to cultivating the Turbid Heaven Scroll, Tang Yan’s power had condensed considerably. When he delivered the same attack, the might was at least four times stronger than before.
However, in front of him, this was not enough at all.
Ling Han planned to give Tang Yan some face, and thus began to contend with him. Only after over a hundred moves did he seize the opportunity to strike Tang Yan’s weak point, defeating
him.

“I still can’t beat you!” Tang Yan sighed, but his eyes were filled with excitement. Previously, he hadn’t been able to withstand a single strike from Ling Han. Now, he could fight for more than a hundred moves, which showed how great his improvement was.
“You didn’t let me win, right?” he asked again.
“What do you think?” Ling Han smiled.
“You did?” Tang Yan was a little nervous. “Hehe.”
“Did you let me win or not?”
“Hehe.”

Ling Han didn’t directly answer the question of whether he had let him win or not. When he returned home, he asked, “You didn’t come this time to fight me, did you?” “That’s one of the reasons,” Tang Yan said with a smile. “Have you received the summons?”

“En.” Ling Han nodded, “I was just about to ask you what’s going on.” “Something big has happened.” Tang Yan lowered his voice, “The Shadow Moon Majestic Empire suddenly attacked Golden Wealth Planet. This is one of our most important resource planets, which produces all kinds of precious metals and ores. The materials used in the weapons and armor of our army all came from Golden Wealth Planet.”
“If Golden Wealth Planet is taken, then we would lack important supplies. This war would really be difficult to fight.”

chapters.title: Chapter 3799: Going to war
paragraphs: Chapter 3799: Going to war
Hence, Golden Wealth Planet was a strategic location, and was the most important.

Previously, though the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire had invaded, it could only be considered a small skirmish at most, forcing the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire to send a large number of elites to the front lines. They didn’t really launch a large-scale offensive.

But this time was different. The Shadow Moon Majestic Empire suddenly mobilized a large number of troops and took a pedantic detour, invading Golden Wealth Planet and directly striking the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire’s vital point.
If they lost Golden Wealth Planet, the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire would lose their strategic supplies, and it would be extremely disadvantageous if they fought a drawn-out battle.

Thus, in order to express their determination not to lose Golden Wealth Planet, the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire decided to mobilize the young prodigies of the Imperial Capital and the second generation of officials to form an army to head to Golden Wealth Planet and battle against the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire.
Ling Han rubbed his nose awkwardly. Naturally, he was completely displeased.

He did not have the slightest bit of positive feelings towards the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire. Whether it was himself, or taking into account Brother Monkey, Chen Fengyan and the others, he was standing on the opposing side of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire. Now, he had to be willing to throw up his head and shed blood for the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire?
Ling Han was naturally unwilling. It was already good enough that he didn’t stab them in the back, and they still wanted him to work for them?
Moreover, wasn’t he a hostage? How could they allow a hostage to go to the battlefield?

However, from this, it could be seen that the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire was really anxious. They were about to mobilize the second-generation young masters into the battlefield. This was a signal to all the citizens that Golden Wealth Planet could not be lost, and this battle could not be lost either.
Whether Ling Han was willing or not, he still went to the military encampment at noon the next day.
-If he did not go, that would be publicly disobeying the imperial decree, unless he wanted to immediately turn hostile.

An official was reading there. It was a crusading declaration that had been created by a few great scholars of the Empire, expressing a strong fury at the invasion of the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire. The words used were lavish, and very capable of stirring emotions, making those who heard feel impassioned, wanting nothing more than to immediately charge to the front lines and fight. They would not regret it even if they were buried here.

Ling Han was sure that these people would only be excited for five minutes. There was no need for them to go to Golden Wealth Planet. Probably, once the mobilization meeting ended, they would be filled with regret.

In short, this was a very successful mobilization meeting. Everyone’s faces were glowing, filled with longing. They all dreamed of killing their enemies to repay their country’s favour, and establish an undying empire.

Finally, that official announced that three days later, everyone would board the warship together, and charge towards Golden Wealth Planet. Whoever dared to flee during battle would be killed without mercy.
Why was the warship used instead of the Transfer Formation?

Because once the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire invaded Golden Wealth Planet, it took control of the Transfer Formation. If they used the Transfer Formation to enter, then they would really be sending everyone to death, and whether they wanted to kill them or cut them into pieces was completely up to the whim of their enemies.
After Ling Han returned, he discussed this with the empress and the others.

This trip to Golden Wealth Planet should be very dangerous, but at the same time, it should also be filled with opportunities. That was because Golden Wealth Planet was an extraordinarily rich resource planet, which produced high-level Celestial Material, as well as some Celestial medicines. If they could be harvested, they would be extremely beneficial for cultivation.

However, Ling Han was going to battle, so he naturally couldn’t bring his family with him. Moreover, if Ling Han was alone, he could leave or stop whenever he wanted, so he would have much less scruples.
After much consideration, the empress, Hu Niu, and the babies still stayed behind at the Moonlight Planet. However, the large black dog and the pervert pig could follow Ling Han as pet beasts.
The perverted pig was naturally unwilling to do this. However, he was unable to resist. Meanwhile, the large black dog was delighted. This guy loved to join in on the excitement.
The short three days of preparation time quickly passed. Everyone gathered at the designated location, and then boarded the ship.

There were many, many people. One warship couldn’t hold them all, and a total of twelve warships were mobilized. It was said that even the imperial heirs had all been mobilized. This was a very good chance to make a contribution. Who knows, they might be able to rise above the rest, and upon their return, their status as imperial heirs would be confirmed.
It wasn’t long before the warship set off for Golden Wealth Planet.

Ling Han stayed in his room. Aside from cultivating, he basically spent his time in the Galaxy Network. Aside from being able to battle, there were also Mystery Realms that he could explore, and they basically all existed in real life. They had all been moved into the Galaxy Network, and experiencing it with his divine sense, it was extremely signifcant for his
understanding of Mystery Realms.

Aside from that, he was also learning new formation techniques. As his cultivation level increased, his influence on the great power of heaven and earth was naturally also increasing, and he could set up even stronger formation techniques.

He had bought a formation through the Galaxy Network. Its name was Extreme Thunder Formation, and among Two Star Formation Techniques, it could be considered very powerful. Those who did not know formation techniques would be madly blasted by the power of lightning upon entering, and die from it.
Ling Han even rented the Time Chamber, but in order to save money, he did not use the highest acceleration rate.

From the Moonlight Planet to the Golden Wealth Planet, it was only about a month’s galactic journey. When 30 days had passed, and after passing through one wormhole after another, that resource-rich planet also appeared in their vision.
From afar, this was a great planet that was purple-gold in colour, and was surrounded by four
moons.
The warship began to descend, and through the Galaxy Network, it communicated with the people on the ground, locating a safe landing spot.
Xiu, a ray of light suddenly shot out from Golden Wealth Planet, and landed on one of the warships. Instantly, a brilliant light exploded.
Thankfully, the warship had long since activated its defenses. Otherwise, with such a blow, the warship would definitely disintegrate.
“Enemy attack!”

The 12 warships all entered into battle mode. However, they were unable to determine which corner of Golden Wealth Planet the attack originated from, so they were naturally unable to counterattack. Moreover, the warships didn’t have such a large range of attack.
-The attacker must be a supreme elite, and it was highly possible that it was a great elite of
the level of Sect Master.
Xiu, another streak of light shot over. The clumsy warship couldn’t dodge at all, and could only take it head-on. Peng, the originally invisible shield immediately manifested, trembling
endlessly.
“Land quickly! Land quickly!”
The 12 warships all rapidly descended. Right now, they could only take a beating. Even their shields wouldn’t be able to withstand this kind of bombardment. They would definitely be
destroyed.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! Multiple streaks of light blasted over, all aimed at the same warship. As

expected, after sustaining just over thirty attacks, that warship’s light shield was finally shattered. Another streak of light shot over, and the warship was forcefully disintegrated, shattering into at least a few hundred pieces.

Some were directly crushed into dust, while others were fortunate enough not to die. They all flew on their Spirit Tools, wanting to fly to another warship, or land directly on ground. However, even dozens of times faster than the speed of sound was exceedingly slow in the vast universe. Though it was not crawling like a turtle, it was not much better. Fortunately, this warship that had disintegrated was not the one that Ling Han had been
aboard.
However, after destroying a warship, those streaks of light targeted another warship. Unfortunately, this was the warship that Ling Han was aboard.
“F*ck! We’re about to die!” the large black dog exclaimed in shock.
“Wu!” The perverted pig also screamed in pain. If it was still on Celestial Sea Planet, it would
definitely be eating and hitting on girls. How could there be so many dangerous things going
on?
Ling Han was calm and unperturbed. He summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower and released streaks of Primal Chaos Qi. This was just in case.
Peng, peng, peng! The ship shuddered violently, and its shield continued to withstand the barrage of attacks. It was on the verge of shattering.

As his cultivation level increased, his influence on the great power of heaven and earth was naturally also increasing, and he could set up even stronger formation techniques.
He had bought a formation through the Galaxy Network.
Its name was Extreme Thunder Formation, and among Two Star Formation Techniques, it could be considered very powerful.
Those who did not know formation techniques would be madly blasted by the power of lightning upon entering, and die from it.
Ling Han even rented the Time Chamber, but in order to save money, he did not use the highest acceleration rate.
From the Moonlight Planet to the Golden Wealth Planet, it was only about a month’s galactic journey.
When 30 days had passed, and after passing through one wormhole after another, that resource-rich planet also appeared in their vision.
From afar, this was a great planet that was purple-gold in colour, and was surrounded by four
moons.
The warship began to descend, and through the Galaxy Network, it communicated with the people on the ground, locating a safe landing spot.
Xiu, a ray of light suddenly shot out from Golden Wealth Planet, and landed on one of the warships.
Instantly, a brilliant light exploded.
Thankfully, the warship had long since activated its defenses.
Otherwise, with such a blow, the warship would definitely disintegrate.
“Enemy attack!”
The 12 warships all entered into battle mode.
However, they were unable to determine which corner of Golden Wealth Planet the attack originated from, so they were naturally unable to counterattack.
Moreover, the warships didn’t have such a large range of attack.
-The attacker must be a supreme elite, and it was highly possible that it was a great elite of
the level of Sect Master.
Xiu, another streak of light shot over.
The clumsy warship couldn’t dodge at all, and could only take it head-on.
Peng, the originally invisible shield immediately manifested, trembling
endlessly.
“Land quickly!
Land quickly!”
The 12 warships all rapidly descended.
Right now, they could only take a beating.
Even their shields wouldn’t be able to withstand this kind of bombardment.
They would definitely be
destroyed.
Xiu, xiu, xiu!
Multiple streaks of light blasted over, all aimed at the same warship.
As
expected, after sustaining just over thirty attacks, that warship’s light shield was finally shattered.
Another streak of light shot over, and the warship was forcefully disintegrated, shattering into at least a few hundred pieces.
Some were directly crushed into dust, while others were fortunate enough not to die.
They all flew on their Spirit Tools, wanting to fly to another warship, or land directly on ground.
However, even dozens of times faster than the speed of sound was exceedingly slow in the vast universe.
Though it was not crawling like a turtle, it was not much better.
Fortunately, this warship that had disintegrated was not the one that Ling Han had been
aboard.
However, after destroying a warship, those streaks of light targeted another warship.
Unfortunately, this was the warship that Ling Han was aboard.
“F*ck!
We’re about to die!” the large black dog exclaimed in shock.
“Wu!” The perverted pig also screamed in pain.
If it was still on Celestial Sea Planet, it would
definitely be eating and hitting on girls.
How could there be so many dangerous things going
on?
Ling Han was calm and unperturbed.
He summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower and released streaks of Primal Chaos Qi.
This was just in case.
Peng, peng, peng!
The ship shuddered violently, and its shield continued to withstand the barrage of attacks.
It was on the verge of shattering.

chapters.title: Chapter 3800: Extermination of the Army
paragraphs: Chapter 3800: Extermination of the Army
“We’re bout to explode!” The large black dog hugged Ling Han’s thigh, and its mouth gaped open. It was so anxious that it began to bark.

The perverted pig also “paled in terror”. Although it was impervious to all attacks, and it was as if it would never be wounded, in terms of abilities, it was truly an ordinary pig. If it floated in space, how long would it take to land on a planet?
He was really scared to death, b@stard.
Ling Han grabbed hold of the lecherous pig. He didn’t need to worry about the large black dog, as he was already grabbing onto him with all his might.
Inside the warship, it was complete chaos, and everyone was worried about themselves.

They had come with hot blood in their hearts, but the result was great. They had not even seen the enemy, and they had already suffered a heavy blow, causing the mentality of a great many people to collapse all of a sudden.

Peng, the warship’s shield was quickly shattered. Then, a ray of light blasted over, forcibly severing this colossal warship. The remaining power spread out in all directions, shattering the warship that had been broken into two halves, turning into several hundred slightly larger pieces of the warship, as well as innumerable tiny pieces.

Instantly, a powerful force pulled Ling Han along, and rapidly swept through the galaxy. Previously, inside the ship, there was a steady pressure, but now that the ship had shattered, this pressure naturally disappeared, causing everyone to float rapidly.

Aside from that, endless coldness also assaulted Ling Han madly, instantly causing Ling Han’s whole body to be covered with frost. The large black dog and pervert pig also turned into an ice dog and an ice pig.

Ling Han activated the Starlight Screen, and instantly, the coldness was completely expelled from his body. He controlled the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, and xiu, it descended towards one of the moons in Golden Wealth Planet.
It couldn’t be helped. The other planets were too far away. If one were to fly with his physical body, he would need dozens or even hundreds of years. Furthermore, there was no
replenishment from the power of heaven and earth in this process, so it wouldn’t take long for him to die.
‘Wormhole?’
Those who could physically pass through the wormhole had to be Spirit Transformation True Lords.
Furthermore, if they flew towards Golden Wealth Planet, they would only have to be struck by the streaks of light once, and it was guaranteed that they would die immediately.
Thus, after comprehensive consideration, it was best to go to one of the moons to hide.

Ling Han unleashed his full speed. At close to 40 times the speed of sound, he was overwhelmingly fast. If it was not for the protection of the Starlight Screen, it was guaranteed that the large black dog would have been torn into pieces at any moment.
On the way, Ling Han saw another warship being destroyed, and a great many people chose to fly towards a certain moon just like him.
It wasn’t that they didn’t directly land on Golden Wealth Planet, but they were basically sliced into pieces by the sweeping light.
That should be saber light.

Ling Han deduced. Previously, the warship he had been on had been destroyed. He sensed that light at a very close distance, and it was filled with the domineering nature of a saber, causing him to deduce that it was an elite wielding a saber on Golden Wealth Planet that had moved, sniping the expeditionary troops like them.
In fact, this elite was on the level of Sect Master.
That was because there were Spirit Transformation True Lords in the army, but they were completely unable to resist that saber light. They could just barely protect themselves.

In just a few moves, nine of the 12 warships were destroyed, and the elites were killed. Two successfully retreated, while one circled to the other side of Golden Wealth Planet, and it was possible that they could land safely.
The problem was, could it be the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire’s troops that were waiting for them on the ground?

According to the intelligence that had been sent back previously, the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire had already occupied half of Golden Wealth Planet’s territory in a flash. However, a month had already passed, so would there be any changes? Could it be that the entire Golden Wealth Planet had already fallen into the hands of the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire?
Of course, it was already meaningless to talk about this now.

Golden Wealth Planet was very big, and Golden Wealth Planet’s moon was also very big. Thus, there were clearly a great many people that were heading towards the moon that Ling Han had aimed for, but when they landed on the ground, they were very far away.

This was a moon, lacking vitality. Greenery could not be seen anywhere. However, this place was not completely devoid of life. Some rocks were very damp, and dark red moss grew here, showing a strong vitality.
Without air, gravity was extremely weak. One only had to exert a little force to jump, and his whole person would be able to soar high.

“Let’s find a place to hide first. After the first wave of attack from the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire, the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire will definitely send out an army to search for us who have slipped through their net,” Ling Han said.
“Sigh, Little Han, you’re definitely a jinx. Just take a look, we haven’t even reached our destination yet, and we were almost shot through,” the large black dog grumbled.
The pervert pig nodded repeatedly, his expression filled with resentment. He had been forcefully dragged here, b@stard.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “If I don’t experience the storms, how can I see the rainbow? Don’t worry, it’s fine. I’m here!”
His eyes swept over the surroundings, “Where should we go?”
He activated his eye technique and saw a mountain in the distance.
“Let’s go.”
He grabbed the large black dog and the perverted pig, and flew on his divine tool, heading
towards that mountain.
Half an hour later, he arrived at the foot of the mountain.
This was really a large mountain, but it was mostly bare rocks. Some of them even shone with
a metallic luster.
“Who knows, we may be able to gain something here,” Ling Han said.

“It would be best if I can find a piece of Origin Gold. Grandpa Dog also wants to forge an Imperial Weapon that belongs to me.” The large black dog was filled with greed. Ling Han smiled, “Your exclusive Imperial Weapon, is it a pair of Origin Gold underpants?” “Woof, don’t tease Grandpa Dog about this,” the large black dog said in frustration. The perverted pig bared his mouth in a grin, not giving him any face at all. He was so infuriated that the large black dog pounced over and bit him. However, though the perverted pig was weak in battle, his defense was invincible. No matter how the large black dog bit him, he was still unscathed. He continued to grin and laugh at the large black dog.
“Let’s go and take a look.”

Ling Han ascended the mountain, planning to look around. He had the Void Beast hide, which could hide him very well. Unless it was an existence on the level of Spirit Transformation True Lord, it would be impossible to see through his disguise.
“Little Han, there are pursuers coming,” the large black dog suddenly said. He pointed in the direction of Golden Wealth Planet.
Dozens of small dots were rapidly approaching. Upon a closer look, weren’t they warships? However, compared to the warships that Ling Han had boarded, these were clearly much
smaller.
These warships rapidly left Golden Wealth Planet, then dispersed, going to the four different moons. Each moon had ten warships, which landed in different locations.

One of the ships was at the foot of the mountain. The hatch opened, and groups of soldiers walked out. There were ten of them in a group, and they spread out in all directions. Ling Han had long since wrapped himself, the large black dog, and the perverted pig in the Void Beast’s hide. He stood by the roadside, watching a small team pass by.
He could clearly see that there were nine Foundation Building Tier cultivators in this team,

and the remaining person was a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator. As a search team, this setup was also quite powerful. If they encountered danger, they only had to send out a signal, and he was sure that powerful reinforcements would soon arrive.

Ling Han did not make a move. Though he could have destroyed this team in an instant, it would naturally not be difficult for them to guess that the culprit was nearby, since a team had lost contact with base so quickly.
He looked at the warship, and a thought involuntarily flashed through his mind. Could he
steal this thing?
Worse come to worst, he could steer this warship back to the Moonlight Planet.
